`il2cpp_dump.py`:

```py
"""il2cpp_dump.py - Unity-(IL2CPP)-Spiele: Ausgabe von Il2CppDumper lesen und im laufenden Spiel benutzen.

Das ist das Gegenstueck zu uesdk.py/ue_live.py fuer Unreal.  Keine Oberflaeche, kein Netzwerk-Code: alles
bekommt read/write-Funktionen uebergeben und ist deshalb ohne Konsole testbar.

Eingabe ist ein Spiel-Ordner mit der Ausgabe von Il2CppDumper (Fork TetzkatLipHoka):
    dump.cs          Klassen, Felder (mit Offsets), Methoden (mit RVA), Enums           <- wichtig
    script.json      Methodennamen mit Adresse + TypeInfo-Zeiger der Klassen             <- fuer Live-Zugriff
    DummyDll/        (optional) dieselben Daten als .NET-DLLs fuer dnSpy/ILSpy - wird hier nicht gebraucht
Die Ordner duerfen verschachtelt liegen (z. B. entpackte ZIPs): find_game_files() sucht darin.

  GameDump         geladen: .classes, .methods, .typeinfo_rva; Suche, Zahlen-Felder, Enum-Namen
  find_module_base Basisadresse des IL2CPP-Moduls im laufenden Spiel (per Klassennamen-Pruefung, nicht raten)
  Il2CppLive       Instanzen einer Klasse im Heap finden, statische Felder lesen
  patch_*          Bytes fuer einfache Methoden-Patches (Rueckgabewert festlegen / Methode leer machen)
"""

import json
import os
import re
import struct
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Typen: IL2CPP/C#-Typname -> Name, den ue_quick.Target kennt
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
PRIMS = {
    "bool": "bool", "byte": "uint8", "sbyte": "int8", "char": "uint16",
    "short": "int16", "ushort": "uint16", "int": "int32", "uint": "uint32",
    "long": "int64", "ulong": "uint64", "float": "float", "double": "double",
    "int8": "int8", "uint8": "uint8", "int16": "int16", "uint16": "uint16",
    "int32": "int32", "uint32": "uint32", "int64": "int64", "uint64": "uint64",
    "intptr": "uint64", "uintptr": "uint64",
}
# Wert-Groesse in Bytes (fuer Enum-Felder: Standard int32)
SIZES = {"bool": 1, "uint8": 1, "int8": 1, "int16": 2, "uint16": 2, "int32": 4, "uint32": 4,
         "int64": 8, "uint64": 8, "float": 4, "double": 8}


def _split_name(full):
    """'Namespace.Outer.Inner' laesst sich nicht sicher trennen - dump.cs liefert Namespace getrennt."""
    return full


@dataclass
class Field:
    name: str
    type: str
    offset: int          # -1: statisch/Konstante ohne Instanz-Offset
    static: bool = False
    const_value: str = None

    @property
    def prim(self):
        return PRIMS.get(self.type)


@dataclass
class Method:
    name: str
    ret: str
    params: str
    rva: int
    static: bool
    cls: "Class" = None

    @property
    def sig(self):
        return f"{self.ret} {self.name}({self.params})"

    @property
    def key(self):
        return f"{self.cls.full if self.cls else '?'}.{self.name}"

    @property
    def n_params(self):
        p = self.params.strip()
        if not p:
            return 0
        depth, n = 0, 1
        for ch in p:
            if ch in "<[(":
                depth += 1
            elif ch in ">])":
                depth -= 1
            elif ch == "," and depth == 0:
                n += 1
        return n


@dataclass
class Class:
    namespace: str
    name: str            # inkl. Aussen-Klassen: 'UIMoneyHeld.CounterAnimInfo'
    kind: str            # class | struct | enum | interface
    base: str = ""
    typedef: int = -1
    fields: list = field(default_factory=list)
    methods: list = field(default_factory=list)
    image: str = ""
    enum_values: list = field(default_factory=list)   # [(Name, Wert)]
    enum_underlying: str = "int32"

    @property
    def full(self):
        return f"{self.namespace}.{self.name}" if self.namespace else self.name

    def find_field(self, name):
        for f in self.fields:
            if f.name == name:
                return f
        return None


class DumpError(Exception):
    pass


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Spiel-Ordner finden
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def find_game_files(folder, max_depth=4):
    """Sucht dump.cs, script.json, stringliteral.json, DummyDll und Il2CppDumper.exe in einem (verschachtelten) Ordner.
    -> dict mit Pfaden oder None.  Nimmt den ersten (flachsten) Treffer."""
    want = {"dump_cs": "dump.cs", "script": "script.json", "strings": "stringliteral.json"}
    found = {k: None for k in list(want) + ["dummydll", "dumper"]}
    base_depth = os.path.normpath(folder).count(os.sep)
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(folder):
        if root.count(os.sep) - base_depth >= max_depth:
            dirs[:] = []
        low = {f.lower(): f for f in files}
        for key, fn in want.items():
            if found[key] is None and fn in low:
                found[key] = os.path.join(root, low[fn])
        if found["dumper"] is None and "il2cppdumper.exe" in low:
            found["dumper"] = os.path.join(root, low["il2cppdumper.exe"])
        for d in list(dirs):
            if d.lower() == "dummydll" and found["dummydll"] is None:
                found["dummydll"] = os.path.join(root, d)
        # DummyDll ohne eigenen Unterordner: viele .dll mit Assembly-CSharp.dll
        if found["dummydll"] is None and "assembly-csharp.dll" in low:
            found["dummydll"] = root
    return found


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# dump.cs lesen
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
_RE_NS = re.compile(r"^// Namespace: (.*)$")
_RE_IMG_FULL = re.compile(r"^// Image \d+: (.+?) - (\d+)$")
_RE_TYPE = re.compile(
    r"^(?:\[[^\]]*\]\s*)*(?:(?:public|private|protected|internal|sealed|abstract|static|unsafe|partial|readonly|new)\s+)*"
    r"(class|struct|enum|interface)\s+(\S+?)(?:\s*:\s*(.+?))?\s*(?://\s*TypeDefIndex:\s*(\d+))?\s*$"
)
_RE_RVA = re.compile(r"^\s*// RVA: 0x([0-9A-Fa-f]+) Offset: 0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+ VA: 0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+")
_RE_FIELD = re.compile(r"^\t(?:(?:public|private|protected|internal|static|readonly|const|volatile|new)\s+)+(.+?)\s+(\S+?)(?:\s*=\s*(.+?))?;(?:\s*//\s*(0x[0-9A-Fa-f]+))?\s*$")
_RE_METHOD = re.compile(r"^\t((?:(?:public|private|protected|internal|static|virtual|override|abstract|sealed|extern|new|unsafe)\s+)*)(.+?)\s+([^\s(]+)\((.*)\)\s*\{")


def _norm_type(t):
    t = t.strip()
    if t.startswith("ref "):
        t = t[4:]
    return t


def parse_dump_cs(path, log=None):
    """dump.cs -> [Class].  Zeilenweise (die Datei ist leicht 50+ MB gross)."""
    classes = []
    images = []
    ns = ""
    cur = None
    pending_rva = None
    in_enum = False
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
        for raw in fh:
            line = raw.rstrip("\r\n")
            if not line:
                continue
            c0 = line[0]
            if c0 == "/":                                  # Kommentarzeilen auf oberster Ebene
                m = _RE_IMG_FULL.match(line)
                if m:
                    images.append((int(m.group(2)), m.group(1)))
                    continue
                m = _RE_NS.match(line)
                if m:
                    ns = m.group(1).strip()
                continue
            if c0 not in "\t{} ":
                if line.startswith("["):                   # Attribut vor einem Typ
                    continue
                m = _RE_TYPE.match(line)
                if m:
                    kind, name, base, td = m.groups()
                    cur = Class(ns, name, kind, (base or "").strip(), int(td) if td else -1)
                    classes.append(cur)
                    in_enum = kind == "enum"
                    pending_rva = None
                continue
            if cur is None or c0 != "\t":
                continue
            if line.startswith("\t//"):
                m = _RE_RVA.match(line)
                if m:
                    pending_rva = int(m.group(1), 16)
                continue
            if line.startswith("\t["):
                continue
            if "(" in line and line.rstrip().endswith("}") and pending_rva is not None:
                m = _RE_METHOD.match(line)
                if m:
                    mods, ret, name, params = m.groups()
                    cur.methods.append(Method(name, _norm_type(ret), params.strip(), pending_rva, "static" in mods.split(), cur))
                pending_rva = None
                continue
            m = _RE_FIELD.match(line)
            if m:
                ftype, fname, const, off = m.groups()
                is_static = bool(re.match(r"^\t(?:\w+\s+)*static\s", line))
                is_const = bool(re.match(r"^\t(?:\w+\s+)*const\s", line))
                if in_enum and fname != "value__":
                    try:
                        cur.enum_values.append((fname, int(const, 0) if const else 0))
                    except ValueError:
                        pass
                    continue
                if fname == "value__":
                    cur.enum_underlying = PRIMS.get(ftype.strip(), "int32")
                    continue
                cur.fields.append(Field(fname, _norm_type(ftype), int(off, 16) if off and not is_const else -1,
                                        is_static or is_const, const if is_const else None))
    images.sort()
    starts = [a for a, _n in images]
    import bisect
    for c in classes:
        if c.typedef >= 0 and images:
            c.image = images[max(0, bisect.bisect_right(starts, c.typedef) - 1)][1]
    if log:
        log(f"dump.cs: {len(classes)} Klassen")
    return classes


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# script.json: TypeInfo-Zeiger (RVA des Zeigers auf Il2CppClass)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
_RE_TI = re.compile(r'"Address":\s*(\d+),\s*"Name":\s*"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*?)_TypeInfo",\s*"Signature":\s*"Il2CppClass\*|'
                    r'"Address":\s*(\d+),\s*"Name":\s*"((?:[^"\\]|\\.)*?)_TypeInfo",\s*"Signature":\s*"[A-Za-z0-9_]+_c\*"')


def _unescape(s):
    s = s.replace("\\\\u003C", "<").replace("\\\\u003E", ">").replace("\\u003C", "<").replace("\\u003E", ">")
    return s.replace("\\\\", "\\")


def parse_typeinfo(script_path):
    """script.json -> {Klassenname (mit Namespace): RVA des TypeInfo-Zeigers}.  Per Regex ueber den Text:
    die Datei ist >100 MB, json.load wuerde mehr als 1 GB RAM brauchen."""
    out = {}
    with open(script_path, encoding="utf-8", errors="replace") as fh:
        text = fh.read()
    for m in _RE_TI.finditer(text):
        addr = m.group(1) or m.group(3)
        name = m.group(2) if m.group(1) else m.group(4)
        out.setdefault(_unescape(name), int(addr))
    return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Anzeige: Compiler-Kram ausblenden, Backing-Fields lesbar machen
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
_RE_BACKING = re.compile(r"^<(.+)>k__BackingField$")


def clean_field_name(name):
    """'<Reputation>k__BackingField' -> 'Reputation' (Property); sonst unveraendert."""
    m = _RE_BACKING.match(name)
    return m.group(1) if m else name


def is_generated(cls, fld=None):
    """Vom Compiler erzeugt (Lambda-/Closure-Klassen, Iterator-Zustandsautomaten, Hilfsfelder) - fuer Cheats uninteressant."""
    last = cls.name.rsplit(".", 1)[-1]
    if last.startswith("<") or "__DisplayClass" in last:
        return True
    return fld is not None and fld.name.startswith("<") and not _RE_BACKING.match(fld.name)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Das geladene Spiel
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
class GameDump:
    def __init__(self, files, log=print):
        self.files = files
        self.log = log
        self.classes = []
        self.by_full = {}
        self.typeinfo_rva = {}
        self.title = ""
        self._methods = None

    def load(self):
        if not self.files.get("dump_cs"):
            hint = ""
            if self.files.get("dummydll"):
                hint = (" Es gibt zwar einen DummyDll-Ordner, aber die Felder-Offsets und Methoden-Adressen stehen in "
                        "dump.cs - Il2CppDumper schreibt beide zusammen; bitte dump.cs mit in den Ordner legen.")
            raise DumpError("dump.cs nicht gefunden." + hint)
        self.classes = parse_dump_cs(self.files["dump_cs"], self.log)
        self.by_full = {}
        for c in self.classes:
            self.by_full.setdefault(c.full, c)
        if self.files.get("script"):
            try:
                self.typeinfo_rva = parse_typeinfo(self.files["script"])
                self.log(f"script.json: {len(self.typeinfo_rva)} Klassen-Zeiger")
            except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
                self.log(f"script.json nicht lesbar: {e}")
        else:
            self.log("script.json fehlt: Methoden-Patches gehen, aber keine Live-Instanzen (TypeInfo-Zeiger fehlen)")
        asm = [c for c in self.classes if c.image.startswith("Assembly-CSharp.dll")]
        self.title = os.path.basename(os.path.dirname(self.files["dump_cs"])) or "Unity-Spiel"
        self.log(f"{len(self.classes)} Klassen, {len(asm)} davon im Spiel-Code (Assembly-CSharp)")
        return self

    # --- Suche -------------------------------------------------------------
    def find_class(self, name):
        if name in self.by_full:
            return self.by_full[name]
        low = name.lower()
        for c in self.classes:
            if c.name.lower() == low or c.full.lower() == low:
                return c
        return None

    def typeinfo_for(self, cls):
        return self.typeinfo_rva.get(cls.full)

    def _build_tree(self):
        by_name = {}
        for c in self.classes:
            by_name.setdefault(c.name, c)
        self._parent, self._children = {}, {}
        for c in self.classes:
            b = (c.base or "").split(",")[0].strip()
            if not b or c.kind != "class":
                continue
            b = b.split("<")[0].strip()
            par = self.by_full.get(b) or self.by_full.get(f"{c.namespace}.{b}" if c.namespace else b) or by_name.get(b)
            if par is not None and par is not c:
                self._parent[c.full] = par
                self._children.setdefault(par.full, []).append(c)

    def parent_of(self, cls):
        if not hasattr(self, "_parent"):
            self._build_tree()
        return self._parent.get(cls.full)

    def family(self, cls, cap=64):
        """Klasse + alle Unterklassen (breit zuerst, max. cap).  Geerbte Felder liegen im Dump nur bei der Basisklasse,
        die Objekte im Speicher tragen aber den Zeiger der Unterklasse."""
        if not hasattr(self, "_parent"):
            self._build_tree()
        out, queue = [cls], [cls]
        while queue and len(out) < cap:
            for ch in self._children.get(queue.pop(0).full, []):
                if ch not in out:
                    out.append(ch)
                    queue.append(ch)
        return out[:cap]

    def value_targets(self, only_game_code=False):
        """Alle Zahlen-/Bool-/Enum-Felder mit Instanz-Offset -> [(Class, Field, prim, size)].
        Enum-Felder gelten als Ganzzahl.  Statische Felder stehen in static_targets()."""
        out = []
        enums = {c.full: c for c in self.classes if c.kind == "enum"}
        enum_short = {c.name: c for c in self.classes if c.kind == "enum"}
        for c in self.classes:
            if c.kind == "enum" or c.kind == "interface":
                continue
            if only_game_code and not c.image.startswith("Assembly-CSharp"):
                continue
            for f in c.fields:
                if f.static or f.offset < 0:
                    continue
                prim = f.prim
                if prim is None:
                    e = enums.get(f.type) or enum_short.get(f.type)
                    if e is None:
                        continue
                    prim = e.enum_underlying
                out.append((c, f, prim, SIZES.get(prim, 4)))
        return out

    def static_targets(self):
        out = []
        for c in self.classes:
            if c.kind in ("enum", "interface"):
                continue
            for f in c.fields:
                if f.static and f.const_value is None and f.prim:
                    out.append((c, f))
        return out

    def all_methods(self):
        if self._methods is None:
            self._methods = [m for c in self.classes for m in c.methods]
        return self._methods

    def search_methods(self, text, limit=3000):
        q = text.lower().strip()
        if not q:
            return []
        parts = q.split()
        out = []
        for m in self.all_methods():
            hay = f"{m.key} {m.params}".lower()
            if all(p in hay for p in parts):
                out.append(m)
                if len(out) >= limit:
                    break
        return out

    def enum_search(self, text, limit=3000):
        """Enum-Eintraege nach Namen suchen: 'Item Apple' -> [(Enum, Name, Wert)]."""
        parts = text.lower().split()
        out = []
        for c in self.classes:
            if c.kind != "enum":
                continue
            for n, v in c.enum_values:
                hay = f"{c.name} {n}".lower()
                if all(p in hay for p in parts):
                    out.append((c, n, v))
                    if len(out) >= limit:
                        return out
        return out


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Live: Modul-Basis und Instanzen
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Il2CppClass (64 Bit): image @0x0, gc_desc @0x8, name @0x10, namespace @0x18 - seit Unity 5 unveraendert.
K_NAME, K_NAMESPACE = 0x10, 0x18
K_STATIC_FIELDS = 0xB8        # Unity 2018.3 ... 6; per Ui-Feld aenderbar


def _cstr(read, addr, n=96):
    try:
        raw = read(addr, n)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return None
    z = raw.find(b"\0")
    return raw[: z if z >= 0 else n].decode("utf-8", "replace")


class SafeReader:
    """read() mit lokaler Pruefung gegen die Speicherkarte (jede gemappte Region zaehlt, auch ohne Lese-Bit): Adressen ausserhalb lesbarer Regionen werden gar nicht erst an
    die Konsole geschickt.  Ein fehlgeschlagener Read kostet dort Sekunden (Wiederholung + Warten) - bei hunderten
    Kandidaten-Adressen wuerde die Modulsuche sonst minutenlang haengen."""

    def __init__(self, read, maps):
        self._read = read
        regs = sorted((m[0], m[1]) for m in maps)          # jede gemappte Region: Code ist auf der PS5 oft nur ausfuehrbar
        merged = []
        for s, e in regs:
            if merged and s <= merged[-1][1]:
                merged[-1][1] = max(merged[-1][1], e)
            else:
                merged.append([s, e])
        self.regions = merged
        self._starts = [r[0] for r in merged]

    def readable(self, addr, n=1):
        import bisect
        i = bisect.bisect_right(self._starts, addr) - 1
        return i >= 0 and addr + n <= self.regions[i][1]

    def __call__(self, addr, n):
        if addr < 0 or not self.readable(addr, n):
            raise OSError(f"{addr:#x} nicht lesbar (nicht in der Speicherkarte)")
        return self._read(addr, n)


def _safe(read, maps):
    return read if isinstance(read, SafeReader) else SafeReader(read, maps)


def _slots(game):
    """[(rva, Klassenname)] fuer normale Klassen (keine Generics/Verschachtelten), nach RVA sortiert."""
    out = []
    for c in game.classes:
        rva = game.typeinfo_for(c)
        if rva and c.kind != "interface" and "<" not in c.name and "`" not in c.name and "." not in c.name:
            out.append((rva, c.name, c.namespace))
    out.sort()
    return out


def check_base(read, base, game, samples=12, maps=None):
    """Stimmt base als Modul-Basis?  Die ganze TypeInfo-Tabelle auf einmal lesen, die befuellten Eintraege (IL2CPP
    fuellt sie erst beim ersten Benutzen einer Klasse) gegen Klassennamen im Speicher pruefen.
    -> (Treffer, geprueft).  Mit maps: Adressen ausserhalb der Speicherkarte kosten nichts."""
    if maps is not None:
        read = _safe(read, maps)
    slots = getattr(game, "_slot_cache", None)
    if slots is None:
        slots = game._slot_cache = _slots(game)
    if not slots:
        return 0, 0
    lo, hi = slots[0][0], slots[-1][0] + 8
    try:
        if hi - lo > 0x2000000:                      # unplausibel gross -> nur Stichproben
            raise ValueError
        blob = bytearray()
        pos = base + lo
        while pos < base + hi:
            n = min(0x40000, base + hi - pos)
            blob += read(pos, n)
            pos += n
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return 0, 0
    ok = tried = 0
    for rva, name, ns in slots:
        off = rva - lo
        ptr = struct.unpack_from("<Q", blob, off)[0]
        if ptr < 0x10000:
            continue                                  # noch nicht initialisiert
        tried += 1
        try:
            nptr = struct.unpack("<Q", read(ptr + K_NAME, 8))[0]
            got = _cstr(read, nptr)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            got = None
        if got == name:
            ok += 1
            if ok >= samples:
                break
        elif tried >= samples * 4 and ok == 0:
            break
    return ok, tried


def _good(ok, tried):
    """Genug Namenstreffer?  Mind. 4, oder (kleine Spiele/frueher Start) mindestens einer und die Haelfte der befuellten Slots."""
    return ok >= 4 or (ok >= 1 and ok * 2 >= tried)


def candidate_bases(maps):
    """Moegliche Modul-Anfaenge: Beginn jeder lesbaren Region (Module liegen oft ohne Luecke hintereinander, deshalb
    reichen Gruppen-Anfaenge nicht).  Ausfuehrbare Regionen zuerst - dort beginnt ein Modul mit seinem Code."""
    regs = sorted({(m[0], m[2]) for m in maps})
    return [s for s, p in regs if p & 4] + [s for s, p in regs if not p & 4]


def named_modules(maps):
    """maps mit Modulnamen (4. Eintrag) -> [(Name, Basis, Ende)], Basis = niedrigste Region des Moduls (so wie il2mem.py).
    IL2CPP-Module zuerst, dann eboot, dann der Rest."""
    mods = {}
    for m in maps:
        if len(m) > 3 and m[3]:
            b, e = mods.get(m[3], (m[0], m[1]))
            mods[m[3]] = (min(b, m[0]), max(e, m[1]))
    def rank(n):
        low = n.lower()
        return (0 if "il2cpp" in low else 1 if low.startswith("eboot") else 2, n)
    return [(n, mods[n][0], mods[n][1]) for n in sorted(mods, key=rank)]


def diagnose(read, base, game, maps, name=""):
    """Textbericht fuer die Fehlersuche: Ist die TypeInfo-Tabelle lesbar, wie viele Slots sind befuellt, was steht drin?"""
    sread = _safe(read, maps)
    slots = getattr(game, "_slot_cache", None) or _slots(game)
    out = [f"Diagnose {name or 'Modul'} @ {base:#x}: {len(slots)} Klassen-Slots erwartet ab RVA {slots[0][0]:#x}"]
    try:
        blob = sread(base + slots[0][0], slots[-1][0] + 8 - slots[0][0])
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
        return out + [f"  Tabelle nicht lesbar: {e}"]
    filled = [(r, n, struct.unpack_from("<Q", blob, r - slots[0][0])[0]) for r, n, _ns in slots]
    filled = [x for x in filled if x[2]]
    out.append(f"  davon befuellt: {len(filled)} (der Rest wird von IL2CPP erst beim ersten Benutzen gesetzt)")
    for r, n, ptr in filled[:3]:
        try:
            got = _cstr(sread, struct.unpack("<Q", sread(ptr + K_NAME, 8))[0])
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            got = f"<{e}>"
        out.append(f"  RVA {r:#x}: erwartet {n!r}, Zeiger {ptr:#x}, im Speicher gelesen {got!r}")
    if not filled:
        out.append("  Alle Slots leer: Spiel noch nicht weit genug gestartet, oder Basis falsch.")
    return out


def find_module_base(read, maps, game, log=print, cancel=None):
    """Basisadresse des IL2CPP-Moduls (PS5: meist Il2CppUserAssemblies.prx, sonst eboot) finden.
    Stufe 1: jede Region als Modul-Anfang pruefen (Klassennamen). Stufe 2: ueber Klassenzeiger im Speicher rueckwaerts."""
    if not game.typeinfo_rva:
        raise DumpError("script.json fehlt oder enthaelt keine TypeInfo-Zeiger - Modul-Basis nicht pruefbar")
    sread = _safe(read, maps)
    cands = candidate_bases(maps)
    slots = getattr(game, "_slot_cache", None) or _slots(game)
    game._slot_cache = slots
    lo = slots[0][0] if slots else 0
    best = (0, None)
    named_first = None
    mods = named_modules(maps)
    if mods:
        log(f"Module im Spiel: " + ", ".join(f"{n} @ {b:#x}" for n, b, _e in mods[:8]) + (" ..." if len(mods) > 8 else ""))
    for n, b, _e in mods:
        if cancel and cancel():
            break
        if not sread.readable(b + lo, 8):
            continue
        ok, t = check_base(sread, b, game, maps=maps)
        if _good(ok, t):
            log(f"IL2CPP-Modul {n} bei {b:#x} ({ok} Klassennamen bestaetigt)")
            return b
        if named_first is None and "il2cpp" in n.lower():
            named_first = (n, b)
    log(f"Pruefe {len(cands)} Speicherregionen auf das IL2CPP-Modul ...")
    for i, base in enumerate(cands):
        if cancel and cancel():
            break
        if not sread.readable(base + lo, 8):
            continue
        ok, _t = check_base(sread, base, game, maps=maps)
        if ok > best[0] and _good(ok, _t):
            best = (ok, base)
        if ok >= 4:
            log(f"IL2CPP-Modul bei {base:#x} ({ok} Klassennamen bestaetigt)")
            return base
        if i and i % 100 == 0:
            log(f"... {i}/{len(cands)} Regionen geprueft")
    if best[0] >= 1:
        log(f"IL2CPP-Modul bei {best[1]:#x} ({best[0]} Klassennamen bestaetigt)")
        return best[1]
    log("Tabelle nicht direkt gefunden - suche ueber Klassen im Speicher (dauert laenger) ...")
    base = _find_base_by_pointer(sread, maps, game, slots, log, cancel)
    if base:
        return base
    if named_first:
        for line in diagnose(read, named_first[1], game, maps, named_first[0]):
            log(line)
    raise DumpError("Kein Modul passt zu den Klassennamen aus dump.cs. Stimmen Spiel-Version und Dump (derselbe Build)? "
                    "Ist das Spiel schon im Menue/Spielstand geladen? Notfalls die Basis von Hand eintragen.")


def _find_base_by_pointer(sread, maps, game, slots, log, cancel):
    """Klasse per Name im Speicher finden -> Zeiger darauf suchen (liegt im TypeInfo-Slot) -> Basis = Fundort - RVA."""
    live = Il2CppLive(sread, game, 0, maps, log=log)
    tried = 0
    rw = live.heap_regions()
    for rva, name, ns in slots[::max(1, len(slots) // 40)]:
        if cancel and cancel():
            return None
        c = game.by_full.get(f"{ns}.{name}" if ns else name)
        if c is None:
            continue
        kp = live.resolve_by_name(c, cancel=cancel)
        if not kp:
            continue
        tried += 1
        for h in live._scan(struct.pack("<Q", kp), rw, limit=16, align=8, cancel=cancel):
            base = h - rva
            ok, _t = check_base(sread, base, game, maps=maps)
            if _good(ok, _t):
                log(f"IL2CPP-Modul bei {base:#x} ueber {name} gefunden ({ok} Klassennamen bestaetigt)")
                return base
        if tried >= 6:
            break
    return None


class Il2CppLive:
    """Zugriff auf das laufende Spiel: Klassenzeiger, Instanzen, statische Felder."""

    def __init__(self, read, game, base, maps, static_off=K_STATIC_FIELDS, log=print):
        self.read, self.game, self.base, self.maps = _safe(read, maps), game, base, maps
        self.static_off = static_off
        self.log = log
        self._klass = {}
        self._kstarts = []
        self.objects = None         # nach census(): {Klasse: [Objekt-Adressen]} - macht instances() sofort
        self.counts = {}            # nach census(): {Klasse: Anzahl}
        self.known = set()          # Klassen, deren Zeiger beim census bekannt waren
        self.last_source = ""
        self._raw = read._read if isinstance(read, SafeReader) else read

    def set_maps(self, maps):
        """Neue Speicherkarte (nach Levelwechsel o. ae.) - Klassenzeiger bleiben gueltig, Heap-Regionen aendern sich."""
        self.maps = maps
        self.read = SafeReader(self._raw, maps)

    def klass_ptr(self, cls, by_name=True, cancel=None):
        """Zeiger auf die Il2CppClass im Spiel.  Erst ueber den TypeInfo-Zeiger aus script.json; hat die Klasse keinen
        (Il2CppDumper listet nur Klassen, auf die der Code direkt zeigt), dann ueber ihren Namen im Speicher.
        None = nicht gefunden (Klasse im Spiel noch nie benutzt)."""
        if cls.full in self._klass and (self._klass[cls.full] or not by_name):
            return self._klass[cls.full]
        rva = self.game.typeinfo_for(cls)
        val = None
        if rva:
            try:
                p = struct.unpack("<Q", self.read(self.base + rva, 8))[0]
                if p > 0x10000:
                    val = p
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
        if val is None and by_name and "." not in cls.name:
            val = self.resolve_by_name(cls, cancel=cancel)
        self._klass[cls.full] = val
        return val

    def _scan(self, needle, regions, limit=16, align=1, chunk=0x400000, cancel=None, stop_after=None):
        hits = []
        for s, e in regions:
            pos = s
            while pos < e and len(hits) < limit:
                if cancel and cancel():
                    return hits
                n = min(chunk + len(needle), e - pos)
                try:
                    buf = self.read(pos, n)
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    pos += chunk
                    continue
                i = buf.find(needle)
                while i >= 0 and len(hits) < limit:
                    if (pos + i) % align == 0:
                        hits.append(pos + i)
                    i = buf.find(needle, i + 1)
                pos += chunk
            if len(hits) >= limit or (stop_after and len(hits) >= stop_after):
                break
        return hits

    def resolve_by_name(self, cls, cancel=None):
        """Il2CppClass ueber Namen finden: Name-String suchen -> Zeiger darauf bei klass+0x10 suchen -> Namespace und
        element_class (zeigt auf sich selbst) pruefen."""
        name = cls.name.encode()
        readable = [(m[0], m[1]) for m in self.maps if (m[2] & 1) and (m[1] - m[0]) >= 0x1000]
        strs = [h + 1 for h in self._scan(b"\0" + name + b"\0", readable, limit=8, cancel=cancel)]
        if not strs:
            return None
        rw = self.heap_regions()
        for sa in strs:
            for h in self._scan(struct.pack("<Q", sa), rw, limit=32, align=8, cancel=cancel):
                k = h - K_NAME
                try:
                    nsp = struct.unpack("<Q", self.read(k + K_NAMESPACE, 8))[0]
                    ns = _cstr(self.read, nsp) if nsp > 0x10000 else ""
                    elem = struct.unpack("<Q", self.read(k + 0x40, 8))[0]
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    continue
                if (ns or "") == cls.namespace and elem == k:
                    return k
        return None

    def drop_cache(self):
        self._klass.clear()

    MODULE_SUFFIXES = (".prx", ".sprx", ".bin", ".elf", ".self")

    def heap_regions(self):
        """Lesbar+schreibbar, nicht ausfuehrbar und - wenn die Speicherkarte Namen hat - nicht Teil eines Moduls (.prx,
        eboot.bin: Code/Daten/BSS, dort liegen keine verwalteten Objekte).  Das spart bei der Suche viel Lesezeit."""
        out = []
        for m in self.maps:
            if (m[2] & 3) != 3 or (m[2] & 4) or (m[1] - m[0]) < 0x1000:
                continue
            if len(m) > 3 and m[3] and m[3].lower().endswith(self.MODULE_SUFFIXES):
                continue
            out.append((m[0], m[1]))
        return out

    def _in_class_struct(self, addr, extra=()):
        """Liegt addr in einer bekannten Il2CppClass-Struktur?  (castClass/element_class zeigen dort auf die Klasse selbst
        und waeren sonst Scheinobjekte.)"""
        import bisect
        ks = self._kstarts
        i = bisect.bisect_right(ks, addr) - 1
        if i >= 0 and addr < ks[i] + 0x400:
            return True
        return any(k <= addr < k + 0x400 for k in extra)

    def klass_table(self):
        """{Klassenzeiger: Class} fuer alle Klassen, deren TypeInfo-Slot schon befuellt ist (ein Block-Read)."""
        slots = getattr(self.game, "_slot_cache", None) or _slots(self.game)
        self.game._slot_cache = slots
        if not slots:
            return {}
        lo, hi = slots[0][0], slots[-1][0] + 8
        blob = bytearray()
        pos = self.base + lo
        while pos < self.base + hi:
            n = min(0x40000, self.base + hi - pos)
            blob += self.read(pos, n)
            pos += n
        out = {}
        for rva, name, ns in slots:
            ptr = struct.unpack_from("<Q", blob, rva - lo)[0]
            c = self.game.by_full.get(f"{ns}.{name}" if ns else name)
            if ptr > 0x10000 and c is not None:
                out[ptr] = c
        self._kstarts = sorted(out)
        return out

    def census(self, progress=None, cancel=None, chunk=0x400000):
        """Ein Durchlauf ueber den schreibbaren Speicher: wie viele Objekte gibt es von jeder Klasse?
        -> ({Klassenname: Anzahl}, {Klassenname, die schon initialisiert sind}).  Objekt = Klassenzeiger an Offset 0 und
        leeres Monitor-Feld an Offset 8 (schliesst Zeiger in Klassen-Strukturen aus)."""
        from collections import Counter
        table = self.klass_table()
        kset = set(table)
        counts = Counter()
        objs = {}
        keep = 2000                       # pro Klasse max. so viele Adressen merken (Zaehler bleibt exakt)
        regs = self.heap_regions()
        total = sum(e - s for s, e in regs) or 1
        done = 0
        for s, e in regs:
            pos = s
            while pos < e:
                if cancel and cancel():
                    return dict(counts), {c.full for c in table.values()}     # abgebrochen: kein Cache
                n = min(chunk, e - pos) // 8 * 8
                if n <= 0:
                    break
                try:
                    buf = self.read(pos, n + 8 if pos + n + 8 <= e else n)
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    pos += n
                    done += n
                    continue
                mv = memoryview(buf)[: n].cast("Q")
                nxt = memoryview(buf).cast("Q") if len(buf) % 8 == 0 else mv
                hits = [i for i, w in enumerate(mv) if w in kset]
                for i in hits:
                    mon = nxt[i + 1] if i + 1 < len(nxt) else 0
                    if mon == 0 and not self._in_class_struct(pos + i * 8):
                        full = table[mv[i]].full
                        counts[full] += 1
                        lst = objs.setdefault(full, [])
                        if len(lst) < keep:
                            lst.append(pos + i * 8)
                pos += n
                done += n
                if progress:
                    progress(done, total)
        self.objects, self.counts = objs, dict(counts)
        self.known = {c.full for c in table.values()}
        return dict(counts), set(self.known)

    def _header_ok(self, addr, kps):
        """Ist an addr noch ein Objekt einer der Klassen (Klassenzeiger + leeres Monitor-Feld)?"""
        try:
            k, mon = struct.unpack("<QQ", self.read(addr, 16))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return False
        return k in kps and mon == 0

    def instances(self, cls, limit=400, chunk=0x800000, progress=None, use_cache=True, cancel=None):
        """Alle Objekte der Klasse (und ihrer Unterklassen): Klassenzeiger an Offset 0, Monitor-Feld an Offset 8 leer.
        Nach census() sofort aus dem Cache (jede Adresse wird kurz geprueft); sonst - oder mit use_cache=False - wird der
        schreibbare Speicher durchsucht und der Cache aktualisiert.  last_source sagt, was passiert ist."""
        if not self._kstarts:
            try:
                self.klass_table()
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
        fam = self.game.family(cls, cap=24)
        needles = {}                                   # Bytes -> Zeiger
        owner = {}                                     # Zeiger -> Klasse
        for c in fam:
            kp = self.klass_ptr(c, by_name=(c is cls))
            if kp:
                needles[struct.pack("<Q", kp)] = kp
                owner[kp] = c
        if not needles:
            self.last_source = "none"
            return []
        kps = set(needles.values())
        if use_cache and self.objects is not None and any(c.full in self.known for c in fam):
            cached = sorted(a for c in fam for a in self.objects.get(c.full, ()))
            out = []
            for a in cached:
                if len(out) >= limit:
                    break
                if self._header_ok(a, kps):
                    out.append(a)
                else:                                  # Objekt gibt es nicht mehr -> aus dem Cache nehmen
                    for c in fam:
                        lst = self.objects.get(c.full)
                        if lst and a in lst:
                            lst.remove(a)
            self.last_source = "cache"
            return out
        found, per = [], {kp: [] for kp in kps}
        regs = self.heap_regions()
        for ri, (s, e) in enumerate(regs):
            pos = s
            while pos < e and len(found) < limit:
                if cancel and cancel():
                    break
                n = min(chunk, e - pos)
                try:
                    buf = self.read(pos, min(n + 16, e - pos))
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    pos += n
                    continue
                for needle, kp in needles.items():
                    i = buf.find(needle, 0, n + 8)
                    while i >= 0 and len(found) < limit:
                        mon = buf[i + 8:i + 16]
                        if i < n and i % 8 == 0 and not self._in_class_struct(pos + i, tuple(kps)) and (len(mon) < 8 or mon == b"\0" * 8):
                            found.append(pos + i)
                            per[kp].append(pos + i)
                        i = buf.find(needle, i + 1, n + 8)
                pos += n
            if progress:
                progress(ri + 1, len(regs))
            if len(found) >= limit:
                break
        if self.objects is not None and len(found) < limit:
            for kp, lst in per.items():
                self.objects[owner[kp].full] = lst              # vollstaendiger Lauf: Cache dieser Klassen erneuern
                self.known.add(owner[kp].full)
        self.last_source = "scan"
        return sorted(found)

    def static_base(self, cls):
        """Adresse des Static-Fields-Blocks einer Klasse (statische Felder liegen dort bei ihren Offsets)."""
        kp = self.klass_ptr(cls)
        if not kp:
            return None
        try:
            p = struct.unpack("<Q", self.read(kp + self.static_off, 8))[0]
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return None
        return p if p > 0x10000 else None

    def method_addr(self, m):
        return self.base + m.rva


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Patch-Bytes (x86-64)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
def patch_return_int(value, wide=False):
    """mov eax, imm32 ; ret   (wide: mov rax, imm64).  Fuer bool/int/enum-Rueckgaben."""
    if wide:
        return b"\x48\xb8" + struct.pack("<Q", value & 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF) + b"\xc3"
    return b"\xb8" + struct.pack("<I", value & 0xFFFFFFFF) + b"\xc3"


def patch_return_float(value):
    """mov eax, bits ; movd xmm0, eax ; ret"""
    return b"\xb8" + struct.pack("<f", value) + b"\x66\x0f\x6e\xc0\xc3"


def patch_return_double(value):
    """mov rax, bits ; movq xmm0, rax ; ret"""
    return b"\x48\xb8" + struct.pack("<d", value) + b"\x66\x48\x0f\x6e\xc0\xc3"


def patch_ret():
    """ret  (void-Methode tut nichts)"""
    return b"\xc3"


def make_patch(method, mode, value=None):
    """Methode + Modus -> Patch-Bytes.
       mode: 'true' | 'false' | 'value' (Zahl) | 'noop' (Methode ueberspringen)
       Prueft, ob der Rueckgabetyp zu dem Modus passt - sonst ValueError mit verstaendlicher Meldung."""
    ret = method.ret
    prim = PRIMS.get(ret)
    if mode == "noop":
        if ret != "void":
            raise ValueError(f"'{method.name}' gibt {ret} zurueck - leer machen geht nur bei void (sonst Absturz). "
                             "Nimm 'Wert zurueckgeben'.")
        return patch_ret()
    if ret == "void":
        raise ValueError(f"'{method.name}' ist void und hat keinen Rueckgabewert - waehle 'Methode leer machen'.")
    if mode in ("true", "false"):
        if prim != "bool":
            raise ValueError(f"'{method.name}' gibt {ret} zurueck, nicht bool. Nimm 'Wert zurueckgeben'.")
        return patch_return_int(1 if mode == "true" else 0)
    if mode == "value":
        if prim is None:
            raise ValueError(f"Rueckgabetyp {ret} ist kein einfacher Zahlentyp (Objekt/Struct) - nicht patchbar.")
        if prim == "float":
            return patch_return_float(float(value))
        if prim == "double":
            return patch_return_double(float(value))
        if prim == "bool":
            return patch_return_int(1 if value else 0)
        v = int(value)
        return patch_return_int(v, wide=SIZES[prim] == 8)
    raise ValueError(f"unbekannter Modus {mode}")


def reapproj_for_patch(name, rva, original, new, author="", info=""):
    """Eintrag im ReaperPy-Projektformat (.reapproj): Offset = RVA im IL2CPP-Modul.
       ImageBase bleibt 0x0 - in ReaperPy die Image-Basis auf die IL2CPP-Modul-Basis stellen (Unity-Tab zeigt sie)."""
    sp = lambda b: " ".join(f"{x:02X}" for x in bytes(b))  # noqa: E731
    return {
        "name": name, "author": author, "Info": info, "ImageBase": "0x0",
        "Variables": [{"label": "OriginSource", "offset": hex(rva), "defaultValue": sp(original), "newValue": sp(new)}],
    }


def write_reapproj(folder, doc, fname=None):
    os.makedirs(folder, exist_ok=True)
    fname = fname or (re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]+", "_", doc["name"]).strip("_")[:80] + ".reapproj")
    path = os.path.join(folder, fname)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh:
        json.dump(doc, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        fh.write("\n")
    return path
```

`journal.py`:

```py
"""journal.py - Schreib-Journal: jede Speicher-Aenderung der Tools ist rueckgaengig machbar.

`WriteJournal.attach(client)` ersetzt client.write_memory durch eine Variante, die vorher die
alten Bytes liest.  Alles, was ueber diesen Client schreibt (Hex-Editor, Scanner, Patcher, Skripte,
Caller), landet im Journal; `undo()` schreibt die alten Bytes zurueck (neueste zuerst).
Nicht protokolliert: Schreibzugriffe > 64 KiB und Freeze-Ticks (write_multi).
"""
import threading
import time

MAX_ENTRIES = 3000
MAX_SIZE = 0x10000


class Entry:
    __slots__ = ("t", "addr", "old", "new", "source", "undone")

    def __init__(self, addr, old, new, source):
        self.t, self.addr, self.old, self.new = time.time(), addr, old, new
        self.source, self.undone = source, False

    def line(self):
        n = len(self.new)
        h = lambda b: b[:8].hex(" ").upper() + (" .." if len(b) > 8 else "")
        return (time.strftime("%H:%M:%S", time.localtime(self.t)), f"{self.addr:#x}", n,
                h(self.old), h(self.new), self.source)


class WriteJournal:
    def __init__(self):
        self.entries = []
        self.lock = threading.RLock()
        self.client = None
        self._orig = None
        self.source = "Tool"
        self.enabled = True

    def attach(self, client):
        if self.client is client:
            return
        self.detach()
        self.client, self._orig = client, client.write_memory
        orig = self._orig

        def journaled(address, data, *a, **k):
            data = bytes(data)
            old = None
            if self.enabled and 0 < len(data) <= MAX_SIZE:
                try:
                    old = bytes(client.read_memory(address, len(data)))
                except Exception:
                    old = None
            res = orig(address, data, *a, **k)
            if old is not None and old != data:
                with self.lock:
                    if not (self.entries and self.entries[-1].addr == address
                            and self.entries[-1].new == data):
                        self.entries.append(Entry(address, old, data, self.source))
                        del self.entries[:-MAX_ENTRIES]
            return res
        client.write_memory = journaled

    def detach(self):
        if self.client is not None and self._orig is not None:
            self.client.write_memory = self._orig
        self.client = self._orig = None

    def clear(self):
        with self.lock:
            self.entries.clear()

    def undo(self, entry):
        """Eine Aenderung zurueck.  Der Rueckschreib-Vorgang selbst wird nicht erneut protokolliert."""
        if entry.undone:
            return False
        self._orig(entry.addr, entry.old)
        entry.undone = True
        return True

    def undo_all(self, upto=None):
        """Alles (oder alles ab `upto` bis heute) rueckgaengig, neueste zuerst -> Anzahl."""
        n = 0
        with self.lock:
            todo = [e for e in reversed(self.entries) if not e.undone]
            if upto is not None:
                todo = todo[:todo.index(upto) + 1] if upto in todo else []
        for e in todo:
            if self.undo(e):
                n += 1
        return n

```

`klog_tab.py`:

```py
"""klog_tab.py - Kernel-Log der Konsole (ps5debug-NG: TCP 3232) mit Fehler-Hervorhebung.

Zeigt Abstuerze, Page-Faults und Fehler rot - hilft, wenn ein Patch/Cave das Spiel beendet.
Die Verbindung baut sich bei Abbruch selbst neu auf, solange START aktiv ist.
"""
import collections
import re
import socket
import threading
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog

from tools_common import (ACCENT, BG, BG_BAR, ERROR, FONT_LABEL, TEXT_DIM, WARN, BaseTab,
                          button, entry, label, textbox)

KLOG_PORT = 3232
ERR_RE = re.compile(r"(fault|panic|crash|sigsegv|sigill|sigbus|sigabrt|abort|fatal|exception|"
                    r"killed|trap|segmentation)", re.I)
WARN_RE = re.compile(r"(error|fail|warn|denied|invalid|unable|timeout)", re.I)
MAX_LINES = 50000
SHOW_LINES = 5000


def classify(line):
    if ERR_RE.search(line):
        return "err"
    if WARN_RE.search(line):
        return "warn"
    return ""


class KlogReader:
    """Liest /dev/klog-Stream in einem Thread; on_lines(list[str]) kommt aus diesem Thread."""

    def __init__(self, host, port=KLOG_PORT, on_lines=None, on_state=None):
        self.host, self.port = host, port
        self.on_lines = on_lines or (lambda ls: None)
        self.on_state = on_state or (lambda s: None)
        self._stop = threading.Event()
        self._thread = None
        self._sock = None

    def start(self):
        if self._thread and self._thread.is_alive():
            return
        self._stop.clear()
        self._thread = threading.Thread(target=self._run, daemon=True)
        self._thread.start()

    def stop(self):
        self._stop.set()
        s = self._sock
        if s:
            try:
                s.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def _run(self):
        while not self._stop.is_set():
            buf = b""
            try:
                self.on_state("verbinde ...")
                s = socket.create_connection((self.host, self.port), timeout=4)
                s.settimeout(1.0)
                self._sock = s
                self.on_state("verbunden")
                while not self._stop.is_set():
                    try:
                        data = s.recv(65536)
                    except socket.timeout:
                        continue
                    if not data:
                        break
                    buf += data
                    parts = buf.split(b"\n")
                    buf = parts.pop()
                    if parts:
                        self.on_lines([p.decode("utf-8", "replace").rstrip("\r") for p in parts])
                    if len(buf) > 1 << 20:               # Schutz gegen Endlos-Zeile
                        self.on_lines([buf.decode("utf-8", "replace")])
                        buf = b""
                try:
                    s.close()
                except Exception:
                    pass
                self.on_state("getrennt")
            except Exception as e:
                self.on_state(f"Fehler: {e}")
            for _ in range(20):                          # 2 s warten, aber abbrechbar
                if self._stop.is_set():
                    return
                time.sleep(0.1)


class KlogTab(BaseTab):
    def __init__(self, parent, win):
        super().__init__(parent, win)
        self.lines = collections.deque(maxlen=MAX_LINES)     # (text, tag)
        self.incoming = collections.deque()
        self.reader = None
        self.v_filter = tk.StringVar()
        self.v_err = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        self.v_scroll = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
        self.v_state = tk.StringVar(value="gestoppt")

        bar = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG)
        bar.pack(fill="x", padx=6, pady=6)
        self.btn = button(bar, "START", self.toggle, accent=True)
        self.btn.pack(side="left")
        button(bar, "LEEREN", self.clear).pack(side="left", padx=4)
        button(bar, "SPEICHERN…", self.save).pack(side="left")
        label(bar, "Filter").pack(side="left", padx=(14, 3))
        e = entry(bar, self.v_filter, width=24)
        e.pack(side="left")
        e.bind("<KeyRelease>", lambda _e: self._render())
        for txt, var, cmd in (("nur Fehler/Warnungen", self.v_err, self._render),
                              ("Autoscroll", self.v_scroll, None)):
            tk.Checkbutton(bar, text=txt, variable=var, command=cmd, bg=BG, fg=TEXT_DIM,
                           selectcolor=BG_BAR, activebackground=BG, activeforeground=ACCENT,
                           font=FONT_LABEL).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        tk.Label(bar, textvariable=self.v_state, bg=BG, fg=WARN, font=FONT_LABEL).pack(side="right")

        self.txt = textbox(self, height=20, width=100)
        self.txt.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=6, pady=(0, 6))
        self.txt.configure(state="disabled", undo=False)
        self.txt.tag_configure("err", foreground=ERROR)
        self.txt.tag_configure("warn", foreground=WARN)
        self.after(150, self._drain)

    # -- Steuerung -----------------------------------------------------
    def toggle(self):
        if self.reader:
            self.reader.stop()
            self.reader = None
            self.btn.configure(text="START")
            self.v_state.set("gestoppt")
            return
        host = self.win.app.backend.host
        self.reader = KlogReader(host, KLOG_PORT, self._on_lines,
                                 lambda s: self.win.ui(lambda: self.v_state.set(s)))
        self.reader.start()
        self.btn.configure(text="STOP")

    def shutdown(self):
        if self.reader:
            self.reader.stop()
            self.reader = None

    def _on_lines(self, lines):
        self.incoming.extend(lines)

    def clear(self):
        self.lines.clear()
        self._render()

    def save(self):
        path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(parent=self, defaultextension=".log",
                                            initialfile="klog.log", filetypes=[("Log", "*.log *.txt")])
        if path:
            with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write("\n".join(t for t, _ in self.lines) + "\n")
            self.log(f"klog gespeichert: {path}", "ok")

    # -- Anzeige ---------------------------------------------------------
    def _match(self, text, tag):
        if self.v_err.get() and not tag:
            return False
        f = self.v_filter.get().strip().lower()
        return not f or f in text.lower()

    def _drain(self):
        n = 0
        batch = []
        while self.incoming and n < 2000:
            t = self.incoming.popleft()
            tag = classify(t)
            self.lines.append((t, tag))
            if self._match(t, tag):
                batch.append((t, tag))
            n += 1
        if batch:
            self.txt.configure(state="normal")
            for t, tag in batch:
                self.txt.insert("end", t + "\n", tag or ())
            extra = int(self.txt.index("end-1c").split(".")[0]) - SHOW_LINES
            if extra > 0:
                self.txt.delete("1.0", f"{extra + 1}.0")
            if self.v_scroll.get():
                self.txt.see("end")
            self.txt.configure(state="disabled")
        try:
            if self.winfo_exists():
                self.after(150, self._drain)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _render(self):
        self.txt.configure(state="normal")
        self.txt.delete("1.0", "end")
        shown = [(t, g) for t, g in self.lines if self._match(t, g)][-SHOW_LINES:]
        for t, tag in shown:
            self.txt.insert("end", t + "\n", tag or ())
        if self.v_scroll.get():
            self.txt.see("end")
        self.txt.configure(state="disabled")

```

`library.py`:

```py
"""library.py – Spiele-Bibliothek: ordnet Icons und Patch-Dateien über die Spiel-ID zu.

Spiel-ID  = [A-Z]{4}\\d{5}  (PPSA01234, CUSA12345 ...), irgendwo im Datei- oder Ordnernamen.

Icons    : PPSA01234.png (exakt) hat Vorrang vor Dateien, die die ID nur irgendwo im Namen tragen
           (PPSA01234_icon0.jpg).  Gesucht wird im Bibliotheks-Ordner (bis 3 Ebenen tief).
Patches  : jede Patch-Datei (reapatch.is_patch_file) im Bibliotheks-Ordner, im Projekte-Ordner und in
           den bekannten Projekt-Ordnern.  Zuordnung per Dateiname, sonst per Ordnerpfad.
           Ohne ID wird nach Ordner gruppiert, damit nichts versteckt bleibt.
"""
import os
import re
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

from reapatch import is_patch_file

ID_RE = re.compile(r"(?<![A-Za-z])([A-Za-z]{4}\d{5})(?!\d)")
IMAGE_EXT = (".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg", ".webp", ".bmp", ".gif")
GENERIC_ICON_NAMES = ("icon0", "icon", "cover", "logo", "folder")
SKIP_DIRS = {".git", "__pycache__", "node_modules", "$recycle.bin"}
MAX_DEPTH = 3


def extract_id(*texts):
    """Erste Spiel-ID aus den Texten (in der Reihenfolge der Argumente); '' wenn keine."""
    for t in texts:
        if not t:
            continue
        m = ID_RE.search(str(t))
        if m:
            return m.group(1).upper()
    return ""


def clean_title(name, game_id=""):
    """'PPSA01234 - Super_Game (v1.02)' -> 'Super Game (v1.02)'."""
    base = os.path.splitext(name)[0] if os.path.splitext(name)[1].lower() in (
        IMAGE_EXT + (".reapproj", ".json", ".shnext", ".reapatch")) else name
    if game_id:
        base = re.sub(game_id, "", base, flags=re.I)
    base = re.sub(r"[_\.]+", " ", base)
    base = re.sub(r"\s*[-–]\s*", " - ", base).strip(" -")
    base = re.sub(r"\s{2,}", " ", base)
    return base or game_id


@dataclass
class GameEntry:
    id: str = ""
    title: str = ""
    icon: str = ""
    patches: list = field(default_factory=list)       # Pfade der Patch-Dateien
    project_dir: str = ""                              # Ordner, der die Patches enthält

    @property
    def key(self):
        return self.id or f"dir:{self.project_dir}"

    def matches(self, text):
        t = (text or "").strip().lower()
        return not t or t in self.title.lower() or t in self.id.lower()


def _walk(root, depth=MAX_DEPTH):
    """(ordner, [dateien]) bis `depth` Ebenen, ohne versteckte/Systemordner."""
    if not root or not os.path.isdir(root):
        return
    root = os.path.abspath(root)
    base_level = root.rstrip(os.sep).count(os.sep)
    for dirpath, dirnames, filenames in os.walk(root):
        level = dirpath.rstrip(os.sep).count(os.sep) - base_level
        dirnames[:] = [d for d in dirnames
                       if d.lower() not in SKIP_DIRS and not d.startswith(".")] if level < depth else []
        yield dirpath, filenames


class Library:
    def __init__(self, library_dir, projects_root="", extra_dirs=()):
        self.library_dir = library_dir or ""
        self.projects_root = projects_root or ""
        self.extra_dirs = [d for d in extra_dirs if d]
        self.entries = []

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _scan_icons(self):
        """id -> Pfad.  Exakter Name (PPSA01234.png) schlägt 'ID irgendwo im Namen'."""
        best = {}
        for dirpath, files in _walk(self.library_dir):
            for f in files:
                stem, ext = os.path.splitext(f)
                if ext.lower() not in IMAGE_EXT:
                    continue
                gid = extract_id(stem)
                if not gid:
                    continue
                prio = 0 if stem.upper() == gid else 1
                if gid not in best or prio < best[gid][0]:
                    best[gid] = (prio, os.path.join(dirpath, f))
        return {k: v[1] for k, v in best.items()}

    @staticmethod
    def _generic_icon(folder):
        """Fallback: icon0.png / cover.jpg ... direkt im Projekt-Ordner."""
        try:
            names = {n.lower(): n for n in os.listdir(folder)}
        except OSError:
            return ""
        for g in GENERIC_ICON_NAMES:
            for ext in IMAGE_EXT:
                if g + ext in names:
                    return os.path.join(folder, names[g + ext])
        return ""

    def scan(self):
        icons = self._scan_icons()
        roots, seen_roots = [], set()
        for r in [self.library_dir, self.projects_root] + self.extra_dirs:
            ar = os.path.abspath(r) if r else ""
            if ar and ar not in seen_roots and os.path.isdir(ar):
                seen_roots.add(ar)
                roots.append(ar)

        games = {}            # key -> GameEntry
        seen_files = set()
        for root in roots:
            for dirpath, files in _walk(root):
                for f in sorted(files):
                    if not is_patch_file(f):
                        continue
                    path = os.path.join(dirpath, f)
                    if path in seen_files:
                        continue
                    seen_files.add(path)
                    rel = os.path.relpath(dirpath, root)
                    parts = [] if rel == "." else rel.split(os.sep)
                    # Dateiname zuerst, dann Ordner von innen nach außen
                    gid = extract_id(f, *reversed(parts))
                    if gid:
                        src = f if extract_id(f) else next(
                            (p for p in reversed(parts) if extract_id(p)), f)
                        key = gid
                    elif parts:
                        src, key = parts[-1], f"dir:{dirpath}"
                    else:
                        src, key = f, f"file:{path}"
                    g = games.get(key)
                    if g is None:
                        g = games[key] = GameEntry(id=gid, title=clean_title(src, gid),
                                                   project_dir=dirpath)
                    g.patches.append(path)

        for gid, icon in icons.items():
            g = games.get(gid)
            if g is None:
                g = games[gid] = GameEntry(id=gid, title=gid)
            g.icon = icon
        for g in games.values():
            if not g.icon and g.project_dir:
                g.icon = self._generic_icon(g.project_dir)

        self.entries = sorted(games.values(), key=lambda g: (g.title.lower(), g.id))
        return self.entries

    def filter(self, text):
        return [g for g in self.entries if g.matches(text)]

```

`library_gui.py`:

```py
"""library_gui.py – Bibliotheks-Fenster: Spiele als Karten (Icon + Titel + ID + Patch-Anzahl).

Klick auf eine Karte öffnet das Projekt des Spiels im Hauptfenster.
"""
import os
import queue
import threading
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, filedialog, messagebox

import projects
from library import Library, GameEntry
from tools_common import (BG, BG_BAR, BG_CARD, BG_CARD_HVR, BORDER, BORDER_HVR, ACCENT, ACCENT_DIM,
                          TEXT, TEXT_DIM, WARN, ERROR, FONT_MONO, FONT_LABEL, FONT_HEAD, style_ttk)

try:
    from PIL import Image, ImageTk
    HAVE_PIL = True
except Exception:                       # Pillow fehlt -> Initialen-Fallback
    Image = ImageTk = None
    HAVE_PIL = False

ICON = 96
CARD_W = 200
FONT_NAME = ("Consolas", 10, "bold")
FONT_SUB = ("Consolas", 8)
_PALETTE = ("#12353a", "#2a2f55", "#3a2a4d", "#10403a", "#40302a", "#1f3a52", "#3d3a1c", "#2c4a2c")


def initials(entry):
    """Zwei Buchstaben für den Fallback-Icon: erste Buchstaben der ersten zwei Wörter."""
    words = [w for w in "".join(c if c.isalnum() else " " for c in entry.title).split() if w]
    if len(words) >= 2:
        return (words[0][0] + words[1][0]).upper()
    if words:
        return words[0][:2].upper()
    return (entry.id[:2] or "?").upper()


def load_icon_image(path):
    """PhotoImage (ICON x ICON) oder None.  Mit Pillow jedes Format; ohne Pillow nur PNG/GIF
    (ganzzahlig verkleinert) - sonst None -> Initialen."""
    try:
        if HAVE_PIL:
            im = Image.open(path).convert("RGBA")
            im.thumbnail((ICON, ICON), Image.LANCZOS)
            canvas = Image.new("RGBA", (ICON, ICON), BG_CARD)
            canvas.paste(im, ((ICON - im.width) // 2, (ICON - im.height) // 2), im)
            return ImageTk.PhotoImage(canvas)
        if path.lower().endswith((".png", ".gif")):
            img = tk.PhotoImage(file=path)
            f = max(1, max(img.width(), img.height()) // ICON)
            return img.subsample(f, f) if f > 1 else img
    except Exception:
        pass
    return None


class GameCard(tk.Frame):
    def __init__(self, parent, entry, on_click):
        super().__init__(parent, bg=BG_CARD, highlightthickness=1, highlightbackground=BORDER, bd=0,
                         cursor="hand2")
        self.entry = entry
        self._img = None
        self.cv = tk.Canvas(self, width=ICON, height=ICON, bg=BG_CARD, highlightthickness=0, bd=0)
        self.cv.pack(padx=12, pady=(12, 6))
        self._draw_icon()
        self.lbl_title = tk.Label(self, text=entry.title, bg=BG_CARD, fg=TEXT, font=FONT_NAME,
                                  wraplength=CARD_W - 28, justify="center")
        self.lbl_title.pack(padx=8)
        self.lbl_id = tk.Label(self, text=entry.id or "-", bg=BG_CARD, fg=ACCENT_DIM, font=FONT_SUB)
        self.lbl_id.pack()
        n = len(entry.patches)
        self.lbl_n = tk.Label(self, text=f"{n} Patch{'es' if n != 1 else ''}", bg=BG_CARD,
                              fg=TEXT_DIM if n else BORDER_HVR, font=FONT_SUB)
        self.lbl_n.pack(pady=(0, 12))
        self._kids = (self, self.cv, self.lbl_title, self.lbl_id, self.lbl_n)
        for w in self._kids:
            w.bind("<Button-1>", lambda _e: on_click(entry))
            w.bind("<Enter>", lambda _e: self._hover(True))
            w.bind("<Leave>", lambda _e: self._hover(False))

    def _draw_icon(self):
        self._img = load_icon_image(self.entry.icon) if self.entry.icon else None
        c = self.cv
        c.delete("all")
        if self._img is not None:
            c.create_image(ICON // 2, ICON // 2, image=self._img)
            return
        col = _PALETTE[sum(map(ord, self.entry.id or self.entry.title)) % len(_PALETTE)]
        c.create_rectangle(2, 2, ICON - 2, ICON - 2, fill=col, outline=BORDER_HVR)
        c.create_text(ICON // 2, ICON // 2, text=initials(self.entry), fill=ACCENT,
                      font=("Consolas", 28, "bold"))

    def _hover(self, on):
        bg = BG_CARD_HVR if on else BG_CARD
        for w in self._kids:
            w.configure(bg=bg)
        self.configure(highlightbackground=ACCENT_DIM if on else BORDER)


class LibraryWindow(tk.Toplevel):
    def __init__(self, app):
        super().__init__(app.root)
        self.app = app
        self.tr = app.tr
        self.title(f"REAPERPY  //  {self.tr.t('lib_title')}")
        self.configure(bg=BG)
        self.geometry("1000x700")
        self.minsize(560, 400)
        style_ttk(self)

        self.lib = None
        self.cards = []
        self._cols = 0
        self._q = queue.Queue()
        self._scanning = False

        head = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG_BAR)
        head.pack(fill="x")
        tk.Label(head, text=f"\u25b8  {self.tr.t('lib_title')}", bg=BG_BAR, fg=ACCENT,
                 font=FONT_HEAD).pack(side="left", padx=12, pady=8)
        self.lbl_count = tk.Label(head, text="", bg=BG_BAR, fg=TEXT_DIM, font=FONT_LABEL)
        self.lbl_count.pack(side="right", padx=12)

        bar = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG)
        bar.pack(fill="x", padx=12, pady=8)
        tk.Label(bar, text=self.tr.t("lib_search"), bg=BG, fg=TEXT_DIM, font=FONT_LABEL).pack(side="left")
        self.v_search = tk.StringVar()
        self.v_search.trace_add("write", lambda *_: self._render())
        tk.Entry(bar, textvariable=self.v_search, width=28, bg=BG_CARD, fg=TEXT, insertbackground=ACCENT,
                 relief="flat", font=FONT_MONO, highlightthickness=1, highlightbackground=BORDER,
                 highlightcolor=ACCENT_DIM).pack(side="left", padx=8)
        for key, cmd, acc in (("lib_rescan", self.rescan, True), ("lib_folder", self.pick_folder, False),
                              ("lib_add_patch", self.add_patch, False)):
            tk.Button(bar, text=self.tr.t(key), command=cmd, bg=BG_CARD, fg=ACCENT if acc else TEXT,
                      font=FONT_LABEL, relief="flat", bd=0, padx=12, pady=4, cursor="hand2",
                      activebackground=BG_CARD_HVR, activeforeground=ACCENT).pack(side="left", padx=3)

        wrap = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG)
        wrap.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8, pady=(0, 8))
        self.canvas = tk.Canvas(wrap, bg=BG, highlightthickness=0, bd=0)
        sb = ttk.Scrollbar(wrap, orient="vertical", command=self.canvas.yview, style="Vertical.TScrollbar")
        self.inner = tk.Frame(self.canvas, bg=BG)
        self.win_id = self.canvas.create_window((0, 0), window=self.inner, anchor="nw")
        self.inner.bind("<Configure>", lambda _e: self.canvas.configure(scrollregion=self.canvas.bbox("all")))
        self.canvas.bind("<Configure>", self._resized)
        self.canvas.configure(yscrollcommand=sb.set)
        self.canvas.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
        sb.pack(side="right", fill="y")
        self.bind_all("<MouseWheel>", self._wheel, add="+")

        self.lbl_empty = tk.Label(self.inner, text="", bg=BG, fg=TEXT_DIM, font=FONT_MONO, justify="center")

        self.after(100, self._poll)
        self.rescan()                                   # Auto-Scan beim Öffnen

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _library_dir(self):
        d = self.app.cfg.get("library_dir") or projects.DEFAULTS["library_dir"]
        try:
            os.makedirs(d, exist_ok=True)
        except OSError:
            pass
        return d

    def rescan(self):
        if self._scanning:
            return
        self._scanning = True
        self.lbl_count.configure(text=self.tr.t("lib_scanning"), fg=WARN)
        cfg = self.app.cfg
        lib = Library(self._library_dir(), cfg.get("projects_root", ""),
                      [k for k in cfg.get("projects", {})])

        def job():
            try:
                lib.scan()
                self._q.put(("done", lib))
            except Exception as e:
                self._q.put(("err", e))
        threading.Thread(target=job, daemon=True).start()

    def _poll(self):
        if not self.winfo_exists():
            return
        try:
            while True:
                kind, val = self._q.get_nowait()
                self._scanning = False
                if kind == "done":
                    self.lib = val
                    self._render()
                else:
                    self.lbl_count.configure(text=str(val), fg=ERROR)
        except queue.Empty:
            pass
        self.after(100, self._poll)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _render(self):
        if self.lib is None:
            return
        for c in self.cards:
            c.destroy()
        self.cards = []
        entries = self.lib.filter(self.v_search.get())
        self.lbl_count.configure(text=self.tr.t("lib_found", n=len(entries)), fg=TEXT_DIM)
        if not entries:
            self.lbl_empty.configure(text=self.tr.t("lib_empty", folder=self._library_dir()))
            self.lbl_empty.grid(row=0, column=0, pady=60, padx=20)
            return
        self.lbl_empty.grid_forget()
        for e in entries:
            self.cards.append(GameCard(self.inner, e, self.open_entry))
        self._grid(max(1, self.canvas.winfo_width() // (CARD_W + 16)) if self.canvas.winfo_width() > 1 else 4)

    def _grid(self, cols):
        for c in range(max(cols, self._cols)):
            self.inner.columnconfigure(c, weight=0, minsize=CARD_W if c < cols else 0)
        for i, card in enumerate(self.cards):
            card.grid(row=i // cols, column=i % cols, padx=8, pady=8, sticky="n")
        self._cols = cols

    def _resized(self, e):
        self.canvas.itemconfig(self.win_id, width=e.width)
        cols = max(1, e.width // (CARD_W + 16))
        if cols != self._cols and self.cards:
            self._grid(cols)

    def _wheel(self, e):
        try:
            if e.widget.winfo_toplevel() is not self:
                return
            self.canvas.yview_scroll(int(-1 * (e.delta / 120)) or (-1 if e.delta > 0 else 1), "units")
        except Exception:
            pass

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def open_entry(self, entry: GameEntry):
        if self.app.open_library_entry(entry):
            self.destroy()

    def pick_folder(self):
        d = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self, title=self.tr.t("lib_pick_dir"),
                                    initialdir=self._library_dir())
        if d:
            self.app.cfg["library_dir"] = d
            projects.save_config(self.app.cfg)
            self.rescan()

    def add_patch(self):
        fn = filedialog.askopenfilename(parent=self, title=self.tr.t("lib_pick_patch"))
        if not fn:
            return
        try:
            self.app.add_patch_from_file(fn)
        except Exception as e:
            return messagebox.showerror(self.tr.t("dlg_error"), str(e), parent=self)
        self.rescan()

    def destroy(self):
        try:
            self.unbind_all("<MouseWheel>")        # nur unser Binding wäre falsch -> Hauptfenster neu setzen
            self.app.root.bind_all("<MouseWheel>", self.app._wheel, add="+")
        except Exception:
            pass
        super().destroy()

```

`logger.py`:

```py
"""logger.py - Function-Logger: protokolliert jeden Aufruf einer Spiel-Funktion.

Die ersten >= 8 Byte der Funktion werden durch einen Sprung in eine Code-Cave ersetzt.  Die Cave
legt bei jedem Aufruf einen 128-Byte-Eintrag (Argument-Register, Rueckkehradresse, Stack-Argumente,
xmm0/xmm1) in einen Ringpuffer im Spiel-Speicher, fuehrt die verschobenen Original-Befehle aus und
springt zurueck.  Das Tool liest den Ringpuffer nur noch aus - das Spiel wird nie angehalten.

Idee (Funktionen per Code-Cave loggen) wie im Function-Logger von PS5Debug-studio (alfizari,
Apache-2.0); Stub, Ringpuffer-Layout und Session sind eigene Umsetzung.

Ringpuffer (Anfang des Datenblocks)
  +0x00  u32 Schreibindex (wird per `lock xadd` hochgezaehlt, mehrere Threads sind ok)
  +0x40  Eintrag[N], je 128 Byte, N = Zweierpotenz
Eintrag
  +0x00 seq   (= Index+1, ZULETZT geschrieben -> ein Eintrag ist nur gueltig, wenn seq stimmt)
  +0x08 rdi  +0x10 rsi  +0x18 rdx  +0x20 rcx  +0x28 r8  +0x30 r9
  +0x38 Rueckkehradresse   +0x40 rax   +0x48 rsp beim Eintritt
  +0x50 Stack-Arg 7  +0x58 Stack-Arg 8  +0x60 xmm0 (low64)  +0x68 xmm1 (low64)  +0x70 Thread (fs:0)
"""
import re
import struct
import time

REC = 128
HEADER = 0x40
FIELDS = ("rdi", "rsi", "rdx", "rcx", "r8", "r9", "ret", "rax", "rsp", "s7", "s8", "xmm0", "xmm1",
          "thread")


def stub_asm(data_addr, ring_entries=1024, thread=False):
    """Logging-Teil der Cave (Intel-Syntax, laeuft in Keystone und GNU as).  Erhaelt alle Register
    und Flags."""
    if ring_entries & (ring_entries - 1) or ring_entries < 2:
        raise ValueError("ring_entries muss eine Zweierpotenz sein")
    L = ["pushfq", "push rax", "push rdx", "sub rsp, 8",
         f"mov rdx, {data_addr:#x}",
         "mov eax, 1", "lock xadd dword ptr [rdx], eax", "mov dword ptr [rsp], eax",
         f"and eax, {ring_entries - 1:#x}", "shl eax, 7", f"lea rdx, [rdx + rax + {HEADER:#x}]",
         "mov qword ptr [rdx + 0x08], rdi", "mov qword ptr [rdx + 0x10], rsi",
         "mov qword ptr [rdx + 0x20], rcx", "mov qword ptr [rdx + 0x28], r8",
         "mov qword ptr [rdx + 0x30], r9",
         "mov rax, qword ptr [rsp + 8]", "mov qword ptr [rdx + 0x18], rax",      # rdx
         "mov rax, qword ptr [rsp + 0x10]", "mov qword ptr [rdx + 0x40], rax",   # rax
         "mov rax, qword ptr [rsp + 0x20]", "mov qword ptr [rdx + 0x38], rax",   # Rueckkehr
         "lea rax, [rsp + 0x20]", "mov qword ptr [rdx + 0x48], rax",
         "mov rax, qword ptr [rsp + 0x28]", "mov qword ptr [rdx + 0x50], rax",
         "mov rax, qword ptr [rsp + 0x30]", "mov qword ptr [rdx + 0x58], rax",
         "movq qword ptr [rdx + 0x60], xmm0", "movq qword ptr [rdx + 0x68], xmm1"]
    if thread:
        L += ["mov rax, qword ptr fs:[0]", "mov qword ptr [rdx + 0x70], rax"]
    L += ["mov eax, dword ptr [rsp]", "add eax, 1", "mov qword ptr [rdx], rax",   # seq zuletzt
          "add rsp, 8", "pop rdx", "pop rax", "popfq"]
    return L


def parse_record(raw):
    v = struct.unpack("<16Q", raw[:REC])
    d = {"seq": v[0]}
    d.update({n: v[i + 1] for i, n in enumerate(FIELDS)})
    return d


def collect(read, data_addr, ring_entries, last):
    """Neue Eintraege seit `last` (absoluter Index) holen.  read(addr, n) -> bytes.
    -> (eintraege, neuer_index, verloren)."""
    cur = struct.unpack("<I", read(data_addr, 4))[0]
    new = (cur - last) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    if new == 0 or new > 0x80000000:
        return [], last, 0
    lost = 0
    if new > ring_entries:
        lost = new - ring_entries
        last = (last + lost) & 0xFFFFFFFF
        new = ring_entries
    first = last & (ring_entries - 1)
    n1 = min(new, ring_entries - first)
    raw = read(data_addr + HEADER + first * REC, n1 * REC)
    if new > n1:
        raw += read(data_addr + HEADER, (new - n1) * REC)
    out, idx = [], last
    for i in range(new):
        rec = parse_record(raw[i * REC:(i + 1) * REC])
        if rec["seq"] != ((idx + 1) & 0xFFFFFFFF):
            break                          # Eintrag wird gerade geschrieben -> naechste Runde
        rec["index"] = idx
        out.append(rec)
        idx = (idx + 1) & 0xFFFFFFFF
    return out, idx, lost


class LoggerSession:
    def __init__(self, backend, hook_addr, ring_entries=1024, thread=False):
        self.b, self.hook, self.ring, self.thread = backend, hook_addr, ring_entries, thread
        self.data = self.cave = None
        self.original = b""
        self.last = 0
        self.lost = 0
        self.active = False

    def start(self, force=False):
        import asm_tools
        import patch_engine as pe
        b = self.b
        code = bytes(b.read(self.hook, 32) or b"")
        if len(code) < 16:
            raise RuntimeError(f"{self.hook:#x} nicht lesbar")
        if code[:1] == b"\xE9" and not force:
            raise RuntimeError("an der Adresse liegt schon ein JMP (anderer Hook?) - erst entfernen")
        info = asm_tools.build_cave_hook(code, self.hook, 8)
        size = info["size"]
        self.original = code[:size]
        size_total = HEADER + self.ring * REC
        self.data = b.alloc_mem(size_total)
        b.write(self.data, bytes(size_total))                     # Puffer sicher auf 0
        body = [ln.strip() for ln in info["cave"].splitlines()
                if ln.strip() and not ln.strip().startswith(";")]
        body = [re.sub(r"\bOriginReturn\b", f"{self.hook + size:#x}", ln) for ln in body]
        lines = stub_asm(self.data, self.ring, self.thread) + body
        self.cave = b.find_cave(self.hook, 0x400)
        lines = pe._resolve_rip_tokens(b, lines, self.cave, self.hook)
        cave_bytes = pe._extract_bytes(b.assemble("\n".join(lines) + "\n", self.cave))
        try:
            b.set_rwx(self.cave, 0x400)
        except Exception:
            pass
        b.write(self.cave, cave_bytes)
        if bytes(b.read(self.cave, len(cave_bytes)) or b"") != cave_bytes:
            raise RuntimeError("Cave-Write nicht verifiziert")
        hook = pe.build_hook(b, self.hook, self.cave, length=8)
        if size > 8:
            hook = hook + b"\x90" * (size - 8)
        b.write(self.hook, hook)
        time.sleep(0.1)
        self.last, self.lost, self.active = 0, 0, True
        return {"data": self.data, "cave": self.cave, "cave_size": len(cave_bytes), "stolen": size}

    def poll(self):
        recs, self.last, lost = collect(self.b.read, self.data, self.ring, self.last)
        self.lost += lost
        return recs

    def stop(self):
        """Original-Bytes zurueck.  Cave und Puffer bleiben liegen (ein Thread koennte noch drin
        sein) - sie sind harmlos."""
        if self.active:
            self.b.write(self.hook, self.original)
            self.active = False
```
