```py
class Versions(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_parse_and_compare(self):
        self.assertEqual(U.parse_version("v5.7.0"), ((5, 7, 0), 1, ""))
        self.assertEqual(U.parse_version("5.7"), ((5, 7, 0), 1, ""))
        self.assertEqual(U.parse_version("5.7.0-beta1"), ((5, 7, 0), 0, "beta1"))
        self.assertTrue(U.is_newer("5.8.0", "5.7.0"))
        self.assertTrue(U.is_newer("5.10.0", "5.9.9"))                           # numerisch, nicht als Text
        self.assertTrue(U.is_newer("5.7.0", "5.7.0-beta1"))
        self.assertFalse(U.is_newer("5.7.0-beta1", "5.7.0"))
        self.assertFalse(U.is_newer("5.7.0", "5.7.0"))
        for bad in ("", "abc", "x.y"):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                U.parse_version(bad)

        U.parse_version(version.__version__)

class Resp:
    def __init__(self, data): self.data = data
    def read(self, n=-1): return self.data[:n] if n >= 0 else self.data
    def __enter__(self): return self
    def __exit__(self, *a): return False


class Opener:
    def __init__(self, data): self.data, self.req = data, None
    def open(self, req, timeout=None): self.req = (req, timeout); return Resp(self.data)


class Fetch(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_fetch_json_validates_scheme_size_and_content(self):
        op = Opener(b'{"version": "5.8.0", "url": "https://x/dl"}')
        self.assertEqual(U.fetch_json("https://example.org/v.json", opener=op)["version"], "5.8.0")
        self.assertEqual(op.req[0].get_header("User-agent"), "ReaperPy-update-check")
        self.assertEqual(op.req[1], U.TIMEOUT)
        for url in ("http://example.org/v.json", "ftp://x/y", "file:///etc/passwd", "javascript:alert(1)", "example.org/v.json"):
            with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                U.fetch_json(url, opener=op)
        U.fetch_json("http://localhost:8000/v.json", opener=op)                  # lokal darf http
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            U.fetch_json("https://x/y", opener=Opener(b"x" * (U.MAX_BYTES + 5)))
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            U.fetch_json("https://x/y", opener=Opener(b"[1, 2]"))

    def test_check_results(self):
        ok = lambda d: (lambda url: d)  # noqa: E731
        self.assertEqual(U.check("", "5.7.0").status, "off")
        r = U.check("https://x", "5.7.0", ok({"version": "5.8.0", "url": "https://x/dl", "notes": "Neu: Hotkeys"}))
        self.assertEqual((r.status, r.remote, r.url, r.notes, r.local), ("newer", "5.8.0", "https://x/dl", "Neu: Hotkeys", "5.7.0"))
        self.assertEqual(U.check("https://x", "5.7.0", ok({"version": "5.7.0"})).status, "uptodate")
        self.assertEqual(U.check("https://x", "5.7.0", ok({"version": "5.6.9"})).status, "uptodate")

    def test_bad_data_and_errors_become_error_results_without_raising(self):
        def boom(url): raise OSError("Netz weg")
        r = U.check("https://x", "5.7.0", boom)
        self.assertEqual(r.status, "error")
        self.assertIn("Netz weg", r.error)
        self.assertEqual(U.check("https://x", "5.7.0", lambda u: {"nope": 1}).status, "error")
        self.assertEqual(U.check("https://x", "5.7.0", lambda u: {"version": "kaputt"}).status, "error")
        self.assertEqual(U.check("https://x", "5.7.0", lambda u: (_ for _ in ()).throw(RuntimeError("x"))).status, "error")

    def test_only_https_download_links_are_passed_on_and_notes_are_cut(self):
        r = U.check("https://x", "1.0", lambda u: {"version": "2.0", "url": "javascript:alert(1)", "notes": "n" * 900})
        self.assertEqual((r.status, r.url, len(r.notes)), ("newer", "", 500))
        r = U.check("https://x", "1.0", lambda u: {"version": "2.0", "url": "http://evil/dl"})
        self.assertEqual(r.url, "")                                              # auch kein unverschluesseltes http


class BuildFiles(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_version_info_is_valid_pyinstaller_syntax(self):
        calls = {}

        def rec(name):
            return lambda *a, **k: calls.setdefault(name, []).append((a, k)) or (name, a, k)
        env = {n: rec(n) for n in ("VSVersionInfo", "FixedFileInfo", "StringFileInfo", "StringTable", "StringStruct", "VarFileInfo", "VarStruct")}
        eval(buildtools.version_info_text("5.7.0").split("\n", 1)[1], env)
        ffi = calls["FixedFileInfo"][0][1]
        self.assertEqual((ffi["filevers"], ffi["prodvers"]), ((5, 7, 0, 0), (5, 7, 0, 0)))
        strings = {a[0]: a[1] for a, _k in calls["StringStruct"]}
        self.assertEqual((strings["FileVersion"], strings["ProductVersion"], strings["OriginalFilename"]), ("5.7.0.0", "5.7.0.0", "ReaperPy.exe"))
        self.assertEqual(buildtools.version_info_text("5.8.1-beta2").count("5.8.1.0"), 2)

    def test_spec_covers_modules_assets_icon_and_version(self):
        spec = rd("ReaperPy.spec")
        self.assertIn("glob.glob(os.path.join(ROOT, '*.py'))", spec)             # alle Module automatisch
        self.assertIn("'test_', 'build', 'icon_art'", spec)
        self.assertIn("'assets'", spec)
        self.assertIn("reaperpy.ico", spec)
        self.assertIn("version_info.txt", spec)
        self.assertIn("collect_all(pkg)", spec)
        self.assertIn("console=False", spec)
        self.assertIn("exclude_binaries=True", spec)                              # Ordner-Version
        self.assertTrue(os.path.isfile(os.path.join(ROOT, "assets", "reaperpy.ico")))

    def test_every_dynamically_imported_tab_module_is_a_project_file(self):
        """tools_gui laedt Tabs per __import__(name): jedes dieser Module muss als .py im Projekt liegen (die Spec nimmt alle mit)."""
        src = rd("tools_gui.py")
        mods = set(re.findall(r'\("(tools_\w+|klog_tab|script_tab)", "\w+Tab"', src)) | set(re.findall(r"from (tools_\w+|klog_tab|script_tab) import", src))
        self.assertGreaterEqual(len(mods), 8)
        for m in mods:
            self.assertTrue(os.path.isfile(os.path.join(ROOT, m + ".py")), m)

    def test_batch_files_use_the_spec_and_keep_windows_line_endings(self):
        with open(os.path.join(ROOT, "build_exe.bat"), "rb") as f:
            raw = f.read()
        bat = raw.decode("utf-8")
        self.assertNotIn(b"\n", raw.replace(b"\r\n", b""))                        # ueberall CRLF
        for needle in ("buildtools.py", "PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean ReaperPy.spec", "Compress-Archive", "version.__version__"):
            self.assertIn(needle, bat)
        self.assertNotIn("--hidden-import", bat)                                  # eine Quelle der Wahrheit: die Spec
        with open(os.path.join(ROOT, "ReaperPy.spec"), "rb") as f:
            self.assertNotIn(b"\n", f.read().replace(b"\r\n", b""))

    def test_no_stellar_blade_modules_left_for_the_build(self):
        for f in os.listdir(ROOT):
            if f.endswith(".py"):
                self.assertFalse(f.startswith("sb_") or f == "tools_sb_gui.py", f)


class StartButtonAndHandler(unittest.TestCase):
    def make_start(self, url):
        import tools_start_gui as S
        logs = []
        app = types.SimpleNamespace(backend=types.SimpleNamespace(client=None, pid=None), current_project=None, patches={}, gp=None,
                                    cfg={"update_url": url}, root=None)
        win = types.SimpleNamespace(app=app, log=lambda m, k="info": logs.append((k, m)), ui=lambda fn: fn())
        t = S.StartTab(None, win)
        t.bg = lambda job, ok=None, err=None: ok(job())
        return t, logs

    def test_no_url_gives_a_hint(self):
        t, logs = self.make_start("")
        t.check_updates()
        self.assertEqual(logs[-1][0], "info")
        self.assertIn("update_url", logs[-1][1])

    def test_results_are_reported_and_download_needs_confirmation(self):
        import tools_start_gui as S
        t, logs = self.make_start("https://x/v.json")
        opened, asked = [], []
        old_ask = S.messagebox.askyesno
        self.addCleanup(setattr, S.messagebox, "askyesno", old_ask)           # Fake-Dialogmodul wird von allen Tests geteilt
        S.messagebox.askyesno = lambda *a, **k: asked.append(a) or True
        import webbrowser
        old = webbrowser.open
        webbrowser.open = opened.append
        try:
            orig = U.check
            U.check = lambda url, cur, fetch=None: U.Result("newer", cur, "9.9.9", "https://x/dl", "Hotkeys")
            t.check_updates()
            self.assertIn("Neue Version 9.9.9", logs[-1][1])
            self.assertIn("Hotkeys", logs[-1][1])
            self.assertEqual(opened, ["https://x/dl"])
            self.assertEqual(len(asked), 1)
            S.messagebox.askyesno = lambda *a, **k: False
            opened.clear()
            t.check_updates()
            self.assertEqual(opened, [])                                           # ohne Zustimmung wird nichts geoeffnet
            U.check = lambda url, cur, fetch=None: U.Result("uptodate", cur, cur)
            t.check_updates()
            self.assertEqual(logs[-1][0], "ok")
            U.check = lambda url, cur, fetch=None: U.Result("error", cur, error="OSError: weg")
            t.check_updates()
            self.assertEqual(logs[-1][0], "err")
        finally:
            U.check = orig
            webbrowser.open = old

    def test_main_window_logs_only_when_newer(self):
        import gui
        from i18n import Translator
        app = object.__new__(gui.App)
        app.tr = Translator("en")
        out = []
        app.log_msg = lambda m, tag=None: out.append((tag, m))
        app._on_update(U.Result("uptodate", "5.7.0", "5.7.0"))
        app._on_update(U.Result("error", "5.7.0", error="x"))
        app._on_update(U.Result("off"))
        self.assertEqual(out, [])
        app._on_update(U.Result("newer", "5.7.0", "5.8.0", "https://x/dl"))
        self.assertEqual(out, [("accent", "[update] New version 5.8.0 available (installed: 5.7.0) - download: https://x/dl")])

    def test_async_check_is_off_without_url_or_when_disabled(self):
        import gui
        app = object.__new__(gui.App)
        started = []
        orig = gui.threading.Thread
        gui.threading.Thread = lambda **k: started.append(k) or types.SimpleNamespace(start=lambda: None)
        try:
            app.cfg = {}
            app._update_check_async()
            app.cfg = {"update_url": "https://x/v.json", "auto_update_check": False}
            app._update_check_async()
            self.assertEqual(started, [])
            app.cfg = {"update_url": "https://x/v.json"}
            app._update_check_async()
            self.assertEqual(len(started), 1)
        finally:
            gui.threading.Thread = orig
```

`tests/test_cave_trainer.py`:

```py
"""Tests fuer cave_trainer (statische Item-Cave als ReaperPy-Projekt).

Die Cave wird hier WIRKLICH ausgefuehrt (Linux x86-64, mmap + ctypes):  ein Treiber ruft sie wie das Spiel das
ProcessEvent (mit magischen Werten in den callee-saved Registern), eine Hilfsfunktion (Item-Funktion) und ein
Hilfs-ProcessEvent schreiben ihre Register in Puffer.  Alles liegt in EINEM mmap-Bereich, damit die rel32-Spruenge
reichen.  Zusaetzlich wird die Cave mit objdump zerlegt.  Ohne gcc/binutils/Linux/x86-64 werden diese Tests
uebersprungen; die Plan-/Projekt-Tests laufen ueberall.
"""
import ctypes
import json
import mmap
import os
import platform
import re
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import threading
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
import cave_trainer as T

NATIVE = (platform.system() == "Linux" and platform.machine() in ("x86_64", "AMD64")
          and all(shutil.which(x) for x in ("as", "ld", "objcopy", "objdump")))

# Layout im mmap-Bereich
HELP_OFF = 0x0000       # Hilfscode (rec_fn @0, rec_pe @0x100, driver @0x200)
LOG_OFF = 0x0800        # logcnt (8 Byte) + logbuf (48 Byte je Aufruf)
PE_BUF = 0x0F00         # rec_pe schreibt: rdi, rsi, rdx, rsp
DRV_BUF = 0x0F80        # Treiber schreibt: rbx, rbp, r12..r15 nach dem Aufruf, rax
CAVE_OFF = 0x1000
FLAG_OFF = 0x3000
SIZE = 0x4000

HELPERS = r"""
.intel_syntax noprefix
.text
.org 0x0
rec_fn:
  mov rax, [rip+logcnt]
  lea r10, [rip+logbuf]
  imul r11, rax, 48
  add r10, r11
  mov [r10], rdi
  mov [r10+8], rsi
  mov [r10+16], rdx
  mov [r10+24], rcx
  mov [r10+32], r8
  mov [r10+40], rsp
  inc rax
  mov [rip+logcnt], rax
  mov eax, 0x1234
  ret
.org 0x100
rec_pe:
  lea rax, [rip+pebuf]
  mov [rax], rdi
  mov [rax+8], rsi
  mov [rax+16], rdx
  mov [rax+24], rsp
  mov eax, 77
  ret
.org 0x200
driver:
  push rbx
  push rbp
  push r12
  push r13
  push r14
  push r15
  sub rsp, 8
  mov rbx, 0xB1B1B1B1
  mov rbp, 0xB2B2B2B2
  mov r12, 0xC1C1C1C1
  mov r13, 0xC2C2C2C2
  mov r14, 0xC3C3C3C3
  mov r15, 0xC4C4C4C4
  call CAVE
  lea r10, [rip+drvbuf]
  mov [r10], rbx
  mov [r10+8], rbp
  mov [r10+16], r12
  mov [r10+24], r13
  mov [r10+32], r14
  mov [r10+40], r15
  mov [r10+48], rax
  add rsp, 8
  pop r15
  pop r14
  pop r13
  pop r12
  pop rbp
  pop rbx
  ret
.org 0x800
logcnt: .quad 0
logbuf: .space 0x6F8
.org 0xF00
pebuf: .space 0x40
.org 0xF80
drvbuf: .space 0x40
"""


def make_options():
    return [
        T.Option("Gold", [T.Row("Item_Gold", bytes.fromhex("0102030405060708"), 99999)]),
        T.Option("Traenke", [T.Row("Item_PotionA", bytes.fromhex("1111111111111111"), 10),
                             T.Row("Item_PotionB", bytes.fromhex("2222222222222222"), 7)]),
        T.Option("Material", [T.Row("Item_Mat", bytes.fromhex("3333333333333333"), 0xFFFFFFFF)]),
    ]


def build_helpers(tmp, cave_abs_off):
    src = os.path.join(tmp, "h.s")
    with open(src, "w") as f:
        f.write(HELPERS.replace("call CAVE", f"call {cave_abs_off}"))
    obj, elf, binf = (os.path.join(tmp, n) for n in ("h.o", "h.elf", "h.bin"))
    subprocess.run(["as", "--64", "-o", obj, src], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["ld", "-Ttext=0", "-e", "0", "-o", elf, obj], check=True)
    subprocess.run(["objcopy", "-O", "binary", "-j", ".text", elf, binf], check=True)
    with open(binf, "rb") as f:
        return f.read()


@unittest.skipUnless(NATIVE, "braucht Linux x86-64, as, ld, objcopy")
class NativeCave(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.mm = mmap.mmap(-1, SIZE, prot=mmap.PROT_READ | mmap.PROT_WRITE | mmap.PROT_EXEC)
        self.base = ctypes.addressof(ctypes.c_char.from_buffer(self.mm))
        self.tmp = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        self.options = make_options()
        # 'call' im Treiber ist rel32 auf die absolute Cave-Adresse: Hilfscode wird mit Basis 0 gebaut und liegt bei
        # mmap+0, also ist CAVE_OFF das richtige Ziel (Position-unabhaengig)
        help_bin = build_helpers(self.tmp, CAVE_OFF)
        self.mm[HELP_OFF:HELP_OFF + len(help_bin)] = help_bin
        self.cave = self.base + CAVE_OFF
        code = T.build_cave(self.cave, self.base + FLAG_OFF, self.base + 0x100, self.base + 0x000, self.options)
        self.mm[CAVE_OFF:CAVE_OFF + len(code)] = code
        self.code = code
        self.driver = ctypes.CFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_uint64, ctypes.c_uint64, ctypes.c_uint64, ctypes.c_uint64)(
            self.base + 0x200)

    def tearDown(self):
        del self.driver
        try:
            self.mm.close()
        except BufferError:
            pass
        shutil.rmtree(self.tmp, ignore_errors=True)

    # -- Helfer ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_flag(self, i, v=1):
        self.mm[FLAG_OFF + i] = v

    def flag(self, i):
        return self.mm[FLAG_OFF + i]

    def calls(self):
        n = struct.unpack("<Q", self.mm[LOG_OFF:LOG_OFF + 8])[0]
        out = []
        for k in range(n):
            o = LOG_OFF + 8 + 48 * k
            out.append(struct.unpack("<6Q", self.mm[o:o + 48]))
        return out

    def pe_seen(self):
        return struct.unpack("<4Q", self.mm[PE_BUF:PE_BUF + 32])

    def drv_seen(self):
        return struct.unpack("<7Q", self.mm[DRV_BUF:DRV_BUF + 56])

    def fname(self, row):
        return struct.unpack("<Q", row.fname)[0]

    # -- Tests ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def test_idle_forwards_untouched(self):
        rax = self.driver(0x1111, 0x2222, 0x3333)
        self.assertEqual(rax, 77)                                       # Rueckgabe des ECHTEN ProcessEvent
        rdi, rsi, rdx, rsp = self.pe_seen()
        self.assertEqual((rdi, rsi, rdx), (0x1111, 0x2222, 0x3333))
        self.assertEqual(rsp % 16, 8)                                   # ABI: Eintritt rsp = 8 (mod 16)
        self.assertEqual(self.calls(), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.drv_seen()[:6], (0xB1B1B1B1, 0xB2B2B2B2, 0xC1C1C1C1, 0xC2C2C2C2, 0xC3C3C3C3, 0xC4C4C4C4))

    def test_flag_fires_once_with_exact_registers(self):
        self.set_flag(0)
        rax = self.driver(0x1111, 0x2222, 0x3333)
        self.assertEqual(rax, 77)
        gold = self.options[0].rows[0]
        calls = self.calls()
        self.assertEqual(len(calls), 1)
        rdi, rsi, rdx, rcx, r8, rsp = calls[0]
        self.assertEqual((rdi, rsi, rdx, rcx, r8), (0, self.fname(gold), 99999, 1, 0))
        self.assertEqual(rsp % 16, 8)                                   # Stack am call richtig ausgerichtet
        self.assertEqual(self.flag(0), 0)                               # Schalter zurueckgesetzt
        rdi, rsi, rdx, _ = self.pe_seen()                               # Originalargumente danach unveraendert
        self.assertEqual((rdi, rsi, rdx), (0x1111, 0x2222, 0x3333))
        # callee-saved Register (rbx, rbp, r12-r15) sind nach dem Durchlauf unveraendert
        self.assertEqual(self.drv_seen()[:6], (0xB1B1B1B1, 0xB2B2B2B2, 0xC1C1C1C1, 0xC2C2C2C2, 0xC3C3C3C3, 0xC4C4C4C4))
        # zweiter Aufruf: nichts mehr
        self.driver(1, 2, 3)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls()), 1)

    def test_multi_row_option_runs_rows_in_order(self):
        self.set_flag(1)
        self.driver(5, 6, 7)
        rows = self.options[1].rows
        got = [(c[1], c[2], c[3], c[4]) for c in self.calls()]
        self.assertEqual(got, [(self.fname(r), r.amount, 1, 0) for r in rows])

    def test_amount_uses_full_32_bits(self):
        self.set_flag(2)
        self.driver(1, 2, 3)
        self.assertEqual(self.calls()[0][2], 0xFFFFFFFF)

    def test_several_flags_run_in_option_order(self):
        self.set_flag(2)
        self.set_flag(0)
        self.driver(1, 2, 3)
        names = [c[1] for c in self.calls()]
        self.assertEqual(names, [self.fname(self.options[0].rows[0]), self.fname(self.options[2].rows[0])])
        self.assertEqual((self.flag(0), self.flag(1), self.flag(2)), (0, 0, 0))

    def test_unused_flag_byte_does_nothing_and_still_forwards(self):
        self.set_flag(5)                                                # gehoert zu keinem Eintrag
        rax = self.driver(0xA, 0xB, 0xC)
        self.assertEqual(rax, 77)
        self.assertEqual(self.calls(), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.pe_seen()[:3], (0xA, 0xB, 0xC))

    def test_flag_value_other_than_one_also_fires(self):
        self.set_flag(0, 0x80)
        self.driver(1, 2, 3)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.calls()), 1)

    def test_two_threads_only_one_gives(self):
        for _ in range(300):
            ctypes.memset(self.base + LOG_OFF, 0, 8)
            self.set_flag(0)
            bar = threading.Barrier(2)

            def run():
                bar.wait()
                for _k in range(3):
                    self.driver(1, 2, 3)

            ts = [threading.Thread(target=run) for _ in range(2)]
            for t in ts:
                t.start()
            for t in ts:
                t.join()
            self.assertEqual(len(self.calls()), 1)

    def test_more_than_eight_options(self):
        opts = [T.Option(f"E{i}", [T.Row(f"A{i}", struct.pack("<Q", 0x100 + i), i + 1)]) for i in range(20)]
        code = T.build_cave(self.cave, self.base + FLAG_OFF, self.base + 0x100, self.base + 0x000, opts)
        self.assertLess(len(code), FLAG_OFF - CAVE_OFF)
        self.mm[CAVE_OFF:CAVE_OFF + len(code)] = code
        self.set_flag(17)
        self.set_flag(9)
        self.driver(1, 2, 3)
        self.assertEqual([(c[1], c[2]) for c in self.calls()], [(0x100 + 9, 10), (0x100 + 17, 18)])

    def test_disassembly_matches_intent(self):
        raw = os.path.join(self.tmp, "c.bin")
        with open(raw, "wb") as f:
            f.write(self.code)
        out = subprocess.run(["objdump", "-D", "-b", "binary", "-mi386:x86-64", "-M", "intel", raw],
                             check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
        for needle in ("xor    eax,eax", "or     rax,QWORD PTR [rip+", "xchg   BYTE PTR [rip+", "test   al,al",
                       "push   rdi", "push   rsi", "push   rdx", "movabs rsi,0x807060504030201", "mov    edx,0x1869f",
                       "mov    ecx,0x1", "xor    r8d,r8d", "xor    edi,edi", "call", "pop    rdx", "pop    rsi", "pop    rdi",
                       "jmp"):
            self.assertIn(needle, out, needle)
        self.assertNotIn("(bad)", out)
        # jeder Befehl endet sauber: letzter Befehl ist der jmp zum echten ProcessEvent
        last = [ln for ln in out.splitlines() if re.match(r"\s+[0-9a-f]+:", ln)][-1]
        self.assertIn("jmp", last)


# ======================================================================
# Plan / Projekt (ohne Prozessor)
# ======================================================================
class FakeImage:
    """Kleines Fake-Image: Code r-x | rodata r-- | daten rw- ; Speicher = bytearray."""

    BASE = 0x400000

    def __init__(self):
        b = self.BASE
        self.maps = [(b, b + 0x10000, 5), (b + 0x10000, b + 0x12000, 1), (b + 0x12000, b + 0x16000, 3),
                     (0x7000000000, 0x7000100000, 3)]            # Heap, gehoert NICHT zum Image
        self.mem = {}
        for s, e, _p in self.maps:
            self.mem[s] = bytearray(e - s)
        self.impl = b + 0x1000
        self.pe = b + 0x2000
        self.slot = b + 0x12100
        self.write(self.slot, struct.pack("<Q", self.pe))
        self.write(self.impl, b"\x55\x48\x89\xe5" * 8)           # Code, kein Padding
        self.write(self.pe, b"\x55\x48\x89\xe5" * 8)

    def _reg(self, addr):
        for s, e, _p in self.maps:
            if s <= addr < e:
                return s, e
        raise IOError(f"{addr:#x} nicht gemappt")

    def write(self, addr, data):
        s, e = self._reg(addr)
        self.mem[s][addr - s:addr - s + len(data)] = data

    def read(self, addr, n):
        s, e = self._reg(addr)
        if addr + n > e:
            raise IOError("ueber Regionsende")
        return bytes(self.mem[s][addr - s:addr - s + n])


class PlanTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def mk(self, **kw):
        img = FakeImage()
        opts = kw.pop("options", make_options())
        return img, T.plan(img.read, img.maps, img.BASE, opts, img.impl, img.pe, kw.pop("slots", [img.slot]),
                           log=lambda _m: None, settle=0, **kw)

    def test_places_cave_and_flags_inside_image(self):
        img, p = self.mk()
        self.assertTrue(img.BASE + 0x0 <= p.cave < img.BASE + 0x10000)           # Code-Region
        self.assertEqual(p.cave % 16, 0)
        self.assertTrue(img.BASE + 0x12000 <= p.flag_addr < img.BASE + 0x16000)  # Daten-Region, nicht Heap
        self.assertEqual(p.flag_addr % 8, 0)
        self.assertEqual(p.cave_bytes, T.build_cave(p.cave, p.flag_addr, img.pe, img.impl, p.options))
        self.assertEqual(p.cave_orig, bytes(len(p.cave_bytes)))
        self.assertGreaterEqual(p.flag_size, 3)

    def test_slot_must_point_to_process_event(self):
        img = FakeImage()
        img.write(img.slot, struct.pack("<Q", img.pe + 0x10))
        with self.assertRaises(T.TrainerError) as c:
            T.plan(img.read, img.maps, img.BASE, make_options(), img.impl, img.pe, [img.slot], settle=0)
        self.assertIn("zeigt nicht auf ProcessEvent", str(c.exception))

    def test_addresses_outside_image_rejected(self):
        img = FakeImage()
        with self.assertRaises(T.TrainerError) as c:
            T.plan(img.read, img.maps, img.BASE, make_options(), 0x7000000100, img.pe, [img.slot], settle=0)
        self.assertIn("nicht im Spiel-Image", str(c.exception))

    def test_busy_flag_area_rejected(self):
        img = FakeImage()
        end = img.BASE + 0x16000
        img.write(end - 0x20, b"\x01")                         # Spiel nutzt das Ende der Daten-Region
        with self.assertRaises(T.TrainerError):
            T.plan(img.read, img.maps, img.BASE, make_options(), img.impl, img.pe, [img.slot], settle=0)

    def test_no_code_padding_rejected(self):
        img = FakeImage()
        img.write(img.BASE + 0x10000 - 8, b"\x55" * 8)         # Code reicht bis zum Regionsende
        with self.assertRaises(T.TrainerError) as c:
            T.plan(img.read, img.maps, img.BASE, make_options(), img.impl, img.pe, [img.slot], settle=0)
        self.assertIn("Code-Platz", str(c.exception))

    def test_limits_and_duplicates(self):
        img = FakeImage()
        many = [T.Option(f"E{i}", [T.Row("A", bytes(8), 1)]) for i in range(65)]
        with self.assertRaises(T.TrainerError):
            T.plan(img.read, img.maps, img.BASE, many, img.impl, img.pe, [img.slot], settle=0)
        dup = [T.Option("Gold", [T.Row("A", bytes(8), 1)]), T.Option("gold", [T.Row("B", bytes(8), 1)])]
        with self.assertRaises(T.TrainerError):
            T.plan(img.read, img.maps, img.BASE, dup, img.impl, img.pe, [img.slot], settle=0)
        with self.assertRaises(T.TrainerError):
            T.plan(img.read, img.maps, img.BASE, [], img.impl, img.pe, [img.slot], settle=0)

    def test_row_validation(self):
        with self.assertRaises(T.TrainerError):
            T.Row("x", b"\x01" * 7, 1)
        with self.assertRaises(T.TrainerError):
            T.Row("x", bytes(8), 0)
        with self.assertRaises(T.TrainerError):
            T.Row("x", bytes(8), 2 ** 32)

    def test_changing_flag_area_detected(self):
        img = FakeImage()
        calls = {"n": 0}
        real = img.read

        def flaky(addr, n):
            d = bytearray(real(addr, n))
            if n == 8 and addr >= img.BASE + 0x12000 and addr != img.slot:
                calls["n"] += 1
                if calls["n"] >= 2:
                    d[0] = 7
            return bytes(d)

        with self.assertRaises(T.TrainerError) as c:
            T.plan(flaky, img.maps, img.BASE, make_options(), img.impl, img.pe, [img.slot],
                   log=lambda _m: None, settle=0.01)
        self.assertIn("aendert sich", str(c.exception))

    def test_image_span_tolerates_small_gaps_but_not_far_regions(self):
        b = 0x400000
        maps = [(b, b + 0x10000, 5), (b + 0x11000, b + 0x14000, 3), (b + 0x40000000, b + 0x40001000, 3)]
        span = T.image_span(maps, b)
        self.assertEqual([(s, e) for s, e, _p in span], [(b, b + 0x10000), (b + 0x11000, b + 0x14000)])
        self.assertEqual(T.image_span(maps, 0x10), [])

    def test_split_package_in_14er_chunks(self):
        rows = [T.Row(f"I{i}", struct.pack("<Q", i), 1) for i in range(30)]
        o = T.split_package("Fische", rows)
        self.assertEqual([(x.name, len(x.rows)) for x in o], [("Fische 1", 14), ("Fische 2", 14), ("Fische 3", 2)])
        self.assertEqual([r.alias for x in o for r in x.rows], [r.alias for r in rows])
        self.assertEqual([x.name for x in T.split_package("Fische", rows[:14])], ["Fische"])
        self.assertEqual([x.name for x in T.split_package("Fische", rows[:15])], ["Fische 1", "Fische 2"])


class ProjectTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.img = FakeImage()
        self.p = T.plan(self.img.read, self.img.maps, self.img.BASE, make_options(), self.img.impl, self.img.pe,
                        [self.img.slot], log=lambda _m: None, settle=0)
        self.dir = tempfile.mkdtemp()

    def tearDown(self):
        shutil.rmtree(self.dir, ignore_errors=True)

    def test_files_written_and_loadable_by_reaperpy(self):
        import reapatch
        files = T.write_project(self.dir, self.p, "Test-Trainer", game="Spiel", title_id="PPSA20946", author="ich")
        names = sorted(os.path.basename(f) for f in files)
        self.assertIn(T.BASE_FILE, names)
        self.assertIn("01_Gold.reapproj", names)
        self.assertIn("02_Traenke.reapproj", names)
        self.assertIn("03_Material.reapproj", names)
        self.assertIn(T.SPEC_FILE, names)
        self.assertTrue(reapatch.is_patch_file("01_Gold.reapproj"))
        self.assertFalse(reapatch.is_patch_file(T.SPEC_FILE) and False)
        base = reapatch.ReapPatch.load(os.path.join(self.dir, T.BASE_FILE))
        sites = base.sites()
        self.assertEqual(len(sites), 2)                                   # Cave + 1 vtable-Slot
        self.assertEqual(sites[0][0], self.p.cave - self.p.base)
        self.assertEqual(sites[1][0], self.img.slot - self.p.base)
        self.assertEqual(bytes.fromhex(sites[0][2].replace(" ", "")), self.p.cave_bytes)
        self.assertEqual(bytes.fromhex(sites[1][2].replace(" ", "")), struct.pack("<Q", self.p.cave))
        self.assertEqual(bytes.fromhex(sites[1][1].replace(" ", "")), struct.pack("<Q", self.img.pe))
        gold = reapatch.ReapPatch.load(os.path.join(self.dir, "01_Gold.reapproj"))
        self.assertEqual(gold.origin_source[0], self.p.flag_addr - self.p.base)
        self.assertEqual(gold.origin_source[1:], ("00", "01"))
        mat = reapatch.ReapPatch.load(os.path.join(self.dir, "03_Material.reapproj"))
        self.assertEqual(mat.origin_source[0], self.p.flag_addr + 2 - self.p.base)

    def test_not_cave_patch_for_engine(self):
        """Die Dateien muessen als SIMPLE-Patches behandelt werden (keine Label-Spruenge)."""
        import patch_engine as PE
        import reapatch
        T.write_project(self.dir, self.p, "X")
        for f in os.listdir(self.dir):
            if f.endswith(".reapproj"):
                self.assertFalse(PE.is_cave_patch(reapatch.ReapPatch.load(os.path.join(self.dir, f))), f)

    def test_apply_and_deactivate_with_patch_engine(self):
        """Mit dem echten patch_engine auf einem Fake-Backend: BASIS an -> Cave + Haken stehen, aus -> alles wie vorher."""
        import patch_engine as PE
        import reapatch
        T.write_project(self.dir, self.p, "X")
        img = self.img

        class Backend:
            def read(self, a, n):
                return img.read(a, n)

            def write(self, a, d):
                img.write(a, bytes(d))

            def get_maps(self, force=False):
                return img.maps

            def assemble(self, *_a, **_k):
                raise AssertionError("Hex-Patches duerfen keinen Assembler brauchen")

        be = Backend()
        before = {a: img.read(a, 16) for a in (self.p.cave, self.img.slot)}
        base = reapatch.ReapPatch.load(os.path.join(self.dir, T.BASE_FILE))
        state = PE.apply_patch(be, base, img.BASE + base.origin_source[0])
        self.assertEqual(img.read(self.p.cave, len(self.p.cave_bytes)), self.p.cave_bytes)
        self.assertEqual(struct.unpack("<Q", img.read(img.slot, 8))[0], self.p.cave)
        self.assertTrue(PE.detect_patched(be, base, img.BASE + base.origin_source[0])[0])
        gold = reapatch.ReapPatch.load(os.path.join(self.dir, "01_Gold.reapproj"))
        PE.apply_patch(be, gold, img.BASE + gold.origin_source[0])
        self.assertEqual(img.read(self.p.flag_addr, 1), b"\x01")
        PE.deactivate_patch(be, base, state)
        self.assertEqual({a: img.read(a, 16) for a in (self.p.cave, self.img.slot)}, before)

    def test_goldhen_export_of_the_project(self):
        """Der vorhandene GoldHEN-Export versteht die Dateien (BASIS + Eintraege als Checkboxen)."""
        import export_goldhen as E
        import reapatch
        T.write_project(self.dir, self.p, "X")
        img = self.img

        class Backend:
            pid = 1

            def read(self, a, n):
                return img.read(a, n)

            def get_maps(self, force=False):
                return img.maps

            def assemble(self, *_a, **_k):
                raise AssertionError("kein Assembler noetig")

        pats = [reapatch.ReapPatch.load(os.path.join(self.dir, f)) for f in sorted(os.listdir(self.dir))
                if f.endswith(".reapproj")]
        mods, report = E.build_mods(Backend(), pats, img.BASE, log=lambda _m: None)
        self.assertEqual([r["status"] for r in report], ["ok"] * 4, report)
        self.assertEqual(len(mods), 4)
        base_mod = next(m for m in mods if m["name"].startswith("00"))
        self.assertEqual(len(base_mod["memory"]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(base_mod["memory"][1]["on"], struct.pack("<Q", self.p.cave).hex().upper())
        gold = next(m for m in mods if "Gold" in m["name"])
        self.assertEqual(gold["memory"], [{"offset": f"{self.p.flag_addr - img.BASE:X}", "on": "01", "off": "00"}])

    def test_spec_roundtrip_merge_and_rewrite_removes_stale_files(self):
        T.write_project(self.dir, self.p, "X", game="G", title_id="PPSA20946")
        old = T.load_options(self.dir)
        self.assertEqual([o.name for o in old], ["Gold", "Traenke", "Material"])
        new = [T.Option("gold", [T.Row("Item_Gold", bytes(8), 5)]), T.Option("Neu", [T.Row("Z", bytes(8), 3)])]
        merged = T.merge_options(old, new)
        self.assertEqual([o.name for o in merged], ["gold", "Traenke", "Material", "Neu"])
        self.assertEqual(merged[0].rows[0].amount, 5)
        p2 = T.plan(self.img.read, self.img.maps, self.img.BASE, merged, self.img.impl, self.img.pe,
                    [self.img.slot], log=lambda _m: None, settle=0)
        T.write_project(self.dir, p2, "X")
        files = sorted(f for f in os.listdir(self.dir) if f.endswith(".reapproj"))
        self.assertEqual(files, [T.BASE_FILE, "01_gold.reapproj", "02_Traenke.reapproj", "03_Material.reapproj",
                                 "04_Neu.reapproj"])
        self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(os.path.join(self.dir, "01_Gold.reapproj")) and
                         os.path.exists(os.path.join(self.dir, "01_gold.reapproj")) and
                         os.name != "nt" and False)

    def test_compare_fnames(self):
        T.write_project(self.dir, self.p, "X")
        live = {"Item_Gold": bytes.fromhex("0102030405060708"),
                "Item_PotionA": bytes.fromhex("9999999999999999"),
                "Item_Mat": bytes.fromhex("3333333333333333")}
        ok, changed, missing = T.compare_fnames(self.dir, live)
        self.assertEqual(sorted(ok), ["Item_Gold", "Item_Mat"])
        self.assertEqual([c[0] for c in changed], ["Item_PotionA"])
        self.assertEqual(missing, ["Item_PotionB"])
        with self.assertRaises(T.TrainerError):
            T.compare_fnames(tempfile.mkdtemp(), live)

    def test_readme_mentions_limits(self):
        txt = T.readme_text(self.p, "X")
        for needle in ("NICHT GETESTET", "FNAMES PRUEFEN", "BASIS", "Gold"):
            self.assertIn(needle, txt)

    def test_clean_name(self):
        self.assertEqual(T.clean_name('a/b:c*"d'), "a b c d")
        self.assertEqual(T.clean_name("   "), "Eintrag")
        self.assertLessEqual(len(T.clean_name("x" * 200)), T.NAME_MAX)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import os, sys, tempfile, unittest, json
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
import cheatfmt as C, gh_import

DOC = C.new_doc("Test Game", "CUSA12345", "01.05", "eboot.bin", ["Alice", "Bob"], [
    {"name": "Infinite HP", "type": "checkbox", "memory": [
        {"offset": "751BF8", "section": 0, "on": "90909090", "off": "FF4B1C89"}]},
    {"name": "Cave & <Test>", "type": "checkbox", "memory": [
        {"offset": "10", "section": 0, "on": "E9 01 02 03 04 90 90 90", "off": "0000000000000000"},
        {"offset": "20", "section": 0, "on": "C3", "off": "55"}]},
])


class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_key_iv_lengths(self):
        self.assertEqual(len(C.MC4_KEY), 32)
        self.assertEqual(len(C.MC4_IV), 16)

    def test_shn_roundtrip(self):
        text = C.build_shn(DOC)
        self.assertIn("<ValueOn>90-90-90-90</ValueOn>", text)
        back = C.parse_shn(text)
        self.assertEqual(back["id"], "CUSA12345")
        self.assertEqual(back["credits"], ["Alice", "Bob"])
        self.assertEqual(back["mods"][0]["memory"][0]["off"], "FF4B1C89")
        self.assertEqual(back["mods"][1]["name"], "Cave & <Test>")      # Sonderzeichen ueberleben in SHN
        self.assertEqual(len(back["mods"][1]["memory"]), 2)

    def test_mc4_roundtrip_and_sanitize(self):
        raw = C.build_mc4(DOC)
        text = C.decrypt_mc4(raw)
        back = C.parse_shn(text)
        self.assertEqual(back["mods"][0]["name"], "Infinite HP")
        self.assertEqual(back["mods"][1]["name"], "Cave + (Test)")      # mc4: Sonderzeichen entschaerft
        self.assertEqual(back["mods"][1]["memory"][0]["on"], "E901020304909090")

    def test_json_roundtrip(self):
        back = C.parse_json(C.build_json(DOC))
        self.assertEqual(back["mods"][1]["memory"][1]["on"], "C3")
        self.assertEqual(back["version"], "01.05")

    def test_check(self):
        errs, _ = C.check(DOC, "shn")
        self.assertEqual(errs, [])
        bad = dict(DOC, id="XXXX1", version="1")
        errs, _ = C.check(bad, "mc4")
        self.assertEqual(len(errs), 2)
        sec = json.loads(json.dumps(DOC)); sec["mods"][0]["memory"][0]["section"] = 1
        self.assertTrue(C.check(sec, "json")[0])
        self.assertFalse(C.check(sec, "shn")[0])

    def test_files_and_detect(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            for fmt in ("json", "shn", "mc4"):
                p = os.path.join(d, C.default_filename(DOC, fmt))
                C.save_file(DOC, p, fmt)
                self.assertEqual(C.detect(p), fmt)
                self.assertEqual(len(C.load_file(p)["mods"]), 2)
            self.assertEqual(C.default_filename(DOC, "mc4"), "CUSA12345_01.05.mc4")
            # mc4 ohne Endung wird am Inhalt erkannt
            raw = os.path.join(d, "noext")
            open(raw, "wb").write(C.build_mc4(DOC))
            self.assertEqual(C.detect(raw), "mc4")
            self.assertEqual(len(C.load_file(raw)["mods"]), 2)

    def test_import_into_patches(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            p = os.path.join(d, "x.mc4"); C.save_file(DOC, p, "mc4")
            notes = []
            w, sk = gh_import.import_into(d, p, 0x400000, 0x400000, notes=notes)
            self.assertEqual(len(w), 2)
            data = json.load(open(os.path.join(d, w[0]), encoding="utf-8"))
            self.assertIn("Variables", data)

    def test_other_section_skipped(self):
        doc = json.loads(json.dumps(DOC)); doc["mods"][0]["memory"][0]["section"] = 2
        notes = []
        out = gh_import.convert(doc, notes=notes)
        self.assertEqual(len(out), 1)
        self.assertTrue(notes and "Section" in notes[0])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
"""Tests fuer cheatmenu.py: Cheat-Menue ohne CheatManager (Shipping-Builds) - Engine-Werte + SDK-Werte an der Spielfigur."""
import os
import struct
import sys
import types
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
import cheatmenu as M
import uesdk


def cls(name, parent, members=()):
    out = [f"// Class /Script/Game.{name[1:]}", "// 0x0040 (0x0400 - 0x0010)",
           f"class {name}" + (f" : public {parent}" if parent else ""), "{", "public:"]
    for typ, mname, off, sz, extra in members:
        bits = " : 1" if "BitIndex" in extra else ""
        out.append(f"\t{typ:<30} {mname + bits + ';':<34} // {off:#06x} ({sz:#06x}) [0x0018001040022a01] Property {extra}")
    out.append("};")
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"


SDK_TEXT = "".join([
    cls("UObject", "", []),
    cls("AActor", "UObject", [("uint8_t", "bCanBeDamaged", 0x58, 1, "BitIndex: 0x02"), ("float", "CustomTimeDilation", 0x60, 4, "")]),
    cls("APawn", "AActor", []),
    cls("ACharacter", "APawn", [("class UCharacterMovementComponent*", "CharacterMovement", 0x300, 8, "")]),
    cls("UCharacterMovementComponent", "UObject",
        [("uint8_t", "MovementMode", 0x168, 1, ""), ("float", "MaxWalkSpeed", 0x178, 4, ""), ("float", "MaxFlySpeed", 0x17C, 4, ""),
         ("float", "JumpZVelocity", 0x180, 4, ""), ("float", "GravityScale", 0x184, 4, ""),
         ("uint8_t", "bCheatFlying", 0x1A0, 1, "BitIndex: 0x03")]),
    cls("AController", "AActor", [("class APawn*", "Pawn", 0x100, 8, ""), ("class APlayerState*", "PlayerState", 0x108, 8, "")]),
    cls("APlayerController", "AController", []),
    cls("AWorldSettings", "AActor", [("float", "TimeDilation", 0x40, 4, "")]),
    cls("UVitalsComponent", "UObject", [("float", "Health", 0x30, 4, ""), ("float", "MaxHealth", 0x34, 4, ""),
                                         ("float", "Stamina", 0x38, 4, ""), ("float", "MaxStamina", 0x3C, 4, "")]),
])

CTRL, PAWN, COMP, WORLD, VIT, VIT_ENEMY = 0x2000_0000, 0x3000_0000, 0x4000_0000, 0x5000_0000, 0x6000_0000, 0x6100_0000
STATE = 0x2100_0000


class Mem:
    def __init__(self):
        self.b = {}
        self.writes = []

    def read_memory(self, addr, n):
        return bytes(self.b.get(addr + i, 0) for i in range(n))

    def write_memory(self, addr, data):
        self.writes.append((addr, bytes(data)))
        for i, v in enumerate(data):
            self.b[addr + i] = v

    def put(self, addr, data):
        for i, v in enumerate(data):
            self.b[addr + i] = v


class FakeLive:
    OFFS = {("AController", "Pawn"): 0x100, ("AController", "PlayerState"): 0x108, ("ACharacter", "CharacterMovement"): 0x300,
            ("AActor", "bCanBeDamaged"): 0x58, ("AActor", "CustomTimeDilation"): 0x60, ("AWorldSettings", "TimeDilation"): 0x40,
            ("UCharacterMovementComponent", "MovementMode"): 0x168, ("UCharacterMovementComponent", "MaxWalkSpeed"): 0x178,
            ("UCharacterMovementComponent", "MaxFlySpeed"): 0x17C, ("UCharacterMovementComponent", "JumpZVelocity"): 0x180,
            ("UCharacterMovementComponent", "GravityScale"): 0x184, ("UCharacterMovementComponent", "bCheatFlying"): 0x1A0,
            ("UVitalsComponent", "Health"): 0x30}

    def __init__(self):
        self.index = {}
        self.inst = {"APlayerController": [CTRL], "AWorldSettings": [WORLD], "UVitalsComponent": [VIT, VIT_ENEMY]}
        self.outers = {VIT: PAWN, VIT_ENEMY: 0x7000_0000, 0x7000_0000: 0}

    def member_offset(self, c, m):
        return self.OFFS.get((c, m))

    def instances(self, c, **kw):
        return [{"addr": a, "name": f"{c}_{a:x}", "class": c, "owner": ""} for a in self.inst.get(c, [])]

    def outer(self, a):
        return self.outers.get(a, 0)

    def build_index(self):
        pass


def make(mem=None, live=None):
    mem = mem or Mem()
    mem.put(CTRL + 0x100, struct.pack("<Q", PAWN))
    mem.put(CTRL + 0x108, struct.pack("<Q", STATE))
    mem.put(PAWN + 0x300, struct.pack("<Q", COMP))
    mem.put(PAWN + 0x58, bytes([0b0000_0100]))               # bCanBeDamaged = true (Bit 2)
    mem.put(PAWN + 0x60, struct.pack("<f", 1.0))
    mem.put(COMP + 0x168, bytes([1]))                          # Walking
    mem.put(COMP + 0x178, struct.pack("<f", 600.0))
    mem.put(WORLD + 0x40, struct.pack("<f", 1.0))
    mem.put(VIT + 0x30, struct.pack("<ff", 40.0, 100.0))       # Health 40 / MaxHealth 100
    mem.put(VIT + 0x38, struct.pack("<ff", 10.0, 80.0))
    mem.put(VIT_ENEMY + 0x30, struct.pack("<ff", 7.0, 7.0))
    sdk = uesdk.parse_header_text(SDK_TEXT)
    menu = M.CheatMenu(live or FakeLive(), sdk, mem, log=lambda *a, **k: None)
    menu.build()
    return menu, mem


def f32(mem, addr):
    return struct.unpack("<f", mem.read_memory(addr, 4))[0]


class Menu(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_engine_entries_are_built_from_the_sdk(self):
        menu, _ = make()
        by = menu.by_key
        for k in ("god", "fly", "walkspeed", "flyspeed", "jump", "gravity", "ptime", "wtime"):
            self.assertTrue(by[k].ok, (k, by[k].status))
        self.assertEqual(by["god"].bit, 2)                                  # Bitfeld aus dem SDK

    def test_missing_sdk_member_is_explained_not_hidden(self):
        sdk = uesdk.parse_header_text(SDK_TEXT.replace("bCanBeDamaged", "bSomethingElse"))
        menu = M.CheatMenu(FakeLive(), sdk, Mem(), log=lambda *a, **k: None)
        menu.build()
        self.assertIn("gibt es in diesem Spiel nicht", menu.by_key["god"].status)
        self.assertTrue(menu.by_key["walkspeed"].ok)

    def test_god_toggles_only_the_bit_and_restores_it(self):
        menu, mem = make()
        menu.set_toggle("god", True)
        self.assertEqual(mem.read_memory(PAWN + 0x58, 1)[0], 0)             # Bit 2 aus
        mem.put(PAWN + 0x58, bytes([0b0000_0111]))                          # Spiel setzt es zurueck (+ andere Bits)
        menu.tick()
        self.assertEqual(mem.read_memory(PAWN + 0x58, 1)[0], 0b0000_0011)   # festgehalten, andere Bits unberuehrt
        menu.set_toggle("god", False)
        self.assertTrue(mem.read_memory(PAWN + 0x58, 1)[0] & 0b100)         # Original zurueck

    def test_fly_sets_movement_mode_and_cheatflying_and_goes_back_to_falling(self):
        menu, mem = make()
        menu.set_toggle("fly", True)
        self.assertEqual(mem.read_memory(COMP + 0x168, 1)[0], 5)
        self.assertTrue(mem.read_memory(COMP + 0x1A0, 1)[0] & 0b1000)
        mem.put(COMP + 0x168, bytes([1]))                                    # Landung: Spiel schaltet auf Walking
        menu.tick()
        self.assertEqual(mem.read_memory(COMP + 0x168, 1)[0], 5)             # wird wieder auf Flying gehalten
        menu.set_toggle("fly", False)
        self.assertEqual(mem.read_memory(COMP + 0x168, 1)[0], 1)             # Originalwert (Walking)
        self.assertFalse(mem.read_memory(COMP + 0x1A0, 1)[0] & 0b1000)

    def test_value_entry_sets_and_holds_and_releases(self):
        menu, mem = make()
        menu.set_value("walkspeed", "1200")
        self.assertEqual(f32(mem, COMP + 0x178), 1200.0)
        mem.put(COMP + 0x178, struct.pack("<f", 600.0))
        menu.tick()
        self.assertEqual(f32(mem, COMP + 0x178), 1200.0)
        menu.set_value("walkspeed", "*2", hold=False)                        # relativ, ohne Festhalten
        self.assertEqual(f32(mem, COMP + 0x178), 2400.0)
        mem.put(COMP + 0x178, struct.pack("<f", 600.0))
        menu.tick()
        self.assertEqual(f32(mem, COMP + 0x178), 600.0)

    def test_world_time_uses_world_settings(self):
        menu, mem = make()
        menu.set_value("wtime", "0.5")
        self.assertEqual(f32(mem, WORLD + 0x40), 0.5)

    def test_game_stats_only_touch_the_players_instance_and_use_max_for_auto(self):
        menu, mem = make()
        health = next(e for e in menu.entries if e.source == "spiel" and e.member == "Health")
        self.assertTrue(health.ok, health.status)
        menu.set_value(health.key, "auto")
        self.assertEqual(f32(mem, VIT + 0x30), 100.0)                        # MaxHealth der Figur
        self.assertEqual(f32(mem, VIT_ENEMY + 0x30), 7.0)                    # Gegner unberuehrt
        mem.put(VIT + 0x30, struct.pack("<f", 10.0))
        menu.tick()
        self.assertEqual(f32(mem, VIT + 0x30), 100.0)

    def test_pawn_change_drops_everything_and_never_writes_to_the_old_pawn(self):
        menu, mem = make()
        menu.set_toggle("god", True)
        menu.set_value("walkspeed", "900")
        mem.put(CTRL + 0x100, struct.pack("<Q", 0x3100_0000))               # Figur gewechselt (Tod/Level)
        n = len(mem.writes)
        msg = menu.tick()
        self.assertIn("gewechselt", msg)
        self.assertEqual(len(mem.writes), n)                                 # kein Schreibzugriff auf alte Adressen
        self.assertFalse(menu.by_key["god"].active)
        self.assertEqual(len(menu.freezer), 0)

    def test_no_player_controller_gives_a_clear_reason(self):
        live = FakeLive()
        live.inst["APlayerController"] = []
        menu, _ = make(live=live)
        menu.check_live()
        self.assertIn("Kein PlayerController", menu.by_key["god"].status)

    def test_check_live_marks_entries_without_player_instance(self):
        live = FakeLive()
        live.outers[VIT] = 0x7000_0000                                       # Komponente gehoert nicht zur Figur
        menu, _ = make(live=live)
        menu.check_live()
        health = next(e for e in menu.entries if e.source == "spiel" and e.member == "Health")
        self.assertIn("Spielfigur", health.status)
        self.assertTrue(menu.by_key["god"].ok)

    def test_release_all_restores_originals(self):
        menu, mem = make()
        menu.set_toggle("god", True)
        menu.set_value("walkspeed", "900")
        menu.release_all()
        self.assertTrue(mem.read_memory(PAWN + 0x58, 1)[0] & 0b100)
        self.assertEqual(f32(mem, COMP + 0x178), 600.0)
        self.assertEqual(len(menu.freezer), 0)

    def test_toggle_and_value_misuse_is_reported(self):
        menu, _ = make()
        with self.assertRaises(M.MenuError):
            menu.set_value("god", "1")
        with self.assertRaises(M.MenuError):
            menu.set_toggle("walkspeed", True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
```

```py
take_damage:

def entry(label, kind, cls, member, typ, offset, **kw):
    return M.Entry(key=f"g:{cls}.{member}", cat="Test", label=label, kind=kind, cls=cls, member=member, type=typ,
                   offset=offset, source="spiel", **kw)


class FakeMenu:
    sdk = None

    def _off(self, cls, member):
        return None


class FakeClient:
    def __init__(self, maps, mem):
        self.maps, self.mem, self.reads = maps, mem, []

    def get_maps(self):
        return self.maps

    def read_memory(self, addr, n):
        self.reads.append((addr, n))
        if addr < 0x400000 or addr + n > 0x400000 + len(self.mem):
            raise OSError("unlesbar")
        return self.mem[addr - 0x400000: addr - 0x400000 + n]


class Pure(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_value_bits(self):
        self.assertEqual(C.value_bits("float", "100", 4), struct.unpack("<I", struct.pack("<f", 100.0))[0])
        self.assertEqual(C.value_bits("int32", "99", 4), 99)
        self.assertEqual(C.value_bits("int32", "-1", 4), 0xFFFFFFFF)
        self.assertEqual(C.value_bits("bool", "an", 1), 1)
        self.assertEqual(C.value_bits("uint8", "aus", 1), 0)
        self.assertEqual(C.value_bits("double", "0", 8), 0)
        for typ, text, size in (("float", "1", 8), ("double", "1.5", 8), ("int32", "abc", 4), ("float", "auto", 4)):
            with self.assertRaises(C.CaveError, msg=(typ, text, size)):
                C.value_bits(typ, text, size)

    def test_entry_value_defaults(self):
        t = entry("Schalter", "toggle", "A", "bX", "bool", 0x150, on=True, off=False)
        self.assertEqual(C.entry_value(t), "1")
        t2 = entry("Modus", "toggle", "A", "Mode", "uint8", 0x150, on=5, off=3)
        self.assertEqual(C.entry_value(t2), "5")
        t3 = entry("Gott", "toggle", "A", "bCan", "bool", 0x150, on=False, off=True)
        self.assertEqual(C.entry_value(t3), "0")
        v = entry("Leben", "value", "A", "Health", "float", 0x348, default="auto")
        self.assertEqual(C.entry_value(v, "250"), "250")

    def test_small_offset_is_explained(self):

        with self.assertRaises(C.CaveError) as cm:
            C.entry_offset(FakeMenu(), e)
        self.assertIn("+0x60", str(cm.exception))

    def test_live_offset_wins_for_engine_entries(self):
        class Live(FakeMenu):
            def _off(self, cls, member):
                return 0x1A0
        e = M.Entry(key="x", cat="c", label="l", kind="value", cls="A", member="B", type="float", offset=0x150)
        self.assertEqual(C.entry_offset(Live(), e), 0x1A0)
        self.assertEqual(C.entry_offset(FakeMenu(), e), 0x150)          # nicht lesbar -> SDK-Offset

    def test_save_patch_never_overwrites(self):
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        p = {"name": "Leben: <test>", "author": "", "Variables": []}
        a, b = C.save_patch(d, p), C.save_patch(d, p)
        self.assertNotEqual(a, b)
        self.assertTrue(a.endswith(".reapproj") and os.path.exists(os.path.join(d, a)))
        self.assertEqual(json.load(open(os.path.join(d, b), encoding="utf-8"))["name"], p["name"])

    def test_code_from_console_reads_the_main_exec_region(self):
        mem = bytes(range(256)) * 64
        maps = [(0x200000, 0x300000, 3), (0x400000, 0x400000 + len(mem) // 2, 5),
                (0x400000 + len(mem) // 2, 0x400000 + len(mem), 5), (0x9000000, 0x9100000, 5)]
        cl = FakeClient(maps, mem)
        seen = []
        code = C.code_from_console(cl, 0x400000, progress=lambda a, b: seen.append((a, b)), chunk=0x1000)
        self.assertEqual(code["buf"], mem)                              # beide zusammenhaengende Teile
        self.assertEqual((code["base_va"], code["dump_rva"], code["range"]), (0x400000, 0, (0, len(mem))))
        self.assertEqual(seen[-1][0], len(mem))

    def test_code_from_console_fills_unreadable_chunks(self):
        mem = b"\x90" * 0x2000
        cl = FakeClient([(0x400000, 0x400000 + 0x4000, 5)], mem)        # zweite Haelfte nicht lesbar
        code = C.code_from_console(cl, 0x400000, chunk=0x2000)
        self.assertEqual(len(code["buf"]), 0x4000)
        self.assertEqual(code["buf"][:0x2000], mem)
        self.assertEqual(code["buf"][0x2000:], b"\x00" * 0x2000)

    def test_code_from_console_errors(self):
        with self.assertRaises(C.CaveError):
            C.code_from_console(FakeClient([(0x200000, 0x300000, 3)], b""), 0x400000)
        with self.assertRaises(C.CaveError):
            C.code_from_console(FakeClient([(0x900000, 0x901000, 5)], b""), 0x400000)       # nichts lesbar

    def test_code_from_project_needs_a_dump(self):
        with self.assertRaises(C.CaveError):
            C.code_from_project(type("P", (), {"dm": None})())


@unittest.skipUnless(HAVE, "Toolchain fehlt")
class Real(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        open(os.path.join(d, "t.s"), "w").write(ASM)
        subprocess.run(["as", "--64", "-o", os.path.join(d, "t.o"), os.path.join(d, "t.s")], check=True)
        subprocess.run(["objcopy", "-O", "binary", "-j", ".text", os.path.join(d, "t.o"), os.path.join(d, "t.bin")],
                       check=True)
        dump = b"\xCC" * 16 + open(os.path.join(d, "t.bin"), "rb").read()
        cls.code = {"buf": dump, "lo": 0, "hi": len(dump), "base_va": 0x400000, "dump_rva": 0, "range": (0, len(dump))}
        cls.dis = U.ObjdumpDisasm()

    def opts(self, e):
        return C.find_options(FakeMenu(), e, self.code, self.dis)

    def run_cave(self, patch, setup, check, arg_kind="int"):
        """Cave-Text (Haken-Rueckkehr -> Ziel-Label) in eine Testfunktion setzen und nativ ausfuehren."""
        lines = [l.replace("OriginReturn", "done_cave") for l in patch["Variables"][2]["defaultValue"].splitlines()]
        if arg_kind == "float":
            pre = ["push rbx", "mov rbx, rdi", "movaps xmm1, xmm0", "xor ecx, ecx"]
            post = ["done_cave:", "mov eax, ecx", "pop rbx", "ret"]
            proto = "extern int run(char *base, float f);"
        else:
            pre = ["xor ecx, ecx"]
            post = ["done_cave:", "mov eax, ecx", "ret"]
            proto = "extern int run(char *base, int v);"
        asm = ".intel_syntax noprefix\n.text\n.globl run\n" + "\n".join(["run:"] + pre + lines + post) + "\n"
        c = ("#include <stdio.h>\n" + proto + "\nint main(void){ static char buf[0x1000];\n" + setup +
             "\n  return 0; }\n")
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        open(os.path.join(d, "c.s"), "w").write(asm)
        open(os.path.join(d, "m.c"), "w").write(c)
        subprocess.run(["gcc", "-o", os.path.join(d, "m"), os.path.join(d, "m.c"), os.path.join(d, "c.s")],
                       check=True, capture_output=True)
        out = subprocess.run([os.path.join(d, "m")], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout.split()
        self.assertEqual(out, check)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ Treffer
    def test_health_prefers_keep_cave(self):
        e = entry("UHealthComponent.Health", "value", "UHealthComponent", "Health", "float", 0x348, default="auto")
        opts = self.opts(e)
        opt, mode = C.pick_best(e, opts)
        self.assertEqual(mode, "keep")
        self.assertEqual(opt.hit.ins.mnem, "movss")
        self.assertTrue(opt.modes["force"][0] and opt.modes["nop"][0])
        self.assertIn("movss", C.describe(opt)[0])

    def test_toggle_gets_force_not_keep(self):
        e = entry("ACharacter.bFlag", "toggle", "ACharacter", "bFlag", "bool", 0x150, on=False, off=True)
        opt, mode = C.pick_best(e, self.opts(e))
        self.assertEqual(mode, "force")
        self.assertFalse(opt.modes["keep"][0])
        self.assertIn("Schalter", opt.modes["keep"][1])

    def test_bitfield_toggle_refuses_byte_store(self):
        e = entry("AActor.bBit", "toggle", "AActor", "bBit", "uint8", 0x150, on=True, off=False, bit=3)
        opt = self.opts(e)[0]
        self.assertFalse(opt.modes["force"][0])
        self.assertIn("Bit", opt.modes["force"][1])
        self.assertEqual(C.pick_best(e, [opt]), (None, None))

    def test_wrapped_struct_refuses_force(self):
        import ue_quick as Q

                             " printf(\"%.1f %.1f\\n\", a, *hp);", ["100.0", "150.0"], "float")
```

`tests/test_debugger_attach.py`:

```py
"""Debugger-Attach gegen einen Fake-PS5 (mehrere Verbindungen, Rueckkanal wie bei ps5debug-NG)."""

import os
import socket
import struct
import sys
import threading
import time
import unittest
from unittest import mock

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
import debugger as D
import ps5_ext as X
from ps5_client import STATUS_SUCCESS, PS5DebugClient

OK = struct.pack("<I", STATUS_SUCCESS)


def free_port():
    s = socket.socket()
    s.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
    port = s.getsockname()[1]
    s.close()
    return port


def rx(s, n):
    b = b""
    while len(b) < n:
        c = s.recv(n - len(b))
        if not c:
            raise EOFError
        b += c
    return b


class BadBind(socket.socket):
    """Socket, dessen bind() wie unter Windows (TIME_WAIT / SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE) scheitert."""

    def __init__(self, code, text):
        super().__init__(socket.AF_INET, socket.SOCK_STREAM)
        self._err = (code, text)

    def bind(self, addr):
        raise OSError(*self._err)


class FakePS5(threading.Thread):
    """Beantwortet VERSION / DEBUG_ATTACH / DEBUG_DETACH.  attach_results: Liste von Status-Woertern."""

    def __init__(self, listener_port, attach_results):
        super().__init__(daemon=True)
        self.srv = socket.socket()
        self.srv.bind(("127.0.0.1", 0))
        self.srv.listen(5)
        self.port = self.srv.getsockname()[1]
        self.listener_port = listener_port
        self.attach_results = list(attach_results)
        self.detaches = 0
        self.attaches = 0
        self.back = []
        self.cmds = []
        self.conns = []
        self.refuse = False
        self._stop = False

    def run(self):
        while not self._stop:
            try:
                conn, _ = self.srv.accept()
            except OSError:
                return
            if self.refuse:
                conn.close()
                continue
            self.conns.append(conn)
            threading.Thread(target=self._serve, args=(conn,), daemon=True).start()

    def _serve(self, s):
        try:
            while True:
                _magic, cmd, ln = struct.unpack("<III", rx(s, 12))
                if ln:
                    rx(s, ln)
                self.cmds.append(cmd)
                if cmd == 0xBD000001:  # VERSION
                    s.sendall(struct.pack("<I", 4) + b"1.3\x00")
                elif cmd == X.CMD_DEBUG_ATTACH:
                    self.attaches += 1
                    status = self.attach_results.pop(0) if self.attach_results else STATUS_SUCCESS
                    if status == STATUS_SUCCESS and self.listener_port:
                        back = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", self.listener_port), timeout=2)
                        self.back.append(back)
                    s.sendall(struct.pack("<I", status))
                elif cmd == X.CMD_DEBUG_DETACH:
                    self.detaches += 1
                    s.sendall(OK)
                else:
                    s.sendall(OK)
        except (EOFError, OSError):
            pass
        finally:
            s.close()

    def close(self):
        self._stop = True
        self.srv.close()
        for b in self.back:
            b.close()


class AttachTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.lp = free_port()
        self.logs = []
        self.fakes = []

    def tearDown(self):
        for f in self.fakes:
            f.close()

    def fake(self, results):
        f = FakePS5(self.lp, results)
        f.start()
        self.fakes.append(f)
        return f

    def session(self, fake):
        s = D.DebugSession("127.0.0.1", fake.port, 77, on_log=self.logs.append, listener_port=self.lp)
        s.retry_delay = 0
        return s

    def port_is_free(self):
        s = socket.socket()
        s.setsockopt(socket.SOL_SOCKET, socket.SO_REUSEADDR, 1)  # TIME_WAIT-Reste zaehlen nicht als belegt
        try:
            s.bind(("127.0.0.1", self.lp))
            s.listen(1)  # nur ein aktiv lauschender Socket macht den Port wirklich "belegt"
            return True
        except OSError:
            return False
        finally:
            s.close()

    def test_attach_detach_attach_again_immediately(self):
        fake = self.fake([])
        for _ in range(2):  # zweiter Attach direkt nach Detach darf nicht an Port 755 scheitern
            sess = self.session(fake)
            sess.attach()
            self.assertTrue(sess.attached)
            self.assertTrue(sess.listener.connected.is_set())
            sess.detach()
            self.assertFalse(sess.attached)
        self.assertEqual(fake.detaches, 2)

    def test_borrowed_main_connection_is_used_and_stays_open(self):
        fake = self.fake([])
        main = PS5DebugClient("127.0.0.1", fake.port)
        main.connect()
        sess = D.DebugSession("127.0.0.1", fake.port, 77, on_log=self.logs.append, listener_port=self.lp, client=main)
        sess.attach()
        self.assertIs(sess.client, main)
        self.assertEqual(fake.attaches, 1)
        sess.detach()
        self.assertIsNotNone(main.sock)  # Hauptverbindung nicht geschlossen
        self.assertTrue(main._recv_status is not None and X._status_cmd(main, 0xBDAACC06) == STATUS_SUCCESS)
        # nach Fehlschlag bleibt sie ebenfalls offen
        with mock.patch.object(X, "dbg_attach", side_effect=TimeoutError("t")):
            with self.assertRaises(D.DebugError):
                sess.attach()
        self.assertIsNotNone(main.sock)
        self.assertTrue(self.port_is_free())
        main.close()

    def test_already_debugged_is_recovered(self):
        fake = self.fake([0xF0000004, STATUS_SUCCESS])
        sess = self.session(fake)
        sess.attach()
        self.assertTrue(sess.attached)
        self.assertEqual(fake.attaches, 2)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(fake.detaches, 1)  # alter Zustand wurde zuerst geloest
        self.assertTrue(any("bereits debuggt" in m for m in self.logs))
        sess.detach()

    def test_permanent_already_debugged_gives_clear_error_and_frees_port(self):
        fake = self.fake([0xF0000004, 0xF0000004])
        sess = self.session(fake)
        with self.assertRaises(D.DebugError) as ctx:
            sess.attach()
        self.assertIn("debuggt", str(ctx.exception))
        self.assertFalse(sess.attached)
        self.assertTrue(self.port_is_free())

    def test_other_status_frees_everything(self):
        fake = self.fake([0xF0000001])
        sess = self.session(fake)
        with self.assertRaises(D.DebugError) as ctx:
            sess.attach()
        self.assertIn("0xF0000001", str(ctx.exception))
        self.assertTrue(self.port_is_free())

    def test_timeout_mentions_firewall_and_frees_port(self):
        fake = self.fake([])
        sess = self.session(fake)
        with mock.patch.object(X, "dbg_attach", side_effect=TimeoutError("timed out")):
            with self.assertRaises(D.DebugError) as ctx:
                sess.attach()
        self.assertIn("Firewall", str(ctx.exception))
        self.assertTrue(self.port_is_free())
        sess.attach()  # und danach geht es sofort wieder
        self.assertTrue(sess.attached)
        sess.detach()

    def test_busy_port_gives_clear_error(self):
        blocker = socket.socket()
        blocker.bind(("127.0.0.1", self.lp))
        blocker.listen(1)
        try:
            fake = self.fake([])
            sess = self.session(fake)
            with self.assertRaises(D.DebugError) as ctx:
                sess.attach()
            self.assertIn("nicht verfügbar", str(ctx.exception))
        finally:
            blocker.close()
        time.sleep(0.05)

    def test_windows_exclusive_bind_falls_back_when_nobody_listens(self):
        """Windows: SO_EXCLUSIVEADDRUSE scheitert an TIME_WAIT -> Fallback, solange niemand lauscht."""
        real = X.InterruptListener._make_socket

        def fake_make(mode):
            if mode == "exclusive":
                return BadBind(10013, "Zugriff verweigert (TIME_WAIT)")
            return real("reuse")

        with mock.patch.object(X.os, "name", "nt"), mock.patch.object(
            X.InterruptListener, "_make_socket", staticmethod(fake_make)
        ):
            lst = X.InterruptListener(lambda p: None, port=self.lp)
            lst.close()

    def test_windows_fallback_refuses_when_port_really_taken(self):
        blocker = socket.socket()
        blocker.bind(("127.0.0.1", self.lp))
        blocker.listen(1)
        real = X.InterruptListener._make_socket

        def fake_make(mode):
            if mode == "exclusive":
                return BadBind(10048, "belegt")
            return real("reuse")

        try:
            with mock.patch.object(X.os, "name", "nt"), mock.patch.object(
                X.InterruptListener, "_make_socket", staticmethod(fake_make)
            ):
                with self.assertRaises(OSError):
                    X.InterruptListener(lambda p: None, port=self.lp, host="127.0.0.1")
        finally:
            blocker.close()


class KeepAliveTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.lp = free_port()
        self.fake = FakePS5(self.lp, [])
        self.fake.start()
        self.states, self.logs = [], []

    def tearDown(self):
        self.fake.close()

    def session(self, **kw):
        s = D.DebugSession("127.0.0.1", self.fake.port, 1234, on_log=self.logs.append, on_state=self.states.append,
                           listener_port=self.lp, **kw)
        s.keepalive_s = 0.05
        return s

    def wait(self, cond, t=5.0):
        end = time.time() + t
        while time.time() < end:
            if cond():
                return True
            time.sleep(0.02)
        return False

    def test_idle_debug_connection_gets_pings(self):
        s = self.session()
        s.attach()
        try:
            n0 = self.fake.cmds.count(0xBD000000 + 0) if False else len(self.fake.cmds)
            self.assertTrue(self.wait(lambda: len(self.fake.cmds) > n0 + 3))      # ohne Keep-Alive blieb die Verbindung still
            self.assertEqual(self.states[:1], ["attached"])
        finally:
            s.detach()

    def test_dropped_debug_connection_is_rebuilt_with_breakpoints(self):
        s = self.session()
        s.attach()
        try:
            s.set_breakpoint(2, 0x401000)
            s.set_watchpoint(1, 0x7000, 4, 1)
            first = self.fake.conns[0]
            n_bp = self.fake.cmds.count(X.CMD_DEBUG_SET_BREAKPOINT)
            first.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RDWR)                                        # PS5/Netz kappt die Debug-Verbindung
            first.close()
            self.assertTrue(self.wait(lambda: s.reconnects == 1), self.logs)
            self.assertEqual(self.states, ["attached", "reconnecting", "attached"])
            self.assertEqual(self.fake.attaches, 2)
            self.assertTrue(self.wait(lambda: self.fake.cmds.count(X.CMD_DEBUG_SET_BREAKPOINT) > n_bp))   # Breakpoint neu gesetzt
            self.assertIn(X.CMD_DEBUG_SET_WATCHPOINT, self.fake.cmds)
            self.assertTrue(s.attached)
            self.assertTrue(s.health()["debug_ping"])
            self.assertTrue(any("wiederhergestellt" in m for m in self.logs))
        finally:
            s.detach()

    def test_rebuild_failure_reports_lost(self):
        s = self.session()
        s.keepalive_misses = 1
        s.attach()
        self.fake.refuse = True                                                     # PS5 komplett weg
        for c in list(self.fake.conns):
            try:
                c.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RDWR)
                c.close()
            except OSError:
                pass
        self.assertTrue(self.wait(lambda: "lost" in self.states, 15), (self.states, self.logs))
        self.assertFalse(s.attached)
        s.detach()

    def test_borrowed_connection_reports_lost_instead_of_rebuilding(self):
        main = PS5DebugClient("127.0.0.1", self.fake.port)
        main.connect()
        main.pid = 1234
        s = self.session(client=main)
        s.attach()
        for c in list(self.fake.conns):
            c.shutdown(socket.SHUT_RDWR)
            c.close()
        self.assertTrue(self.wait(lambda: "lost" in self.states, 5), self.states)
        self.assertEqual(s.reconnects, 0)
        s.detach()

    def test_detach_stops_keepalive_and_health_reports_back_channel(self):
        s = self.session()
        s.attach()
        h = s.health()
        self.assertTrue(h["debug_ping"])
        self.assertIsNone(h["main_ping"])
        s.detach()
        self.assertIsNone(s._ka_thread)
        self.assertEqual(self.states[-1], "detached")
        n = len(self.fake.cmds)
        time.sleep(0.3)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.fake.cmds), n)                                     # nach Detach keine Pings mehr


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Treffer / WEITER / STEP wie im PS5 Debug Toolkit (Server macht den Breakpoint-Schritt selbst)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def make_packet(lwpid, rip, rsp=0x7FFF0000, signal=5, dr6=0):
    buf = bytearray(X.INTERRUPT_PACKET_SIZE)
    struct.pack_into("<II", buf, 0, lwpid, (signal << 8) | 0x7F)
    regs = {n: 0 for n in X._REG_NAMES}
    regs["rip"], regs["rsp"] = rip, rsp
    buf[0x30:0x30 + X.REGS_SIZE] = X.pack_regs(regs)
    struct.pack_into("<Q", buf, 0x420 + 6 * 8, dr6)
    return bytes(buf)


class SessionFake(FakePS5):
    """Wie FakePS5, kennt aber Register, CONTINUE und STEP und kann Ereignisse auf dem Rueckkanal senden."""

    def __init__(self, listener_port):
        super().__init__(listener_port, [])
        self.live_rip = {}            # lwpid -> RIP, den GETREGS liefert
        self.on_step = None           # callable(lwpid) -> sendet Ereignis
        self.continues = 0

    def send_event(self, pkt):
        self.back[-1].sendall(pkt)

    def _serve(self, s):
        try:
            while True:
                _m, cmd, ln = struct.unpack("<III", rx(s, 12))
                body = rx(s, ln) if ln else b""
                self.cmds.append(cmd)
                if cmd == 0xBD000001:
                    s.sendall(struct.pack("<I", 4) + b"1.3\x00")
                elif cmd == X.CMD_DEBUG_ATTACH:
                    self.attaches += 1
                    self.back.append(socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", self.listener_port), timeout=2))
                    s.sendall(OK)
                elif cmd == X.CMD_DEBUG_GETREGS:
                    lw = struct.unpack("<I", body[:4])[0]
                    regs = {n: 0 for n in X._REG_NAMES}
                    regs["rip"] = self.live_rip.get(lw, 0)
                    s.sendall(OK + X.pack_regs(regs))
                elif cmd == 0xBDAA0002:
                    _pid, _addr, n = struct.unpack("<IQI", body[:16])
                    s.sendall(OK + b"\x90" * n)
                elif cmd == X.CMD_DEBUG_CONTINUE:
                    self.continues += 1
                    s.sendall(OK)
                elif cmd == X.CMD_DEBUG_STEP_THREAD:
                    lw = struct.unpack("<I", body[:4])[0]
                    s.sendall(OK)
                    if self.on_step:
                        self.on_step(lw)
                elif cmd == X.CMD_DEBUG_DETACH:
                    self.detaches += 1
                    s.sendall(OK)
                else:
                    s.sendall(OK)
        except (EOFError, OSError):
            pass
        finally:
            s.close()


class HitTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.lp = free_port()
        self.fake = SessionFake(self.lp)
        self.fake.start()
        self.hits, self.logs = [], []
        self.s = D.DebugSession("127.0.0.1", self.fake.port, 77, on_hit=self.hits.append,
                                on_log=self.logs.append, listener_port=self.lp)
        self.s.keepalive_s = 60
        self.s.attach()

    def tearDown(self):
        self.s.detach()
        self.fake.close()

    def wait(self, cond, t=3.0):
        end = time.time() + t
        while time.time() < end:
            if cond():
                return True
            time.sleep(0.02)
        return False

    def hit_at(self, addr, lwpid=5, live=None):
        self.fake.live_rip[lwpid] = addr if live is None else live
        self.fake.send_event(make_packet(lwpid, addr))
        self.assertTrue(self.wait(lambda: self.hits))
        return self.hits[-1]

    def test_hit_rip_equals_breakpoint_address(self):
        self.s.set_breakpoint(0, 0x401000)
        h = self.hit_at(0x401000)
        self.assertEqual((h["kind"], h["index"], h["addr"]), ("BP", 0, 0x401000))
        self.assertFalse(h["prestepped"])

    def test_hit_rip_behind_int3_is_still_recognised(self):
        self.s.set_breakpoint(1, 0x402000)
        h = self.hit_at(0x402001)
        self.assertEqual((h["kind"], h["addr"]), ("BP", 0x402000))

    def test_resume_is_a_plain_continue_without_register_writes(self):
        self.s.set_breakpoint(0, 0x401000)
        self.hit_at(0x401000)
        n_set = self.fake.cmds.count(X.CMD_DEBUG_SETREGS)
        n_bp = self.fake.cmds.count(X.CMD_DEBUG_SET_BREAKPOINT)
        self.s.resume()
        self.assertEqual(self.fake.continues, 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.fake.cmds.count(X.CMD_DEBUG_SETREGS), n_set)        # kein RIP-Zuruecksetzen
        self.assertEqual(self.fake.cmds.count(X.CMD_DEBUG_SET_BREAKPOINT), n_bp)  # kein Entfernen/Neusetzen
        self.assertNotIn(X.CMD_DEBUG_STEP_THREAD, self.fake.cmds)
        self.assertEqual(self.s.stopped, {})

    def test_prestepped_is_detected_and_step_does_not_wait_for_the_console(self):
        self.s.set_breakpoint(0, 0x401000)
        h = self.hit_at(0x401000, live=0x401003)          # Konsole hat den Befehl schon ausgefuehrt
        self.assertTrue(h["prestepped"])
        self.s.step()
        self.assertNotIn(X.CMD_DEBUG_STEP_THREAD, self.fake.cmds)
        self.assertEqual(self.hits[-1]["kind"], "STEP")
        self.assertEqual(self.hits[-1]["regs"]["rip"], 0x401003)
        self.assertFalse(self.hits[-1]["prestepped"])

    def test_step_waits_for_the_step_event(self):
        self.s.set_breakpoint(0, 0x401000)
        self.hit_at(0x401000)
        self.fake.on_step = lambda lw: self.fake.send_event(make_packet(lw, 0x401004))
        self.s.step()
        self.assertIn(X.CMD_DEBUG_STEP_THREAD, self.fake.cmds)
        self.assertEqual((self.hits[-1]["kind"], self.hits[-1]["addr"]), ("STEP", 0x401004))

    def test_step_without_event_reports_clear_error(self):
        self.s.set_breakpoint(0, 0x401000)
        self.hit_at(0x401000)
        old = D.STEP_TIMEOUT
        D.STEP_TIMEOUT = 0.3
        try:
            with self.assertRaises(D.DebugError) as cm:
                self.s.step()
            self.assertIn(str(self.lp), str(cm.exception))
        finally:
            D.STEP_TIMEOUT = old

    def test_clear_breakpoint_while_stopped_is_deferred_until_resume(self):
        self.s.set_breakpoint(0, 0x401000)
        self.hit_at(0x401000)
        n_bp = self.fake.cmds.count(X.CMD_DEBUG_SET_BREAKPOINT)
        self.s.clear_breakpoint(0)
        self.assertEqual(self.fake.cmds.count(X.CMD_DEBUG_SET_BREAKPOINT), n_bp)  # noch scharf auf der Konsole
        self.assertEqual(self.s.bps, {})
        self.assertEqual(self.s.free_bp_index(), 1)                                # Slot 0 noch belegt
        self.s.resume()
        self.assertEqual(self.fake.cmds.count(X.CMD_DEBUG_SET_BREAKPOINT), n_bp + 1)
        self.assertEqual(self.s.free_bp_index(), 0)

    def test_clear_breakpoint_while_running_is_immediate(self):
        self.s.set_breakpoint(0, 0x401000)
        n_bp = self.fake.cmds.count(X.CMD_DEBUG_SET_BREAKPOINT)
        self.s.clear_breakpoint(0)
        self.assertEqual(self.fake.cmds.count(X.CMD_DEBUG_SET_BREAKPOINT), n_bp + 1)

    def test_run_slots_are_reserved(self):
        for i in range(X.MAX_BREAKPOINTS - len(D.RUN_SLOTS)):
            self.s.set_breakpoint(self.s.free_bp_index(), 0x1000 + i)
        with self.assertRaises(D.DebugError):
            self.s.free_bp_index()

    def test_run_to_recursion_keeps_running_until_stack_is_unwound(self):
        self.s.run_to(0x500000, min_rsp=0x7FFF0000)
        n = self.fake.continues
        self.fake.live_rip[5] = 0x500000
        self.fake.send_event(make_packet(5, 0x500000, rsp=0x7FFE0000))               # tiefere Rekursion -> weiter
        self.assertTrue(self.wait(lambda: self.fake.continues == n + 1))
        self.assertEqual(self.hits, [])
        self.fake.send_event(make_packet(5, 0x500000, rsp=0x7FFF0008))               # Ziel erreicht
        self.assertTrue(self.wait(lambda: self.hits))
        self.assertEqual((self.hits[-1]["kind"], self.hits[-1]["addr"]), ("STEP", 0x500000))

    def test_keepalive_does_not_ping_or_rebuild_while_a_thread_is_stopped(self):
        self.s.set_breakpoint(0, 0x401000)
        self.hit_at(0x401000)
        self.s.keepalive_s = 0.05
        self.s._start_keepalive()
        n = len(self.fake.cmds)
        time.sleep(0.4)
        self.assertEqual(len(self.fake.cmds), n)
        self.assertEqual(self.s.reconnects, 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import json, os, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile, unittest
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import dumpmem as D

REGIONS = [
    {"name": "executable", "start": 0x400000, "end": 0x500000, "prot": 5, "offset": 0},
    {"name": "executable", "start": 0x500000, "end": 0x580000, "prot": 1, "offset": 0x100000},
    {"name": "executable", "start": 0x700000, "end": 0x710000, "prot": 3, "offset": 0x180000},
    {"name": "libc.prx", "start": 0x80000000, "end": 0x80010000, "prot": 5, "offset": 0x190000},
```
