```py
def make_dump(d, code=b""):
    total = 0x1A0000
    buf = bytearray(total)
    buf[0:len(code)] = code
    buf[0x100000:0x100008] = b"DATA1234"
    buf[0x180000:0x180008] = (0x1122334455667788).to_bytes(8, "little")
    p = os.path.join(d, "dump.bin"); open(p, "wb").write(buf)
    j = os.path.join(d, "dump.json"); json.dump({"name": "eboot.bin", "title_id": "PPSA00000", "regions": REGIONS}, open(j, "w"))
    return p, j


class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_read_and_map(self):
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); p, j = make_dump(d)
        dm = D.DumpMemory(p, j)
        self.assertEqual(dm.base, 0x400000); self.assertEqual(dm.module_name, "executable")
        self.assertEqual(dm.read(0x500000, 8), b"DATA1234")
        self.assertEqual(int.from_bytes(dm.read(0x700000, 8), "little"), 0x1122334455667788)
        self.assertIsNone(dm.va_to_off(0x600000))                       # Luecke
        with self.assertRaises(OSError): dm.read(0x600000, 4)
        with self.assertRaises(OSError): dm.read(0x57FFFC, 8)           # ragt hinter die Region in eine Luecke
        dm.close()

    def test_cross_region_contiguous(self):
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); p, j = make_dump(d)
        dm = D.DumpMemory(p, j)
        # 0x4FFFF8..0x500008: Code-Ende (offset 0xFFFF8) und Daten-Anfang (offset 0x100000) liegen luckenlos
        self.assertEqual(dm.read(0x4FFFF8, 16)[8:], b"DATA1234")
        buf, lo, hi, base_va = dm.code_view()
        self.assertEqual((lo, hi, base_va), (0, 0x100000, 0x400000))
        dm.close()

    def test_native_convention(self):
        if not (shutil.which("as") and shutil.which("objcopy")):
            self.skipTest("as fehlt")
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        asm = ".intel_syntax noprefix\n.text\n" + "".join(
            f".p2align 4,0xCC\nf{i}:\n  push rbx\n  mov eax, {i}\n  pop rbx\n  ret\n" for i in range(40))
        open(os.path.join(d, "t.s"), "w").write(asm)
        subprocess.run(["as", "--64", "-o", os.path.join(d, "t.o"), os.path.join(d, "t.s")], check=True)
        subprocess.run(["objcopy", "-O", "binary", "-j", ".text", os.path.join(d, "t.o"), os.path.join(d, "t.bin")], check=True)
        code = b"\xCC" * 16 + open(os.path.join(d, "t.bin"), "rb").read()
        p, j = make_dump(d, code)
        dm = D.DumpMemory(p, j)
        starts = [i for i in range(16, len(code), 16) if code[i - 1] in (0xCC, 0xC3) and code[i] != 0xCC][:30]
        rvas = starts                                                  # Position = RVA (Base 0x400000, Offset 0)
        conv, r, v = D.native_convention(dm, rvas, 0x400000)
        self.assertEqual(conv, "rva"); self.assertGreater(r, 0.9)
        conv, r, v = D.native_convention(dm, [a + 0x400000 for a in rvas], 0x400000)
        self.assertEqual(conv, "va")
        dm.close()

    def test_find_game_files_real_layout(self):
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, "SDK", "SDK_HEADERS")); os.makedirs(os.path.join(d, "Anderes Spiel"))
        for n in ("A_classes.hpp", "A_structs.hpp", "A_parameters.hpp"):
            open(os.path.join(d, "SDK", "SDK_HEADERS", n), "w").write("//")
        for n in ("offsets.json", "dump.json", "GObjects.txt", "dump.bin.engine.json"):
            open(os.path.join(d, n), "w").write("{}")
        open(os.path.join(d, "dump.bin"), "wb").write(b"0")
        f = D.find_game_files(d)
        self.assertTrue(f["sdk"].endswith("SDK_HEADERS")); self.assertTrue(f["dump_bin"].endswith("dump.bin"))
        for k in ("offsets", "dump_json", "gobjects", "engine"):
            self.assertTrue(f[k], k)

    def test_find_game_files_ps4_unreal_dumper_layout(self):
        """dumps/<TitleID>/{dump.bin,dump.json,dump.bin.engine.json} + SDK/{offsets.json,GObjects.txt,SDK_HEADERS}"""
```

`tests/test_export_allocator.py`:

```py
"""Tests: der Exporter legt Caves nur im Spiel-Image an (nicht unter der Basis, nicht in fremden Modulen)."""
import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
import export_goldhen as E

BASE = 0x400000


class Backend:
    """Fake-PS5: Regionen (start, end, prot) + Speicher (Standard: Code-Bytes, Padding wo gewuenscht)."""

    def __init__(self, maps, padded):
        self.maps, self.padded = maps, set(padded)
        self.mem = {}

    def get_maps(self, force=False):
        return self.maps

    def read(self, addr, n):
        for s, e, _p in self.maps:
            if s <= addr and addr + n <= e:
                end = e
                out = bytearray(b"\x55" * n)
                if (s, e) in self.padded:                       # Padding am Region-Ende (letzte 0x800 Byte)
                    for i in range(n):
                        if addr + i >= end - 0x800:
                            out[i] = 0
                return bytes(out)
        return None


class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def maps(self):
        return [(0x0, 0x10000, 5),                              # niedrige Region UNTER der Basis (z. B. Stub/Loader)
                (BASE, BASE + 0x400000, 5),                     # Spiel-Image: Code
                (BASE + 0x400000, BASE + 0x500000, 1),          # rodata
                (BASE + 0x500000, BASE + 0x600000, 3),          # data
                (0x7000000000, 0x7000100000, 5)]                # fremdes Modul weit weg

    def alloc(self, padded, base=BASE, near=BASE + 0x1000):
        be = Backend(self.maps(), padded)
        a = E.CaveAllocator(be, log=lambda _m: None, image_base=base)
        return a, a.alloc(0x40, near)

    def test_cave_is_inside_the_image_not_below_the_base(self):
        low, img = (0x0, 0x10000), (BASE, BASE + 0x400000)
        a, (cave, size) = self.alloc([low, img])
        self.assertTrue(img[0] <= cave < img[1], hex(cave))
        self.assertFalse(a.used_outside)

    def test_the_old_behaviour_would_have_picked_the_low_region(self):
        """Regression: ohne Image-Basis (altes Verhalten) wird die groesste Luecke genommen - hier die niedrige Region."""
        be = Backend(self.maps(), [(0x0, 0x10000), (BASE, BASE + 0x400000)])
        a = E.CaveAllocator(be, log=lambda _m: None)               # image_base=None
        cave, _ = a.alloc(0x40, BASE + 0x1000)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(cave, 0)                           # funktioniert weiter (Rueckwaertskompatibel)

    def test_regions_below_base_are_never_used_even_if_only_they_have_padding(self):
        a = E.CaveAllocator(Backend(self.maps(), [(0x0, 0x10000)]), log=lambda _m: None, image_base=BASE)
        with self.assertRaises(E.ExportError) as c:
            a.alloc(0x40, BASE + 0x1000)
        self.assertIn("Spiel-Image", str(c.exception))
        self.assertIn("0x400000", str(c.exception))

    def test_foreign_module_far_away_is_not_used(self):
        a = E.CaveAllocator(Backend(self.maps(), [(0x7000000000, 0x7000100000)]), log=lambda _m: None, image_base=BASE)
        with self.assertRaises(E.ExportError):
            a.alloc(0x40, BASE + 0x1000)

    def test_fallback_above_base_outside_contiguous_image_warns(self):
        maps = [(BASE, BASE + 0x100000, 5), (BASE + 0x40000000, BASE + 0x40100000, 5)]    # 1 GiB Luecke -> nicht zusammenhaengend
        logs = []
        be = Backend(maps, [(BASE + 0x40000000, BASE + 0x40100000)])
        a = E.CaveAllocator(be, log=logs.append, image_base=BASE)
        cave, _ = a.alloc(0x40, BASE + 0x1000)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(cave, BASE + 0x40000000)
        self.assertTrue(a.used_outside)
        self.assertTrue(any("WARNUNG" in m for m in logs))

    def test_release_gives_space_back(self):
        a, (cave, size) = self.alloc([(BASE, BASE + 0x400000)])
        a.release(cave, size)
        cave2, _ = a.alloc(0x40, BASE + 0x1000)
        self.assertEqual(cave, cave2)

    def test_successive_allocations_do_not_overlap_and_stay_aligned(self):
        be = Backend(self.maps(), [(BASE, BASE + 0x400000)])
        a = E.CaveAllocator(be, log=lambda _m: None, image_base=BASE)
        c1, _ = a.alloc(0x25, BASE + 0x1000)
        c2, _ = a.alloc(0x25, BASE + 0x1000)
        self.assertEqual((c1 % 16, c2 % 16), (0, 0))
        self.assertLessEqual(c2 + 0x30, c1)

    def test_build_mods_passes_the_image_base_to_the_allocator(self):
        seen = {}
        orig = E.CaveAllocator

        class Spy(orig):
            def __init__(self, backend, log=print, image_base=None):
                seen["base"] = image_base
                super().__init__(backend, log, image_base)
        E.CaveAllocator = Spy
        try:
            E.build_mods(Backend(self.maps(), []), [], BASE, log=lambda _m: None)
        finally:
            E.CaveAllocator = orig
        self.assertEqual(seen["base"], BASE)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_export_cave_scope.py`:

```py
"""Regression: "Cave-Adresse 0xffd0 liegt unter der Basis 0x400000".  Der Cave-Allokator suchte in ALLEN ausfuehrbaren
Regionen des Prozesses (Bibliotheken, Tiny-Regionen unter der Basis) und nahm die groesste Padding-Luecke - ein JSON-
Offset kann dort aber nicht hinzeigen.  Jetzt: nur das Spiel-Image."""
import os
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))

import cave_trainer
import export_goldhen as E

BASE = 0x400000
# (start, end, prot, fuellbyte am Ende, Laenge des Fuellers)
REGIONS = [
    (0x0000E000, 0x00010000, 5, 0xCC, 0x1800),        # winzige Exec-Region UNTER der Basis (hier lag 0xffd0), groesster Fueller
    (0x00400000, 0x00600000, 5, 0x00, 0x300),         # Spiel-Image: .text
    (0x00600000, 0x00700000, 1, 0x00, 0x0),           # Spiel-Image: .rodata
    (0x00700000, 0x00800000, 3, 0x00, 0x0),           # Spiel-Image: .data
    (0x7F0000000, 0x7F0100000, 5, 0xCC, 0x4000),      # Systembibliothek weit weg, ebenfalls grosser Fueller
]


class Backend:
    def __init__(self, regions=REGIONS):
        self.regions = regions

    def get_maps(self, force=False):
        return [(s, e, p) for s, e, p, _f, _n in self.regions]

    def read(self, addr, n):
        for s, e, _p, fill, run in self.regions:
            if s <= addr and addr + n <= e:
                data = bytearray(b"\x90" * (e - s))              # Code
                data[len(data) - run:] = bytes([fill]) * run     # Padding am Ende
                return bytes(data[addr - s:addr - s + n])
        raise OSError(f"nicht lesbar {addr:#x}")


class CaveScopeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_old_behaviour_picked_the_region_below_the_base(self):
        a = E.CaveAllocator(Backend(), log=lambda _m: None)                 # ohne Basis = altes Verhalten
        cave, _n = a.alloc(0x100, 0xB2C491)
        self.assertLess(cave, BASE)                                          # genau der gemeldete Fehler (0xffd0)

    def test_cave_is_taken_from_the_game_image_only(self):
        a = E.CaveAllocator(Backend(), log=lambda _m: None, image_base=BASE)
        cave, n = a.alloc(0x100, 0xB2C491)
        self.assertTrue(BASE <= cave and cave + n <= 0x600000, hex(cave))   # im .text des Spiels
        self.assertEqual(cave + n, 0x600000 & ~0xF)                          # am Region-Ende (Segment-Padding)
        cave2, _n = a.alloc(0x100, 0xB2C491)
        self.assertEqual(cave2 + 0x100, cave)                                # naechste Cave davor, nie woanders

    def test_many_caves_never_leave_the_image(self):
        a = E.CaveAllocator(Backend(), log=lambda _m: None, image_base=BASE)
        for _ in range(3):
            cave, n = a.alloc(0x100, 0xB2C491)
            self.assertTrue(0x600000 - 0x300 <= cave and cave + n <= 0x600000)
        with self.assertRaises(E.ExportError):                               # Padding ist alle -> Fehler statt Fremdregion
            for _ in range(5):
                a.alloc(0x100, 0xB2C491)

    def test_image_span(self):
        span = cave_trainer.image_span(Backend().get_maps(), BASE)
        self.assertEqual([(s, e) for s, e, _p in span], [(0x400000, 0x600000), (0x600000, 0x700000), (0x700000, 0x800000)])
        self.assertEqual(cave_trainer.image_span(Backend().get_maps(), 0x123456), [])

    def test_wrong_base_falls_back_to_regions_above_it_and_says_so(self):
        msgs = []
        a = E.CaveAllocator(Backend(), log=msgs.append, image_base=0x500)         # Basis liegt in keiner Region
        cave, _n = a.alloc(0x100, 0xB2C491)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(cave, 0x500)                                 # nie unter der Basis
        self.assertTrue(any("keiner Speicherregion" in m for m in msgs))

    def test_build_mods_uses_the_game_image(self):
        """Durchgang durch build_mods: Offsets sind nie negativ, die Cave liegt im Image."""
        import reapatch
        import tempfile, json
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        patch = os.path.join(d, "Inf Hp.reapproj")
        json.dump({"name": "Inf Hp", "ImageBase": hex(BASE), "Variables": [
            {"label": "OriginSource", "offset": "0xb2c491", "defaultValue": "90 90 90 90 90",
             "newValue": "90 90 90 90 90"}]}, open(patch, "w"))
        rp = reapatch.ReapPatch.load(patch)
        be = Backend()
        be.pid = 1
        mods, report = E.build_mods(be, [rp], BASE, log=lambda _m: None)
        self.assertNotIn("liegt unter der Basis", " ".join(r["msg"] for r in report))


HOOK_RVA = 0x1000                                   # Hook-Stelle im Image: vmovss [rbx+0x11C], xmm0
ORIG = bytes.fromhex("C5FA11831C010000")
HP_ASM = """cmp byte ptr [rbx+0x49A], 1
jne skip
mov dword ptr [rbx+0x11C], 0x457A0000
jmp OriginReturn
skip:
vmovss dword ptr [rbx+0x11C], xmm0
jmp OriginReturn"""


class CaveBackend(Backend):
    """Image mit der Hook-Stelle; assemble() ueber Keystone wie im echten Tool."""
    pid = 1

    def __init__(self, regions):
        super().__init__(regions)

    def read(self, addr, n):
        data = bytearray(super().read(addr, n))
        for i in range(n):
            if BASE + HOOK_RVA <= addr + i < BASE + HOOK_RVA + len(ORIG):
                data[i] = ORIG[addr + i - BASE - HOOK_RVA]
        return bytes(data)

    def assemble(self, text, base=0):
        from asm_tools import assemble
        return assemble(text, base)


def hp_patch():
    import reapatch
    rp = reapatch.ReapPatch("Inf Hp.reapproj")
    rp.name = "Inf Hp"
    rp.origin_source = (HOOK_RVA, "vmovss dword ptr [rbx+0x11C], xmm0", "jmp OriginTarget\nnop\nnop\nnop")
    rp.origin_return_offset = 8
    rp.labels = [("OriginTarget", HP_ASM)]
    return rp


try:
    import keystone  # noqa: F401
    import capstone  # noqa: F401
    HAVE_ASM = True
except ImportError:  # pragma: no cover
    HAVE_ASM = False


@unittest.skipUnless(HAVE_ASM, "keystone/capstone fehlen")
class CaveExportTests(unittest.TestCase):
    TEXT = (0x00400000, 0x00600000, 5, 0x00, 0x300)       # r-x, Padding am Ende
    RWX = (0x00600000, 0x00700000, 7, 0x00, 0x4000)       # rwx mit GROESSEREM Padding (unsicher: kann Spiel-Daten sein)
    DATA = (0x00700000, 0x00800000, 3, 0x00, 0x0)

    def export(self, regions):
        msgs = []
        mods, report = E.build_mods(CaveBackend(regions), [hp_patch()], BASE, log=msgs.append)
        return mods, report, msgs

    def test_cave_goes_to_rx_region_even_if_a_writable_one_has_more_room(self):
        mods, report, _m = self.export([self.TEXT, self.RWX, self.DATA])
        self.assertEqual(report[0]["status"], "ok", report)
        cave, hook = mods[0]["memory"]
        addr = BASE + int(cave["offset"], 16)
        self.assertTrue(0x600000 - 0x300 <= addr < 0x600000, hex(addr))                 # im r-x-Padding
        self.assertIn("r-x", report[0]["msg"])
        self.assertIn("Region 0x400000-0x600000", report[0]["msg"])

    def test_untick_keeps_the_cave_and_only_restores_the_hook(self):
        """Reihenfolge der Eintraege = Reihenfolge des Schreibens: 'off' darf die Cave nicht vor dem Hook nullen."""
        mods, _r, _m = self.export([self.TEXT, self.RWX, self.DATA])
        cave, hook = mods[0]["memory"]
        self.assertEqual(cave["on"], cave["off"])
        self.assertNotEqual(set(bytes.fromhex(cave["off"])), {0})
        self.assertEqual(bytes.fromhex(hook["off"]), ORIG)                              # Hook: Original zurueck
        self.assertTrue(hook["on"].startswith("E9"))                                    # jmp rel32 + nops
        self.assertEqual(len(bytes.fromhex(hook["on"])), 8)

    def test_falls_back_to_writable_region_with_warning_only_when_needed(self):
        full_text = (0x00400000, 0x00600000, 5, 0x00, 0x0)                              # r-x ohne freies Padding
        mods, report, msgs = self.export([full_text, self.RWX, self.DATA])
        self.assertEqual(report[0]["status"], "ok", report)
        addr = BASE + int(mods[0]["memory"][0]["offset"], 16)
        self.assertTrue(0x700000 - 0x4000 <= addr < 0x700000, hex(addr))
        self.assertTrue(any("WARNUNG" in m and "beschreibbare" in m for m in msgs))
        self.assertIn("rwx", report[0]["msg"])

    def test_no_space_anywhere_is_an_error_not_a_foreign_region(self):
        full = (0x00400000, 0x00600000, 5, 0x00, 0x0)
        _mods, report, _m = self.export([full, self.DATA, REGIONS[0], REGIONS[4]])      # unter der Basis / Bibliothek ignoriert
        self.assertEqual(report[0]["status"], "error")
        self.assertIn("Kein freier Platz", report[0]["msg"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
import os, sys, tempfile, unittest
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
import export_goldhen as E, cheatfmt as C

MODS = [{"name": "Unendlich HP", "type": "checkbox",
         "memory": [{"offset": "751BF8", "on": "9090", "off": "FF4B"}]}]

class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self._orig = E.build_mods
        E.build_mods = lambda *a, **k: (MODS, [])
    def tearDown(self): E.build_mods = self._orig

    def run_fmt(self, fmt, tid="CUSA12345", ver="01.05"):
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp(); p = os.path.join(d, "x." + fmt)
        doc, rep, issues = E.export(None, [], 0x400000, p, "Spiel", tid, ver, "eboot.bin", ["Ich"], fmt=fmt)
        return p, doc, issues

    def test_all_formats_roundtrip(self):
        for fmt in ("json", "shn", "mc4"):
            p, doc, issues = self.run_fmt(fmt)
            self.assertTrue(os.path.exists(p), fmt)
            back = C.load_file(p)
            self.assertEqual(back["mods"][0]["memory"][0]["on"], "9090", fmt)
            self.assertEqual(back["id"], "CUSA12345")

    def test_bad_id_not_written(self):
        p, doc, issues = self.run_fmt("mc4", tid="FOO", ver="1")
        self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(p))
        self.assertEqual(doc["mods"], [])
        self.assertTrue(any("NICHT geschrieben" in i for i in issues))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_gameprofile_cheatlist.py`:

```py
"""Tests: Spiel-Profile (Speichern/Laden) und Cheat-Listen-Logik (Suche, Favoriten, Gruppen, Hotkeys)."""
import json
import os
import shutil
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
import cheatlist as CL
import gameprofile as GP


class Profile(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, self.d, True)

    def test_key_for(self):
        self.assertEqual(GP.key_for("ppsa01234", "x"), "PPSA01234")
        self.assertEqual(GP.key_for("CUSA12345"), "CUSA12345")
        self.assertEqual(GP.key_for("", "Super Game: Deluxe/Edition?"), "Super Game_ Deluxe_Edition")
        self.assertEqual(GP.key_for("", ""), "default")
        self.assertEqual(GP.key_for("PPSA1", "Name"), "Name")                 # ungueltige ID -> Projektname

    def test_roundtrip(self):
        gp = GP.GameProfile("PPSA01234", self.d)
        gp.title, gp.notes = "Super Game", "Boss 2: Phase 3\nSchwachstelle Ruecken"
        gp.toggle_favorite("Inf Hp.reapproj")
        gp.set_group("Inf Hp.reapproj", "Leben")
        gp.set_hotkey("Inf Hp.reapproj", "F5")
        gp.ui = {"group": "Leben", "only_fav": True}
        gp.discover = {"sig": "1/2/3", "json": "{}"}
        self.assertTrue(gp.save())
        b = GP.load("PPSA01234", self.d)
        self.assertEqual((b.title, b.notes), ("Super Game", "Boss 2: Phase 3\nSchwachstelle Ruecken"))
        self.assertEqual((b.favorites, b.groups, b.hotkeys), ({"Inf Hp.reapproj"}, {"Inf Hp.reapproj": "Leben"}, {"Inf Hp.reapproj": "F5"}))
        self.assertEqual((b.ui, b.discover), ({"group": "Leben", "only_fav": True}, {"sig": "1/2/3", "json": "{}"}))
        self.assertGreater(b.updated, 0)
        self.assertFalse(os.path.exists(gp.path() + ".tmp"))

    def test_missing_and_broken_files(self):
        gp = GP.load("PPSA99999", self.d)
        self.assertEqual((gp.notes, gp.favorites), ("", set()))
        p = os.path.join(self.d, "PPSA11111.json")
        with open(p, "w") as f:
            f.write("{kaputt")
        gp = GP.load("PPSA11111", self.d)
        self.assertEqual(gp.favorites, set())
        self.assertTrue(os.path.exists(p + ".bad"))                              # Original bleibt erhalten
        with open(p, "w") as f:
            json.dump([1, 2], f)
        self.assertEqual(GP.load("PPSA11111", self.d).notes, "")
        with open(p, "w") as f:
            json.dump({"favorites": ["a", 5], "groups": None, "discover": {"zu": "wenig"}}, f)
        gp = GP.load("PPSA11111", self.d)
        self.assertEqual((gp.favorites, gp.groups, gp.discover), ({"a"}, {}, None))

    def test_hotkey_conflicts_and_cleanup(self):
        gp = GP.GameProfile("k", self.d)
        self.assertIsNone(gp.set_hotkey("a", "F5"))
        self.assertEqual(gp.set_hotkey("b", "F5"), "a")                         # Konflikt: nichts gesetzt
        self.assertNotIn("b", gp.hotkeys)
        self.assertIsNone(gp.set_hotkey("a", "F5"))                             # gleicher Cheat darf neu setzen
        gp.clear_hotkey("a")
        self.assertIsNone(gp.set_hotkey("b", "F5"))
        gp.toggle_favorite("x"); gp.toggle_favorite("b"); gp.set_group("x", "G")
        gp.forget_missing(["b"])
        self.assertEqual((gp.favorites, gp.groups, gp.hotkeys), ({"b"}, {}, {"b": "F5"}))

    def test_group_names_and_unsetting(self):
        gp = GP.GameProfile("k", self.d)
        gp.set_group("a", "zeta"); gp.set_group("b", "Alpha"); gp.set_group("c", "Alpha")
        self.assertEqual(gp.group_names(), ["Alpha", "zeta"])
        gp.set_group("a", "  ")
        self.assertEqual(gp.group_names(), ["Alpha"])
        self.assertFalse(gp.toggle_favorite("a") is False)                      # erster Aufruf: an
        self.assertFalse(gp.toggle_favorite("a"))                               # zweiter: aus

    def test_save_failure_is_reported_not_raised(self):
        blocker = os.path.join(self.d, "datei")
        open(blocker, "w").close()
        self.assertFalse(GP.GameProfile("k", os.path.join(blocker, "x")).save())


ITEMS = [("/p/Inf Hp.reapproj", "Inf Hp"), ("/p/Inf Shield.reapproj", "Inf Shield"), ("/p/Gold x10.reapproj", "Gold x10"),
         ("/p/Alle Items.reapproj", "Alle Items"), ("/p/Schnell.reapproj", "Schnell")]


class ListLogic(unittest.TestCase):
    def gp(self):
        gp = GP.GameProfile("k", None)
        gp.set_group("Inf Hp.reapproj", "Leben")
        gp.set_group("Inf Shield.reapproj", "Leben")
        gp.set_group("Gold x10.reapproj", "Geld")
        gp.toggle_favorite("Schnell.reapproj")
        return gp

    def names(self, order):
        return [p.rsplit("/", 1)[-1][:-9] for p in order]

    def test_default_order_favorites_then_groups_then_ungrouped(self):
        order = CL.visible_order(ITEMS, self.gp())
        self.assertEqual(self.names(order), ["Schnell", "Gold x10", "Inf Hp", "Inf Shield", "Alle Items"])

    def test_search_matches_name_and_group_case_insensitive(self):
        gp = self.gp()
        self.assertEqual(self.names(CL.visible_order(ITEMS, gp, "inf")), ["Inf Hp", "Inf Shield"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(CL.visible_order(ITEMS, gp, "GELD")), ["Gold x10"])               # Treffer ueber den Gruppennamen
        self.assertEqual(CL.visible_order(ITEMS, gp, "gibtsnicht"), [])
        self.assertEqual(len(CL.visible_order(ITEMS, gp, "   ")), 5)

    def test_group_and_favorite_filters(self):
        gp = self.gp()
        self.assertEqual(self.names(CL.visible_order(ITEMS, gp, group="Leben")), ["Inf Hp", "Inf Shield"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(CL.visible_order(ITEMS, gp, group=CL.NO_GROUP)), ["Schnell", "Alle Items"])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(CL.visible_order(ITEMS, gp, only_fav=True)), ["Schnell"])
        self.assertEqual(CL.visible_order(ITEMS, gp, group="Leben", only_fav=True), [])
        self.assertEqual(self.names(CL.visible_order(ITEMS, None)), sorted(self.names(CL.visible_order(ITEMS, None)), key=str.lower))

    def test_windows_paths_use_the_file_name(self):
        gp = GP.GameProfile("k", None)
        gp.toggle_favorite("B.reapproj")
        order = CL.visible_order([("C:\\x\\A.reapproj", "A"), ("C:\\x\\B.reapproj", "B")], gp)
        self.assertEqual(order[0], "C:\\x\\B.reapproj")


class Hotkeys(unittest.TestCase):
    def spec(self, k, s, plat="win32"):
        return CL.spec_from_event(k, s, plat)

    def test_spec_from_event(self):
        self.assertEqual(self.spec("F5", 0), "F5")
        self.assertEqual(self.spec("F5", 0x4), "Ctrl+F5")
        self.assertEqual(self.spec("F5", 0x4 | 0x1), "Ctrl+Shift+F5")
        self.assertEqual(self.spec("a", 0x4), "Ctrl+A")
        self.assertEqual(self.spec("A", 0x1 | 0x4), "Ctrl+Shift+A")
        self.assertEqual(self.spec("a", 0x20000), "Alt+A")                      # Windows: Alt = 0x20000
        self.assertEqual(self.spec("a", 0x8, "win32"), "A")                     # Windows: 0x8 ist NumLock, kein Alt
        self.assertEqual(self.spec("a", 0x8, "linux"), "Alt+A")
        self.assertEqual(self.spec("1", 0x4), "Ctrl+1")
        self.assertEqual(self.spec("F5", 0x8, "win32"), "F5")                   # NumLock stoert F-Tasten nicht
        self.assertIsNone(self.spec("Control_L", 0x4))
        self.assertIsNone(self.spec("Shift_R", 0x1))
        self.assertIsNone(self.spec("", 0))

    def test_valid_spec_rules(self):
        for ok in ("F1", "F12", "F24", "Ctrl+F5", "Ctrl+1", "Alt+X", "Ctrl+Shift+A"):
            self.assertTrue(CL.valid_spec(ok), ok)
        for bad in ("", "A", "1", "Shift+A", "Escape", "Tab", "Return", "Ctrl+C", "Ctrl+V", "Alt+F4", "F25", "F0", "Ctrl+Tab"):
            self.assertFalse(CL.valid_spec(bad), bad)

    def test_typing_in_text_fields_blocks_hotkeys(self):
        for c in ("Entry", "TEntry", "TCombobox", "Text"):
            self.assertTrue(CL.typing_in_text(c))
        for c in ("Button", "Frame", "Canvas", "Tk"):
            self.assertFalse(CL.typing_in_text(c))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
"""GUI-Logik der Cheat-Liste im Hauptfenster (ohne Display): Filter, Favoriten, Gruppen, Hotkeys, Karten-Menue."""
import os
import sys
import time
import types
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))

import gameprofile as GP

from i18n import Translator


class Var:
    def __init__(self, v=""): self.v = v
    def get(self): return self.v
    def set(self, v): self.v = v


class Card:
    def __init__(self, path, name, author=""):
        self.path, self.rp = path, types.SimpleNamespace(name=name, author=author)
        self.state, self.gridded, self.clicks, self.meta = gui.St.OFF, None, 0, 0
    def grid(self, **k): self.gridded = (k["row"], k["column"])
    def grid_remove(self): self.gridded = None
    def refresh_meta(self): self.meta += 1
    def _click(self): self.clicks += 1


def make_app():
    app = object.__new__(gui.App)
    app.tr = Translator("de")
    app.logs = []
    app.log_msg = lambda m, tag=None: app.logs.append((tag, m))
    app.gp = GP.GameProfile("PPSA00001", None)
    app.gp.save = lambda: True
    app.cards = {f"/p/{n}.reapproj": Card(f"/p/{n}.reapproj", n) for n in ("Inf Hp", "Inf Shield", "Gold", "Schnell")}
    app._cols = 2
    app._hotkeys, app._last_hot = {}, ("", 0.0)
    app.v_search, app.v_group, app.v_favonly = Var(), Var(app.tr.t("filter_all")), Var(False)
    app.group_combo = types.SimpleNamespace(configure=lambda **k: setattr(app, "combo_values", k.get("values")))
    app.cards_frame = types.SimpleNamespace(columnconfigure=lambda *a, **k: None)
    return app


class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.app = make_app()

    def shown(self):
        return {os.path.basename(p)[:-9]: c.gridded for p, c in self.app.cards.items()}

    def test_search_hides_and_shows_cards(self):
        a = self.app
        a._grid_cards(2)
        self.assertTrue(all(v is not None for v in self.shown().values()))
        a.v_search.set("inf")
        a._apply_filter()
        s = self.shown()
        self.assertIsNone(s["Gold"])
        self.assertIsNone(s["Schnell"])
        self.assertEqual({s["Inf Hp"], s["Inf Shield"]}, {(0, 0), (0, 1)})
        a.v_search.set("")
        a._apply_filter()
        self.assertTrue(all(v is not None for v in self.shown().values()))

    def test_favorite_group_and_filters(self):
        a = self.app
        card = a.cards["/p/Schnell.reapproj"]
        a.toggle_favorite(card)
        self.assertIn("Schnell.reapproj", a.gp.favorites)
        self.assertEqual(self.shown()["Schnell"], (0, 0))                       # Favoriten zuerst
        self.assertTrue(all(c.meta >= 1 for c in a.cards.values()))
        a.v_favonly.set(True)
        a._apply_filter()
        self.assertEqual([n for n, v in self.shown().items() if v is not None], ["Schnell"])
        self.assertEqual(a.gp.ui["only_fav"], True)
        a.v_favonly.set(False)
        a.gp.set_group("Inf Hp.reapproj", "Leben")
        a._refresh_group_values()
        self.assertEqual(a.combo_values, ["Alle", "(ohne Gruppe)", "Leben"])
        a.v_group.set("Leben")
        a._apply_filter()
        self.assertEqual([n for n, v in self.shown().items() if v is not None], ["Inf Hp"])
        a.v_group.set("(ohne Gruppe)")
        a._apply_filter()
        self.assertEqual(sorted(n for n, v in self.shown().items() if v is not None), ["Gold", "Inf Shield", "Schnell"])
        self.assertEqual(a.gp.ui["group"], "(ohne Gruppe)")

    def test_group_vanishing_resets_filter_to_all(self):
        a = self.app
        a.gp.set_group("Gold.reapproj", "Geld")
        a._refresh_group_values()
        a.v_group.set("Geld")
        a.gp.set_group("Gold.reapproj", "")
        a._refresh_group_values()

    def test_hotkey_choice_validation_conflict_and_apply(self):
        a = self.app

        self.assertEqual(a._hotkey_chosen(c1, None), "wait")                    # nur Modifier gedrueckt: weiter warten
        self.assertEqual(a._hotkey_chosen(c1, "A"), "bad")
        self.assertEqual(a.logs[-1][0], "warn")
        self.assertEqual(a._hotkey_chosen(c1, "F5"), "ok")
        self.assertEqual(a._hotkeys, {"F5": "/p/Gold.reapproj"})
        self.assertEqual(a._hotkey_chosen(c2, "F5"), "conflict:Gold.reapproj")
        self.assertNotIn("Schnell.reapproj", a.gp.hotkeys)
        a.clear_card_hotkey(c1)
        self.assertEqual(a._hotkeys, {})

    def key(self, keysym, state=0, cls="Frame"):
        return types.SimpleNamespace(keysym=keysym, state=state, widget=types.SimpleNamespace(winfo_class=lambda: cls))

    def test_hotkey_fires_toggles_once_and_ignores_text_fields_and_repeats(self):
        a = self.app
        a._hotkey_chosen(a.cards["/p/Gold.reapproj"], "F5")
        gold = a.cards["/p/Gold.reapproj"]
        self.assertEqual(a._on_key(self.key("F5")), "break")
        self.assertEqual(gold.clicks, 1)
        self.assertEqual(a._on_key(self.key("F5")), "break")                    # Tastenwiederholung (<0,4 s)
        self.assertEqual(gold.clicks, 1)
        a._last_hot = ("F5", time.time() - 1)
        a._on_key(self.key("F5"))
        self.assertEqual(gold.clicks, 2)
        self.assertIsNone(a._on_key(self.key("F5", cls="Entry")))               # beim Tippen nichts ausloesen
        self.assertIsNone(a._on_key(self.key("F6")))
        self.assertEqual(gold.clicks, 2)
        a._hotkeys = {}
        self.assertIsNone(a._on_key(self.key("F5")))

    def test_card_menu_items_follow_state_and_profile(self):
        a = self.app
        card = types.SimpleNamespace(app=a, path="/p/Gold.reapproj", state=gui.St.OFF, rp=types.SimpleNamespace(name="Gold", author=""),
                                     _click=None, _info=None, _copy_name=None, _show_file=None)
        labels = [i[0] for i in gui.CheatCard.menu_items(card) if i[0]]
        self.assertEqual(labels, ["Aktivieren", "Info anzeigen", "★ Als Favorit markieren", "Gruppe setzen…", "Hotkey setzen…",
                                  "Namen kopieren", "Patch-Datei im Ordner zeigen"])
        a.gp.favorites.add("Gold.reapproj")
        a.gp.hotkeys["Gold.reapproj"] = "F5"
        card.state = gui.St.ON
        labels = [i[0] for i in gui.CheatCard.menu_items(card) if i[0]]
        self.assertEqual(labels[0], "Deaktivieren")
        self.assertIn("Favorit entfernen", labels)
        self.assertIn("Hotkey entfernen", labels)
        a.tr.set_lang("en")
        self.assertEqual(gui.CheatCard.menu_items(card)[0][0], "Deactivate")

    def test_refresh_meta_shows_star_group_and_hotkey(self):
        a = self.app
        a.gp.favorites.add("Gold.reapproj")
        a.gp.groups["Gold.reapproj"] = "Geld"
        a.gp.hotkeys["Gold.reapproj"] = "Ctrl+F5"
        out = {}
        lbl = lambda k: types.SimpleNamespace(configure=lambda **kw: out.setdefault(k, kw))   # noqa: E731
        card = types.SimpleNamespace(app=a, path="/p/Gold.reapproj", rp=types.SimpleNamespace(name="Gold", author="Michi"),
                                     lbl_name=lbl("n"), lbl_sub=lbl("s"))
        gui.CheatCard.refresh_meta(card)

        self.assertEqual(out["s"]["text"], "by : Michi  ·  [Geld]  ·  ⌨ Ctrl+F5")
        out.clear()

        self.assertEqual((out["n"]["text"], out["s"]["text"]), ("Gold", "by : Michi"))

    def test_load_game_profile_uses_title_id_and_restores_view(self):
        import gameprofile
        import tempfile
        d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        old = gameprofile.load
        gameprofile.load = lambda key, directory=None: old(key, d)
        try:
            a = self.app
            a.gp = None
            a.current_project, a.PATCH_DIR = "Super Game PPSA11111", "/x/y"
            pre = GP.GameProfile("PPSA11111", d)
            pre.ui = {"group": "Leben", "only_fav": True}
            pre.groups = {"A.reapproj": "Leben"}

            a._load_game_profile()
            self.assertEqual(a.gp.key, "PPSA11111")
            self.assertEqual((a.v_group.get(), a.v_favonly.get()), ("Leben", True))
            a.current_project, a.PATCH_DIR = "Ohne ID", "/x/z"
            a._load_game_profile()
            self.assertEqual(a.gp.key, "Ohne ID")
        finally:
            gameprofile.load = old
```

```py
"""GUI-Tests fuer den Tab CHEAT-MENUE (Fake-Tk, kein Display, keine Konsole)."""
import os
import struct
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))

import test_cheatmenu as TM
import uesdk
from test_gui_smoke import FakeWin


class FakeUeLive:
    def __init__(self, sdk, live):
        self.proj = type("P", (), {"sdk": sdk, "name": "Testspiel"})()
        self.live = live


FakeUeLive.__name__ = "UeLiveTab"


class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        import tools_cheatmenu_gui as G
        self.mem = TM.Mem()
        _menu, self.mem = TM.make(self.mem)                           # Speicher der Fake-Welt fuellen
        self.w = FakeWin()
        self.w.client = self.mem
        self.live = TM.FakeLive()
        self.ue = FakeUeLive(uesdk.parse_header_text(TM.SDK_TEXT), self.live)
        self.w.extra_tabs = [self.ue]
        self.t = G.CheatMenuTab(None, self.w)

    def errs(self):
        return [m for k, m in self.w.logs if k == "err"]

    def pick(self, label_part):
        iid = next(i for i, e in enumerate(self.t.view) if label_part in e.label)
        self.t.tv.sel = (str(iid),)
        self.t._on_select()
        return self.t.view[iid]

    def test_build_without_sdk_explains(self):
        self.ue.proj.sdk = None
        self.t.build()
        self.assertTrue(any("kein SDK" in m for m in self.errs()))

    def test_build_lists_reachable_entries(self):
        self.t.build()
        rows = list(self.t.tv.rows.values())
        self.assertTrue(rows)
        self.assertIn("erreichbar", self.t.v_info.get())
        god = next(r for r in rows if "Unverwundbar" in r[2])
        self.assertEqual(god[0], "☐")
        self.assertEqual(god[3], "bereit")

    def test_toggle_switches_the_game_value_and_back(self):
        self.t.build()
        self.pick("Unverwundbar")
        self.t.toggle()
        self.assertEqual(self.mem.read_memory(TM.PAWN + 0x58, 1)[0] & 0b100, 0)
        self.assertEqual(next(r for r in self.t.tv.rows.values() if "Unverwundbar" in r[2])[0], "✔")
        self.t.toggle()
        self.assertTrue(self.mem.read_memory(TM.PAWN + 0x58, 1)[0] & 0b100)
        self.assertEqual(self.errs(), [])

    def test_value_entry_uses_typed_number(self):
        self.t.build()
        self.pick("Lauftempo")
        self.assertEqual(self.t.v_val.get(), "1200")                      # Vorgabe wird eingetragen
        self.t.v_val.set("900")
        self.t.set_value()
        self.assertEqual(TM.f32(self.mem, TM.COMP + 0x178), 900.0)

    def test_set_value_on_a_switch_is_refused_politely(self):
        self.t.build()
        self.pick("Unverwundbar")
        self.t.set_value()
        self.assertTrue(any("Wert-Eintrag" in m for m in self.errs()))

    def test_tick_holds_values_and_reports_a_character_change(self):
        self.t.build()
        self.pick("Lauftempo")
        self.t.v_val.set("900")
        self.t.set_value()
        self.mem.put(TM.COMP + 0x178, struct.pack("<f", 600.0))           # Spiel setzt zurueck
        self.t._tick()
        self.assertEqual(TM.f32(self.mem, TM.COMP + 0x178), 900.0)
        self.mem.put(TM.CTRL + 0x100, struct.pack("<Q", 0x3100_0000))     # Figur gewechselt
        self.t._tick()
        self.assertTrue(any("gewechselt" in m for m in self.errs()))
        self.assertEqual(next(r for r in self.t.tv.rows.values() if "Lauftempo" in r[2])[0], "☐")

    def test_all_off_restores_everything(self):
        self.t.build()
        self.pick("Unverwundbar"); self.t.toggle()
        self.pick("Lauftempo"); self.t.v_val.set("900"); self.t.set_value()
        self.t.all_off()
        self.assertTrue(self.mem.read_memory(TM.PAWN + 0x58, 1)[0] & 0b100)
        self.assertEqual(TM.f32(self.mem, TM.COMP + 0x178), 600.0)

    def test_without_menu_actions_say_what_to_do(self):
        self.t.toggle()
        self.assertTrue(any("erst einen Eintrag" in m for m in self.errs()))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
def _rd(path):
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return f.read()


class Rec:
    def __init__(self): self.t = ""
    def delete(self, *a): self.t = ""
    def insert(self, _i, text): self.t += text
    def __getattr__(self, n): return lambda *a, **k: None


class FakeLive:
    index = {}

        self.lt = lt
        self.index = {0x7000_0000_8000: (1, 0x1111, "DT_Items"), 0x7000_0000_9000: (2, 0x1111, "DT_Enemies"),
                      0x7000_0000_A000: (3, 0x1111, "Default__DataTable")}
        self.rd, self.fname_str = lt.m.read, lt.fname
    def name(self, cl): return "DataTable"
    def is_template(self, ptr): return False

    def _client_with_entries(self):
        import struct
        m = TP.WMem()
        base = 0x7000_0300_0000
        heap = bytearray(0x2000)
        for off, ix, cnt in ((0x100, 10, 500), (0x140, 11, 7)):
            struct.pack_into("<II", heap, off, ix, 0)
            struct.pack_into("<i", heap, off + 8, cnt)
        m.put(base, heap)
        self.mem = m
        self.w.client = type("C", (), {"read_memory": lambda s, a, n: m.read(a, n), "write_memory": lambda s, a, d: m.write(a, bytes(d)),
                                       "get_maps": lambda s: [(base, base + 0x2000, 3), (0x10000, 0x20000, 5)]})()
        return base

    def test_find_entries_and_set_count(self):
        import struct
        import tkinter.simpledialog as sd
        base = self._client_with_entries()
        self.t.analyze()

        self.pick("Item-Struct", "FInvEntry")

        self.t.tv_rows.sel = ("0",)                                            # Item_Gold
        self.t.find_entries()
        self.assertEqual(self.errs(), [])
        self.assertEqual([(h.name, h.count) for h in self.t.hits], [("Item_Gold", 500)])
        self.assertEqual(self.t.hits[0].base, base + 0x100)
        self.t.v_cnt.set("500"); self.t.find_entries()
        self.assertEqual(len(self.t.hits), 1)
        self.t.tv_hits.sel = ("0",)
        sd.askstring = lambda *a, **k: "99999"
        self.t.set_entry_count()
        self.assertEqual(struct.unpack("<i", self.mem.read(base + 0x108, 4))[0], 99999)
        self.t.tv_hits.sel = (); self.w.logs.clear(); self.t.set_entry_count()
        self.assertTrue(self.errs())
        self.t.tv_hits.sel = ("0",); self.t._goto_hit()
        self.assertEqual(self.w.went[-1], ("mem", base + 0x108))

    def _cave_world(self, answer=False, name="Paket"):
        import tkinter.messagebox as mb
        import tkinter.simpledialog as sd
        import tools_discover_gui as G
        import test_cave_trainer as TS
        img = TS.FakeImage()
        out = tempfile.mkdtemp(); self.addCleanup(shutil.rmtree, out, True)
        self.w.client = type("C", (), {"read_memory": lambda s, a, n: img.read(a, n), "get_maps": lambda s: img.maps})()
        self.ue.live.function_entry = lambda owner, nm: (img.BASE + 0x1000,)
        self.t._hook_targets = lambda live: (img.pe, [img.slot], [])
        saved = [(G, "_find_impl", G._find_impl), (mb, "askyesnocancel", getattr(mb, "askyesnocancel", None)),
                 (self.fd, "askdirectory", getattr(self.fd, "askdirectory", None)), (sd, "askstring", getattr(sd, "askstring", None))]
        for o, a, v in saved:
            self.addCleanup(setattr, o, a, v)
        G._find_impl = lambda read, base, thunk: img.impl
        mb.askyesnocancel = lambda *a, **k: answer
        self.fd.askdirectory = lambda *a, **k: out
        sd.askstring = lambda *a, **k: name
        self.t.analyze()
        self.pick("Tabelle", "FItemRow"); self.t.read_table()
        return img, out
```

```py
import os

class TclObj:
    """Wie _tkinter.Tcl_Obj: weder int() noch Vergleich mit Zahlen funktioniert."""
    def __int__(self): raise TypeError("int() argument must be ... not '_tkinter.Tcl_Obj'")


class T(unittest.TestCase):

        card = types.SimpleNamespace(lbl_name=lbl)

            gui.CheatCard._on_resize(card, types.SimpleNamespace(width=width))
```

```py
import os, sys, unittest, struct

import ghost_tk; ghost_tk.install()


class FakeClient:
    def __init__(self): self.mem = bytearray(0x40000); self.nxt = 0x10000; self.pid = 1
    def read_memory(self, a, n): return bytes(self.mem[a:a + n])
    def write_memory(self, a, d): self.mem[a:a + len(d)] = d
    def allocate_memory(self, n): a = self.nxt; self.nxt += n + 0x100; return a
    def free_memory(self, a, n): pass
    def get_maps(self): return [(0x10000, 0x30000, 3), (0x1000, 0x2000, 5)]


class FakeWin:
    def __init__(self):
        self.client = FakeClient(); self.logs = []; self.went = []
        self.app = type("A", (), {"IMAGE_BASE": 0x400000, "backend": object()})()
    def bg(self, fn, ok=None, err=None, lock=True):
        try: r = fn()
        except Exception as e:
            (err or (lambda e: self.logs.append(("err", str(e)))))(e); return
        if ok: ok(r)
    def log(self, m, k="info"): self.logs.append((k, m))
    def goto_memory(self, a): self.went.append(("mem", a))
    def goto_disasm(self, a): self.went.append(("dis", a))
    def ui(self, fn): fn()


class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_imports(self):

        self.assertIn("0x1234", t.history[0])
        t.v_args[2].set("@nope"); t.run()
        self.assertTrue(any(k == "err" for k, _ in w.logs))

    def test_journal_tab(self):

            lost = 0
            def __init__(self, *a): started["args"] = a
            def start(self): return {"cave": 0x500000, "cave_size": 100, "data": 0x600000}
            def poll(self):
                return [{"index": 0, "ret": 0x401234, "rdi": 1, "rsi": 2, "rdx": 3, "rcx": 4, "r8": 5,
                         "r9": 6, "thread": 0}] * 3

        t.snapshot(); self.assertIsNotNone(t.snap)
```

```py
"""Tests fuer hackfx (ACCESS GRANTED / ACCESS DENIED beim Verbinden)."""
import os
import random

class FakeCanvas:
    def __init__(self, *a, **k): self.texts = []; self.rects = 0; self.lines = 0; self.bound = {}
    def pack(self, **k): pass
    def bind(self, seq, fn): self.bound[seq] = fn
    def delete(self, *a): self.texts = []; self.rects = 0; self.lines = 0
    def create_text(self, x, y, **k): self.texts.append(k.get("text", ""))
    def create_rectangle(self, *a, **k): self.rects += 1
    def create_line(self, *a, **k): self.lines += 1


class FakeTop:
    instances = []
    def __init__(self, root=None, **k):
        self.attrs, self.afters, self.destroyed, self.bound, self.cancelled = {}, [], False, {}, []
        FakeTop.instances.append(self)
    def overrideredirect(self, v): self.over = v
    def configure(self, **k): pass
    def attributes(self, *a): self.attrs[a[0]] = a[1] if len(a) > 1 else None
    def geometry(self, g): self.geo = g
    def bind(self, seq, fn): self.bound[seq] = fn
    def after(self, ms, fn): self.afters.append((ms, fn)); return len(self.afters)
    def after_cancel(self, job): self.cancelled.append(job)
    def destroy(self): self.destroyed = True


class Root:
    def winfo_rootx(self): return 100
    def winfo_rooty(self): return 50
    def winfo_width(self): return 1000
    def winfo_height(self): return 700


FAKE_TK = types.SimpleNamespace(Toplevel=FakeTop, Canvas=FakeCanvas)


class Clock:
    def __init__(self): self.now = 1000.0
    def __call__(self): return self.now


class Pure(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_classify_error_gives_helpful_reason(self):
        self.assertEqual(F.classify_error(ConnectionRefusedError(10061, "refused"))[0], "> CONNECTION REFUSED")
        self.assertIn("PAYLOAD", F.classify_error("Connection refused")[1])
        self.assertEqual(F.classify_error("[Errno 11001] getaddrinfo failed")[0], "> HOST UNREACHABLE")
        self.assertEqual(F.classify_error("[Errno 101] Network is unreachable")[0], "> HOST UNREACHABLE")
        self.assertEqual(F.classify_error("timed out")[0], "> NO RESPONSE FROM HOST")
        self.assertEqual(F.classify_error("Kein ps5debug-Payload gefunden")[0], "> CONNECTION REFUSED")
        self.assertEqual(F.classify_error("Kein Spiel-Prozess gefunden")[0], "> LINK OK - NO GAME PROCESS")
        other = F.classify_error("irgendein seltsamer Fehler " * 5)
        self.assertEqual(other[0], "> CONNECTION FAILED")
        self.assertLessEqual(len(other[1]), 48)
        self.assertEqual(F.classify_error("")[1], "> UNKNOWN ERROR")

    def test_granted_lines(self):
        self.assertEqual(F.granted_lines("1.2.3.4", 744, 99),
                         ["> HANDSHAKE ............ OK", "> TARGET 1.2.3.4:744", "> GAME PROCESS 99 ATTACHED"])
        self.assertEqual(F.granted_lines(), ["> HANDSHAKE ............ OK"])

    def test_typewriter(self):
        self.assertEqual(F.typed("ACCESS", 0.0, 10), "")
        self.assertEqual(F.typed("ACCESS", 0.25, 10), "AC")
        self.assertEqual(F.typed("ACCESS", 5, 10), "ACCESS")
        self.assertEqual(F.typed("ACCESS", 0.5, 10, start=0.3), "AC")
        self.assertEqual(F.typed("ACCESS", 0.1, 10, start=0.3), "")

    def test_glitch_only_in_window_and_deterministic(self):
        self.assertEqual(F.glitch(0.2), (0, 0, True))
        self.assertEqual(F.glitch(2.0), (0, 0, True))
        g = F.glitch(1.1, seed=3)
        self.assertEqual(g, F.glitch(1.1, seed=3))
        seen = {F.glitch(0.95 + i * 0.025, 0) for i in range(22)}
        self.assertGreater(len(seen), 3)                                  # es flackert wirklich
        self.assertTrue(all(abs(dx) <= 5 and abs(dy) <= 2 for dx, dy, _b in seen))

    def test_shake_decays(self):
        self.assertEqual(F.shake(1.3), 0)
        self.assertNotEqual(F.shake(0.02), 0)
        self.assertLessEqual(abs(F.shake(1.0)), 2)

    def test_alpha_fades_at_the_end(self):
        self.assertEqual(F.alpha(0.0, 3.0), 1.0)
        self.assertEqual(F.alpha(2.5, 3.0), 1.0)
        self.assertAlmostEqual(F.alpha(2.9, 3.0), 0.1 / F.FADE_S, places=3)
        self.assertEqual(F.alpha(3.0, 3.0), 0.0)

    def test_rain_falls_and_wraps(self):
        rng = random.Random(1)
        cols = [[0, 6, "A"], [F.H + 20, 6, "B"]]
        nxt = F.rain_step(cols, rng, F.H)
        self.assertEqual(nxt[0][0], 6)
        self.assertLessEqual(nxt[1][0], 0)                                # unten raus -> oben neu
        self.assertIn(nxt[1][1], (4, 6, 8, 10))

    def test_enabled_flag_and_env(self):
        self.assertTrue(F.enabled({}))
        self.assertFalse(F.enabled({"hack_fx": False}))
        os.environ["REAPERPY_NO_FX"] = "1"
        try:
            self.assertFalse(F.enabled({}))
        finally:
            del os.environ["REAPERPY_NO_FX"]


class BannerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        FakeTop.instances.clear()
        self.clock = Clock()
        self.old = F.time.time
        F.time.time = self.clock
        F._current = None

    def tearDown(self):
        F.time.time = self.old
        F._current = None

    def run_to_end(self, banner, step=0.1):
        top = FakeTop.instances[-1]
        guard = 0
        while not banner.closed and guard < 200:
            ms, fn = top.afters[-1]
            self.clock.now += step
            fn()
            guard += 1
        return top

    def test_granted_runs_about_three_seconds_then_closes(self):
        done = []
        b = F.Banner(Root(), True, F.granted_lines("1.2.3.4", 744, 7), on_done=lambda: done.append(1), tk=FAKE_TK)
        top = FakeTop.instances[-1]
        self.assertTrue(top.over)
        self.assertEqual(top.attrs["-topmost"], True)
        self.assertEqual(top.geo, "600x260+300+196")                      # mittig ueber dem Hauptfenster
        self.assertEqual(top.afters[-1][0], 45)
        self.clock.now += 0.4
        top.afters[-1][1]()
        shown = " ".join(b.cv.texts)
        self.assertTrue(any(t.startswith("ACC") for t in b.cv.texts), shown)    # Schreibmaschine laeuft
        self.assertGreater(b.cv.lines, 10)                                # Scanlines
        self.clock.now += 1.9                                              # alles getippt
        top.afters[-1][1]()
        self.assertTrue(any("ACCESS GRANTED" in t for t in b.cv.texts))
        self.assertTrue(any("TARGET 1.2.3.4:744" in t for t in b.cv.texts))
        self.run_to_end(b)
        self.assertTrue(top.destroyed)
        self.assertEqual(done, [1])
        self.assertGreaterEqual(self.clock.now - b.t0, F.GRANTED_S)
        self.assertLess(self.clock.now - b.t0, F.GRANTED_S + 0.3)

    def test_denied_is_red_and_shows_reason(self):
        b = F.Banner(Root(), False, F.classify_error("timed out"), tk=FAKE_TK)
        top = FakeTop.instances[-1]
        self.assertEqual(b.fg, F.RED)
        self.clock.now += 2.5
        top.afters[-1][1]()
        self.assertTrue(any("ACCESS DENIED" in t for t in b.cv.texts))
        self.assertTrue(any("NO RESPONSE FROM HOST" in t for t in b.cv.texts))
        self.run_to_end(b)
        self.assertGreaterEqual(self.clock.now - b.t0, F.DENIED_S)

    def test_click_closes_immediately_and_only_once(self):
        done = []
        b = F.Banner(Root(), True, ["x"], on_done=lambda: done.append(1), tk=FAKE_TK)
        b.cv.bound["<Button-1>"](None)
        b.close()
        self.assertTrue(FakeTop.instances[-1].destroyed)
        self.assertEqual(done, [1])
        self.assertIsNone(b.win)

    def test_fade_sets_alpha_near_the_end(self):
        b = F.Banner(Root(), True, ["x"], tk=FAKE_TK)
        top = FakeTop.instances[-1]
        self.clock.now += F.GRANTED_S - 0.1
        top.afters[-1][1]()
        self.assertLess(top.attrs.get("-alpha", 1.0), 1.0)

    def test_failures_in_the_ui_never_raise(self):
        class BadTop(FakeTop):
            def overrideredirect(self, v): raise RuntimeError("kein Display")
        b = F.Banner(Root(), True, ["x"], tk=types.SimpleNamespace(Toplevel=BadTop, Canvas=FakeCanvas))
        self.assertTrue(b.closed)
        self.assertIsNone(b.win)

        class BadCanvas(FakeCanvas):
            def create_text(self, *a, **k): raise RuntimeError("Zeichenfehler")
        done = []
        b = F.Banner(Root(), False, ["x"], on_done=lambda: done.append(1), tk=types.SimpleNamespace(Toplevel=FakeTop, Canvas=BadCanvas))
        self.assertTrue(b.closed)                                          # Fehler beim Zeichnen schliesst still
        self.assertEqual(done, [1])

    def test_show_respects_flag_replaces_previous_and_maps_kinds(self):
        self.assertIsNone(F.show(Root(), "granted", {}, {"hack_fx": False}, tk=FAKE_TK))
        self.assertEqual(FakeTop.instances, [])
        a = F.show(Root(), "granted", {"host": "h", "port": 1, "pid": 5}, {}, tk=FAKE_TK)
        self.assertTrue(a.ok)
        b = F.show(Root(), "denied", {"error": "Connection refused"}, {}, tk=FAKE_TK)
        self.assertTrue(a.closed)                                          # altes Banner wird ersetzt
        self.assertFalse(b.ok)
        self.assertEqual(b.lines[0], "> CONNECTION REFUSED")
        self.assertIsNone(F.show(Root(), "granted", {}, {}, tk=types.SimpleNamespace(Toplevel=None, Canvas=None)))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

```py
"""Englisch-Modus: Meldungen aus allen Modulen, Statuszeile, neue Fenster (Export-Dialog) - nichts bleibt still deutsch."""
import glob
import os
import re
import sys
import unittest

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import ghost_tk; ghost_tk.install()  # noqa: E702
import i18n_harvest as H
import tools_i18n as T
from tools_i18n_en import EN, SAME

ROOT = os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), "..")
GERMAN = re.compile(r"[äöüÄÖÜß]|\b(und|oder|nicht|kein|keine|Spiel|wird|fuer|für|mit|bitte|zuerst|gefunden|Fehler|Datei|"
                    r"Adresse|waehlen|wählen|schreiben|lesen|nach|aus|ein)\b", re.I)


class Lang:
    def __enter__(self):
        self.old = T.lang()
        T.set_lang("en")

    def __exit__(self, *a):
        T.set_lang(self.old)


class Backend(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_german_messages_in_all_modules_have_english(self):
        files = sorted(os.path.basename(f) for f in glob.glob(os.path.join(ROOT, "*.py")))
        old = (H.FILES, H.CTX)
        H.FILES = files
        H.CTX = H.CTX + ("Toplevel", "Entry", "Text", "Combobox", "_say", "say", "Frame")
        try:
            miss = [(f, s) for f, s in H.missing(set(EN) | SAME) if GERMAN.search(s)]
        finally:
            H.FILES, H.CTX = old
        self.assertEqual(miss, [], f"{len(miss)} deutsche Meldung(en) ohne Englisch, z. B. {miss[:5]}")

    def test_status_line_and_export_dialog_texts(self):
        with Lang():
            self.assertEqual(T.translate("verbunden"), "connected")
            self.assertEqual(T.translate("nicht verbunden"), "not connected")
            self.assertEqual(T.translate("TITEL-ID/VERSION VOM SPIEL"), "TITLE ID/VERSION FROM GAME")
            self.assertEqual(T.translate("Spielname"), "Game name")
            self.assertEqual(T.translate("EXPORTIEREN ..."), "EXPORT ...")
            self.assertEqual(T.translate("Erkannt: PPSA13197  \"eboot.bin\"  Version 01.014.001"),
                             "Detected: PPSA13197  \"eboot.bin\"  Version 01.014.001")
            self.assertIn("must be running", T.translate(
                "Spiel muss laufen und ps5debug verbunden sein. Cave-Platz und Original-Bytes werden live aus dem Spiel gelesen."))
        self.assertEqual(T.translate("verbunden"), "verbunden")            # DE bleibt unveraendert

    def test_german_values_never_leak_umlauts_into_english(self):
        bad = [(k, v) for k, v in EN.items() if re.search("[äöüßÄÖÜ]", v)]
        self.assertEqual(bad, [])

    def test_dictionary_status_reports_entries(self):
        n, err = T.status()
        self.assertGreater(n, 1000)
        self.assertEqual(err, "")

    def test_toplevel_hook_translates_new_windows(self):
        import types
        applied = []

        class Top:
            def __init__(self, *a, **k):
                self.calls = []

            def after(self, ms, fn):
                self.calls.append(ms)
                fn()

            def winfo_exists(self):
                return True
        tk = types.SimpleNamespace(Toplevel=Top)
        old = T.apply_to
        T.apply_to = lambda w: applied.append(w)
        try:
            T.install_toplevel_hook(tk)
            T.install_toplevel_hook(tk)                  # idempotent
            with Lang():
                t = tk.Toplevel()
                self.assertEqual(t.calls, [60, 400, 1500])
            self.assertEqual(len(applied), 3)
            applied.clear()
            tk.Toplevel()                                # DE: nichts tun
            self.assertEqual(applied, [])
        finally:
            T.apply_to = old


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```

`tests/test_il2cpp.py`:

```py
"""Tests fuer il2cpp_dump.py: Mini-dump.cs/script.json + simulierter Spielspeicher (keine Konsole noetig)."""
import json
import os
import struct
import tempfile
import unittest

import il2cpp_dump as D

DUMP = """// Image 0: Assembly-CSharp.dll - 0
// Image 1: mscorlib.dll - 3

// Namespace: Game
public enum ItemId // TypeDefIndex: 0
{
\tpublic int value__; // 0x0
\tpublic const ItemId None = 0;
\tpublic const ItemId Apple = 7;
}

// Namespace: Game
public class Wallet // TypeDefIndex: 1
{
\t// Fields
\tpublic int gold; // 0x10
\tpublic float luck; // 0x14
\tpublic bool god; // 0x18
\tpublic ItemId last; // 0x1C
\tpublic static Wallet Instance; // 0x0
\tpublic const int MAX = 99;

\t// Methods

\t// RVA: 0x1000 Offset: 0x1000 VA: 0x1000
\tpublic bool CanBuy(int price) { }

\t// RVA: 0x1010 Offset: 0x1010 VA: 0x1010
\tpublic void Spend(int n) { }

\t// RVA: 0x1020 Offset: 0x1020 VA: 0x1020
\tpublic float GetLuck() { }
}

// Namespace: Game
public class Hidden // TypeDefIndex: 2
{
\tpublic int hp; // 0x10
}

// Namespace: System
public class Object // TypeDefIndex: 3
{
}
"""
SCRIPT = {"ScriptMetadata": [{"Address": 0x2000, "Name": "Game.Wallet_TypeInfo", "Signature": "Game_Wallet_c*"}]}
BASE = 0x7000000
KLASS = 0x9000000


class FakeMem:
    def __init__(self):
        self.d = {}

    def put(self, addr, data):
        for i, b in enumerate(data):
            self.d[addr + i] = b

    def read(self, addr, n):
        return bytes(self.d.get(addr + i, 0) for i in range(n))


class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.tmp = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        sub = os.path.join(self.tmp.name, "a", "b")
        os.makedirs(sub)
        open(os.path.join(sub, "dump.cs"), "w").write(DUMP)
        json.dump(SCRIPT, open(os.path.join(sub, "script.json"), "w"), indent=2)
        self.g = D.GameDump(D.find_game_files(self.tmp.name), log=lambda m: None).load()

    def tearDown(self):
        self.tmp.cleanup()

    def test_parse(self):
        w = self.g.find_class("Game.Wallet")
        self.assertEqual([f.name for f in w.fields], ["gold", "luck", "god", "last", "Instance", "MAX"])
        self.assertEqual(w.find_field("gold").offset, 0x10)
        self.assertTrue(w.find_field("Instance").static)
        self.assertEqual(w.methods[0].rva, 0x1000)
        self.assertEqual(w.image, "Assembly-CSharp.dll")
        self.assertEqual(self.g.find_class("Object").image, "mscorlib.dll")
        e = self.g.find_class("ItemId")
        self.assertEqual(e.enum_values, [("None", 0), ("Apple", 7)])
        self.assertEqual(self.g.typeinfo_for(w), 0x2000)
        self.assertEqual(self.g.enum_search("item apple")[0][2], 7)

    def test_targets(self):
        names = {(c.name, f.name, p) for c, f, p, _s in self.g.value_targets()}
        self.assertIn(("Wallet", "gold", "int32"), names)
        self.assertIn(("Wallet", "last", "int32"), names)     # Enum-Feld
        self.assertNotIn(("Wallet", "Instance", "uint64"), names)

    def test_patch_bytes(self):
        m = self.g.find_class("Wallet").methods
        self.assertEqual(D.make_patch(m[0], "true"), b"\xb8\x01\x00\x00\x00\xc3")
        self.assertEqual(D.make_patch(m[1], "noop"), b"\xc3")
        self.assertEqual(D.make_patch(m[2], "value", 1.0), b"\xb8\x00\x00\x80\x3f\x66\x0f\x6e\xc0\xc3")
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            D.make_patch(m[1], "true")        # void
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            D.make_patch(m[0], "noop")        # bool darf nicht leer gemacht werden
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            D.make_patch(m[2], "true")        # float

    def test_live(self):
        mem = FakeMem()
        name_str, ns_str = 0x5000100, 0x5000200
        mem.put(name_str - 1, b"\0Wallet\0")
        mem.put(ns_str, b"Game\0")
        mem.put(KLASS + 0x10, struct.pack("<Q", name_str))
        mem.put(KLASS + 0x18, struct.pack("<Q", ns_str))
        mem.put(KLASS + 0x40, struct.pack("<Q", KLASS))
        mem.put(BASE + 0x2000, struct.pack("<Q", KLASS))
        mem.put(KLASS + D.K_STATIC_FIELDS, struct.pack("<Q", 0xA000000))
        inst = 0x8000040
        mem.put(inst, struct.pack("<Q", KLASS))
        mem.put(inst + 0x10, struct.pack("<i", 123))
        maps = [(BASE, BASE + 0x10000, 5), (0x5000000, 0x5001000, 1), (0x8000000, 0x8001000, 3), (KLASS, KLASS + 0x1000, 3)]
        # Basis wird gegen Klassennamen geprueft (Name an klass+0x10)
        self.assertEqual(D.find_module_base(mem.read, maps, self.g, log=lambda m: None), BASE)
        live = D.Il2CppLive(mem.read, self.g, BASE, maps, log=lambda m: None)
        w = self.g.find_class("Wallet")
        self.assertEqual(live.klass_ptr(w), KLASS)
        self.assertEqual(live.instances(w), [inst])
        self.assertEqual(live.static_base(w), 0xA000000)

    def _world(self):
        mem = FakeMem()
        name_str, ns_str = 0x5000100, 0x5000200
        mem.put(name_str - 1, b"\0Wallet\0")
        mem.put(ns_str, b"Game\0")
        mem.put(KLASS + 0x10, struct.pack("<Q", name_str))
        mem.put(KLASS + 0x18, struct.pack("<Q", ns_str))
        mem.put(KLASS + 0x40, struct.pack("<Q", KLASS))
        mem.put(BASE + 0x2000, struct.pack("<Q", KLASS))
        return mem

    def test_no_reads_outside_maps(self):
        """Regression: unmappte Adressen duerfen nie an die Konsole gehen (ein fehlgeschlagener Read kostet dort Sekunden)."""
        mem = self._world()
        maps = [(0x100000 + i * 0x20000, 0x100000 + i * 0x20000 + 0x1000, 5) for i in range(300)]
        maps += [(BASE, BASE + 0x10000, 5), (0x5000000, 0x5001000, 1), (KLASS, KLASS + 0x1000, 3)]
        bad = []

        def read(a, n):
            if not any(s <= a and a + n <= e for s, e, _p in maps):
                bad.append(a)
            return mem.read(a, n)

        self.assertEqual(D.find_module_base(read, maps, self.g, log=lambda m: None), BASE)
        self.assertEqual(bad, [])

    def test_base_in_the_middle_of_a_group(self):
        """Modul beginnt nicht am Anfang einer Speichergruppe (Module liegen ohne Luecke hintereinander)."""
        mem = self._world()
        maps = [(BASE - 0x100000, BASE, 5), (BASE, BASE + 0x10000, 5), (0x5000000, 0x5001000, 1), (KLASS, KLASS + 0x1000, 3)]
        self.assertEqual(D.find_module_base(mem.read, maps, self.g, log=lambda m: None), BASE)

    def test_uninitialized_slots_are_skipped(self):
        """IL2CPP fuellt TypeInfo-Zeiger erst beim ersten Benutzen: leere Slots duerfen die Basis nicht verwerfen."""
        import copy
        g = copy.copy(self.g)
        g.typeinfo_rva = dict(self.g.typeinfo_rva)
        for i, n in enumerate(("Game.Hidden", "Game.ItemId", "System.Object")):
            g.typeinfo_rva[n] = 0x1F00 + i * 8          # Slots bleiben 0
        g._slot_cache = None
        mem = self._world()
        maps = [(BASE, BASE + 0x10000, 5), (0x5000000, 0x5001000, 1), (KLASS, KLASS + 0x1000, 3)]
        ok, tried = D.check_base(mem.read, BASE, g, maps=maps)
        self.assertEqual((ok, tried), (1, 1))

    def test_execute_only_module_start_named(self):
        """PS5: der Code-Anfang eines Moduls ist nur ausfuehrbar (prot=4). Die Basis darf deshalb nicht an 'lesbar' haengen."""
        mem = self._world()
        maps = [(BASE, BASE + 0x1000, 4, "Il2CppUserAssemblies.prx"), (BASE + 0x1000, BASE + 0x10000, 3, "Il2CppUserAssemblies.prx"),
                (0x4000000, 0x4010000, 5, "eboot.bin"), (0x5000000, 0x5001000, 1, ""), (KLASS, KLASS + 0x1000, 3, "")]
        msgs = []
        self.assertEqual(D.find_module_base(mem.read, maps, self.g, log=msgs.append), BASE)
        self.assertTrue(any("Il2CppUserAssemblies.prx" in m for m in msgs))

    def test_execute_only_module_start_unnamed(self):
        """Auch ohne Modulnamen (aeltere Payload): jede Region zaehlt als Kandidat, nicht nur lesbare."""
        mem = self._world()
        maps = [(BASE, BASE + 0x1000, 4), (BASE + 0x1000, BASE + 0x10000, 3), (0x5000000, 0x5001000, 1), (KLASS, KLASS + 0x1000, 3)]
        self.assertEqual(D.find_module_base(mem.read, maps, self.g, log=lambda m: None), BASE)

    def test_failure_has_diagnosis(self):
        """Falscher Dump: Fehler mit Bericht (Modulname, Basis, was im Speicher steht) statt nur 'passt nicht'."""
        mem = self._world()
        mem.put(BASE + 0x2000, struct.pack("<Q", 0))           # Slot leer
        maps = [(BASE, BASE + 0x1000, 4, "Il2CppUserAssemblies.prx"), (BASE + 0x1000, BASE + 0x10000, 3, "Il2CppUserAssemblies.prx")]
        msgs = []
        with self.assertRaises(D.DumpError):
            D.find_module_base(mem.read, maps, self.g, log=msgs.append)
        text = "\n".join(msgs)
        self.assertIn("Diagnose Il2CppUserAssemblies.prx", text)
        self.assertIn("Alle Slots leer", text)

    def test_census_family_and_monitor(self):
        """census zaehlt Objekte je Klasse; Zeiger in Klassen-Strukturen (Monitor-Feld != 0) zaehlen nicht; Objekte von
        Unterklassen finden sich ueber die Basisklasse."""
        g = self.g
        mem = self._world()
        sub = 0x9100000                                       # Unterklasse 'Hidden' erbt von 'Wallet' (im Test per Hand)
        g.find_class("Hidden").base = "Wallet"
        g._parent = None
        del g._parent
        g.typeinfo_rva["Game.Hidden"] = 0x2008
        g._slot_cache = None
        name2, ns2 = 0x5000300, 0x5000200
        mem.put(name2 - 1, b"\0Hidden\0")
        mem.put(sub + 0x10, struct.pack("<Q", name2))
        mem.put(sub + 0x18, struct.pack("<Q", ns2))
        mem.put(sub + 0x40, struct.pack("<Q", sub))
        mem.put(sub + 0x48, struct.pack("<Q", sub))
        mem.put(BASE + 0x2008, struct.pack("<Q", sub))
        mem.put(KLASS + 0x48, struct.pack("<Q", KLASS))        # castClass zeigt auf sich: kein Objekt
        for i, addr in enumerate((0x8000040, 0x8000080)):      # 2 Wallets, 1 Hidden
            mem.put(addr, struct.pack("<QQ", KLASS, 0))
        mem.put(0x80000C0, struct.pack("<QQ", sub, 0))
        mem.put(0x8000100, struct.pack("<QQ", KLASS, 0x1234))  # Monitor gesetzt -> Klassen-Struktur-artig, ignoriert
        maps = [(BASE, BASE + 0x10000, 5), (0x5000000, 0x5001000, 1), (0x8000000, 0x8001000, 3),
                (KLASS, KLASS + 0x1000, 3), (sub, sub + 0x1000, 3)]
        live = D.Il2CppLive(mem.read, g, BASE, maps, log=lambda m: None)
        counts, inited = live.census()
        self.assertEqual(counts, {"Game.Wallet": 2, "Game.Hidden": 1})
        self.assertEqual(inited, {"Game.Wallet", "Game.Hidden"})
        w = g.find_class("Wallet")
        self.assertEqual(live.instances(w), [0x8000040, 0x8000080, 0x80000C0])   # inkl. Unterklasse
        self.assertEqual(live.instances(g.find_class("Hidden")), [0x80000C0])

    def _census_world(self):
        mem = self._world()
        mem.put(KLASS + 0x48, struct.pack("<Q", KLASS))
        for addr in (0x8000040, 0x8000080, 0x8001040):
            mem.put(addr, struct.pack("<QQ", KLASS, 0))
        maps = [(BASE, BASE + 0x10000, 5, "Il2CppUserAssemblies.prx"), (0x5000000, 0x5001000, 1, ""),
                (0x8000000, 0x8001000, 3, ""), (0x8001000, 0x8002000, 3, ""), (KLASS, KLASS + 0x1000, 3, "")]
        reads = []

        def read(a, n):
            reads.append((a, n))
            return mem.read(a, n)

        live = D.Il2CppLive(read, self.g, BASE, maps, log=lambda m: None)
        return mem, live, reads

    def test_instances_from_census_cache(self):
        """Nach census() liest instances() nur noch die Objekt-Koepfe (16 Byte) statt den Heap neu."""
        mem, live, reads = self._census_world()
        live.census()
        del reads[:]
        w = self.g.find_class("Wallet")
        self.assertEqual(live.instances(w), [0x8000040, 0x8000080, 0x8001040])
        self.assertEqual(live.last_source, "cache")
        self.assertTrue(all(n <= 16 for _a, n in reads), reads)

    def test_cache_drops_freed_objects(self):
        mem, live, reads = self._census_world()
        live.census()
        mem.put(0x8000080, struct.pack("<QQ", 0, 0))              # Objekt wurde freigegeben
        w = self.g.find_class("Wallet")
        self.assertEqual(live.instances(w), [0x8000040, 0x8001040])
        self.assertNotIn(0x8000080, live.objects["Game.Wallet"])

    def test_rescan_refreshes_cache(self):
        mem, live, reads = self._census_world()
        live.census()
        mem.put(0x8000100, struct.pack("<QQ", KLASS, 0))          # neues Objekt nach dem Scan
        w = self.g.find_class("Wallet")
        self.assertEqual(len(live.instances(w)), 3)                # Cache kennt es nicht
        self.assertEqual(len(live.instances(w, use_cache=False)), 4)
        self.assertEqual(live.last_source, "scan")
        self.assertEqual(len(live.instances(w)), 4)                # Cache ist erneuert

    def test_module_regions_are_skipped(self):
        maps = [(0x1000000, 0x1100000, 3, "Il2CppUserAssemblies.prx"), (0x2000000, 0x2100000, 3, "eboot.bin"),
                (0x3000000, 0x3100000, 3, ""), (0x4000000, 0x4100000, 3, "anon")]
        live = D.Il2CppLive(lambda a, n: b"", self.g, BASE, maps, log=lambda m: None)
        self.assertEqual(live.heap_regions(), [(0x3000000, 0x3100000), (0x4000000, 0x4100000)])

    def test_clean_names(self):
        C = D.Class("N", "Foo", "class")
        self.assertEqual(D.clean_field_name("<Reputation>k__BackingField"), "Reputation")
        self.assertEqual(D.clean_field_name("gold"), "gold")
        self.assertTrue(D.is_generated(D.Class("N", "UIMoneyHeld.<>c__DisplayClass30_0", "class")))
        self.assertTrue(D.is_generated(D.Class("N", "Foo.<Run>d__3", "class")))
        self.assertFalse(D.is_generated(C))
        self.assertTrue(D.is_generated(C, D.Field("<>4__this", "Foo", 0x10)))
        self.assertFalse(D.is_generated(C, D.Field("<Gold>k__BackingField", "int", 0x10)))

    def test_resolve_by_name(self):
        mem = FakeMem()
        k = 0x9000000
        mem.put(0x5000100 - 1, b"\0Hidden\0")
        mem.put(0x5000200, b"Game\0")
        mem.put(k + 0x10, struct.pack("<Q", 0x5000100))
        mem.put(k + 0x18, struct.pack("<Q", 0x5000200))
        mem.put(k + 0x40, struct.pack("<Q", k))
        maps = [(0x5000000, 0x5001000, 1), (k, k + 0x1000, 3)]
        live = D.Il2CppLive(mem.read, self.g, BASE, maps, log=lambda m: None)
        self.assertEqual(live.klass_ptr(self.g.find_class("Hidden")), k)

    def test_reapproj(self):
        doc = D.reapproj_for_patch("Gold", 0x1000, b"\x55", b"\xc3")
        p = D.write_reapproj(self.tmp.name, doc)
        import reapatch
        rp = reapatch.ReapPatch.load(p)
        self.assertEqual(rp.origin_source[0], 0x1000)


if __name__ == "__main__":
```

`tests/test_logger_native.py`:

```py
"""Fuehrt den Logger-Stub NATIV aus (gcc/as/ld noetig, sonst uebersprungen): Hook in einer
Testfunktion, mehrere Aufrufe inkl. Ringpuffer-Ueberlauf, Register-/Flag-Erhaltung."""
import os, shutil, struct, subprocess, sys, tempfile, unittest
sys.path.insert(0, os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__), ".."))
import logger as L

BASE, RING = 0x20000000, 16
FN, STUB = BASE + 0x1000, BASE + 0x2000
HOOK = FN + 2                       # direkt hinter 'cmp edi, esi' -> Flags muessen erhalten bleiben
FN_ASM = """
.intel_syntax noprefix
.text
  cmp edi, esi
  mov eax, 1
  nop
  nop
  nop
  je 1f
  add eax, edx
  ret
1: mov eax, 100
  ret
"""
C_SRC = r"""
#define _GNU_SOURCE
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
typedef long (*F)(long,long,long,long,long,long,long,long,double,double);
static void load(const char *p, void *dst){FILE*f=fopen(p,"rb");if(!f)exit(2);char b[4096];size_t n=fread(b,1,4096,f);memcpy(dst,b,n);fclose(f);}
int main(void){
  char *m = mmap((void*)0x20000000, 0x10000, PROT_READ|PROT_WRITE|PROT_EXEC, MAP_PRIVATE|MAP_ANONYMOUS|MAP_FIXED_NOREPLACE, -1, 0);
  if(m != (char*)0x20000000) return 3;
  load("fn.bin", m+0x1000); load("stub.bin", m+0x2000); load("hook.bin", m+0x1002);
  F f = (F)(m+0x1000);
  for(int i=0;i<40;i++){
    long a = (i%3==0)? 5 : i;                       /* i%3==0 -> rdi==rsi -> je genommen */
    long r = f(a, (i%3==0)?5:i+1, 7+i, 1000+i, 2000+i, 3000+i, 4000+i, 5000+i, 1.5+i, 2.5+i);
    printf("%d %ld\n", i, r);
  }
  FILE*o=fopen("ring.bin","wb"); fwrite(m, 1, 0x40+16*128, o); fclose(o);
  return 0; }
"""

@unittest.skipUnless(shutil.which("gcc") and shutil.which("as") and shutil.which("ld"), "keine Toolchain")
class T(unittest.TestCase):
    def sh(self, *cmd):
        subprocess.run(cmd, check=True, capture_output=True, cwd=self.d)

    def test_native(self):
        self.d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
        w = lambda n, t: open(os.path.join(self.d, n), "w").write(t)
        r = lambda n: open(os.path.join(self.d, n), "rb").read()
        w("fn.s", FN_ASM); self.sh("as", "--64", "-o", "fn.o", "fn.s")
        self.sh("objcopy", "-O", "binary", "-j", ".text", "fn.o", "fn.bin")
        stolen = r("fn.bin")[2:10]
        self.assertEqual(stolen[:1], b"\xB8")
        body = "\n".join([".intel_syntax noprefix", ".text"] + L.stub_asm(BASE, RING, thread=True)
                         + ["  .byte " + ",".join(str(b) for b in stolen), f"  jmp {FN + 10:#x}"])
        w("stub.s", body); self.sh("as", "--64", "-o", "stub.o", "stub.s")
        self.sh("ld", f"-Ttext={STUB:#x}", "--oformat", "binary", "-o", "stub.bin", "stub.o")
        rel = STUB - (HOOK + 5)
        open(os.path.join(self.d, "hook.bin"), "wb").write(b"\xE9" + struct.pack("<i", rel) + b"\x90\x90\x90")
        w("h.c", C_SRC); self.sh("gcc", "-O0", "-o", "h", "h.c")
        res = subprocess.run(["./h"], cwd=self.d, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(res.returncode, 0, res.stderr)
        rets = {int(a): int(b) for a, b in (l.split() for l in res.stdout.splitlines())}
        for i in range(40):                                  # Flags + rdx bleiben unberuehrt
            self.assertEqual(rets[i], 100 if i % 3 == 0 else 1 + 7 + i, i)
        ring = r("ring.bin")
        read = lambda a, n: ring[a - BASE:a - BASE + n]
        recs, idx, lost = L.collect(read, BASE, RING, 0)     # 40 Aufrufe, Ring 16 -> 24 verloren
        self.assertEqual((idx, lost, len(recs)), (40, 24, 16))
        for rec in recs:
            i = rec["index"]
            a = 5 if i % 3 == 0 else i
            self.assertEqual((rec["rdi"], rec["rsi"], rec["rdx"], rec["rcx"], rec["r8"], rec["r9"]),
                             (a, 5 if i % 3 == 0 else i + 1, 7 + i, 1000 + i, 2000 + i, 3000 + i))
            self.assertEqual((rec["s7"], rec["s8"]), (4000 + i, 5000 + i))
            self.assertEqual(struct.unpack("<d", struct.pack("<Q", rec["xmm0"]))[0], 1.5 + i)
            self.assertEqual(struct.unpack("<d", struct.pack("<Q", rec["xmm1"]))[0], 2.5 + i)
            self.assertTrue(rec["ret"] > 0 and rec["thread"] > 0 and rec["rsp"] % 8 == 0)
        # Teil-Lesen: ab Index 30 nur 10 Eintraege, keine Verluste
        recs2, idx2, lost2 = L.collect(read, BASE, RING, 30)
        self.assertEqual((idx2, lost2, len(recs2)), (40, 0, 10))
        # unvollstaendiger Eintrag (seq falsch) stoppt das Lesen
        broken = bytearray(ring); off = L.HEADER + (35 & 15) * L.REC; broken[off:off + 8] = bytes(8)
        recs3, idx3, _ = L.collect(lambda a, n: bytes(broken)[a - BASE:a - BASE + n], BASE, RING, 30)
        self.assertEqual((len(recs3), idx3), (5, 35))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
```
