```py
        with_scroll(low2, self.tv_hits)
        self.tv_hits.bind("<Double-1>", lambda _e: self._goto_hit())

    # -- Zugriff auf UE-LIVE ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _uelive(self):
        for t in getattr(self.win, "extra_tabs", []):
            if t.__class__.__name__ == "UeLiveTab":
                return t
        return None

    def _sdk(self):
        return getattr(getattr(self._uelive(), "proj", None), "sdk", None)

    def _live(self):
        live = getattr(self._uelive(), "live", None)
        if live is None:
            raise ValueError("Kein Live-Zugriff - im Tab UE-LIVE zuerst das Spiel laden und verbinden")
        if live.index is None:
            live.build_index()
        return live

    # -- Analyse ------------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _gp(self):
        return getattr(getattr(self.win, "app", None), "gp", None)

    def analyze(self, force=False):
        sdk = self._sdk()
        if sdk is None:
            self.log("Kein SDK geladen - im Tab UE-LIVE den SPIEL-ORDNER waehlen", "err")
            return
        gp = self._gp()
        sig = P.signature(sdk)
        if gp is not None and not force and gp.discover and gp.discover.get("sig") == sig:
            try:
                prof = P.from_json(gp.discover["json"])
            except ValueError:
                prof = None
            if prof is not None:
                self._analyzed(prof, cached=True)
                return
        self.v_info.set("Analysiere SDK …")

        def done(prof):
            if gp is not None:                                  # fuer das naechste Mal merken
                gp.discover = {"sig": sig, "json": P.to_json(prof)}
                gp.save()
            self._analyzed(prof)
        self.bg(lambda: P.build(sdk), done, lambda e: self.log(f"Analyse fehlgeschlagen: {e}", "err"))

    def reanalyze(self):
        self.analyze(force=True)

    def _analyzed(self, prof, cached=False):
        self.prof = prof
        c = prof.counts
        self.v_info.set(f"{len(prof.suggestions)} Vorschlaege · {c.get('item_struct', 0)} Item-Structs · "
                        f"{c.get('table', 0)} Tabellen · {c.get('give_function', 0)} Geben-Funktionen · "
                        f"{c.get('cheat_manager', 0)} Cheat-Manager · {c.get('stat_enum', 0)} Stat-Enums")
        self.fill()
        self.log("UE-Entdecker: " + self.v_info.get() + ("  (aus dem Zwischenspeicher)" if cached else ""), "ok")
        self._next_step()
        for n in prof.notes:
            self.log("   " + n, "info")

    def _unsupported(self, s):
        """None = der Cave-Trainer kann diese Geben-Funktion bauen, sonst der Grund in einfachen Worten."""
        if s.kind != "give_function":
            return None
        key = id(s)
        if key not in self._support:
            try:
                CG.classify_params(s.data["params"], self._sdk())
                CG.check_return(s.data.get("ret"))
                self._support[key] = None
            except (TR.TrainerError, KeyError, TypeError) as e:
                self._support[key] = str(e)
        return self._support[key]

    def fill(self):
        self.tv.delete(*self.tv.get_children())
        self.view = []
        if self.prof is None:
            return
        kind = dict(KINDS).get(self.v_kind.get())
        q = self.v_q.get().strip().lower()
        sugg = [x for x in self.prof.suggestions if not (kind and x.kind != kind)]
        # Geben-Funktionen, die der Trainer bauen kann, vor denen, die er nicht kann (Reihenfolge sonst unveraendert)
        sugg.sort(key=lambda x: 1 if (x.kind == "give_function" and self._unsupported(x)) else 0)
        for s in sugg:
            if q and q not in (s.title + " " + s.detail + " " + " ".join(s.evidence)).lower():
                continue
            why = self._unsupported(s)
            title = ("✗ " if why else ("✔ " if s.kind == "give_function" else "")) + s.title
            detail = s.detail if not why else "GEHT NICHT: " + why
            self.tv.insert("", "end", iid=str(len(self.view)),
                           values=(P.KIND_LABEL.get(s.kind, s.kind), title, s.score, detail))
            self.view.append(s)

    def _next_step(self):
        """Sagt in einem Satz, was als Naechstes zu tun ist - passend zu dem, was die Analyse gefunden hat."""
        if self.prof is None:
            return
        ok = [x for x in self.prof.suggestions if x.kind == "give_function" and not self._unsupported(x)]
        tabs = [x for x in self.prof.suggestions if x.kind == "table"]
        if ok and tabs:
            msg = ("Naechster Schritt: unten TABELLE LIVE LESEN, einen Item-NAMEN in der Liste anklicken, dann eine Zeile mit ✔ "
                   "(Geben-Funktion) oben anklicken und CAVE-TRAINER EXPORTIEREN. IDs musst du nicht kennen.")
        elif ok:
            msg = "Naechster Schritt: eine Zeile mit ✔ (Geben-Funktion) oben anklicken und CAVE-TRAINER EXPORTIEREN."
        elif tabs:
            msg = ("Keine Geben-Funktion ist baubar - Weg ueber den Speicher: Tabelle lesen, Item-Namen waehlen, "
                   "dann INVENTAR-EINTRAEGE SUCHEN und die Menge direkt setzen.")
        else:
            msg = "Nichts Passendes gefunden - Bericht speichern oder in UE-LIVE von Hand suchen."
        self.v_info.set(self.v_info.get() + "   |   " + msg)

    def _selected(self):
        sel = self.tv.selection()
        if not sel:
            return None
        try:
            return self.view[int(sel[0])]
        except (ValueError, IndexError):
            return None

    def on_select(self):
        s = self._selected()
        self.txt.delete("1.0", "end")
        if s is None:
            return
        if s.kind == "table":
            self.v_table.set(s.data.get("table_name") or "")        # Name direkt eintragen (leer = automatisch passende Tabelle)
        lines = [f"{P.KIND_LABEL.get(s.kind, s.kind)}: {s.title}   (Wert {s.score}/10)", s.detail, ""]
        lines += [f"  • {e}" for e in s.evidence]
        why = self._unsupported(s)
        if why:
            lines += ["", "✗ Dafuer laesst sich KEIN Cave-Trainer bauen: " + why,
                      "  Tipp: eine Zeile mit ✔ nehmen, oder den Weg ueber INVENTAR-EINTRAEGE SUCHEN (Menge direkt im Speicher setzen)."]
        if s.howto:
            lines += ["", "So benutzt du es: " + s.howto]
        self.txt.insert("1.0", "\n".join(lines))

    def on_double(self):
        """Doppelklick auf einen Vorschlag: Tabelle -> sofort live lesen; Member-Vorschlaege -> in UE-LIVE oeffnen."""
        s = self._selected()
        if s is None:
            return
        if s.kind == "table":
            self.read_table()
        elif s.kind in ("currency", "stat_array", "attribute_set"):
            self.open_in_live()

    def on_rows_double(self):
        """Doppelklick in der unteren Liste: in der Tabellen-Auswahl -> diese Tabelle lesen."""
        if self.rows_mode != "tables":
            return
        sel = self.tv_rows.selection()
        try:
            addr, name = self.tab_list[int(sel[0])]
        except (IndexError, ValueError):
            return
        self.v_table.set(name)
        self.read_table()

    def _show_tables(self, tabs):
        self.rows_mode, self.tab_list = "tables", list(tabs)
        self.tv_rows.delete(*self.tv_rows.get_children())
        for i, (_a, n) in enumerate(self.tab_list):
            self.tv_rows.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(n, "", "Doppelklick = diese Tabelle lesen"))

    def _selected_rows(self):
        """Angeklickte Tabellenzeilen (nur wenn unten Zeilen angezeigt werden)."""
        if self.rows_mode != "rows" or not self.cur:
            return []
        out = []
        for i in self.tv_rows.selection():
            try:
                out.append(self.cur[1][int(i)])
            except (ValueError, IndexError):
                pass
        return out

    # -- Tabellen live -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    def list_tables(self):
        def job():
            live = self._live()
            self.tables = P.find_table_objects(live)
            return self.tables

        def ok(tabs):
            if not tabs:
                self.log("Keine DataTable-Objekte im Spiel gefunden (Spielstand geladen?)", "err")
                return
            self._show_tables(tabs)
            self.log(f"{len(tabs)} DataTables im Spiel - unten per Doppelklick lesen", "ok")

        self.bg(job, ok, lambda e: self.log(str(e), "err"))

    def read_table(self):
        s = self._selected()
        typed = self.v_table.get().strip().lower()
        if s is None and not typed:
            self.log("Erst einen Tabellen-Vorschlag anklicken oder einen Tabellen-Namen eintippen", "err")
            return
        if s is not None and s.kind != "table" and not typed:
            self.log("Das ist keine Tabelle - eine Zeile der Art 'Tabelle' anklicken (oder Namen eintippen)", "err")
            return

        def job():
            live = self._live()
            if self.tables is None:
                self.tables = P.find_table_objects(live)
            tabs = self.tables
            pick = None
            if typed:
                pick = next(((a, n) for a, n in tabs if typed in n.lower()), None)
            elif s is not None:
                pick = P.best_table_for(s, tabs)
            if pick is None:
                if not tabs:
                    raise ValueError("Keine DataTable-Objekte im Spiel gefunden (Spielstand geladen?)")
                return "choose", tabs
            cols = s.data.get("columns", []) if s is not None and not typed else []
            if typed and s is not None and s.kind == "table":
                cols = s.data.get("columns", [])
            rows, cols = P.read_table(live.rd, live.fname_str, pick[0], cols)
            return pick[1], rows, cols

        def ok(res):
            if res[0] == "choose":
                self._show_tables(res[1])
                self.log("Keine eindeutig passende Tabelle gefunden - unten die Tabellen des Spiels: "
                         "die richtige per Doppelklick lesen", "info")
                return
            name, rows, cols = res
            self.cur = res
            self.rows_mode = "rows"
            self.v_rowq.set("")
            self._fill_rows()
            if not rows:
                self.log(f"Tabelle {name}: keine Zeilen gelesen (RowMap nicht erkannt?)", "err")
            else:
                self.log(f"Tabelle {name}: {len(rows)} Zeilen, {len(cols)} Spalten gelesen"
                         + (f" (Anzeige {MAX_ROWS_SHOWN})" if len(rows) > MAX_ROWS_SHOWN else ""), "ok")

        self.bg(job, ok, lambda e: self.log(str(e), "err"))

    def _fill_rows(self):
        """Tabellenzeilen anzeigen, gefiltert nach dem Item-Namen (iid bleibt der Index in der vollen Liste)."""
        if self.rows_mode != "rows" or not self.cur:
            return
        q = self.v_rowq.get().strip().lower()
        self.tv_rows.delete(*self.tv_rows.get_children())
        shown = 0
        for i, r in enumerate(self.cur[1]):
            if q and q not in r["name"].lower():
                continue
            if shown >= MAX_ROWS_SHOWN:
                break
            vals = "; ".join(f"{k}={v}" for k, v in r["values"].items())
            self.tv_rows.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(r["name"], r["fname_hex"], vals))
            shown += 1

    def _auto_id(self):
        """Eine Zeile angeklickt: gibt es in der Tabelle eine ID-Spalte mit Zahl, wird sie als ID-Zahl uebernommen."""
        rows = self._selected_rows()
        if len(rows) != 1:
            return
        for k, v in rows[0]["values"].items():
            if P.ID_NAME.search(str(k)) and isinstance(v, int) and not isinstance(v, bool):
                self.v_idnum.set(str(v))
                self.log(f"ID-Zahl aus Spalte {k} uebernommen: {v}", "info")
                return

    def export_table(self):
        if not self.cur or not self.cur[1]:
            self.log("Erst eine Tabelle lesen (TABELLE LIVE LESEN)", "err")
            return
        name, rows, cols = self.cur
        path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(title="Tabelle speichern", defaultextension=".csv", initialfile=f"{name}.csv",
                                            filetypes=[("CSV", "*.csv"), ("JSON", "*.json")])
        if not path:
            return
        text = P.table_to_json(rows, cols, name) if path.lower().endswith(".json") else P.table_to_csv(rows, cols)
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
            f.write(text)
        self.log(f"Tabelle gespeichert: {path} ({len(rows)} Zeilen, inkl. FName-Bytes)", "ok")

    # -- Inventar-Eintraege suchen / Menge setzen -------------------------------------------------
    def _ranges(self):
        maps = self.win.client.get_maps()
        return sorted((m[0], m[1]) for m in maps if (m[2] & 3) == 3 and 0x1000 <= m[1] - m[0] <= MAX_RANGE)

    def find_entries(self):
        s = self._selected()
        if s is None or s.kind != "item_struct" or not s.data.get("id") or not s.data.get("count"):
            self.log("Erst einen Vorschlag der Art 'Item-Struct' mit ID + Menge anklicken", "err")
            return
        d = s.data
        idinfo, cnt = d["id"], d["count"]
        try:
            ctype = P.base_name(cnt["type"])
            if ctype not in P.INT_FMT:
                raise ValueError(f"Die Menge ist vom Typ {cnt['type']} - so einen Wert kann ich im Speicher nicht suchen/setzen. "
                                 "Anderen Item-Struct-Vorschlag waehlen oder die Menge in UE-LIVE von Hand aendern")
            pats = {}
            if idinfo["id_kind"] == "fname":
                sel = self._selected_rows()
                if not sel:
                    raise ValueError("Erst Items in der Tabelle waehlen (Tabelle doppelklicken, dann Zeile(n) anklicken) - "
                                     "deren FName wird gesucht")
                for r in sel[:50]:
                    pats[bytes.fromhex(r["fname_hex"])] = r["name"]
            else:
                txt = self.v_idnum.get().strip()
                if not txt:
                    raise ValueError("Keine ID-Zahl: erst unten TABELLE LIVE LESEN und das Item anklicken (die ID wird uebernommen) "
                                     "- oder die Zahl ins Feld eintippen")
                num = int(txt, 0)
                pats[P.id_pattern("int", number=num, size=max(1, min(8, idinfo["size"])))] = f"ID {num}"
            cv = self.v_cnt.get().strip()
            value = (float(cv) if ctype in ("float", "double") else int(cv, 0)) if cv else None
        except ValueError as e:
            self.log(str(e), "err")
            return
        client = self.win.client
        ranges = self._ranges()
        self.v_info.set("Suche Eintraege im Speicher …")

        def job():
            return P.find_instances(client.read_memory, ranges, idinfo["offset"], pats, cnt["offset"], ctype, value)

        def ok(hits):
            self.hits = hits
            self.tv_hits.delete(*self.tv_hits.get_children())
            for i, h in enumerate(hits):
                self.tv_hits.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(f"{h.base:#x}", h.name, h.count, f"{h.count_addr:#x}"))
            self.v_info.set(f"{len(hits)} Eintraege gefunden")
            self.log(f"{len(hits)} Inventar-Eintraege von {s.title} gefunden"
                     + ("" if value is not None else " (ohne Mengen-Angabe: nur plausible Mengen - ggf. 'Menge im Spiel' eintragen)"),
                     "ok" if hits else "err")

        self.bg(job, ok, lambda e: self.log(str(e), "err"))

    def _hit(self):
        sel = self.tv_hits.selection()
        if not sel:
            return None
        try:
            return self.hits[int(sel[0])]
        except (ValueError, IndexError):
            return None

    def _goto_hit(self):
        h = self._hit()
        if h is not None:
            self.win.goto_memory(h.count_addr)

    def set_entry_count(self):
        h = self._hit()
        if h is None:
            self.log("Erst einen gefundenen Eintrag anklicken", "err")
            return
        val = simpledialog.askstring("Menge setzen", f"Neue Menge fuer {h.name} (jetzt {h.count}):", parent=self.win)
        if not val:
            return
        try:
            data = P.set_count(self.win.client.write_memory, h, float(val) if h.count_type in ("float", "double") else int(val, 0))
        except (ValueError, struct.error) as e:
            self.log(f"Ungueltige Menge: {e}", "err")
            return
        self.log(f"{h.name}: Menge @ {h.count_addr:#x} = {data.hex()} geschrieben (im Spiel Inventar neu oeffnen)", "ok")

    def _ilog(self, msg):
        self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(msg, "info"))

    def _run(self, job, ok):
        self._busy = True

        def done(res):
            self._busy = False
            ok(res)

        def fail(e):
            self._busy = False
            msg = str(e) or e.__class__.__name__
            self.log(msg, "err")
            self.v_info.set("Fehler: " + msg)

        self.bg(job, done, fail)

    # -- Cave-Trainer fuer beliebige Funktionen ----------------------------------------------------
    def _hook_targets(self, live):
        """Nur LESEN: ProcessEvent-Adresse + vtable-Slots der PlayerController -> (pe, slots, notizen)."""
        import ue_hook as HK
        import ue_call
        sdk = self._sdk()
        pidx = sdk.offset("process_event_index", "processeventindex", default=77)
        prva = sdk.offset("process_event")
        objs = []
        try:
            objs = [i["addr"] for i in live.instances("APlayerController") if "Default__" not in i["name"]]
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
        if not objs:
            raise ValueError("Kein PlayerController gefunden - Spielstand laden (nicht im Hauptmenue)")
        read = self.win.client.read_memory
        pe = ue_call.process_event_addr(read, objs[0], pidx, fallback=(self.base + prva) if prva else None)
        slots, notes = HK.find_slots(read, objs, pidx, pe)
        return pe, slots, notes

    def _parse_extra(self, text):
        out = {}
        for part in [p for p in text.replace(";", ",").split(",") if p.strip()]:
            if "=" not in part:
                raise ValueError(f"'{part.strip()}' - Format 'Name=Wert'")
            k, v = part.split("=", 1)
            v = v.strip()
            out[k.strip()] = float(v) if re.fullmatch(r"-?\d*\.\d+(e-?\d+)?", v) else int(v, 0)
        return out

    def export_cave_trainer(self):
        if self._busy:
            self.log("Es laeuft noch ein Auftrag - kurz warten", "err")
            return
        s = self._selected()
        if s is None or s.kind != "give_function":
            self.log("Erst eine Zeile der Art 'Geben-Funktion' anklicken (z. B. AddItem / GiveItem)", "err")
            return
        d = s.data
        sdk = self._sdk()
        try:
            cls = CG.classify_params(d["params"], sdk)
            CG.check_return(d.get("ret"))
            ctext = self.v_amount.get().strip() or "1"
            fl = any(a["role"] == "count" and a["kind"] in ("float", "double") for a in cls)
            amount = float(ctext) if fl else int(ctext, 0)
            extra = self._parse_extra(self.v_extra.get())
            id_arg = next((a for a in cls if a["role"] == "id"), None)
            ids = []                                        # [(alias, wert)]
            if id_arg is None:
                ids = [(f"{d['name']} x{ctext}", None)]
            elif id_arg["kind"] == "fname":
                sel = self._selected_rows()
                if not sel:
                    raise ValueError("Die Funktion braucht einen Item-Namen (FName): erst eine Item-Tabelle doppelklicken, "
                                     "dann Zeile(n) unten anklicken")
                ids = [(r["name"], bytes.fromhex(r["fname_hex"])) for r in sel]
            else:
                txt = self.v_idnum.get().strip()
                if not txt:
                    raise ValueError("Die Funktion braucht eine ID-Zahl, die in der Tabelle nicht zu finden war - erst eine Item-Tabelle "
                                     "lesen und das Item anklicken (die ID wird dann automatisch uebernommen) oder die Zahl eintippen")
                ids = [(f"ID {int(txt, 0)}", int(txt, 0))]
        except (ValueError, TR.TrainerError) as e:
            self.log(str(e), "err")
            return
        byref = [a["name"] for a in cls if a["kind"] == "fname"] if self.v_byref.get() else []
        # Eintraege: je Zeile einer ODER ein Paket (in 14er geteilt)
        package = False
        if len(ids) > 1:
            ans = messagebox.askyesnocancel("Trainer-Eintraege", f"{len(ids)} Zeilen gewaehlt.\n\nJA = Paket-Eintraege "
                                            f"(je {TR.PACK_SIZE} Items)\nNEIN = je Zeile ein eigener Eintrag", parent=self.win)
            if ans is None:
                return
            package = ans
        pname = ""
        if package:
            pname = simpledialog.askstring("Name des Eintrags", "Name des Trainer-Eintrags:",
                                           initialvalue=d["name"], parent=self.win)
            if not pname:
                return
        out_dir = filedialog.askdirectory(title="Ordner fuer das Trainer-Projekt waehlen (neu, oder vorhandener Trainer wird erweitert)",
                                          parent=self.win)
        if not out_dir:
            return
        old = TR.load_options(out_dir)
        client, base = self.win.client, self.base
        this_pick = self.v_this.get()
        self.v_info.set("Baue Cave-Trainer …")

        def job():
            live = self._live()
            ent = live.function_entry(d["owner"], d["name"])
            if not ent:
                raise ValueError(f"{d['owner']}.{d['name']} wurde im laufenden Spiel nicht gefunden")
            impl = _find_impl(client.read_memory, base, ent[0])
            if impl is None:
                raise ValueError("Die native Implementierung wurde nicht erkannt (Blueprint-Funktion oder ungewohnter Thunk) - "
                                 "dafuer laesst sich keine statische Cave bauen.")
            mode, off, note = CG.choose_this(sdk, d["owner"])
            self._ilog("this: " + note)
            if this_pick != "auto":
                if this_pick == "member" and mode != "member":
                    raise ValueError("this=member: im PlayerController wurde kein Zeiger auf " + d["owner"] + " gefunden")
                mode, off = this_pick, (off if this_pick == "member" else 0)
            rows = [CG.build_row(alias, impl - base, d["params"], d.get("ret"), sdk, (mode, off), id_value=val,
                                 count_value=amount, extra=extra, byref=byref, function=f"{d['owner']}.{d['name']}")
                    for alias, val in ids]
            if package:
                opts = TR.split_package(pname, rows)
            elif id_arg is None:
                opts = [TR.Option(rows[0].alias, rows)]
            else:
                opts = [TR.Option(f"{r.alias} x{ctext}", [r]) for r in rows]
            merged = TR.merge_options(old, opts)
            pe, slots, notes = self._hook_targets(live)
            for n in notes:
                self._ilog("Haken: " + n)
            maps = [(m[0], m[1], m[2]) for m in client.get_maps()]
            p = TR.plan(client.read_memory, maps, base, merged, None, pe, slots, log=self._ilog)
            files = TR.write_project(out_dir, p, game=str(getattr(getattr(self._uelive(), "proj", None), "name", "") or ""))
            return p, files

        def ok(res):
            p, files = res
            self.log(f"Cave-Trainer geschrieben: {out_dir}", "ok")
            self.log(f"   {len(p.options)} Eintrag/Eintraege, Cave base+{p.cave - p.base:#x} ({len(p.cave_bytes)} Byte), "
                     f"Schalter base+{p.flag_addr - p.base:#x}, {len(p.slots)} Haken-Slot(s)", "ok")
            for w in p.warnings:
                self.log("   " + w, "info")
            self.log("In ReaperPy den Ordner als Projekt waehlen, '00 BASIS' EINMAL aktivieren, dann Eintraege anklicken. "
                     "Am echten Spiel NICHT getestet - vorher speichern; bei Absturz zuerst 'this' und 'FName per Zeiger' pruefen.", "info")
            self.v_info.set(f"Cave-Trainer exportiert: {len(p.options)} Eintraege -> {os.path.basename(out_dir)}")

        self._run(job, ok)

    # -- Bericht / UE-LIVE ----------------------------------------------------------------------
    def save_report(self):
        if self.prof is None:
            self.log("Erst ANALYSIEREN", "err")
            return
        path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(title="Bericht speichern", defaultextension=".md", initialfile="UE_ENTDECKER.md",
                                            filetypes=[("Markdown", "*.md"), ("JSON", "*.json")])
        if not path:
            return
        text = P.to_json(self.prof) if path.lower().endswith(".json") else P.render_markdown(self.prof)
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(text)
        self.log(f"Bericht gespeichert: {path}", "ok")

    def open_in_live(self):
        s = self._selected()
        if s is None:
            self.log("Erst einen Vorschlag anklicken", "err")
            return
        d = s.data
        owner = d.get("owner") or (d.get("containers") or [{}])[0].get("owner") or (d.get("struct") or "")
        member = d.get("member") or ((d.get("id") or {}).get("name") if s.kind == "item_struct" else "")
        if s.kind == "attribute_set":
            member = d["attrs"][0][0] if d.get("attrs") else ""
        if not owner or not member:
            self.log("Dieser Vorschlag zeigt auf keinen einzelnen Member - Details im Textfeld", "err")
            return
        ue = self._uelive()
        if ue is None:
            self.log("Tab UE-LIVE nicht gefunden", "err")
            return
        ue.v_q.set(f"{owner}.{member}")
        try:
            ue._fill_targets()
            self.win.show_tab(ue)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - nur Komfort
            pass
        self.log(f"UE-LIVE: Suche auf {owner}.{member} gesetzt", "ok")

```

`tools_extra_gui.py`:

```py
"""tools_extra_gui.py - neue Tabs in ReaperPy 5.0: FUNKTION AUFRUFEN, FUNKTIONS-LOGGER, JOURNAL.

Idee von Funktions-Caller und -Logger: PS5Debug-studio (alfizari, Apache-2.0).  Umsetzung eigen
(siehe caller.py / logger.py / journal.py - dort steht die ganze Logik, hier nur die Oberflaeche).
"""
import csv
import time
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, ttk

import asm_tools as AT
import caller as CL
import logger as LG
from tools_common import (BG, BG_CARD, ACCENT, TEXT_DIM, WARN, ERROR, FONT_LABEL, BaseTab,
                          button, entry, label, textbox, tree, with_scroll, hexs)


def _chk(parent, text, var, cmd=None):
    return tk.Checkbutton(parent, text=text, variable=var, command=cmd, bg=BG, fg=TEXT_DIM,
                          selectcolor=BG_CARD, activebackground=BG, activeforeground=ACCENT,
                          font=FONT_LABEL)


# ==================================================================
# Tab: Funktion aufrufen
# ==================================================================
class CallerTab(BaseTab):
    def __init__(self, parent, win):
        super().__init__(parent, win)
        self.bufs = None
        self.history = []

        top = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); top.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=(8, 2))
        label(top, "FUNKTION").pack(side="left")
        self.v_fn = tk.StringVar(value="base+")
        e = entry(top, self.v_fn, 26); e.pack(side="left", padx=6)
        e.bind("<Return>", lambda _e: self.run())
        self.v_safe = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
        _chk(top, "Trampolin (sicher)", self.v_safe).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        button(top, "AUFRUFEN", self.run, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=4)
        button(top, "→ DISASM", self._to_dis).pack(side="right")

        grid = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); grid.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=2)
        self.v_args = []
        for i, reg in enumerate(("rdi", "rsi", "rdx", "rcx", "r8", "r9")):
            label(grid, reg.upper()).grid(row=i // 3, column=(i % 3) * 2, sticky="e", padx=(6, 2), pady=2)
            v = tk.StringVar(value="0"); self.v_args.append(v)
            entry(grid, v, 24).grid(row=i // 3, column=(i % 3) * 2 + 1, padx=2, pady=2)
        label(self, "Argumente: 0x1234 | 123 | -5 | base+0x10 | @puffer | @puffer+8 | \"Text\"   "
                    "(Float-Argumente gehen nicht - nur Ganzzahl-Register)").pack(anchor="w", padx=14)

        mid = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); mid.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8, pady=6)
        left = tk.Frame(mid, bg=BG); left.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
        label(left, "ERGEBNIS (RAX)").pack(anchor="w")
        self.out = textbox(left, height=12, width=60)
        self.out.configure(state="disabled")
        with_scroll(left, self.out)

        right = tk.Frame(mid, bg=BG); right.pack(side="right", fill="y", padx=(8, 0))
        label(right, "PUFFER IM SPIEL").pack(anchor="w")
        row = tk.Frame(right, bg=BG); row.pack(fill="x")
        self.v_bname, self.v_bsize = tk.StringVar(value="buf"), tk.StringVar(value="0x1000")
        entry(row, self.v_bname, 10).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        entry(row, self.v_bsize, 8).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(row, "ANLEGEN", self.buf_alloc, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        self.tv = tree(right, [("n", "NAME"), ("a", "ADRESSE"), ("s", "GROESSE")], [80, 130, 70], height=7)
        self.tv.pack(fill="x", pady=4)
        self.v_bdata = tk.StringVar()
        entry(right, self.v_bdata, 34).pack(fill="x", pady=2)
        row2 = tk.Frame(right, bg=BG); row2.pack(fill="x")
        button(row2, "HEX SCHREIBEN", lambda: self.buf_write(False)).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(row2, "TEXT", lambda: self.buf_write(True)).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(row2, "LESEN", self.buf_read).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        row3 = tk.Frame(right, bg=BG); row3.pack(fill="x", pady=2)
        button(row3, "→ SPEICHER", self.buf_goto).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(row3, "ALLE FREIGEBEN", self.buf_free).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        label(right, "Aufruf haelt einen Spiel-Thread kurz an.\nNICHT parallel zum Debugger\n"
                     "benutzen, wenn das Spiel angehalten ist.", dim=True).pack(anchor="w", pady=6)

    # ---- Hilfen ----
    def _bufs(self):
        c = self.win.client
        if c is None:
            raise RuntimeError("nicht verbunden")
        if self.bufs is None or self.bufs.client is not c:
            self.bufs = CL.RemoteBuffers(c)
        return self.bufs

    def _put(self, text):
        self.out.configure(state="normal"); self.out.delete("1.0", "end")
        self.out.insert("1.0", text); self.out.configure(state="disabled")

    def _to_dis(self):
        try:
            self.win.goto_disasm(self.addr(self.v_fn.get()))
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(str(e), "err")

    # ---- Aufruf ----
    def run(self):
        try:
            rip = self.addr(self.v_fn.get())
            bufs = self._bufs()
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        texts = [v.get() for v in self.v_args]
        safe = self.v_safe.get()
        if not messagebox.askyesno("Funktion aufrufen",
                                   f"{rip:#x} im Spiel ausfuehren?\nFalsche Argumente koennen das Spiel "
                                   "abstuerzen lassen.", parent=self.win):
            return

        def job():
            args = CL.parse_args(texts, bufs, resolver=self.addr)
            t0 = time.time()
            rax = CL.do_call(self.win.client, rip, args, safe=safe)
            return args, rax, time.time() - t0, CL.describe_result(self.win.client, rax)

        def ok(res):
            args, rax, dt, desc = res
            head = f"{time.strftime('%H:%M:%S')}  call {rip:#x}({', '.join(f'{a:#x}' for a in args)})  [{dt * 1000:.0f} ms]"
            body = "\n".join(f"  {k:<12}{v}" for k, v in desc)
            self.history.insert(0, head + "\n" + body)
            self._put("\n\n".join(self.history[:20]))
            self.log(f"call {rip:#x} -> RAX={rax:#x}", "ok")
            self._fill_bufs()
        self.bg(job, ok)

    # ---- Puffer ----
    def _fill_bufs(self):
        self.tv.delete(*self.tv.get_children())
        if self.bufs:
            for n, (a, s) in self.bufs.items.items():
                self.tv.insert("", "end", values=(n, f"{a:#x}", f"{s:#x}"))

    def _sel_buf(self):
        sel = self.tv.selection()
        if not sel:
            raise ValueError("erst einen Puffer in der Liste waehlen")
        return self.tv.item(sel[0], "values")[0]

    def buf_alloc(self):
        try:
            bufs, name, size = self._bufs(), self.v_bname.get().strip(), int(self.v_bsize.get(), 0)
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        self.bg(lambda: bufs.alloc(name, size),
                lambda a: (self.log(f"Puffer '{name}' @ {a:#x} ({size:#x} Byte)", "ok"), self._fill_bufs()))

    def buf_write(self, as_text):
        try:
            bufs, name = self._bufs(), self._sel_buf()
            raw = (self.v_bdata.get().encode("utf-8") + b"\0") if as_text else AT.parse_hex_bytes(self.v_bdata.get())
            if not raw:
                raise ValueError("keine Daten")
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        self.bg(lambda: bufs.write(name, raw), lambda _r: self.log(f"{len(raw)} Byte nach '{name}'", "ok"))

    def buf_read(self):
        try:
            bufs, name = self._bufs(), self._sel_buf()
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        import memtools
        self.bg(lambda: (bufs.items[name][0], bufs.read(name, min(bufs.items[name][1], 0x400))),
                lambda r: self._put(memtools.hexdump(r[1], r[0])))

    def buf_goto(self):
        try:
            self.win.goto_memory(self._bufs().items[self._sel_buf()][0])
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(str(e), "err")

    def buf_free(self):
        try:
            bufs = self._bufs()
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        self.bg(bufs.free_all, lambda _r: (self._fill_bufs(), self.log("Puffer freigegeben", "ok")))

    def shutdown(self):
        try:
            import ps5_more
            if self.win.client is not None:
                ps5_more.forget_trampolines(self.win.client)
        except Exception:
            pass


# ==================================================================
# Tab: Funktions-Logger
# ==================================================================
class LoggerTab(BaseTab):
    def __init__(self, parent, win):
        super().__init__(parent, win)
        self.sess = None
        self.rows = []                  # alle Eintraege (dicts)
        self.running = False

        top = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); top.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=(8, 2))
        label(top, "FUNKTION").pack(side="left")
        self.v_fn = tk.StringVar(value="base+")
        entry(top, self.v_fn, 24).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        label(top, "RING").pack(side="left")
        self.v_ring = tk.StringVar(value="1024")
        ttk.Combobox(top, textvariable=self.v_ring, values=("256", "1024", "4096"), width=6,
                     state="readonly").pack(side="left", padx=4)
        self.v_thr = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        _chk(top, "Thread-ID", self.v_thr).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        self.b_start = button(top, "▶ START", self.start, accent=True); self.b_start.pack(side="left", padx=2)
        self.b_stop = button(top, "■ STOP", self.stop); self.b_stop.pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(top, "LEEREN", self.clear).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(top, "CSV…", self.export).pack(side="right")
        self.lbl = label(self, "Aus. Hook: erste ≥8 Byte der Funktion werden durch einen Sprung ersetzt, "
                               "STOP stellt sie zurueck.")
        self.lbl.pack(anchor="w", padx=10)

        pan = ttk.PanedWindow(self, orient="horizontal"); pan.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8, pady=6)
        lf = tk.Frame(pan, bg=BG); pan.add(lf, weight=3)
        cols = [("n", "#"), ("ret", "RUECKSPRUNG"), ("rdi", "RDI"), ("rsi", "RSI"), ("rdx", "RDX"),
                ("rcx", "RCX"), ("r8", "R8"), ("r9", "R9"), ("th", "THREAD")]
        self.tv = tree(lf, cols, [60, 120, 110, 110, 110, 110, 90, 90, 100], height=18)
        with_scroll(lf, self.tv)
        self.tv.bind("<Double-1>", self._dbl)
        rf = tk.Frame(pan, bg=BG); pan.add(rf, weight=1)
        label(rf, "NACH AUFRUFER").pack(anchor="w")
        self.grp = tree(rf, [("c", "ANZ"), ("ret", "RUECKSPRUNG"), ("off", "OFFSET")], [50, 130, 90], height=18)
        self.grp.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        self.grp.bind("<Double-1>", self._grp_dbl)

    # ---- Steuerung ----
    def start(self):
        if self.running:
            return
        try:
            a = self.addr(self.v_fn.get()); ring = int(self.v_ring.get()); thr = self.v_thr.get()
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        if not messagebox.askyesno("Logger starten",
                                   f"Funktion {a:#x} patchen (Sprung in Code-Cave)?\nSteht am Funktionsanfang "
                                   "ein Sprungziel mitten in den ersten 8 Byte, kann das Spiel abstuerzen.",
                                   parent=self.win):
            return
        sess = LG.LoggerSession(self.win.app.backend, a, ring, thr)

        def ok(info):
            self.sess, self.running = sess, True
            self.lbl.configure(text=f"AKTIV  Hook {a:#x}  Cave {info['cave']:#x} ({info['cave_size']} B)  "
                                    f"Puffer {info['data']:#x}", fg=ACCENT)
            self.log(f"Logger aktiv @ {a:#x}", "ok")
            self.after(300, self._tick)
        self.bg(sess.start, ok)

    def stop(self):
        if not self.sess or not self.running:
            return
        sess, self.running = self.sess, False
        self.bg(sess.stop, lambda _r: (self.lbl.configure(text="Aus - Original-Bytes zurueckgeschrieben.",
                                                          fg=TEXT_DIM), self.log("Logger gestoppt", "ok")))

    def shutdown(self):
        if self.sess and self.running:
            self.running = False
            try:
                self.sess.stop()
            except Exception:
                pass

    def clear(self):
        self.rows.clear(); self._redraw()

    def _tick(self):
        if not self.running or not self.winfo_exists():
            return
        sess = self.sess

        def ok(recs):
            if recs:
                self.rows += recs
                self.rows = self.rows[-20000:]
                self._append(recs)
            if sess.lost:
                self.lbl.configure(text=self.lbl.cget("text").split("  VERLOREN")[0]
                                   + f"  VERLOREN {sess.lost} (Ring zu klein / zu schnell)", fg=WARN)
            self.after(300, self._tick)
        self.bg(sess.poll, ok, lambda e: (self.log(f"Logger-Poll: {e}", "err"), self.after(1000, self._tick)))

    # ---- Anzeige ----
    def _row(self, r):
        return (r["index"], f"{r['ret']:#x} (+{r['ret'] - self.base:#x})", *(f"{r[k]:#x}" for k in
                ("rdi", "rsi", "rdx", "rcx", "r8", "r9")), f"{r['thread']:#x}" if r["thread"] else "")

    def _append(self, recs):
        for r in recs[-500:]:
            self.tv.insert("", "end", values=self._row(r))
        kids = self.tv.get_children()
        if len(kids) > 3000:
            self.tv.delete(*kids[:len(kids) - 3000])
        self.tv.yview_moveto(1.0)
        self._groups()

    def _redraw(self):
        self.tv.delete(*self.tv.get_children())
        self._append(self.rows[-500:]) if self.rows else self._groups()

    def _groups(self):
        cnt = {}
        for r in self.rows:
            cnt[r["ret"]] = cnt.get(r["ret"], 0) + 1
        self.grp.delete(*self.grp.get_children())
        for ret, n in sorted(cnt.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:200]:
            self.grp.insert("", "end", values=(n, f"{ret:#x}", f"+{ret - self.base:#x}"))

    def _dbl(self, _e):
        sel = self.tv.selection()
        if sel:
            self.win.goto_disasm(int(self.tv.item(sel[0], "values")[1].split()[0], 16) - 5)

    def _grp_dbl(self, _e):
        sel = self.grp.selection()
        if sel:
            self.win.goto_disasm(int(self.grp.item(sel[0], "values")[1], 16) - 5)

    def export(self):
        if not self.rows:
            return self.log("nichts zu exportieren", "warn")
        fn = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(parent=self.win, defaultextension=".csv",
                                          filetypes=[("CSV", "*.csv")])
        if not fn:
            return
        with open(fn, "w", newline="", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            w = csv.writer(f)
            w.writerow(["index", *LG.FIELDS])
            for r in self.rows:
                w.writerow([r["index"], *(f"{r[k]:#x}" for k in LG.FIELDS)])
        self.log(f"{len(self.rows)} Aufrufe nach {fn}", "ok")

# Tab: Journal (Rueckgaengig)
# ==================================================================
class JournalTab(BaseTab):
    def __init__(self, parent, win):
        super().__init__(parent, win)
        import journal
        self.j = journal.WriteJournal()
        top = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); top.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=(8, 2))
        self.v_on = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
        _chk(top, "Schreibzugriffe aufzeichnen", self.v_on,
             lambda: setattr(self.j, "enabled", self.v_on.get())).pack(side="left")
        button(top, "AKTUALISIEREN", self.refresh).pack(side="left", padx=8)
        button(top, "AUSGEWAEHLTE ZURUECK", self.undo_sel, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(top, "ALLES ZURUECK", self.undo_all).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(top, "LEEREN", lambda: (self.j.clear(), self.refresh())).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        label(self, "Jeder Schreibzugriff der Werkzeuge (Hex-Editor, Searcher, Skripte, Aufrufe ...) wird mit den "
                    "alten Bytes gemerkt. Freeze-Ticks und Schreibzugriffe > 64 KB nicht.").pack(anchor="w", padx=10)
        box = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); box.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8, pady=6)
        self.tv = tree(box, [("t", "ZEIT"), ("a", "ADRESSE"), ("n", "LAENGE"), ("o", "ALT"), ("w", "NEU"),
                             ("s", "QUELLE")], [80, 130, 60, 200, 200, 120], height=20)
        with_scroll(box, self.tv)
        self.tv.bind("<Double-1>", lambda _e: self.tv.selection() and self.win.goto_memory(
            int(self.tv.item(self.tv.selection()[0], "values")[1], 16)))
        self.after(500, self._auto)

    def attach(self):
        if self.win.client is not None:
            self.j.attach(self.win.client)

    def _auto(self):
        if not self.winfo_exists():
            return
        self.attach()
        if self.winfo_ismapped():
            self.refresh()
        self.after(1500, self._auto)

    def refresh(self):
        self.tv.delete(*self.tv.get_children())
        for i, e in enumerate(reversed(self.j.entries[-1000:])):
            vals = e.line()
            self.tv.insert("", "end", iid=str(len(self.j.entries) - 1 - i),
                           values=vals, tags=("undone",) if e.undone else ())
        self.tv.tag_configure("undone", foreground=TEXT_DIM)

    def undo_sel(self):
        ids = [int(i) for i in self.tv.selection()]
        if not ids:
            return self.log("nichts ausgewaehlt", "warn")
        ents = [self.j.entries[i] for i in sorted(ids, reverse=True) if i < len(self.j.entries)]

        def job():
            return sum(1 for e in ents if self.j.undo(e))
        self.bg(job, lambda n: (self.log(f"{n} Aenderung(en) rueckgaengig", "ok"), self.refresh()))

    def undo_all(self):
        n = len([e for e in self.j.entries if not e.undone])
        if not n or not messagebox.askyesno("Journal", f"{n} Aenderung(en) zurueckschreiben?", parent=self.win):
            return
        self.bg(self.j.undo_all, lambda k: (self.log(f"{k} Aenderung(en) rueckgaengig", "ok"), self.refresh()))

    def shutdown(self):
        self.j.detach()
```

```py
"""tools_gui.py – Werkzeug-Fenster für ReaperPy (Speicher, Disassembler, Konverter,
Cheat-Editor, AOB/Update-Scan, Debugger).  Wird aus gui.py über den Button
"WERKZEUGE" geöffnet und nutzt eine EIGENE Verbindung zur PS5, damit die
Haupt-Verbindung (Patches an/aus) nie durcheinanderkommt."""
import tools_i18n
import json

# ==================================================================

        button(wr, "→ DISASM", lambda: self.win.goto_disasm(self._cur_addr())).pack(side="right")

    def _cur_addr(self):
        return self.cur if self.cur is not None else self.addr(self.v_addr.get())

    def goto(self, address):
        self.v_addr.set(hexs(address))
        self.read()

    def page(self, d):
        try:
            n = int(self.v_len.get(), 0)
            self.v_addr.set(hexs(max(0, self._cur_addr() + d * n)))
            self.read()
        except Exception as e:
            self.log(str(e), "err")

    def _auto(self):
        self.auto = self.v_auto.get()
        if self.auto:
            self._tick()

    def _tick(self):
        if not self.auto or not self.winfo_exists():
            return
        self.read(quiet=True)
        self.after(500, self._tick)

    def read(self, quiet=False):
        try:
            a = self.addr(self.v_addr.get())
            n = max(1, min(int(self.v_len.get(), 0), 0x10000))
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        self.cur = a
        self.v_waddr.set(hexs(a))
        self.bg(lambda: self.win.client.read_memory(a, n),
                lambda data: self._show(a, data),
                (lambda e: None) if quiet else None)

    def _show(self, a, data):
        self.last = (a, bytes(data))
        lines = []
        for i in range(0, len(data), 16):
            row = data[i:i + 16]
            hx = " ".join(f"{b:02X}" for b in row).ljust(47)
            asc = "".join(chr(b) if 32 <= b < 127 else "." for b in row)
            lines.append(f"{a + i:016X}  {hx}  {asc}")
        self.txt.configure(state="normal")
        self.txt.delete("1.0", "end")
        self.txt.insert("1.0", "\n".join(lines))
        self.txt.configure(state="disabled")

    # ---- Inspektor / Snapshot / Datei ----
    def _inspect(self, _e):
        import memtools
        try:
            line, col = (int(x) for x in self.txt.index("insert").split("."))
        except Exception:
            return
        a, data = self.last
        if col >= 18 and col < 18 + 47:
            i = (col - 18) // 3
        elif col >= 18 + 49:
            i = col - (18 + 49)
        else:
            return
        pos = (line - 1) * 16 + i
        if not 0 <= pos < len(data):
            return
        info = memtools.inspect(data[pos:pos + 8])
        self.v_waddr.set(hexs(a + pos))
        self.lbl_insp.configure(text=f"{a + pos:#x}:  " + "   ".join(f"{k} {v}" for k, v in info[:9]))

    def snapshot(self):
        a, data = self.last
        if not data:
            return self.log("erst LESEN", "warn")
        self.snap = (a, data)
        self.log(f"Snapshot {a:#x} ({len(data):#x} Byte) gemerkt - Wert im Spiel aendern, dann VERGLEICH", "ok")

    def compare(self):
        import memtools
        if not self.snap:
            return self.log("erst SNAPSHOT", "warn")
        a, old = self.snap

        def show(new):
            runs = memtools.diff_bytes(old, new, a)
            d = tk.Toplevel(self); d.title(f"Vergleich: {len(runs)} geaenderte Bereiche")
            d.configure(bg=BG)
            tv = tree(d, [("a", "ADRESSE"), ("o", "ALT"), ("n", "NEU")], [140, 220, 220], height=20)
            with_scroll(d, tv)
            for ad, o, n in runs[:5000]:
                tv.insert("", "end", values=(f"{ad:#x}", o.hex(" ").upper(), n.hex(" ").upper()))
            tv.bind("<Double-1>", lambda _e: tv.selection() and (
                self.goto(int(tv.item(tv.selection()[0], "values")[0], 16))))
            self.log(f"Vergleich: {len(runs)} Bereiche geaendert", "ok")
        self.bg(lambda: self.win.client.read_memory(a, len(old)), show)

    def save_file(self):
        a, data = self.last
        if not data:
            return self.log("erst LESEN", "warn")
        fn = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(parent=self.win, initialfile=f"dump_{a:X}.bin",
                                          filetypes=[("Binaer", "*.bin"), ("Alle", "*.*")])
        if fn:
            with open(fn, "wb") as f:
                f.write(data)
            self.log(f"{len(data)} Byte -> {fn}", "ok")

    def load_file(self):
        try:
            a = self.addr(self.v_waddr.get())
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        fn = filedialog.askopenfilename(parent=self.win)
        if not fn:
            return
        with open(fn, "rb") as f:
            data = f.read(0x100000)
        if not data or not messagebox.askyesno("Datei -> Speicher",
                                               f"{len(data)} Byte aus der Datei nach {a:#x} schreiben?",
                                               parent=self.win):
            return
        self.bg(lambda: self.win.client.write_memory(a, data),
                lambda _r: (self.log(f"{len(data)} Byte geschrieben @ {a:#x}", "ok"), self.read()))

    def copy_dump(self):
        import memtools
        a, data = self.last
        if data:
            self.clipboard_clear(); self.clipboard_append(memtools.hexdump(data, a))
            self.log("Hexdump in der Zwischenablage", "ok")

    def write(self):
        try:
            a = self.addr(self.v_waddr.get())
            data = AT.parse_hex_bytes(self.v_wbytes.get())
            if not data:
                raise ValueError("Keine Bytes")
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        if not messagebox.askyesno("Schreiben", f"{len(data)} Byte(s) nach {a:#x} schreiben?"):
            return

        def job():
            self.win.client.write_memory(a, data)
            return self.win.client.read_memory(a, len(data))
        self.bg(job, lambda back: (self.log(f"Geschrieben @ {a:#x}: {AT.hexdump_line(back)}", "ok"),
                                   self.read()))

    def load_maps(self):
        self.bg(lambda: self.win.client.get_maps(), self._show_maps)

    def _show_maps(self, maps):
        self.maps.delete(*self.maps.get_children())
        for s, e, p in sorted(maps):
            flags = ("r" if p & 1 else "-") + ("w" if p & 2 else "-") + ("x" if p & 4 else "-")
            self.maps.insert("", "end", values=(f"{s:016X}", f"{e:016X}", flags))

    def _map_dbl(self, _e):
        sel = self.maps.selection()
        if sel:
            self.goto(int(self.maps.item(sel[0], "values")[0], 16))


# ==================================================================
# Tab: Disassembler
# ==================================================================
class DisasmTab(BaseTab):
    def __init__(self, parent, win):
        super().__init__(parent, win)
        self.lines = []
        bar = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); bar.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=(8, 4))
        label(bar, "ADRESSE").pack(side="left")
        self.v_addr = tk.StringVar(value="base")
        e = entry(bar, self.v_addr, 22); e.pack(side="left", padx=6)
        e.bind("<Return>", lambda _e: self.run())
        label(bar, "ANZAHL").pack(side="left")
        self.v_n = tk.StringVar(value="64")
        entry(bar, self.v_n, 5).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        button(bar, "DISASM", self.run, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(bar, "▶ WEITER", self.next_page).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(bar, "FOLGEN", self.follow).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        if not AT.HAVE_CAPSTONE:
            label(bar, "  Capstone fehlt: pip install capstone").pack(side="left")

        cols = [("addr", "ADRESSE"), ("off", "OFFSET"), ("bytes", "BYTES"), ("ins", "INSTRUKTION")]
        fr = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); fr.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8)
        self.tv = tree(fr, cols, [150, 90, 200, 380], height=22)
        with_scroll(fr, self.tv)
        self.tv.bind("<Double-1>", lambda _e: self.follow())

        act = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); act.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=8)
        button(act, "NOP", self.nop).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(act, "ÄNDERN…", self.patch).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(act, "XREFS AUF ADRESSE", self.xrefs).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(act, "→ HEX", self.to_hex).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(act, "→ CHEAT-EDITOR", self.to_cheat, accent=True).pack(side="right")
        button(act, "ALS CAVE-HOOK", self.to_cave_hook, accent=True).pack(side="right", padx=(0, 6))

    def goto(self, address):
        self.v_addr.set(hexs(address))
        self.run()

    def run(self):
        try:
            a = self.addr(self.v_addr.get())
            n = max(1, min(int(self.v_n.get(), 0), 1000))
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")

        def job():
            data = self.win.client.read_memory(a, n * 15 + 16)
            return AT.disassemble_lines(data, a, n)
        self.bg(job, self._show)

    def _show(self, lines):
        self.lines = lines
        self.tv.delete(*self.tv.get_children())
        base = self.base
        for i, l in enumerate(lines):
            off = l["addr"] - base
            self.tv.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(
                f"{l['addr']:016X}", f"+{off:X}" if off >= 0 else "-",
                AT.hexdump_line(l["bytes"]), f"{l['mnemonic']} {l['op_str']}".strip()))

    def next_page(self):
        if self.lines:
            last = self.lines[-1]
            self.v_addr.set(hexs(last["addr"] + last["size"]))
            self.run()

    def _selected(self):
        return [self.lines[int(i)] for i in self.tv.selection()]

    def follow(self):
        sel = self._selected()
        if not sel:
            return
        t = AT.branch_target(sel[0]) or AT.rip_target(sel[0])
        if t is None:
            return self.log("Kein direktes Sprung-/RIP-Ziel in dieser Zeile", "warn")
        if AT.branch_target(sel[0]) is not None:
            self.goto(t)
        else:
            self.win.goto_memory(t)

    def _write(self, address, data, what):
        def job():
            self.win.client.write_memory(address, data)
            return self.win.client.read_memory(address, len(data))
        self.bg(job, lambda back: (self.log(f"{what} @ {address:#x}: {AT.hexdump_line(back)}", "ok"),
                                   self.run()))

    def nop(self):
        sel = self._selected()
        if not sel:
            return
        a = sel[0]["addr"]
        n = sum(l["size"] for l in sel)
        if messagebox.askyesno("NOP", f"{n} Byte(s) ab {a:#x} mit NOP (90) füllen?"):
            self._write(a, b"\x90" * n, "NOP")

    def patch(self):
        sel = self._selected()
        if not sel:
            return
        a = sel[0]["addr"]
        size = sum(l["size"] for l in sel)
        text = simpledialog.askstring(
            "Ändern", f"Neuer Assembler-Code für {size} Byte(s) @ {a:#x}\n"
                      f"(mehrere Befehle mit ; trennen, Rest wird NOP):", parent=self)
        if not text:
            return
        try:
            data = AT.assemble(text.replace(";", "\n"), a, self.win.client)
            if len(data) > size:
                return messagebox.showerror("Zu groß", f"{len(data)} > {size} Bytes")
            data += b"\x90" * (size - len(data))
        except Exception as e:
            return messagebox.showerror("Assembler", str(e))
        self._write(a, data, "Patch")

    def xrefs(self):
        sel = self._selected()
        if not sel:
            return
        target = sel[0]["addr"]

        def job():
            regs = AOB.exec_regions(self.win.client.get_maps())
            out = []
            for s, e in regs:
                out += X.find_xrefs_to(self.win.client, s, e - s, target)
            return out
        self.bg(job, lambda res: self.win.show_list(f"Xrefs auf {target:#x}", res))

    def to_hex(self):
        sel = self._selected()
        if sel:
            self.win.goto_memory(sel[0]["addr"])

    def to_cave_hook(self):
        """Gewählte Zeile = Hook-Start. Kopiert ganze Befehle (>= 8 Byte) in eine Cave-Vorlage."""
        sel = self._selected()
        if not sel:
            return self.log("Erst die Startzeile des Hooks markieren", "warn")
        a = sel[0]["addr"]

        def job():
            return AT.build_cave_hook(self.win.client.read_memory(a, 96), a)

        def ok(r):
            r["addr"] = a
            self.win.to_cave_hook(r)
            for w in r["warnings"]:
                self.log(f"Hook: {w}", "warn")
        self.bg(job, ok)

    def to_cheat(self):
        sel = self._selected()
        if not sel:
            return
        a = sel[0]["addr"]
        orig = " ".join(AT.hexdump_line(l["bytes"]) for l in sel)
        asm = "\n".join(f"{l['mnemonic']} {l['op_str']}".strip() for l in sel)
        self.win.to_cheat({"addr": a, "default": orig, "default_asm": asm})

# Tab: Konverter

class ConverterTab(BaseTab):
    def __init__(self, parent, win):
        super().__init__(parent, win)
        top = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); top.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8, pady=8)
        l = tk.Frame(top, bg=BG); l.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
        r = tk.Frame(top, bg=BG); r.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True, padx=(8, 0))

        label(l, "ASSEMBLER (x86-64, Intel)").pack(anchor="w")
        self.asm = textbox(l, height=10, width=40); self.asm.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        row = tk.Frame(l, bg=BG); row.pack(fill="x", pady=4)
        label(row, "BASIS").pack(side="left")
        self.v_base = tk.StringVar(value="0")
        entry(row, self.v_base, 16).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        button(row, "→ BYTES", self.to_bytes, accent=True).pack(side="left")

        label(r, "BYTES (hex)").pack(anchor="w")
        self.hx = textbox(r, height=10, width=40); self.hx.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        row = tk.Frame(r, bg=BG); row.pack(fill="x", pady=4)
        button(row, "→ ASSEMBLER", self.to_asm, accent=True).pack(side="left")

        label(self, "WERT-KONVERTER (Hex / Dezimal / Float)").pack(anchor="w", padx=8)
        row = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); row.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=4)
        self.v_val = tk.StringVar(value="0x3F800000")
        e = entry(row, self.v_val, 26); e.pack(side="left")
        e.bind("<Return>", lambda _e: self.conv())
        button(row, "KONVERTIEREN", self.conv, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        self.res = tree(self, [("k", "TYP"), ("v", "WERT")], [180, 420], height=9)
        self.res.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=(0, 8))

    def to_bytes(self):
        try:
            base = self.addr(self.v_base.get()) if self.v_base.get().strip() not in ("", "0") else 0
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        text = self.asm.get("1.0", "end").strip()

        def job():
            return AT.assemble(text, base, self.win.client)
        self.bg(job, lambda b: (self.hx.delete("1.0", "end"),
                                self.hx.insert("1.0", AT.hexdump_line(b)),
                                self.log(f"{len(b)} Byte(s) assembliert", "ok")))

    def to_asm(self):
        try:
            data = AT.parse_hex_bytes(self.hx.get("1.0", "end"))
            base = self.addr(self.v_base.get()) if self.v_base.get().strip() not in ("", "0") else 0
            lines = AT.disassemble_lines(data, base)
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        self.asm.delete("1.0", "end")
        self.asm.insert("1.0", "\n".join(f"{l['mnemonic']} {l['op_str']}".strip() for l in lines))

    def conv(self):
        self.res.delete(*self.res.get_children())
        try:
            out = AT.convert_value(self.v_val.get())
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        for k, v in out.items():
            self.res.insert("", "end", values=(k, v))

# Tab: Cheat-Editor

CAVE_TEMPLATE = (";  Cave-Code (läuft anstelle der überschriebenen Befehle)\n"
                 ";  Die Original-Befehle hier wiederholen, dann zurückspringen:\n"
                 "    jmp OriginReturn\n")


class CheatTab(BaseTab):
    def __init__(self, parent, win):
        super().__init__(parent, win)
        self.test_state = None
        self.test_rp = None
        self.v = {k: tk.StringVar() for k in ("name", "author", "offset", "aob", "aoboff", "ret")}
        self.v["aoboff"].set("0")
        self.v["ret"].set("8")
        self.v_type = tk.StringVar(value="patch")

        g = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); g.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=(8, 2))
        for i, (k, t, w) in enumerate([("name", "NAME", 30), ("author", "AUTOR", 16),
                                        ("offset", "OFFSET (ab Image-Base)", 16)]):
            label(g, t).grid(row=0, column=i * 2, sticky="w", padx=(0, 4))
            entry(g, self.v[k], w).grid(row=0, column=i * 2 + 1, padx=(0, 12))
        t = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); t.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=2)
        for val, txt in (("patch", "EINFACHER PATCH / NOP"), ("cave", "CODE-CAVE")):
            tk.Radiobutton(t, text=txt, variable=self.v_type, value=val, command=self._type,
                           bg=BG, fg=TEXT, selectcolor=BG_CARD, activebackground=BG,
                           activeforeground=ACCENT, font=FONT_LABEL).pack(side="left", padx=(0, 12))
        label(t, "OriginReturn (Bytes)").pack(side="left", padx=(12, 4))
        entry(t, self.v["ret"], 4).pack(side="left")

        cols = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); cols.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8, pady=4)
        a = tk.Frame(cols, bg=BG); a.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True)
        b = tk.Frame(cols, bg=BG); b.pack(side="left", fill="both", expand=True, padx=(8, 0))
        label(a, "ORIGINAL (Assembler oder Hex-Bytes)").pack(anchor="w")
        self.t_def = textbox(a, height=6, width=34); self.t_def.pack(fill="both", expand=True)
        self.lbl_new = label(b, "NEU (Assembler oder Hex-Bytes, z.B.  nop:8 )")
        self.lbl_new.pack(anchor="w")
        self.t_new = textbox(b, height=6, width=34); self.t_new.pack(fill="both", expand=True)

        label(self, "CAVE-CODE (nur bei Code-Cave) – neue Labels mit  'Name:'  in eigener Zeile")\
            .pack(anchor="w", padx=8)
        self.t_cave = textbox(self, height=7, width=80)
        self.t_cave.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8)
        self.t_cave.insert("1.0", tools_i18n.translate(CAVE_TEMPLATE))

        s = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); s.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=4)
        label(s, "SIGNATUR").pack(side="left")
        entry(s, self.v["aob"], 62).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        label(s, "OFFSET").pack(side="left")
        entry(s, self.v["aoboff"], 5).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        button(s, "ERZEUGEN", self.make_sig).pack(side="left")

        f = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); f.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=8)
        button(f, "NEU", self.clear).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(f, "LADEN…", self.load_file).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(f, "TEST AN", self.test_on).pack(side="left", padx=(16, 2))
        button(f, "TEST AUS", self.test_off).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(f, "SPEICHERN…", self.save, accent=True).pack(side="right")
        self._type()

    # ---- Übernahme aus anderen Tabs ----
    def fill(self, d):
        if "addr" in d:
            self.v["offset"].set(hexs(d["addr"] - self.base))
        if "default" in d:
            self.t_def.delete("1.0", "end"); self.t_def.insert("1.0", d["default"])
        if "new" in d:
            self.t_new.delete("1.0", "end"); self.t_new.insert("1.0", d["new"])
        if "aob" in d:
            self.v["aob"].set(d["aob"]); self.v["aoboff"].set(str(d.get("aoboff", 0)))

    def fill_hook(self, d):
        """Vorlage vom Disassembler (AT.build_cave_hook): Code-Cave komplett vorbelegen."""
        self.clear()
        off = d["addr"] - self.base
        self.v["offset"].set(hexs(off))
        if not self.v["name"].get().strip():
            self.v["name"].set(f"Hook_{off:X}")
        self.v["ret"].set(str(d["size"]))                       # OriginReturn = Summe der Befehle
        self.t_def.delete("1.0", "end"); self.t_def.insert("1.0", d["default"])
        self.t_new.delete("1.0", "end"); self.t_new.insert("1.0", d["new"])
        self.v_type.set("cave")
        self._type()                                            # Cave-Textfeld aktivieren
        self.t_cave.delete("1.0", "end"); self.t_cave.insert("1.0", d["cave"])
        self.log(f"Cave-Hook @ {d['addr']:#x}: {d['size']} Byte überschrieben, "
                 f"OriginReturn = {d['size']}", "ok")

    def clear(self):
        for k in self.v:
            self.v[k].set("")
        self.v["aoboff"].set("0"); self.v["ret"].set("8")
        for t in (self.t_def, self.t_new):
            t.delete("1.0", "end")
        self.t_cave.delete("1.0", "end"); self.t_cave.insert("1.0", tools_i18n.translate(CAVE_TEMPLATE))

    def _type(self):
        cave = self.v_type.get() == "cave"
        self.t_cave.configure(state="normal" if cave else "disabled")
        if cave and not self.t_new.get("1.0", "end").strip():
            self.t_new.insert("1.0", "jmp OriginTarget")

    # ---- Modell <-> JSON ----
    def _offset(self):
        t = self.v["offset"].get().strip()
        if not t:
            raise ValueError("Offset fehlt")
        return int(t, 16) if not t.lower().startswith("0x") else int(t, 16)

    def _cave_labels(self):
        """Text -> [(label, code)]. Erster Block ohne Label = OriginTarget."""
        blocks, cur, lines = [], "OriginTarget", []
        for raw in self.t_cave.get("1.0", "end").splitlines():
            s = raw.strip()
            if s.endswith(":") and " " not in s and not s.startswith(";"):
                if lines:
                    blocks.append((cur, "\n".join(lines)))
                cur, lines = s[:-1], []
            elif s and not s.startswith((";", "#", "//")):     # Kommentarzeilen weglassen
                lines.append(raw.rstrip())
        if lines:
            blocks.append((cur, "\n".join(lines)))
        return blocks

    def build_json(self):
        name = self.v["name"].get().strip()
        if not name:
            raise ValueError("Name fehlt")
        src = {"label": "OriginSource", "offset": self._offset(),
               "defaultValue": self.t_def.get("1.0", "end").strip(),
               "newValue": self.t_new.get("1.0", "end").strip()}
        if not src["newValue"]:
            raise ValueError("'NEU' ist leer")
        if self.v["aob"].get().strip():
            AOB.parse_pattern(self.v["aob"].get())         # validieren
            src["aob"] = self.v["aob"].get().strip()
            src["aobOffset"] = int(self.v["aoboff"].get() or "0", 0)
        variables = [src]
        if self.v_type.get() == "cave":
            variables.append({"label": "OriginReturn", "offset": int(self.v["ret"].get() or "8", 0)})
            labels = self._cave_labels()
            if not labels:
                raise ValueError("Cave-Code fehlt")
            for lbl, code in labels:
                variables.append({"label": lbl, "defaultValue": code})
            if "jmp" not in src["newValue"].lower() and "call" not in src["newValue"].lower():
                src["newValue"] = "jmp OriginTarget"
        return {"name": name, "author": self.v["author"].get().strip(), "Variables": variables}

    def _hook_len_hint(self):
        try:
            return max(len(AT.parse_hex_bytes(self.t_def.get("1.0", "end"))), 1)
        except Exception:
            return 8

    def save(self):
        try:
            data = self.build_json()
        except Exception as e:
            return messagebox.showerror("Cheat-Editor", str(e))
        folder = self.win.app.PATCH_DIR or ""
        fn = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            parent=self, initialdir=folder or None,
            initialfile=f"{data['name']}.reapproj", defaultextension=".reapproj",
            filetypes=[("ReapProj", "*.reapproj"), ("JSON", "*.json")])
        if not fn:
            return
        with open(fn, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(data, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        self.log(f"Gespeichert: {fn}", "ok")
        if folder and os.path.abspath(os.path.dirname(fn)) == os.path.abspath(folder):
            self.win.app.load_patches()

    def load_file(self):
        fn = filedialog.askopenfilename(parent=self, initialdir=self.win.app.PATCH_DIR or None,
                                        filetypes=[("Patch", "*.reapproj *.json *.reapatch"), ("Alle", "*.*")])
        if not fn:
            return
        try:
            with open(fn, encoding="utf-8") as f:
                d = json.load(f)
            variables = d.get("Variables") or d.get("variables") or []
            src = next(v for v in variables if str(v.get("label", "")).lower().startswith("originsource"))
        except Exception as e:
            return messagebox.showerror("Laden", f"Kein lesbares Patch-Format: {e}")
        self.clear()
        self.v["name"].set(d.get("name", "")); self.v["author"].set(d.get("author", ""))
        off = src.get("offset", 0)
        self.v["offset"].set(hexs(int(off, 0) if isinstance(off, str) else int(off)))
        self.t_def.insert("1.0", src.get("defaultValue", "")); self.t_new.insert("1.0", src.get("newValue", ""))
        self.v["aob"].set(src.get("aob", "")); self.v["aoboff"].set(str(src.get("aobOffset", 0)))
        labels = [(v["label"], v.get("defaultValue", "")) for v in variables
                  if v is not src and v.get("defaultValue") and v.get("label") != "OriginReturn"]
        ret = next((v for v in variables if v.get("label") == "OriginReturn"), None)
        if labels:
            self.v_type.set("cave")
            self.t_cave.configure(state="normal")
            self.t_cave.delete("1.0", "end")
            for lbl, code in labels:
                if lbl != "OriginTarget":
                    self.t_cave.insert("end", f"{lbl}:\n")
                self.t_cave.insert("end", code + "\n")
            if ret:
                self.v["ret"].set(str(ret.get("offset", 8)))
        else:
            self.v_type.set("patch")
        self._type()

    # ---- Signatur ----
    def make_sig(self):
        try:
            a = self.base + self._offset()
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        hl = 8 if self.v_type.get() == "cave" else self._hook_len_hint()

        def job():
            return AOB.make_signature(self.win.client, self.win.client.get_maps(), a, hl)
        self.bg(job, lambda r: (self.v["aob"].set(r[0]), self.v["aoboff"].set("0"),
                                self.log(f"Signatur eindeutig ({len(r[0].split())} Bytes)", "ok")))

    # ---- Test auf der Konsole ----
    def _temp_patch(self):
        data = self.build_json()
        fd, path = tempfile.mkstemp(suffix=".reapproj")
        with os.fdopen(fd, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(data, f)
        rp = ReapPatch.load(path)
        os.remove(path)
        return rp

    def test_on(self):
        try:
            rp = self._temp_patch()
            hook = self.base + self._offset()
        except Exception as e:
            return messagebox.showerror("Test", str(e))
        if self.test_state:
            return self.log("Test läuft schon - erst TEST AUS", "warn")
        self.test_rp = rp

        def job():
            return apply_patch(self.win.app.backend, rp, hook)
        self.bg(job, lambda st: (setattr(self, "test_state", st),
                                 self.log(f"Test aktiv @ {hook:#x}", "ok")))

    def test_off(self):
        if not self.test_state:
            return self.log("Kein aktiver Test", "warn")
        st, rp = self.test_state, self.test_rp

        def job():
            return deactivate_patch(self.win.app.backend, rp, st)
        self.bg(job, lambda _r: (setattr(self, "test_state", None),
                                 self.log("Test zurückgesetzt", "ok")))
```
