```py
class AobTab(BaseTab):
    def __init__(self, parent, win):
        super().__init__(parent, win)
        top = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); top.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=(8, 2))
        label(top, "MUSTER").pack(side="left")
        self.v_pat = tk.StringVar()
        entry(top, self.v_pat, 60).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        self.v_scope = tk.StringVar(value="exec")
        ttk.Combobox(top, textvariable=self.v_scope, values=["exec", "alle lesbaren"],
                     width=14, state="readonly").pack(side="left", padx=4)
        button(top, "SERVER-SCAN", lambda: self.scan(False), accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(top, "LOKAL (ALLE)", lambda: self.scan(True)).pack(side="left", padx=2)

        sig = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); sig.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=2)
        label(sig, "SIGNATUR AUS ADRESSE").pack(side="left")
        self.v_addr = tk.StringVar()
        entry(sig, self.v_addr, 20).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        label(sig, "HOOK-LÄNGE").pack(side="left")
        self.v_hl = tk.StringVar(value="8")
        entry(sig, self.v_hl, 4).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        self.v_wild = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
        tk.Checkbutton(sig, text="Hook-Bytes wildcarden", variable=self.v_wild, bg=BG, fg=TEXT_DIM,
                       selectcolor=BG_CARD, activebackground=BG, activeforeground=ACCENT,
                       font=FONT_LABEL).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        button(sig, "ERZEUGEN", self.make_sig).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(sig, "→ CHEAT-EDITOR", self.sig_to_cheat).pack(side="left", padx=2)

        fr = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); fr.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=4)
        self.res = tree(fr, [("addr", "TREFFER"), ("off", "OFFSET")], [200, 120], height=5)
        with_scroll(fr, self.res)
        self.res.bind("<Double-1>", self._dbl)

        label(self, "PATCHES – SIGNATUREN & UPDATE-SCAN (nach Spiel-Updates)").pack(anchor="w", padx=8, pady=(8, 0))
        fr2 = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); fr2.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8)
        self.pt = tree(fr2, [("name", "PATCH"), ("off", "OFFSET"), ("sig", "SIGNATUR"),
                             ("found", "GEFUNDEN"), ("new", "NEUER OFFSET"), ("state", "STATUS")],
                       [230, 90, 80, 140, 110, 200], height=10)
        with_scroll(fr2, self.pt)
        self.rows = {}           # iid -> dict(path, rp, new_off)

        act = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); act.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=8)
        button(act, "LISTE LADEN", self.fill_patches).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(act, "SIGNATUREN ERZEUGEN (fehlende)", self.gen_all).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(act, "UPDATE-SCAN", self.update_scan, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(act, "OFFSETS ÜBERNEHMEN", self.apply_updates, accent=True).pack(side="right", padx=2)

    # ---- freies Scannen ----
    def scan(self, local):
        try:
            pat, mask = AOB.parse_pattern(self.v_pat.get())
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        scope = self.v_scope.get()

        def job():
            maps = self.win.client.get_maps()
            regs = AOB.exec_regions(maps) if scope == "exec" else AOB.readable_regions(maps)
            if local:
                return AOB.scan_local(self.win.client, regs, pat, mask, limit=200)
            return AOB.find_matches(self.win.client, regs, pat, mask, limit=50)
        self.bg(job, self._show)

    def _show(self, hits):
        self.res.delete(*self.res.get_children())
        for a in hits:
            self.res.insert("", "end", values=(f"{a:016X}", f"+{a - self.base:X}" if a >= self.base else "-"))
        self.log(f"{len(hits)} Treffer", "ok" if hits else "warn")

    def _dbl(self, _e):
        sel = self.res.selection()
        if sel:
            self.win.goto_disasm(int(self.res.item(sel[0], "values")[0], 16))

    # ---- Signatur aus Adresse ----
    def make_sig(self):
        try:
            a = self.addr(self.v_addr.get())
            hl = int(self.v_hl.get(), 0)
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        wild = self.v_wild.get()

        def job():
            return AOB.make_signature(self.win.client, self.win.client.get_maps(), a, hl, wild)
        self.bg(job, lambda r: (self.v_pat.set(r[0]),
                                self.log(f"Eindeutige Signatur ({len(r[0].split())} Bytes)", "ok")))

    def sig_to_cheat(self):
        try:
            a = self.addr(self.v_addr.get())
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        self.win.to_cheat({"addr": a, "aob": self.v_pat.get().strip(), "aoboff": 0})

    # ---- Patch-Liste ----
    def fill_patches(self):
        self.pt.delete(*self.pt.get_children())
        self.rows.clear()
        for i, (path, rp) in enumerate(self.win.app.patches.items()):
            if not rp.origin_source:
                continue
            iid = str(i)
            self.rows[iid] = {"path": path, "rp": rp, "new_off": None}
            self.pt.insert("", "end", iid=iid, values=(
                rp.name, hexs(rp.origin_source[0]), "ja" if rp.origin_aob else "-", "", "", ""))

    def _set(self, iid, **kw):
        cols = ["name", "off", "sig", "found", "new", "state"]
        vals = list(self.pt.item(iid, "values"))
        for k, v in kw.items():
            vals[cols.index(k)] = v
        self.pt.item(iid, values=vals)

    def _hook_len(self, rp, hook):
        if is_cave_patch(rp):
            return 8
        try:
            d = asm_to_bytes(self.win.app.backend, rp.origin_source[1], hook)
            n = asm_to_bytes(self.win.app.backend, rp.origin_source[2], hook)
            return max(len(d), len(n), 1)
        except Exception:
            return 8

    def gen_all(self):
        if not self.rows:
            self.fill_patches()
        todo = [(iid, r) for iid, r in self.rows.items() if not r["rp"].origin_aob]
        if not todo:
            return self.log("Alle Patches haben schon eine Signatur", "info")
        if not messagebox.askyesno("Signaturen", f"Für {len(todo)} Patch(es) Signaturen erzeugen und "
                                   f"in die Patch-Dateien schreiben?\n(Das Spiel sollte die Version "
                                   f"haben, zu der die Offsets passen!)"):
            return
        base = self.base

        def job():
            maps = self.win.client.get_maps()
            out = []
            for iid, r in todo:
                rp = r["rp"]
                hook = base + rp.origin_source[0]
                try:
                    sig, _ = AOB.make_signature(self.win.client, maps, hook, self._hook_len(rp, hook))
                    AOB.update_patch_file(r["path"], aob=sig, aob_offset=0)
                    out.append((iid, "ok", sig))
                except Exception as e:
                    out.append((iid, "err", str(e)))
            return out

        def done(res):
            for iid, st, msg in res:
                self._set(iid, sig="ja" if st == "ok" else "-",
                          state="Signatur gespeichert" if st == "ok" else f"Fehler: {msg}"[:60])
            self.log(f"{sum(1 for _, s, _ in res if s == 'ok')}/{len(res)} Signaturen gespeichert", "ok")
            self.win.app.load_patches()
            self.after(300, self.fill_patches)
        self.bg(job, done)

    def update_scan(self):
        if not self.rows:
            self.fill_patches()
        base = self.base
        rows = {iid: r for iid, r in self.rows.items() if r["rp"].origin_aob}
        if not rows:
            return self.log("Keine Patches mit Signatur - erst SIGNATUREN ERZEUGEN", "warn")

        def job():
            regs = AOB.exec_regions(self.win.client.get_maps())
            out = []
            for iid, r in rows.items():
                rp = r["rp"]
                try:
                    pat, mask = AOB.parse_pattern(rp.origin_aob)
                    hits = AOB.find_matches(self.win.client, regs, pat, mask, limit=3)
                    out.append((iid, hits))
                except Exception as e:
                    out.append((iid, str(e)))
            return out

        def done(res):
            for iid, hits in res:
                r = self.rows[iid]
                old = base + r["rp"].origin_source[0]
                if isinstance(hits, str):
                    self._set(iid, state=f"Fehler: {hits}"[:60]); continue
                if not hits:
                    self._set(iid, found="-", new="", state="NICHT GEFUNDEN"); continue
                hook = hits[0] + r["rp"].origin_aob_offset
                new_off = hook - base
                r["new_off"] = new_off
                note = "mehrdeutig! " if len(hits) > 1 else ""
                state = (note + "unverändert") if hook == old else (note + "VERSCHOBEN")
                self._set(iid, found=hexs(hook), new=hexs(new_off), state=state)
            self.log("Update-Scan fertig", "ok")
        self.bg(job, done)

    def apply_updates(self):
        changes = [(iid, r) for iid, r in self.rows.items()
                   if r["new_off"] is not None and r["new_off"] != r["rp"].origin_source[0]
                   and "mehrdeutig" not in self.pt.item(iid, "values")[5]]
        if not changes:
            return self.log("Keine eindeutigen Änderungen", "info")
        if not messagebox.askyesno("Offsets übernehmen",
                                   f"{len(changes)} Patch-Datei(en) mit neuem Offset überschreiben?"):
            return
        n = 0
        for iid, r in changes:
            try:
                AOB.update_patch_file(r["path"], new_offset=r["new_off"])
                n += 1
            except Exception as e:
                self._set(iid, state=f"Fehler: {e}"[:60])
        self.log(f"{n} Datei(en) aktualisiert", "ok")
        AOB.clear_cache()
        self.win.app.load_patches()
        self.after(300, self.fill_patches)

    # ---- Verbindung ----
    def _connect(self):
        be = self.app.backend
        if not be.client or be.pid is None:
            raise RuntimeError("Haupt-Fenster nicht verbunden (erst VERBINDEN)")
        c = PS5DebugClient(be.host, be.port)
        c.connect()
        c.pid = be.pid
        self.client = c
        return True

    def _set_state(self, text, color):
        self.lbl_state.configure(text=text, fg=color)

    # ---- Hintergrund-Jobs ----
    def bg(self, fn, ok=None, err=None, lock=True):
        """Job im Hintergrund. lock=False für Jobs mit eigener Verbindung (z.B. Scanner)."""
        def run():
            try:
                if lock:
                    with self.net_lock:
                        res = fn()
                else:
                    res = fn()
            except Exception as e:
                self.q.put((err or self._log_err, e))
            else:
                self.q.put((ok, res))
        threading.Thread(target=run, daemon=True).start()

    def _log_err(self, e):
        self.log(f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}", "err")

    def _poll(self):
        try:
            while True:
                cb, val = self.q.get_nowait()
                if cb:
                    try:
                        cb(val)
                    except Exception as e:
                        self.log(f"UI-Fehler: {e}", "err")
        except queue.Empty:
            pass
        if self.winfo_exists():
            self.after(80, self._poll)

    def log(self, msg, kind="info"):
        if not self.winfo_exists():
            return
        self.logbox.configure(state="normal")
        try:
            import tools_i18n
            msg = tools_i18n.translate(str(msg))
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            import logsetup
            logsetup.log("[tools] " + str(msg), kind)
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.logbox.insert("end", time.strftime("%H:%M:%S ") + str(msg) + "\n", kind)
        self.logbox.see("end")
        self.logbox.configure(state="disabled")

    def apply_language(self):
        """Sprache des Hauptfensters (DE/EN) auf alle Tabs anwenden; im EN-Modus alle 2 s nachziehen
        (Texte, die die Tabs zwischendurch deutsch setzen)."""
        try:
            import tools_i18n
            if not self.winfo_exists():
                return
            tools_i18n.apply_to(self)
            if tools_i18n.lang() == "en" and not getattr(self, "_i18n_tick", False):
                self._i18n_tick = True
                self.after(2000, self._i18n_loop)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def _i18n_loop(self):
        self._i18n_tick = False
        try:
            import tools_i18n
            if self.winfo_exists() and tools_i18n.lang() == "en":
                self.apply_language()
        except Exception:
            pass

    def save_log(self):
        path = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(title="Log speichern", defaultextension=".txt", initialfile="werkzeuge_log.txt",
                                            filetypes=[("Text", "*.txt")])
        if path:
            with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(self.logbox.get("1.0", "end-1c"))

    def ui(self, fn):
        """Thread-sicher etwas im UI-Thread ausführen (z.B. aus dem Debugger-Callback)."""
        self.q.put((lambda _v: fn(), None))

    # ---- Navigation zwischen Tabs ----
    def show_tab(self, tab):
        """Tab nach vorne holen - auch wenn er im Notebook FORTGESCHRITTEN liegt."""
        if tab is None:
            return
        try:
            if getattr(tab, "master", None) is self.adv_nb:
                self.nb.select(self.adv_frame)
                self.adv_nb.select(tab)
            else:
                self.nb.select(tab)
        except Exception:
            pass

    def goto_memory(self, address):
        self.show_tab(self.t_mem); self.t_mem.goto(address)

    def goto_disasm(self, address):
        self.show_tab(self.t_dis); self.t_dis.goto(address)

    def to_pointer(self, address, vname="Int32"):
        if not self.ptr_tab:
            return self.log("Pointer-Tab nicht verfügbar", "err")
        self.show_tab(self.ptr_tab)
        self.ptr_tab.set_target(address, vname)
        self.log("Pointer: 1) KARTE ERSTELLEN  2) PFADE SUCHEN", "info")

    def to_debug_watch(self, address, size=4):
        if not self.dbg_tab:
            return self.log("Debugger-Tab nicht verfügbar", "err")
        self.show_tab(self.dbg_tab)
        self.dbg_tab.v_wp.set(hexs(address))
        self.dbg_tab.v_wsize.set(str(size if size in (1, 2, 4, 8) else 4))
        self.log("Debugger: ATTACH, dann WATCHPOINT SETZEN (Typ 'schreiben'). RIP des Treffers zeigt "
                 "HINTER die schreibende Instruktion - die davor ist der Schreiber.", "info")

    def to_cheat(self, data):
        self.show_tab(self.t_cheat); self.t_cheat.fill(data)

    def to_cave_hook(self, data):
        self.show_tab(self.t_cheat); self.t_cheat.fill_hook(data)

    # ---- Sitzung ----
    def session_save(self):
        import session
        app = self.app
        fn = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(
            parent=self, initialdir=app.PATCH_DIR or None,
            initialfile=os.path.basename(session.default_path(app.PATCH_DIR, app.current_project)),
            defaultextension=session.EXT,
            filetypes=[("Cheat-Session", "*" + session.EXT), ("JSON", "*.json")])
        if not fn:
            return
        try:
            session.save(fn, session.collect(app))
            self.log(f"Sitzung gespeichert: {fn}", "ok")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Sitzung", str(e), parent=self)

    def session_load(self):
        import session
        app = self.app
        fn = filedialog.askopenfilename(
            parent=self, initialdir=app.PATCH_DIR or None,
            filetypes=[("Cheat-Session", "*" + session.EXT), ("JSON", "*.json")])
        if not fn:
            return
        try:
            data = session.load(fn)
        except Exception as e:
            return messagebox.showerror("Sitzung", str(e), parent=self)
        n_active = len((data.get("patches") or {}).get("active", []))
        activate = bool(n_active) and messagebox.askyesno(
            "Sitzung", f"{n_active} gespeicherte aktive Patch(es) jetzt einschalten?", parent=self)
        info = session.apply(app, data, activate=activate)
        if info["project_mismatch"]:
            self.log("Hinweis: Sitzung gehört zu einem anderen Projekt", "warn")
        self.log(f"Sitzung geladen: {info['cheats']} Cheat(s), {info['patches']} Patch(es) vorgemerkt"
                 f"{', ' + str(info['activated']) + ' aktiviert' if activate else ''}"
                 f"{', ' + str(info['missing']) + ' fehlen im Ordner' if info['missing'] else ''}", "ok")

    def on_game_changed(self):
        """Spiel wurde neu gestartet (neue PID): Verbindungen/Sitzungen der Tabs sind ungültig."""
        be = self.app.backend
        if self.client:
            self.client.pid = be.pid
        try:
            if self.dbg_tab:
                self.dbg_tab.shutdown()
                self.dbg_tab.sess = None
                self.dbg_tab.lbl.configure(text="nicht attached", fg=TEXT_DIM)
            if self.scan_tab:
                self.scan_tab.shutdown()
                self.scan_tab.sc = None
                self.scan_tab.running = False
            if self.ptr_tab:
                self.ptr_tab.pm = None
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.log(f"Spiel neu gestartet - neue PID {be.pid}; Scans/Debugger zurückgesetzt", "warn")

    def show_list(self, title, addrs):
        d = tk.Toplevel(self); d.title(title); d.configure(bg=BG)
        tv = tree(d, [("a", "ADRESSE"), ("o", "OFFSET")], [200, 120], height=16)
        tv.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8, pady=8)
        for a in addrs:
            tv.insert("", "end", values=(f"{a:016X}", f"+{a - self.app.IMAGE_BASE:X}"))
        tv.bind("<Double-1>", lambda _e: tv.selection() and
                self.goto_disasm(int(tv.item(tv.selection()[0], "values")[0], 16)))
        self.log(f"{title}: {len(addrs)} Treffer", "ok" if addrs else "warn")

    def close(self):
        try:
            import session
            self.app.tools_stash = session.collect_tools(self)    # Cheat-Liste überlebt das Schließen
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            if self.dbg_tab:
                self.dbg_tab.shutdown()
        except Exception:
            pass
        for _t in (getattr(self, "klog_tab", None), getattr(self, "script_tab", None),
                   *getattr(self, "extra_tabs", [])):
            try:
                if _t:
                    _t.shutdown()
            except Exception:
                pass
        try:
            if self.scan_tab:
                self.scan_tab.shutdown()
            if self.ptr_tab:
                self.ptr_tab.shutdown()
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            if self.client:
                self.client.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
        self.destroy()

```

`tools_i18n.py`:

```py
"""tools_i18n.py - Deutsch -> Englisch fuer die Werkzeug-Tabs (greift, wenn im Hauptfenster auf EN geschaltet wird).

Die Tabs haben ihre Texte deutsch im Code.  Statt jede Stelle umzubauen, uebersetzt diese Schicht zur Laufzeit:
  translate(text)        ganze Texte ueber das Woerterbuch (tools_i18n_en.EN), sonst Bruchstuecke (laengste zuerst) -
                         so werden auch Meldungen mit eingesetzten Zahlen/Namen uebersetzt
  apply_to(root)         Widget-Baum durchgehen: Beschriftungen, Notebook-Reiter, Tabellen-Kopfzeilen, Label-Variablen;
                         merkt sich je Widget den deutschen Originaltext -> Rueckschalten auf DE stellt alles wieder her
  install_var_hook()     StringVar.set uebersetzt Statuszeilen, die der Code nach dem Umschalten setzt
  install_dialog_hooks() Titel/Text von Meldungs-, Eingabe- und Dateidialogen
Auf Deutsch (Standard) tun alle Funktionen nichts.
"""
import re

LANG = "de"
_cache = {}
_rx = None
_EN = None
MIN_FRAGMENT = 4


LOAD_ERROR = ""          # Text des Fehlers, falls tools_i18n_en nicht geladen werden konnte


def _dict():
    global _EN, LOAD_ERROR
    if _EN is None:
        try:
            from tools_i18n_en import EN
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            EN = {}
            LOAD_ERROR = f"{e.__class__.__name__}: {e}"      # sichtbar machen statt still alles deutsch zu lassen
        _EN = EN
    return _EN


def status():
    """-> (Anzahl Woerterbuch-Eintraege, Fehlertext) - leer/0 heisst: Englisch faellt still auf Deutsch zurueck."""
    return len(_dict()), LOAD_ERROR


def set_lang(lang):
    global LANG
    LANG = lang if lang in ("de", "en") else "de"
    _cache.clear()


def lang():
    return LANG


def _regex():
    global _rx
    if _rx is None:
        keys = sorted((k for k in _dict() if len(k.strip()) >= MIN_FRAGMENT), key=len, reverse=True)
        L = "A-Za-zÄÖÜäöüß"

        def pat(k):                      # Bruchstuecke nur an Wortgrenzen ersetzen ('Menge' nicht in 'Mengenangabe')
            p = re.escape(k)
            if k[0].isalpha():
                p = f"(?<![{L}])" + p
            if k[-1].isalpha():
                p += f"(?![{L}])"
            return p
        _rx = re.compile("|".join(pat(k) for k in keys)) if keys else re.compile(r"(?!x)x")
    return _rx


def translate(text):
    """Deutscher Text -> englischer Text (nur im EN-Modus; sonst unveraendert)."""
    if LANG != "en" or not isinstance(text, str) or not text.strip():
        return text
    hit = _cache.get(text)
    if hit is not None:
        return hit
    en = _dict()
    if text in en:
        out = en[text]
    else:
        core = text.strip()
        if core in en:
            lead, trail = text[:len(text) - len(text.lstrip())], text[len(text.rstrip()):]
            out = lead + en[core] + trail
        else:
            out = _regex().sub(lambda m: en[m.group(0)], text)
    _cache[text] = out
    return out


tr = translate


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Widget-Baum
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
TEXT_CLASSES = {"Label", "Button", "Checkbutton", "Radiobutton", "Labelframe", "TLabel", "TButton", "TCheckbutton",
                "TRadiobutton", "TLabelframe", "Menubutton", "TMenubutton"}
VAR_CLASSES = {"Label", "TLabel"}


# Rueckwaerts-Tabelle fuer Auswahllisten: angezeigter englischer Wert -> deutscher Originalwert.
# Der Code vergleicht/ordnet Combobox-Werte ueber die deutschen Texte (z. B. SCOPES[var.get()]); get() liefert deshalb
# im EN-Modus wieder das deutsche Original zurueck.
_REV = {}
_COMBO_VARS = set()    # Namen der StringVars, die an eine Combobox gebunden sind (nur dort wird get() zurueckuebersetzt)


def untranslate(text):
    return _REV.get(text, text) if isinstance(text, str) else text


def translate_values(values):
    """Werteliste einer Combobox uebersetzen (und die Rueckwaerts-Tabelle fuellen)."""
    if LANG != "en":
        return values
    try:
        seq = tuple(values)
    except TypeError:
        return values
    out = []
    for v in seq:
        if isinstance(v, str):
            en = translate(v)
            if en != v:
                _REV.setdefault(en, v)
            out.append(en)
        else:
            out.append(v)
    return tuple(out)


def _remember(w, slot, current):
    """Deutschen Originaltext zu `current` bestimmen: wurde der Text seit unserem letzten Setzen vom Programm geaendert,
    ist der neue Text das neue Original."""
    store = w.__dict__.setdefault("_i18n", {})
    orig, last = store.get(slot, (None, None))
    if orig is None or current != last:
        orig = current
    return store, orig


def _apply_text(w, slot, current, setter):
    store, orig = _remember(w, slot, current)
    new = translate(orig) if LANG == "en" else orig
    if new != current:
        setter(new)
    store[slot] = (orig, new)


def apply_to(root):
    """Ganzen Widget-Baum unterhalb von root uebersetzen / zurueckstellen."""
    stack = [root]
    while stack:
        w = stack.pop()
        try:
            stack.extend(w.winfo_children())
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
        try:
            cls = w.winfo_class()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            continue
        try:
            if cls in TEXT_CLASSES:
                tv = ""
                if cls in VAR_CLASSES:
                    try:
                        tv = str(w.cget("textvariable"))
                    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                        tv = ""
                if tv:
                    cur = w.getvar(tv)
                    if isinstance(cur, str):
                        _apply_text(w, "var", cur, lambda v, w=w, tv=tv: w.setvar(tv, v))
                else:
                    cur = w.cget("text")
                    if isinstance(cur, str) and cur:
                        _apply_text(w, "text", cur, lambda v, w=w: w.configure(text=v))
            elif cls == "TCombobox":
                vals = tuple(str(x) for x in w.cget("values"))
                if vals:
                    store = w.__dict__.setdefault("_i18n", {})
                    orig, last = store.get("values", (None, None))
                    if orig is None or vals != last:
                        orig = tuple(untranslate(x) for x in vals)
                    new = translate_values(orig) if LANG == "en" else orig
                    if new != vals:
                        w.configure(values=new)
                    store["values"] = (orig, new)
                tv = str(w.cget("textvariable"))
                if tv:
                    _COMBO_VARS.add(tv)
                    cur = w.getvar(tv)
                    if isinstance(cur, str) and cur:
                        de = untranslate(cur)
                        new = translate(de) if LANG == "en" else de
                        if new != cur:
                            w.setvar(tv, new)
                            if new != de:
                                _REV.setdefault(new, de)
            elif cls == "TNotebook":
                for tab in w.tabs():
                    cur = w.tab(tab, "text")
                    _apply_text(w, f"tab:{tab}", cur, lambda v, w=w, tab=tab: w.tab(tab, text=v))
            elif cls == "Treeview":
                for col in [str(c) for c in w.cget("columns")]:
                    cur = w.heading(col, "text")
                    _apply_text(w, f"col:{col}", cur, lambda v, w=w, col=col: w.heading(col, text=v))
            elif cls in ("Toplevel", "Tk"):
                cur = w.title()
                _apply_text(w, "title", cur, lambda v, w=w: w.title(v))
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 - ein kaputtes Widget darf die Uebersetzung nicht stoppen
            continue


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Variablen und Dialoge
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def install_var_hook(var_cls):
    """var_cls.set uebersetzt Texte, die der Code spaeter setzt (Statuszeilen).  Idempotent."""
    if getattr(var_cls, "_i18n_hooked", False):
        return
    orig = var_cls.set

    orig_get = getattr(var_cls, "get", None)

    def set_(self, value):
        if LANG == "en" and isinstance(value, str) and len(value) >= MIN_FRAGMENT:
            en = translate(value)
            if en != value and str(self) in _COMBO_VARS:
                _REV.setdefault(en, value)
            value = en
        return orig(self, value)

    def get_(self):
        v = orig_get(self)
        return _REV.get(v, v) if LANG == "en" and isinstance(v, str) and str(self) in _COMBO_VARS else v
    var_cls.set = set_
    if orig_get is not None:
        var_cls.get = get_
    var_cls._i18n_hooked = True


def install_toplevel_hook(tk_mod):
    """Jedes neue Fenster (Export-Dialog, Auswahl-Dialoge ...) wird im EN-Modus nach dem Aufbau uebersetzt.  Idempotent."""
    top = tk_mod.Toplevel
    if getattr(top, "_i18n_hooked", False):
        return
    orig = top.__init__

    def init(self, *a, **kw):
        orig(self, *a, **kw)
        if LANG == "en":
            for ms in (60, 400, 1500):                    # die Widgets entstehen erst nach __init__
                try:
                    self.after(ms, lambda: apply_to(self) if self.winfo_exists() and LANG == "en" else None)
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    break
    top.__init__ = init
    top._i18n_hooked = True


def install_combobox_hook(ttk_mod):
    """Auswahllisten (ttk.Combobox): values werden im EN-Modus uebersetzt, get() liefert das deutsche Original.  Idempotent."""
    cb = ttk_mod.Combobox
    if getattr(cb, "_i18n_hooked", False):
        return
    orig_init, orig_conf, orig_get = cb.__init__, cb.configure, cb.get

    def _tv(self, vals):
        if LANG != "en":
            return vals
        orig = tuple(untranslate(x) for x in vals) if not isinstance(vals, str) else vals
        new = translate_values(orig)
        if not isinstance(vals, str):
            self.__dict__.setdefault("_i18n", {})["values"] = (orig, new)
        return new

    def init(self, master=None, **kw):
        tvar = kw.get("textvariable")
        if tvar is not None:
            _COMBO_VARS.add(str(tvar))
        if "values" in kw:
            vals = kw["values"]
            self.__dict__.setdefault("_i18n", {})
            kw["values"] = _tv(self, vals)
        orig_init(self, master, **kw)

    def conf(self, cnf=None, **kw):
        if isinstance(cnf, dict) and "values" in cnf:
            cnf = dict(cnf)
            cnf["values"] = _tv(self, cnf["values"])
        if "values" in kw:
            kw["values"] = _tv(self, kw["values"])
        return orig_conf(self, cnf, **kw)

    def get(self):
        v = orig_get(self)
        return _REV.get(v, v) if LANG == "en" and isinstance(v, str) else v
    cb.__init__, cb.configure, cb.config, cb.get = init, conf, conf, get
    cb._i18n_hooked = True


def install_dialog_hooks(messagebox, simpledialog, filedialog):
    """Titel/Meldung/Aufforderung der Standarddialoge uebersetzen.  Idempotent."""
    def wrap(mod, name, text_args):
        fn = getattr(mod, name, None)
        if fn is None or getattr(fn, "_i18n", False):
            return

        def w(*args, **kw):
            args = list(args)
            for i in text_args:
                if i < len(args) and isinstance(args[i], str):
                    args[i] = translate(args[i])
            for k in ("title", "message", "prompt"):
                if isinstance(kw.get(k), str):
                    kw[k] = translate(kw[k])
            return fn(*args, **kw)
        w._i18n = True
        setattr(mod, name, w)
    for n in ("showinfo", "showwarning", "showerror", "askyesno", "askokcancel", "askyesnocancel", "askretrycancel"):
        wrap(messagebox, n, (0, 1))
    for n in ("askstring", "askinteger", "askfloat"):
        wrap(simpledialog, n, (0, 1))
    for n in ("askopenfilename", "asksaveasfilename", "askdirectory", "askopenfilenames"):
        wrap(filedialog, n, ())

```

`tools_pointer_gui.py`:

```py
"""tools_pointer_gui.py – Pointer-Scanner-Tab."""
import threading
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk, messagebox, filedialog

import pointerscan as PS
import scanner as SC
import ps5_ext as X
from tools_common import (BG, BG_CARD, ACCENT, TEXT, TEXT_DIM, WARN, ERROR, FONT_LABEL,
                          BaseTab, button, label, entry, tree, with_scroll, hexs)


class PointerTab(BaseTab):
    def __init__(self, parent, win):
        super().__init__(parent, win)
        self.pm = None               # PointerMap
        self.static = []             # statische Bereiche
        self.paths = []              # [(root_off, offsets)]
        self.running = False
        self.cancel_flag = False
        self.sc = None

        r1 = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); r1.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=(8, 2))
        label(r1, "ZIELADRESSE").pack(side="left")
        self.v_target = tk.StringVar()
        entry(r1, self.v_target, 20).pack(side="left", padx=(6, 12))
        label(r1, "TIEFE").pack(side="left")
        self.v_depth = tk.StringVar(value="4")
        ttk.Combobox(r1, textvariable=self.v_depth, values=["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"],
                     width=3, state="readonly").pack(side="left", padx=(6, 12))
        label(r1, "MAX. OFFSET").pack(side="left")
        self.v_off = tk.StringVar(value="0x400")
        entry(r1, self.v_off, 8).pack(side="left", padx=(6, 12))
        label(r1, "STATISCH (Name)").pack(side="left")
        self.v_static = tk.StringVar(value="eboot")
        entry(r1, self.v_static, 12).pack(side="left", padx=(6, 12))
        label(r1, "TYP").pack(side="left")
        self.v_type = tk.StringVar(value="Int32")
        ttk.Combobox(r1, textvariable=self.v_type, values=list(SC.VTYPES), width=8,
                     state="readonly").pack(side="left", padx=6)

        r2 = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); r2.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=2)
        button(r2, "1) KARTE ERSTELLEN", self.build, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(r2, "2) PFADE SUCHEN", self.search, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(r2, "3) PRÜFEN (neues Ziel)", self.verify).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(r2, "⚡ SCHNELL-SCAN (Konsole)", self.fast_search, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=(12, 2))
        button(r2, "ABBRECHEN", self.cancel).pack(side="left", padx=(12, 2))
        button(r2, "SPEICHERN…", self.save).pack(side="right", padx=2)
        button(r2, "LADEN…", self.load).pack(side="right", padx=2)

        r3 = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); r3.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=2)
        self.pb = ttk.Progressbar(r3, orient="horizontal", mode="determinate", length=260, maximum=100)
        self.pb.pack(side="left")
        self.lbl = label(r3, "Ablauf: 1) Karte (einmal pro Spielzustand)  2) Pfade suchen  "
                             "3) Spiel neu starten, neue Adresse suchen, hier eintragen, PRÜFEN",
                         dim=True)
        self.lbl.pack(side="left", padx=10)

        fr = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); fr.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8, pady=4)
        self.tv = tree(fr, [("p", "PFAD  (Basis+Root → Offsets)"), ("d", "TIEFE"), ("l", "LIVE-ZIEL")],
                       [560, 60, 160], height=18)
        with_scroll(fr, self.tv)

        r4 = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG); r4.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=6)
        button(r4, "→ CHEAT-LISTE", self.to_list, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(r4, "TOP 10 → CHEAT-LISTE", lambda: self.to_list(top=10)).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(r4, "LIVE AUFLÖSEN", self.live).pack(side="left", padx=(12, 2))
        self.lbl_info = label(r4, ""); self.lbl_info.pack(side="right")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def set_target(self, address, vname="Int32"):
        self.v_target.set(hexs(address))
        self.v_type.set(vname)

    def _set(self, text, color=TEXT):
        self.lbl.configure(text=text, fg=color)

    def _progress(self, frac, text=""):
        def upd():
            self.pb["value"] = max(0, min(100, frac * 100))
            if text:
                self.lbl.configure(text=text, fg=TEXT)
        self.win.ui(upd)

    def _run(self, job, done, lock=False):
        if self.running:
            return self.log("Es läuft schon etwas", "warn")
        self.running = True
        self.cancel_flag = False
        self.pb["value"] = 0
        self._set("läuft ...", WARN)

        def ok(r):
            self.running = False
            self.pb["value"] = 100
            done(r)

        def err(e):
            self.running = False
            self._set(f"Fehler: {e}", ERROR)
            self.log(f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}", "err")
        self.win.bg(job, ok, err, lock=lock)

    def cancel(self):
        self.cancel_flag = True
        if self.sc:
            threading.Thread(target=self.sc.cancel, daemon=True).start()
        self._set("breche ab ...", WARN)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1) Karte
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def build(self):
        be = self.win.app.backend
        flt = self.v_static.get()
        base = self.base

        def job():
            sc = SC.Scanner(be.host, be.port, be.pid,
                            log=lambda m: self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(m)))
            self.sc = sc
            try:
                sc.connect()
                if sc.mode != "turbo":
                    self.win.ui(lambda: self.log("Kein Turbo-Scan: Karte wird langsam (Fallback)", "warn"))
                maps = sc.client.get_maps()
                rd = [(s, e) for s, e, p in maps if p & 1]
                regs = sc.regions("data", min_mbps=100)
                pm = PS.build_map(sc, regs, (min(s for s, _ in rd), max(e for _, e in rd)), self._progress)
                named = X.maps_named(sc.client)
                return pm, PS.static_ranges(named, flt, base)
            finally:
                sc.close()
                self.sc = None

        def done(r):
            self.pm, self.static = r
            tot = sum(e - s for s, e in self.static)
            self._set(f"Karte fertig: {self.pm.count} Zeiger, statisch: {len(self.static)} Region(en) "
                      f"({tot / 1048576:.1f} MB)", ACCENT)
            if not self.static:
                self.log("Keine statische Region gefunden - Namensfilter anpassen", "warn")
        self._run(job, done)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2) Suchen
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def search(self):
        if not self.pm:
            return self.log("Erst KARTE ERSTELLEN", "warn")
        try:
            target = self.addr(self.v_target.get())
            depth = int(self.v_depth.get())
            max_off = int(self.v_off.get(), 0)
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        pm, static, base = self.pm, self.static, self.base

        def job():
            def prog(d, i, n, found):
                self._progress(i / max(n, 1), f"Ebene {d}: {i}/{n} Knoten, {found} Pfade")
            return pm.find_paths(target, static, depth, max_off, progress=prog,
                                 cancelled=lambda: self.cancel_flag)

        def done(r):
            res, truncated = r
            self.paths = [(a - base, offs) for a, offs in res]
            self._fill()
            self._set(f"{len(self.paths)} Pfad(e)" + ("  (gekürzt)" if truncated else ""),
                      ACCENT if self.paths else WARN)
        self._run(job, done)

    def fast_search(self):
        """Pointer-Scan ohne Karte: die Konsole sucht Ebene fuer Ebene (ptrscan_server.py).
        Braucht die ps5debug-NG-Erweiterung 0xBDAACC30."""
        try:
            target = self.addr(self.v_target.get())
            depth = int(self.v_depth.get())
            max_off = int(self.v_off.get(), 0)
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        be, flt, base = self.win.app.backend, self.v_static.get(), self.base
        import ptrscan_server as PSV

        def job():
            sc = SC.Scanner(be.host, be.port, be.pid, log=lambda m: self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(m)))
            self.sc = sc
            try:
                sc.connect()
                maps = sc.client.get_maps()
                segs = [(s, e - s) for s, e, p in maps if (p & 3) == 3 and e - s >= 0x1000]
                static = PS.static_ranges(X.maps_named(sc.client), flt, base)
                if not static:
                    raise RuntimeError("keine statische Region gefunden - Namensfilter anpassen")
                lvl = {"n": 0}

                def prog(done, total):
                    self._progress(done / max(total, 1), f"Ebene {lvl['n'] + 1}: {done}/{total}")

                fn = PSV.server_level_fn(sc.client, segs, max_off, prog)
                chains, info = PSV.scan(
                    fn, target, segs, static, max_off, depth,
                    on_level=lambda d, n, r: (lvl.__setitem__("n", d), self.win.ui(
                        lambda: self._set(f"Ebene {d}: {n} Treffer, {r} statische Wurzeln", WARN))),
                    should_stop=lambda: self.cancel_flag)
                return chains, info
            finally:
                sc.close()
                self.sc = None

        def done(r):
            chains, info = r
            self.paths = [(c.static - base, tuple(c.offsets)) for c in chains]
            self._fill()
            self._set(f"{len(self.paths)} Pfad(e) (Schnell-Scan, {info['levels']} Ebenen)"
                      + ("  (gekürzt)" if info["capped"] else ""), ACCENT if self.paths else WARN)
        self._run(job, done)

    def _fill(self, live=None):
        self.tv.delete(*self.tv.get_children())
        for i, (r, o) in enumerate(self.paths):
            self.tv.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(
                PS.fmt_path(r, o), len(o), "" if live is None else (hexs(live[i]) if live[i] else "—")))
        self.lbl_info.configure(text=f"{len(self.paths)} Pfade")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3) Prüfen / Live
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def verify(self):
        if not self.paths:
            return self.log("Keine Pfade", "warn")
        try:
            expect = self.addr(self.v_target.get())
        except Exception as e:
            return self.log(str(e), "err")
        paths, base = list(self.paths), self.base

        def job():
            return PS.verify(self.win.client, paths, expect, base, self._progress)

        def done(keep):
            self.log(f"Prüfung: {len(keep)}/{len(paths)} Pfade lösen auf {expect:#x} auf", "ok" if keep else "warn")
            self.paths = keep
            self._fill()
            self._set(f"{len(keep)} Pfad(e) bestätigt", ACCENT if keep else WARN)
        self._run(job, done, lock=True)

    def live(self):
        if not self.paths:
            return
        paths, base = list(self.paths), self.base

        def job():
            return [PS.resolve(self.win.client, base + r, o) for r, o in paths[:500]]
        self.win.bg(job, lambda res: self._fill(res + [None] * (len(paths) - len(res))))

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Liste / Dateien
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def to_list(self, top=None):
        if not self.win.scan_tab:
            return self.log("Searcher-Tab fehlt", "err")
        if top:
            items = self.paths[:top]
        else:
            items = [self.paths[int(i)] for i in self.tv.selection()]
        if not items:
            return self.log("Nichts ausgewählt", "warn")
        for r, o in items:
            self.win.scan_tab.add_pointer(r, o, self.v_type.get())
        self.log(f"{len(items)} Pfad(e) in die Cheat-Liste übernommen", "ok")

    def save(self):
        if not self.paths:
            return
        fn = filedialog.asksaveasfilename(parent=self, defaultextension=".json",
                                          filetypes=[("Pfade", "*.json")], initialfile="pointer_paths.json")
        if fn:
            PS.save_paths(fn, self.paths, {"type": self.v_type.get()})
            self.log(f"Gespeichert: {fn}", "ok")

    def load(self):
        fn = filedialog.askopenfilename(parent=self, filetypes=[("Pfade", "*.json")])
        if not fn:
            return
        try:
            self.paths, info = PS.load_paths(fn)
            if info.get("type") in SC.VTYPES:
                self.v_type.set(info["type"])
            self._fill()
            self.log(f"{len(self.paths)} Pfade geladen", "ok")
        except Exception as e:
            messagebox.showerror("Laden", str(e))

    def shutdown(self):
        self.cancel_flag = True

```

```py
def fmt_addr(addr):
    """Adresse kompakt anzeigen: 0x7F12A4 statt 00000000007F12A4 (ohne fuehrende Nullen)."""
    return f"0x{int(addr):X}"

    def _chk(self, parent, text, default):
        v = tk.BooleanVar(value=default)
        tk.Checkbutton(parent, text=text, variable=v, bg=BG, fg=TEXT_DIM, selectcolor=BG_CARD,
                       activebackground=BG, activeforeground=ACCENT, font=FONT_LABEL).pack(side="left", padx=4)
        return v

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Vergleichs-Auswahl
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _ct_values(self, first):
        vals = [k for k in SC.CTYPES if (k not in SC.NEXT_ONLY if first else k not in SC.FIRST_ONLY)]
        self.cb_ct["values"] = vals
        if self.ct.get() not in vals:
            self.ct.set(vals[0])

    def _ct_changed(self):
        need = SC.CTYPES[self.ct.get()][1]
        self.e1.configure(state="normal" if need >= 1 else "disabled")
        self.e2.configure(state="normal" if need >= 2 else "disabled")

    def _opts(self):
        return {"float_simple": self.o_float.get(), "aliasing": self.o_alias.get(), "parallel": self.o_par.get(),
                "min_region": 256 * 1024 if self.o_small.get() else 0,
                "snap_ram_mb": RAM_CHOICES[self.ram_sel.get()], "spill_dir": SPILL_CHOICES[self.spill_sel.get()]}

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Sitzung
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _status(self, text, color=TEXT):
        self.lbl.configure(text=text, fg=color)

    def _progress(self, frac, text=""):
        def upd():
            self.pb["value"] = max(0, min(100, frac * 100))
            if text:
                self.lbl.configure(text=text, fg=TEXT)
        self.win.ui(upd)

    def _ensure(self):
        """Scanner verbinden (läuft im Hintergrund-Thread)."""
        be = self.win.app.backend
        want_debug = self.o_debug.get()
        if self.sc is None or self.sc.client is None or self.sc.client.sock is None:
            self.sc = SC.Scanner(be.host, be.port, be.pid, log=lambda m: self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(m)),
                                 debug=want_debug)
            self.sc.connect()
            self.win.ui(lambda: self.lbl_mode.configure(
                text=f"Modus: {self.sc.mode}" + ("  (Turbo)" if self.sc.mode == "turbo" else "  (Fallback)")))
        self.sc.debug = want_debug
        self.sc.io.debug = want_debug
        return self.sc

    def _run(self, job, done):
        if self.running:
            return self.log("Es läuft schon ein Scan", "warn")
        self.running = True
        self.pb["value"] = 0
        self._status("läuft ...", WARN)

        def ok(r):
            self.running = False
            self.pb["value"] = 100
            done(r)

        def err(e):
            self.running = False
            self.pb["value"] = 0
            self._status(f"Fehler: {e}", ERROR)
            self.log(f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}", "err")
        self.win.bg(job, ok, err, lock=False)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Scans
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def scan_first(self):
        vname, ctype = self.vt.get(), self.ct.get()
        t1, t2 = self.v1.get(), self.v2.get()
        scope = SCOPES[self.scope.get()]
        min_mbps = SLOW_CHOICES[self.slow_sel.get()]
        opts = self._opts()
        try:        # früh validieren (Meldung im UI-Thread)
            if ctype not in SC.FIRST_ONLY:
                if SC.CTYPES[ctype][1] >= 1:
                    SC.encode_value(vname, t1)
                if SC.CTYPES[ctype][1] >= 2:
                    SC.encode_value(vname, t2)
        except Exception as e:
            return messagebox.showerror("Wert", str(e))

        def job():
            sc = self._ensure()
            sc.reset()
            regs = sc.regions(scope, min_mbps=min_mbps, report=True)
            total = sum(e - s for s, e in regs)
            self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(f"Scanne {len(regs)} Region(en), {total / 1048576:.0f} MB", "info"))
            return sc.first_scan(vname, ctype, t1, t2, regs, opts, self._progress)

        def done(n):
            self._ct_values(first=False)
            self._ct_changed()
            self._status(f"{n} Treffer", ACCENT if n else WARN)
            self._show_results(0)
        self._run(job, done)

    def scan_next(self):
        if not self.sc or not self.sc.first_scan_done:
            return self.log("Erst ERSTER SCAN", "warn")
        ctype, t1, t2 = self.ct.get(), self.v1.get(), self.v2.get()
        opts = self._opts()
        try:
            if SC.CTYPES[ctype][1] >= 1:
                SC.encode_value(self.sc.vname, t1)
            if SC.CTYPES[ctype][1] >= 2:
                SC.encode_value(self.sc.vname, t2)
        except Exception as e:
            return messagebox.showerror("Wert", str(e))

        def job():
            return self._ensure().next_scan(ctype, t1, t2, opts, self._progress)

        def done(n):
            self._status(f"{n} Treffer", ACCENT if n else WARN)
            self._show_results(0)
        self._run(job, done)

    def new_scan(self):
        if self.running:
            return self.log("Erst abbrechen", "warn")
        sc = self.sc

        def job():
            if sc:
                sc.reset()
            return True

        def done(_r):
            self.rt.delete(*self.rt.get_children())
            self.lbl_res.configure(text="GEFUNDEN: 0")
            self._ct_values(first=True)
            self._ct_changed()
            self._status("bereit")
        self._run(job, done)

    def cancel(self):
        if self.sc and self.running:
            self._status("breche ab ...", WARN)
            import threading
            threading.Thread(target=self.sc.cancel, daemon=True).start()

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Ergebnisse
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _page(self, d):
        if not self.sc or self.running:
            return
        last = max(0, (self.sc.count - 1) // PAGE)
        self._show_results(max(0, min(last, self.page + d)))

    def _show_results(self, page):
        self.page = page
        sc = self.sc
        if sc is None:
            return
        start = page * PAGE
        vname = sc.vname

        def job():
            return sc.results(start, PAGE)

        def done(rows):
            self.rt.delete(*self.rt.get_children())
            for r in rows:
                self.rt.insert("", "end", iid=str(r["addr"]), values=(
                    fmt_addr(r['addr']), SC.fmt_value(vname, r["cur"]), SC.fmt_value(vname, r["prev"]),
                    SC.fmt_value(vname, r["first"]) if r["first"] else ""))
            last = max(0, (sc.count - 1) // PAGE) + 1
            self.lbl_res.configure(text=f"GEFUNDEN: {sc.count}  (Seite {page + 1}/{last})")
        self._run_light(job, done)

    def _run_light(self, job, done):
        """Kurze Abfragen (Ergebnisseite) ohne den 'running'-Zustand zu blockieren."""
        self.win.bg(job, done, lambda e: self.log(f"{type(e).__name__}: {e}", "err"), lock=False)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Cheat-Liste
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def add_selected(self):
        if not self.sc:
            return
        vname = self.sc.vname
        for iid in self.rt.selection():
            a = int(iid)
            if any(e["addr"] == a for e in self.entries):
                continue
            vals = self.rt.item(iid, "values")
            self.entries.append({"addr": a, "vname": vname, "desc": "", "frozen": False,
                                 "freeze": None, "cur": vals[1]})
        self._refresh_list()

    def add_all(self):
        """Alle Treffer der aktuell angezeigten Seite in die Adressliste."""
        self.rt.selection_set(self.rt.get_children())
        self.add_selected()

    def add_pointer(self, root_off, offsets, vname):
        """Pointer-Pfad als Eintrag; die Adresse wird bei jedem Tick neu aufgelöst."""
        key = (root_off, tuple(offsets))
        if any(e.get("ptr") == key for e in self.entries):
            return
        self.entries.append({"addr": 0, "vname": vname, "desc": "ptr", "frozen": False,
                             "freeze": None, "cur": "?", "ptr": key})
        self._refresh_list()

    def _addr_of(self, e, client):
        """Aktuelle Adresse eines Eintrags (Pointer-Pfade werden frisch aufgelöst)."""
        if e.get("ptr"):
            a = PS.resolve(client, self.base + e["ptr"][0], e["ptr"][1])
            e["addr"] = a or 0
        return e["addr"]

    def to_pointer(self):
        sel = self._sel_entries()
        if sel and sel[0]["addr"]:
            self.win.to_pointer(sel[0]["addr"], sel[0]["vname"])

    def _sel_entries(self):
        idx = [int(i) for i in self.lt.selection()]
        return [self.entries[i] for i in idx if i < len(self.entries)]

    def _refresh_list(self):
        sel = self.lt.selection()
        self.lt.delete(*self.lt.get_children())
        for i, e in enumerate(self.entries):
            self.lt.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(
                "❄" if e["frozen"] else "", e["desc"], fmt_addr(e["addr"]) if e["addr"] else "?",
                e["vname"], e["cur"]))
        for s in sel:
            if self.lt.exists(s):
                self.lt.selection_add(s)

    def set_value(self):
        sel = self._sel_entries()
        if not sel:
            return
        e = sel[0]
        txt = simpledialog.askstring("Wert setzen", f"Neuer Wert ({e['vname']}) für {e['addr']:#x}:",
                                     initialvalue=str(e["cur"]), parent=self)
        if txt is None:
            return
        try:
            data = SC.encode_value(e["vname"], txt)
        except Exception as ex:
            return messagebox.showerror("Wert", str(ex))
        targets = sel

        def job():
            for t in targets:
                a = self._addr_of(t, self.win.client)
                if not a:
                    continue
                self.win.client.write_memory(a, data)
                if t["frozen"]:
                    t["freeze"] = data
            return True
        self.win.bg(job, lambda _r: self.log(f"{len(targets)} Wert(e) geschrieben", "ok"))

    def toggle_freeze(self):
        sel = self._sel_entries()
        if not sel:
            return

        def job():
            for e in sel:
                if e["frozen"]:
                    e["frozen"] = False
                else:
                    a = self._addr_of(e, self.win.client)
                    if not a:
                        continue
                    e["freeze"] = self.win.client.read_memory(a, SC.VTYPES[e["vname"]][1])
                    e["frozen"] = True
            return True
        self.win.bg(job, lambda _r: self._refresh_list())

    def rename(self):
        sel = self._sel_entries()
        if not sel:
            return
        t = simpledialog.askstring("Beschreibung", "Beschreibung:", initialvalue=sel[0]["desc"], parent=self)
        if t is not None:
            sel[0]["desc"] = t
            self._refresh_list()

    def remove(self):
        for e in self._sel_entries():
            self.entries.remove(e)
        self._refresh_list()

    def who_writes(self):
        sel = self._sel_entries()
        if sel and sel[0]["addr"]:
            self.win.to_debug_watch(sel[0]["addr"], SC.VTYPES[sel[0]["vname"]][1])

    def to_hex(self):
        sel = self._sel_entries()
        if sel and sel[0]["addr"]:
            self.win.goto_memory(sel[0]["addr"])

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Live-Werte + Freeze
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def _tick(self):
        if not self.winfo_exists():
            return
        self.after(150, self._tick)
        if not self.entries or self._busy_tick or self.win.client is None:
            return
        self._tick_n += 1
        frozen = [e for e in self.entries if e["frozen"] and e["freeze"] is not None]
        refresh = self.v_live.get() and self._tick_n % 4 == 0
        if not frozen and not refresh:
            return
        self._busy_tick = True
        entries = list(self.entries)

        def job():
            c = self.win.client
            writes = []
            for e in frozen:
                a = self._addr_of(e, c)
                if a:
                    writes.append((a, e["freeze"]))
            if writes:
                # ein Austausch fuer alle eingefrorenen Werte (und nicht im Journal); aeltere
                # Payloads ohne write_multi -> Einzelschreiben
                if not getattr(self, "_no_multi", False):
                    try:
                        import ps5_more
                        ps5_more.write_multi(c, writes)
                    except Exception:
                        self._no_multi = True
                        for a, d in writes:
                            c.write_memory(a, d)
                else:
                    for a, d in writes:
                        c.write_memory(a, d)
            out = []
            if refresh:
                for e in entries:
                    try:
                        a = self._addr_of(e, c)
                        out.append(SC.fmt_value(e["vname"], c.read_memory(a, SC.VTYPES[e["vname"]][1]))
                                   if a else "?")
                    except Exception:
                        out.append("?")
            return out

        def done(vals):
            self._busy_tick = False
            for e, v in zip(entries, vals):
                e["cur"] = v
            if vals:
                self._refresh_list()

        def err(ex):
            self._busy_tick = False
            self.log(f"Live/Freeze: {ex}", "err")
        self.win.bg(job, done, err)

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    # Selbsttest
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def region_report(self):
        """Alle Speicherregionen des Spiels (Name, Groesse, Rechte) in die Datei regionen_<PID>.txt schreiben."""
        def job():
            import os
            import paths
            import ps5_ext
            import regionreport
            cl = self.win.app.backend.client
            if cl is None or cl.pid is None:
                raise RuntimeError("nicht verbunden - im Hauptfenster VERBINDEN")
            text = regionreport.report(ps5_ext.maps_named(cl))
            path = os.path.join(paths.data_dir(), f"regionen_{cl.pid}.txt")
            with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
                f.write(text)
            return path, text

        def ok(res):
            path, text = res
            for line in text.splitlines()[:12]:
                self.log(line)
            self.log(f"Regionen-Bericht gespeichert: {path}", "ok")

        self.win.bg(job, ok, lambda e: self.log(f"Regionen-Bericht: {e}", "err"))

    def selftest(self):
        """Kleiner Scan über 1 MB: prüft Verbindung, Auth, Turbo, Ergebnis-Abruf."""
        if self.running:
            return

        def job():
            self.win.ui(lambda: self.log("--- Selbsttest ---", "info"))
            be = self.win.app.backend
            sc = SC.Scanner(be.host, be.port, be.pid, debug=True,
                            log=lambda m: self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(m)))
            try:
                sc.connect()
                regs = [(s, e) for s, e in sc.regions("data") if e - s >= 0x10000][:1]
                if not regs:
                    raise SC.ScanError("Keine geeignete Region gefunden")
                s, e = regs[0]
                end = min(e, s + 0x100000)
                data = sc.client.read_memory(s, 8)
                val = str(struct.unpack("<I", data[:4])[0])
                self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(f"Region {s:#x}-{end:#x}, suche UInt32 {val}", "info"))
                n = sc.first_scan("UInt32", "Genau", val, None, [(s, end)], {})
                res = sc.results(0, 50)
                hit = any(r["addr"] == s for r in res)
                n2 = sc.next_scan("Unverändert", "", None, {})
                return (sc.mode, n, hit, n2)
            finally:
                sc.close()

        def done(r):
            mode, n, hit, n2 = r
            ok = hit and n2 >= 1
            self.log(f"Selbsttest {'OK' if ok else 'AUFFÄLLIG'}: Modus={mode}, Treffer={n}, "
                     f"Startadresse gefunden={hit}, 'Unverändert' behält {n2}", "ok" if ok else "warn")
            self._status("Selbsttest fertig", ACCENT if ok else WARN)
        self._run(job, done)

    def shutdown(self):
        try:
            if self.sc:
                self.sc.close()
        except Exception:
            pass
```

```py
"""tools_start_gui.py - Tab "START": Einstieg fuer Anfaenger (drei Schritte, grosse Knoepfe, Klartext).

Zeigt, ob die PS5 verbunden ist und welches Spiel/welche Codes gerade offen sind, und fuehrt per Knopfdruck zu den
einfachen Werkzeugen.  Alles Spezielle liegt im Tab FORTGESCHRITTEN.

import os
import subprocess
import sys
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import messagebox

from tools_common import ACCENT, BG, BG_CARD, FONT_HEAD, FONT_LABEL, TEXT, TEXT_DIM, BaseTab, button

STEPS = [
    ("1", "Spiel verbinden",
     "Starte dein Spiel und lade den Spielstand. Klicke im Hauptfenster oben auf VERBINDEN. "
     "Wenn das Spiel Codes hat, erscheinen sie dort automatisch.",

]

    ("Unreal-Engine-Spiel?", "Items, Tabellen und Funktionen werden automatisch gefunden - ohne Suchen.",

     "FORTGESCHRITTEN ÖFFNEN", "adv_frame"),

HINT = "Tipp: Mit der rechten Maustaste auf Listen und Felder klicken zeigt passende Aktionen (Kopieren, Öffnen, ...)."


class StartTab(BaseTab):
    def __init__(self, parent, win):
        super().__init__(parent, win)
        self.v_status = tk.StringVar(value="")

        tk.Label(self, text="▸  WILLKOMMEN BEI REAPERPY", bg=BG, fg=ACCENT, font=FONT_HEAD).pack(anchor="w", padx=16, pady=(14, 2))
        tk.Label(self, text="In drei Schritten zum eigenen Cheat - ohne Vorkenntnisse.", bg=BG, fg=TEXT_DIM,

                 anchor="w").pack(fill="x", padx=12, pady=8)
        for num, title, text, btn, target in STEPS:

                 wraplength=720).pack(fill="x")
        b = button(row, btn, lambda t=target: self.go(t), accent=True)
        b.pack(side="right", padx=10)
        self.buttons[target] = b

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
    def go(self, target):
        """Knopf: zum passenden Tab / Hauptfenster."""
        if target == "show_main":
            try:
                self.win.app.root.deiconify()
                self.win.app.root.lift()
                self.win.app.root.focus_force()
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
            return
        tab = getattr(self.win, target, None)
        if tab is None:
            self.log("Dieses Werkzeug ist nicht verfügbar", "err")
            return
        self.win.show_tab(tab)

    def status_text(self):
        """Klartext-Status (rein lesend)."""
        app = self.win.app
        be = app.backend
        if not getattr(be, "client", None) or be.pid is None:
            conn = "✗  Nicht verbunden - im Hauptfenster auf VERBINDEN klicken."
        else:
            conn = f"✓  Verbunden mit der PS5 (Spiel-Prozess {be.pid})."
        proj = getattr(app, "current_project", None)
        n = len(getattr(app, "patches", {}) or {})
        if proj and n:
            codes = f"✓  Codes: {n} für „{proj}“ geladen."
        elif proj:
            codes = f"•  Projekt „{proj}“ ist offen, enthält aber keine Codes."
        else:
            codes = "•  Keine Codes geladen (das Spiel hat keine oder es ist noch nichts gewählt)."
        return conn + "\n" + codes

    def _gp(self):
        return getattr(self.win.app, "gp", None)

    def load_notes(self):
        """Notizen des Spiels anzeigen, wenn sich das Spiel/Projekt geaendert hat."""
        gp = self._gp()
        key = gp.key if gp else None
        if key == self._notes_key:
            return
        self._notes_key = key
        self.notes.delete("1.0", "end")
        if gp:
            self.notes.insert("1.0", gp.notes)
        self.v_prof.set(f"({gp.key})" if gp else "(kein Projekt offen)")

    def save_notes(self, quiet=False):
        gp = self._gp()
        if gp is None:
            if not quiet:
                self.log("Erst ein Projekt/Spiel öffnen - Notizen gehören zum Spiel", "err")
            return
        text = self.notes.get("1.0", "end-1c")
        if text != gp.notes:
            gp.notes = text
            gp.save()
            if not quiet:
                self.log("Notizen gespeichert", "ok")

    def check_updates(self):
        """Manuelle Update-Pruefung (nur lesen; Download-Seite wird erst nach Rueckfrage im Browser geoeffnet)."""
        import update_check
        import version
        url = self.win.app.cfg.get("update_url", "")
        if not url:
            self.log("Keine Update-Adresse eingestellt - in reaperpy_config.json 'update_url' auf eine JSON-Datei "
                     "{\"version\": ..., \"url\": ...} setzen", "info")
            return
        self.bg(lambda: update_check.check(url, version.__version__), self._update_result)

    def _update_result(self, res):
        if res.status == "uptodate":
            self.log(f"Du hast die neueste Version ({res.local})", "ok")
        elif res.status == "error":
            self.log(f"Update-Prüfung fehlgeschlagen: {res.error}", "err")
        elif res.status == "newer":
            self.log(f"Neue Version {res.remote} verfügbar (installiert: {res.local})" + (f" - {res.notes}" if res.notes else ""), "ok")
            if res.url and messagebox.askyesno("Update", f"Version {res.remote} ist verfügbar.\n\nDownload-Seite öffnen?"):
                import webbrowser
                webbrowser.open(res.url)

    def open_logs(self):
        import logsetup
        import paths
        d = os.path.dirname(logsetup.current_file() or "") or paths.logs_dir()
        try:
            if os.name == "nt":
                os.startfile(d)  # noqa: S606
            elif sys.platform == "darwin":
                subprocess.Popen(["open", d])
            else:
                subprocess.Popen(["xdg-open", d])
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.log(f"{d}: {e}", "err")

    def refresh(self):
        try:
            self.v_status.set(self.status_text())
            self.load_notes()
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass

    def _tick(self):
        try:
            if not self.winfo_exists():
                return
            self.refresh()
            self.after(2000, self._tick)
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            pass
```

```py
def _norm_type(type_name):
    type_name = type_name.replace("struct ", "").replace("class ", "").replace(" ", "").lower()
    return type_name


def _fmt_for(t):
    return PACK.get(_norm_type(t))


def _show(fmt, raw, t):
    value = struct.unpack(fmt, raw)[0]
    if _norm_type(t) == "ffixedpoint64":
        return f"{value} (= {value / FIXED_SCALE:.6g})"
    return f"{value:.6g}" if fmt in ("<f", "<d") else str(value)
```
