```py
        ).pack(anchor="w")

        live_page = tk.Frame(self.nb, bg=BG)
        self.nb.add(live_page, text="INSTANZEN")
        bar3 = tk.Frame(live_page, bg=BG)
        bar3.pack(fill="x", pady=2)
        button(bar3, "LIVE FINDEN", lambda: self.instances(False), accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(bar3, "AUS DUMP", lambda: self.instances(True)).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(bar3, "→ SPEICHER", self.inst_mem).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(bar3, "→ SCHREIBER FINDEN", self.inst_watch).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        self.v_set = tk.StringVar()
        entry(bar3, self.v_set, 10).pack(side="left", padx=(10, 2))
        button(bar3, "WERT SETZEN", self.inst_set).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        self.ti = tree(
            live_page,
            [("a", "OBJEKT"), ("n", "NAME"), ("m", "MEMBER-ADRESSE"), ("v", "WERT")],
            [140, 220, 150, 170],
            height=14,
        )
        with_scroll(live_page, self.ti)
        label(
            live_page,
            "LIVE: echte Objekte im laufenden Spiel (UE 4.23+/5). AUS DUMP: Zustand zur Dump-Zeit (Adressen "
            "gelten nur für diesen Lauf). FixedPoint-Werte: Eingabe × 1000 (Palworld). Den Schreiber findest "
            "du, indem du im Spiel den Wert änderst - der Debugger zeigt die Instruktion.",
            dim=True,
        ).pack(anchor="w")

    def _pick_game(self):
        folder = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self.win, title="Spielordner (mit offsets.json, dump.json, SDK ...)")
        if not folder:
            return
        self.v["game"].set(folder)
        import dumpmem

        game_files = dumpmem.find_game_files(folder)
        for k, _t, fk in FILE_KEYS:
            self.v[k].set(game_files.get(fk) or "")
        missing = [k for k, value in game_files.items() if not value]
        self.lbl.configure(
            text="gefunden: "
            + ", ".join(k for k, value in game_files.items() if value)
            + (f"   |   FEHLT: {', '.join(missing)}" if missing else ""),
            fg=WARN if missing else ACCENT,
        )

    def _pick_dir(self):
        d = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self.win, title="SDK-Ordner (SDK_HEADERS)")
        if d:
            self.v["sdk"].set(d)

    def _pick_file(self, k):
        f = filedialog.askopenfilename(parent=self.win)
        if f:
            self.v[k].set(f)

    def load(self):
        try:
            min_score = float(self.v_min.get())
        except Exception as error:
            return self.log(str(error), "err")
        files = {k: (self.v[k].get().strip() or None) for k, _t, _f in FILE_KEYS}
        files["engine"] = None
        if not (files["sdk"] or files["offsets"]):
            return self.log("SPIEL-ORDNER wählen (oder SDK-Ordner/offsets.json angeben)", "err")
        native = self.v_nat.get() or "auto"

        def job():
            import ue_project

            proj = ue_project.GameProject(
                files=files, native=native, log=lambda m: self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(m, "warn"))
            ).load()
            return proj, proj.candidates(min_score), proj.functions()

        def ok(result):
            if self.proj:
                self.proj.close()
            self.proj, self.cands, self.funcs = result
            self.by, self.impl, self.live = {}, {}, None
            self._fill_cands()
            self._fill_funcs()
            stats = self.proj.sdk.stats
            nat = self.proj.native_info
            self.lbl.configure(
                text=f"{self.proj.title or '?'}  |  {stats['classes']} Klassen, {stats['members']} Member, {len(self.cands)} Kandidaten, "
                f"{len(self.funcs)} Funktionsziele  |  Basis {self.proj.base:#x}  |  "
                + (f"Dump: ja ({self.proj.dis.name})" if self.proj.dm else "Dump: NEIN")
                + (f"  |  native = {nat[0].upper()}" if nat else ""),
                fg=ACCENT,
            )
            self.log("Spiel geladen", "ok")

        self.bg(job, ok)

    def _fill_cands(self):
        self.tc.delete(*self.tc.get_children())
        cat, query = self.v_cat.get(), self.v_q.get().strip().lower()
        for i, candidate in enumerate(self.cands):
            if (cat not in ("alle", "") and candidate.category != cat) or (
                query and query not in candidate.key.lower()
            ):
                continue
            self.tc.insert(
                "",
                "end",
                iid=str(i),
                values=(
                    f"{candidate.score:.1f}",
                    candidate.category,
                    candidate.key,
                    f"{candidate.offset:#x}",
                    candidate.type,
                ),
            )

    def _fill_funcs(self):
        self.tf.delete(*self.tf.get_children())
        for i, function in enumerate(self.funcs[:4000]):
            nat = f"{self.proj.native_rva(function['native']):#x}" if function["native"] else "—"
            if function["shared"]:
                nat += " (geteilt)"
            impl = self.impl.get(i)
            self.tf.insert(
                "",
                "end",
                iid=str(i),
                values=(
                    function["cls"],
                    function["name"],
                    function["category"],
                    nat,
                    f"{impl - self.proj.base:#x}" if impl else "",
                    function["sig"],
                ),
            )

    def _sel_cands(self):
        return [self.cands[int(i)] for i in self.tc.selection()]

    def _on_cand(self):
        sc = self._sel_cands()
        self.cur_cand = sc[0] if sc else None
        self._show_hits()

    def find_hits(self):
        sel = self._sel_cands()
        if not sel or not self.proj or not self.proj.dm:
            return self.log("erst laden (mit dump.bin) und Kandidaten wählen (Mehrfachauswahl möglich)", "warn")
        proj = self.proj

        def ok(by):
            self.by.update(by)
            self._show_hits()
            n = sum(len(by.get(c.key, [])) for c in sel)
            self.log(f"{n} schreibende Instruktion(en) gefunden", "ok" if n else "warn")

        self.bg(lambda: proj.analyze(sel), ok)

    def _show_hits(self):
        self.th.delete(*self.th.get_children())
        self.cur_hits = self.by.get(self.cur_cand.key, []) if self.cur_cand else []
        for i, cur_hit in enumerate(self.cur_hits[:500]):
            note = []
            if cur_hit.dec_hint:
                note.append("SUB davor")
            if cur_hit.ambiguity > 12:
                note.append(f"mehrdeutig ({cur_hit.ambiguity})")
            self.th.insert(
                "",
                "end",
                iid=str(i),
                values=(
                    f"{cur_hit.score:.1f}",
                    f"{cur_hit.rva:#x}",
                    cur_hit.ins.text,
                    cur_hit.kind,
                    cur_hit.coaccess,
                    ", ".join(note),
                ),
            )

    def _sel_hits(self):
        return [self.cur_hits[int(i)] for i in self.th.selection()]

    def goto_hit(self):
        sh = self._sel_hits()
        if sh:
            self.win.goto_disasm(self.base + sh[0].rva)

    def _patch_dir(self):
        app = self.win.app
        if not app.PATCH_DIR:
            raise RuntimeError("kein Projekt/Patch-Ordner aktiv - erst ein Projekt öffnen")
        return app.PATCH_DIR

    def make_patches(self, caves):
        hits = self._sel_hits()
        if not hits:
            return self.log("erst Treffer wählen", "warn")
        try:
            pdir = self._patch_dir()
        except Exception as error:
            return self.log(str(error), "err")
        if not messagebox.askyesno(
            "Patches erzeugen",
            f"{len(hits)} Treffer -> .reapproj in\n{pdir}\n"
            "Hinweis: gilt für ALLE Objekte, die diesen Code nutzen (auch Gegner).",
            parent=self.win,
        ):
            return
        proj = self.proj

        def job():
            import ue_auto

            code = proj.code()
            return ue_auto.write_patches(
                pdir,
                code["buf"],
                proj.dis,
                hits,
                code["base_va"],
                caves=caves,
                code_range=code["range"],
                log=lambda m: self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(m, "warn")),
            )

        self.bg(job, lambda files: self._patched(files))

    def _patched(self, files):
        try:
            self.win.app.load_patches()
        except Exception as error:
            self.log(f"Patch-Liste nicht neu geladen: {error}", "warn")
        self.log(f"{len(files)} Patch-Datei(en): " + ", ".join(files[:4]) + (" …" if len(files) > 4 else ""), "ok")

    def _sel_func(self):
        sel = self.tf.selection()
        if not sel:
            raise ValueError("erst eine Funktion wählen")
        i = int(sel[0])
        return i, self.funcs[i]

    def func_impl(self):
        try:
            i, func = self._sel_func()
        except Exception as error:
            return self.log(str(error), "err")
        if not self.proj or not self.proj.dm:
            return self.log("dafür wird dump.bin gebraucht", "warn")
        if not func["native"] or func["shared"]:
            return self.log("geteilter Stub bzw. keine Adresse - nichts aufzulösen (Blueprint/Delegate)", "warn")
        proj = self.proj

        def ok(result):
            if not result:
                return self.log(f"{func['cls']}.{func['name']}: keine Implementierung hinter dem Thunk erkannt", "warn")
            self.impl[i] = result[0]
            self._fill_funcs()
            self.log(
                f"{func['cls']}.{func['name']}: Implementierung RVA {result[0] - proj.base:#x}"
                + (f" (+{len(result) - 1} weitere Kandidaten)" if len(result) > 1 else ""),
                "ok",
            )

        self.bg(lambda: proj.resolve_impl(func), ok)

    def func_goto(self):
        try:
            i, f = self._sel_func()
        except Exception as error:
            return self.log(str(error), "err")
        va = self.impl.get(i) or (self.proj.native_va(f["native"]) if f["native"] else None)
        if va:
            self.win.goto_disasm(va)

    def func_patch(self):
        try:
            i, func = self._sel_func()
            pdir = self._patch_dir()
        except Exception as error:
            return self.log(str(error), "err")
        if func["shared"] or not func["native"]:
            return self.log("geteilter Stub bzw. keine Adresse - nicht patchbar", "err")
        if i not in self.impl:
            return self.log("erst IMPL. AUFLÖSEN (der Thunk selbst darf nicht gepatcht werden)", "warn")
        mode, va, name, proj = self.v_mode.get(), self.impl[i], f"{func['cls']}.{func['name']}", self.proj
        if not messagebox.askyesno(
            "Funktions-Patch",
            f"{name}\nImplementierung {va - proj.base:#x}: Modus '{mode}'.\nGilt für alle Aufrufer der Funktion.",
            parent=self.win,
        ):
            return

        def job():
            p = proj.function_patch(va, mode, name)
            fn = os.path.join(
                pdir, "".join(c if c.isalnum() or c in " ._()-+" else "_" for c in p["name"]) + ".reapproj"
            )
            with open(fn, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as handle:
                json.dump(p, handle, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
            return [os.path.basename(fn)]

        self.bg(job, self._patched)

    def func_entry(self):
        try:
            i, func = self._sel_func()
        except Exception as error:
            return self.log(str(error), "err")

        def job():
            return self._ensure_live().function_entry(func["cls"], func["name"])

        def ok(result):
            if not result:
                return self.log(f"{func['cls']}.{func['name']}: kein nativer Einsprung", "warn")
            self.log(f"{func['cls']}.{func['name']}: ExecFunction {result[0]:#x} (RVA {result[1]:#x})", "ok")
            self.win.goto_disasm(result[0])

        self.bg(job, ok)

    def func_call(self):
        """Eine UFunction ueber ProcessEvent aufrufen (Verfahren wie uecall im ps4-unreal-dumper)."""
        try:
            i, func = self._sel_func()
            if not self.proj:
                raise RuntimeError("erst laden")
            assign_txt = self.v_ufarg.get()
        except Exception as error:
            return self.log(str(error), "err")
        sel = self.ti.selection()
        inst = self.insts[int(sel[0])][0]["addr"] if sel else None
        if not messagebox.askyesno(
            "UFunction aufrufen",
            f"{func['cls']}.{func['name']}\nLäuft auf einem Hilfs-Thread des Spiels. Funktionen, die "
            "Objekte erzeugen (SpawnActor, Widgets), können das Spiel zum Absturz bringen.",
            parent=self.win,
        ):
            return
        proj = self.proj

        def job():
            import ue_call

            live = self._ensure_live()
            if live.index is None:
                live.build_index()
            proj.sdk.load_params()
            params = proj.sdk.params_for(func["cls"], func["name"])
            if not params:
                raise ValueError("kein Parameter-Layout gefunden (…_parameters.hpp im SDK-Ordner?)")
            function = live.find_function(func["cls"], func["name"])
            if not function:
                raise ValueError("UFunction-Objekt im Spiel nicht gefunden (Klasse nicht geladen?)")
            obj = inst
            if (func["flags"] & 0x2000) or obj is None:  # FUNC_Static -> Default-Objekt
                if not (func["flags"] & 0x2000):
                    raise ValueError("erst im Tab INSTANZEN eine Instanz wählen")
                obj = live.default_object(func["cls"])
                if not obj:
                    raise ValueError("Default-Objekt der Klasse nicht gefunden")
            idx = proj.sdk.offset("process_event_index", "processeventindex", default=77)
            rva = proj.sdk.offset("process_event")
            process_event = ue_call.process_event_addr(
                self.win.client.read_memory, obj, idx, fallback=(self.base + rva) if rva else None
            )
            return ue_call.call_ufunction(
                self.win.client, obj, function, params, ue_call.parse_assignments(assign_txt), process_event
            )

        def ok(outs):
            self.log(f"{func['cls']}.{func['name']} aufgerufen" + ("" if outs else " (keine Ausgabe)"), "ok")
            for k, v in outs:
                self.log(f"   {k} = {v}", "ok")

        self.bg(job, ok)

    def _ensure_live(self, offline=False):
        import ue_live

        proj = self.proj
        if proj is None:
            raise RuntimeError("erst laden")
        args = proj.live_args()
        if offline:
            if not proj.dm:
                raise RuntimeError("kein Dump geladen")
            live = ue_live.UELive(proj.dm.read, proj.base, proj.sdk, log=self.log)
            live.setup([proj.base], **args)
            return live
        client = self.win.client
        if client is None:
            raise RuntimeError("nicht verbunden")
        if self.live is not None and self.live._read == client.read_memory and self.live.arr:
            return self.live
        bases = [proj.base]
        try:
            module_base = ue_live.live_module_base(client.get_maps())
            if module_base:
                bases.append(module_base)
        except Exception:
            pass
        bases.append(self.base)
        live = ue_live.UELive(client.read_memory, proj.base, proj.sdk, log=self.log)
        try:
            try:
                maps = client.get_maps()
            except Exception:
                maps = None
            live.setup(bases, maps=maps, **args)
        except ue_live.UELiveError as error:
            self.live = None
            raise RuntimeError(
                f"{error}\n(Spiel gestartet und Level geladen? Heap-Adressen aendern sich bei jedem Start - "
                f"Basis im Prozess: {bases[1]:#x})"
                if len(bases) > 1
                else str(error)
            )
        self.live = live
        self.log(
            f"GObjects {live.num_elements} Objekte, Item {live.item_size:#x}, Name-Pool ok, Basis {live.base:#x}", "ok"
        )
        return live

    def instances(self, offline):
        if not self.cur_cand or not self.proj:
            return self.log("erst Kandidat wählen", "warn")
        cand = self.cur_cand
        self.inst_offline = offline

        def job():
            live = self._ensure_live(offline)
            if live.index is None:
                live.build_index()
            fmt, rows = _fmt_for(cand.type), []
            for i in live.instances(cand.cls)[:300]:
                val = ""
                try:
                    if fmt:
                        val = _show(fmt, live.rd(i["addr"] + cand.offset, struct.calcsize(fmt)), cand.type)
                except Exception:
                    val = "?"
                rows.append((i, val))
            return rows

        def ok(rows):
            self.insts = rows
            self.ti.delete(*self.ti.get_children())
            for n, (i, val) in enumerate(rows):
                self.ti.insert(
                    "", "end", iid=str(n), values=(f"{i['addr']:#x}", i["name"], f"{i['addr'] + cand.offset:#x}", val)
                )
            self.nb.select(2)
            self.log(
                f"{len(rows)} Instanz(en) von {cand.cls}" + (" (aus Dump)" if offline else ""), "ok" if rows else "warn"
            )

        self.bg(job, ok)

    def _sel_inst(self):
        sel = self.ti.selection()
        if not sel or not self.cur_cand:
            raise ValueError("erst eine Instanz wählen")
        return self.insts[int(sel[0])][0]["addr"] + self.cur_cand.offset

    def inst_mem(self):
        try:
            self.win.goto_memory(self._sel_inst())
        except Exception as error:
            self.log(str(error), "err")

    def inst_watch(self):
        try:
            self.win.to_debug_watch(self._sel_inst(), min(self.cur_cand.size or 4, 8))
        except Exception as error:
            self.log(str(error), "err")

    def inst_set(self):
        try:
            addr, fmt = self._sel_inst(), _fmt_for(self.cur_cand.type)
            if not fmt:
                raise ValueError(f"Typ '{self.cur_cand.type}' nicht beschreibbar")
            if getattr(self, "inst_offline", False):
                raise ValueError("Instanzen aus dem Dump sind nur zum Ansehen - LIVE FINDEN benutzen")
            txt = self.v_set.get().strip()
            if _norm_type(self.cur_cand.type) == "ffixedpoint64":
                val = int(round(float(txt) * FIXED_SCALE))
            elif fmt in ("<f", "<d"):
                val = float(txt)
            else:
                val = int(txt, 0)
            data = struct.pack(fmt, val)
        except Exception as error:
            return self.log(str(error), "err")
        self.bg(lambda: self.win.client.write_memory(addr, data), lambda _r: self.log(f"{addr:#x} = {txt}", "ok"))

    def shutdown(self):
        if self.proj:
            self.proj.close()

```

`tools_uelive_gui.py`:

```py
"""tools_uelive_gui.py - Tab "UE-LIVE": der einfache Weg.

  1) SPIEL-ORDNER waehlen (wird gemerkt, beim naechsten Start automatisch geladen)
  2) links einen Wert anklicken (z.B. UHealthComponent.Health) - es wird NICHTS ausgeblendet,
     jeder Zahlen-/Bool-Member jeder Klasse steht in der Liste; das Suchfeld sucht nur Text
  3) rechts erscheinen alle Live-Instanzen mit dem aktuellen Wert (aktualisiert sich selbst)
  4) Doppelklick auf eine Zeile oder Wert eintippen -> SETZEN; EINFRIEREN haelt ihn fest

Logik in ue_quick.py (testbar ohne Konsole), Objekt-Leser in ue_live.py, Spiel-Laden in ue_project.py.
"""

import json
import os
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, simpledialog, ttk

import ue_quick as Q
from tools_common import ACCENT, BG, FONT_LABEL, TEXT_DIM, WARN, BaseTab, button, entry, label, tree, with_scroll

CFG = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".reaperpy_uelive.json")
TICK_MS = 400
MAX_LIST_ROWS = 5000  # Anzeige-Grenze der linken Liste (Suche findet trotzdem alles)
MAX_LIVE_ROWS = 120  # so viele sichtbare Zeilen werden je Tick neu gelesen
SNOW = "❄"


def _load_cfg():
    try:
        with open(CFG, encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            return json.load(handle)
    except Exception:
        return {}


def _save_cfg(d):
    try:
        with open(CFG, "w", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
            json.dump(d, handle)
    except Exception:
        pass


class UeLiveTab(BaseTab):
    def __init__(self, parent, win):
        super().__init__(parent, win)
        self.proj = self.live = None
        self.targets, self.shown, self.cands = [], [], []  # alle Ziele / aktuell gelistete / Kandidaten
        self.cur = None  # gewaehltes Target
        self.promo = {}  # key -> ue_promising.Promising (Modus "beste Werte")
        self.rows = []  # Instanzen des gewaehlten Ziels
        self.freezer = Q.Freezer()
        self._busy = False
        self._pending = None
        self._cfg = _load_cfg()

        top = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG)
        top.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=(8, 2))
        button(top, "SPIEL-ORDNER…", self.pick_game, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        self.v_game = tk.StringVar(value=self._cfg.get("game", ""))
        entry(top, self.v_game, 60).pack(side="left", padx=4, fill="x", expand=True)
        button(top, "↻ NEU LADEN", self.load).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(top, "★ BESTE WERTE", self.best_values, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(top, "ALLE WERTE", self._rebuild_targets).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        self.lbl = label(
            self, "① Spiel-Ordner wählen   ② links einen Namen suchen (z. B. Health, Money, Ammo) und anklicken   "
            "③ rechts Zeile wählen → neuen Wert eintippen → SETZEN"
        )
        self.lbl.pack(anchor="w", padx=10, pady=(0, 2))

        pan = ttk.PanedWindow(self, orient="horizontal")
        pan.pack(fill="both", expand=True, padx=8, pady=4)

        left = tk.Frame(pan, bg=BG)
        pan.add(left, weight=2)
        frame = tk.Frame(left, bg=BG)
        frame.pack(fill="x")
        label(frame, "NAME SUCHEN").pack(side="left")
        self.v_q = tk.StringVar()
        search_entry = entry(frame, self.v_q, 24)
        search_entry.pack(side="left", padx=4)
        search_entry.bind("<KeyRelease>", lambda _e: self._fill_targets())
        self.tl = tree(
            left,
            [("k", "KLASSE.MEMBER"), ("t", "TYP / INSTANZEN / WERT")],
            [330, 190],
            height=18,
            details=self._target_details,
        )
        with_scroll(left, self.tl)
        self.lbl_list = label(left, "")
        self.lbl_list.pack(anchor="w")
        self.tl.bind("<<TreeviewSelect>>", lambda _e: self._on_pick())

        right = tk.Frame(pan, bg=BG)
        pan.add(right, weight=3)
        self.lbl_cur = label(right, "← links einen Wert anklicken", dim=False)
        self.lbl_cur.pack(anchor="w")
        fr2 = tk.Frame(right, bg=BG)
        fr2.pack(fill="x", pady=2)
        self.v_live = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
        tk.Checkbutton(
            fr2,
            text="live aktualisieren",
            variable=self.v_live,
            bg=BG,
            fg=TEXT_DIM,
            selectcolor=BG,
            activebackground=BG,
            font=FONT_LABEL,
        ).pack(side="left", padx=4)
        button(fr2, "↻ INSTANZEN NEU", lambda: self.refind(force=True)).pack(side="right", padx=2)

        row_actions = [
            ("Wert ändern…", self.edit_dialog),
            (f"{SNOW} Einfrieren", self.freeze_sel),
            ("Auftauen", self.unfreeze_sel),
            ("Alle auftauen", self.unfreeze_all),
            (None, None),
            ("Im Speicher zeigen", self.to_memory),
            ("Schreiber finden", self.to_watch),
        ]
        self.tr = tree(
            right,
            [("f", SNOW), ("v", "LIVE-WERT"), ("n", "INSTANZ"), ("a", "ADRESSE")],
            [28, 130, 260, 130],
            height=14,
            actions=row_actions,
            details=self._row_details,
        )
        with_scroll(right, self.tr)
        self.tr.bind("<Double-1>", lambda _e: self.edit_dialog())
        self.tr.bind("<<TreeviewSelect>>", lambda _e: self._on_row())

        bottom = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG)
        bottom.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=(0, 2))
        edit_row = tk.Frame(bottom, bg=BG)
        edit_row.pack(fill="x", pady=2)
        label(edit_row, "NEUER WERT").pack(side="left")
        self.v_val = tk.StringVar()
        value_entry = entry(edit_row, self.v_val, 14)
        value_entry.pack(side="left", padx=4)
        value_entry.bind("<Return>", lambda _e: self.set_value())
        button(edit_row, "SETZEN", self.set_value, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        self.v_scope = tk.StringVar(value="Auswahl")
        ttk.Combobox(
            edit_row, textvariable=self.v_scope, values=("Auswahl", "alle Instanzen"), width=14, state="readonly"
        ).pack(side="left", padx=6)
        self.quick = tk.Frame(edit_row, bg=BG)
        self.quick.pack(side="left", padx=6)
        self.btn_max = button(edit_row, "= MAX", self.set_to_max)
        self.btn_max.pack(side="left", padx=2)
        freeze_row = tk.Frame(bottom, bg=BG)
        freeze_row.pack(fill="x", pady=2)
        button(freeze_row, f"{SNOW} EINFRIEREN", self.freeze_sel, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        button(freeze_row, "AUFTAUEN", self.unfreeze_sel).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        self.lbl_fz = label(freeze_row, "")
        self.lbl_fz.pack(side="left", padx=8)
        label(
            self,
            "Doppelklick ändert den Wert, Rechtsklick öffnet weitere Aktionen. '+100' und '*2' rechnen "
            "vom aktuellen Wert aus.",
            dim=True,
        ).pack(anchor="w", padx=10, pady=(0, 4))

        self._build_quick(None)
        self.after(300, self._autoload)
        self.after(TICK_MS, self._tick)

    def _autoload(self):
        g = self.v_game.get().strip()
        if g and os.path.isdir(g) and self.proj is None:
            self.load()

    def pick_game(self):
        d = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self.win, title="Spielordner (mit offsets.json, SDK_HEADERS ...)")
        if d:
            self.v_game.set(d)
            self.load()

    def load(self):
        folder = self.v_game.get().strip()
        if not folder or not os.path.isdir(folder):
            return self.log("UE-LIVE: erst SPIEL-ORDNER wählen", "warn")

        def job():
            import dumpmem
            import ue_project

            files = dumpmem.find_game_files(folder)
            files["dump_bin"] = files["dump_json"] = None  # fuer UE-LIVE nicht noetig -> schneller
            if not (files.get("sdk") or files.get("offsets")):
                raise FileNotFoundError("weder SDK_HEADERS noch offsets.json im Ordner gefunden")
            proj = ue_project.GameProject(
                files=files, native="rva", log=lambda m: self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(m, "warn"))
            ).load()
            return proj

        def ok(r):
            self.proj = r
            self.live = None
            self.freezer.clear()
            self._cfg["game"] = folder
            _save_cfg(self._cfg)
            self._rebuild_targets()
            stats = self.proj.sdk.stats
            self.lbl.configure(
                text=f"{self.proj.title or os.path.basename(folder)}: {stats['classes']} Klassen, "
                f"{len(self.targets)} Werte  -  jetzt links einen Wert anklicken",
                fg=ACCENT,
            )

        self.bg(job, ok)

    def _rebuild_targets(self):
        if not self.proj:
            return
        self.promo = {}
        # ALLE Zahlen-/Bool-Member aller Klassen - nichts wird vorab aussortiert
        self.targets = sorted(Q.targets_from_all_members(self.proj.sdk), key=lambda t: (t.cls.lower(), t.offset))
        self._fill_targets()

    def _fill_targets(self):
        self.tl.delete(*self.tl.get_children())
        q = self.v_q.get().strip().lower()
        self.shown = [target for target in self.targets if not q or q in target.key.lower()]
        for i, t in enumerate(self.shown[:MAX_LIST_ROWS]):
            info = self.promo.get(t.key)
            shown_type = t.type if info is None else f"{t.type}  ×{info.count}  {info.sample}".rstrip()
            self.tl.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(t.key, shown_type))
        if len(self.shown) > MAX_LIST_ROWS:
            self.lbl_list.configure(
                text=f"{len(self.shown)} Treffer - nur die ersten {MAX_LIST_ROWS} sichtbar, Suchwort eingeben", fg=WARN
            )
        else:
            self.lbl_list.configure(text=f"{len(self.shown)} Werte", fg=TEXT_DIM)

    def best_values(self):
        """Nur die vielversprechendsten Werte: Klassen mit echten Instanzen im Spiel + Standard-Engine-Werte,
        mit live gelesenen Offsets und Wert-Stichprobe (ue_promising)."""
        if not self.proj:
            return self.log("UE-LIVE: erst Spiel-Ordner laden", "warn")
        client = self.win.client
        if client is None:
            return self.log("UE-LIVE: nicht verbunden (Haupt-Fenster: VERBINDEN)", "err")
        self.lbl.configure(text="Suche die vielversprechendsten Werte im laufenden Spiel …", fg=WARN)

        def job():
            import ue_promising

            log = lambda m: self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(m, "info"))  # noqa: E731
            live = Q.connect_live(client, self.proj, log=log, cached=self.live)
            if self.live is live:
                live.drop_cache()  # Level kann gewechselt haben
            if live.index is None:
                live.build_index()
            return live, ue_promising.find_promising(live, self.proj.sdk, read=client.read_memory)

        def ok(res):
            live, found = res
            self.live = live
            self.promo = {p.key: p for p in found}
            self.targets = [p.target for p in found]
            self._fill_targets()
            self.lbl.configure(
                text=f"{len(found)} vielversprechende Werte (alle mit Instanzen im Spiel)  -  Zahl hinter dem Typ = Anzahl "
                "Objekte, danach der gelesene Wert",
                fg=ACCENT,
            )

        self.bg(job, ok, lambda e: (self.log(f"UE-LIVE: {e}", "err"), self.lbl.configure(text=f"Fehler: {e}", fg="#ff3366")))

    def _on_pick(self):
        sel = self.tl.selection()
        if not sel:
            return
        self.cur = self.shown[int(sel[0])]
        self.rows = []
        self._render()
        self.lbl_cur.configure(text=f"{self.cur.key}  [{self.cur.type}]  - suche Instanzen im Spiel …", fg=WARN)
        self._build_quick(self.cur)
        self._cancel_pending()
        self._pending = self.after(250, self.refind)  # kurz warten, falls man durch die Liste scrollt

    def _cancel_pending(self):
        if self._pending is not None:
            try:
                self.after_cancel(self._pending)
            except Exception:
                pass
            self._pending = None

    def _build_quick(self, target):
        for child in self.quick.winfo_children():
            child.destroy()
        if target is None:
            self.btn_max.pack_forget()
            return
        if target.is_bool:
            button(self.quick, "AN", lambda: self._quick("an"), accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=1)
            button(self.quick, "AUS", lambda: self._quick("aus")).pack(side="left", padx=1)
        else:
            for txt, val in (
                ("×2", "*2"),
                ("×10", "*10"),
                ("+10", "+10"),
                ("+100", "+100"),
                ("+1000", "+1000"),
                ("0", "0"),
                ("99999", "99999"),
            ):
                button(self.quick, txt, lambda v=val: self._quick(v)).pack(side="left", padx=1)
        if self._companions(target):
            self.btn_max.pack(side="left", padx=2)
        else:
            self.btn_max.pack_forget()

    def _target_details(self, row):
        target = self.shown[int(row)]
        return [
            ("Klasse", target.cls),
            ("Member", target.member),
            ("Typ", target.type),
            ("Offset", f"{target.offset:#x}"),
            ("Bit", target.bit if target.bit >= 0 else "-"),
        ]

    def _row_details(self, row):
        hit = self.rows[int(row)]
        target = self.cur
        return [
            ("Wert", f"{target.key} ({target.type})"),
            ("Objekt-Adresse", f"{hit['addr']:#x}"),
            ("Wert-Adresse", f"{hit['vaddr']:#x}"),
            ("Klasse der Instanz", hit["class"]),
            ("Eingefroren", "ja" if hit["vaddr"] in self.freezer else "nein"),
        ]

    def _quick(self, val):
        self.v_val.set(val)
        self.set_value()

    def refind(self, force=False):
        """Instanzen des gewählten Werts im Spiel suchen.  Der Objekt-Index wird nur einmal gebaut; force=True
        (Button INSTANZEN NEU, z.B. nach Levelwechsel) liest ihn neu."""
        self._pending = None
        cur = self.cur
        client = self.win.client
        if cur is None or not self.proj:
            return self.log("UE-LIVE: erst Spiel laden und einen Wert anklicken", "warn")
        if client is None:
            return self.log("UE-LIVE: nicht verbunden (Haupt-Fenster: VERBINDEN)", "err")

        def job():
            live = Q.connect_live(
                client, self.proj, log=lambda m: self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(m, "info")), cached=self.live
            )
            if self.live is not live:
                self.live = live
                self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(f"UE-LIVE: {live.num_elements} Objekte im Spiel erkannt", "ok"))
            elif force:
                live.drop_cache()  # frisch lesen (Level kann gewechselt haben)
            if live.index is None:
                self.win.ui(
                    lambda: self.log(
                        "UE-LIVE: Objekt-Index wird gebaut (einmalig, kann je nach Spiel einige Sekunden dauern) …",
                        "info",
                    )
                )
            rows = Q.find_instances(live, cur)
            if not rows:
                why = Q.explain_no_instances(live, cur)
                self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(f"UE-LIVE: {why}", "warn"))
            for row in rows:
                try:
                    row["val"], row["txt"] = Q.read_value(client.read_memory, row["vaddr"], cur)
                except Exception:
                    row["val"], row["txt"] = None, "?"
            rows.sort(
                key=lambda r: (
                    "player" not in (r.get("owner", "") + r["name"]).lower(),  # Spieler zuerst
                    r["val"] is None,
                    Q.is_zero(r["val"]) if r["val"] is not None else True,
                    r.get("owner", "") + r["name"],
                )
            )
            return rows

        def ok(rows):
            if cur is not self.cur:
                return
            self.rows = rows
            self._render()
            nz = sum(1 for row in rows if row["val"] is not None and not Q.is_zero(row["val"]))
            self.lbl_cur.configure(
                text=f"{cur.key}  [{cur.type}]  -  {len(rows)} Instanz(en), {nz} mit Wert ≠ 0",
                fg=ACCENT if rows else WARN,
            )

        self.bg(
            job,
            ok,
            lambda e: (
                self.lbl_cur.configure(text=f"{cur.key}  -  Fehler", fg="#ff3366"),
                self.log(f"UE-LIVE: {e}", "err"),
            ),
        )

    def _visible(self):
        return list(range(len(self.rows)))  # keine Filter: jede gefundene Instanz wird gezeigt

    def _render(self):
        keep = {self.rows[int(i)]["vaddr"] for i in self.tr.selection() if int(i) < len(self.rows)}
        self.tr.delete(*self.tr.get_children())
        new_sel = []
        for i in self._visible():
            r = self.rows[i]
            self.tr.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=self._values(r))
            if r["vaddr"] in keep:
                new_sel.append(str(i))
        if new_sel:
            self.tr.selection_set(new_sel)
        self._update_fz_label()

    def _values(self, row):
        return (SNOW if row["vaddr"] in self.freezer else "", row.get("txt", ""), (row.get("owner") + " › " if row.get("owner") else "") + row["name"], f"{row['vaddr']:#x}")

    def _update_fz_label(self):
        n = len(self.freezer)
        self.lbl_fz.configure(text=(f"{SNOW} {n} Wert(e) eingefroren" if n else ""), fg=ACCENT)

    def _sel_rows(self):
        if self.v_scope.get() == "alle Instanzen":
            return [self.rows[i] for i in self._visible()]
        return [self.rows[int(i)] for i in self.tr.selection() if int(i) < len(self.rows)]

    def _on_row(self):
        pass

    # Live-Tick: Freeze schreiben + sichtbare Werte neu lesen
    def _tick(self):
        try:
            if not self.winfo_exists():
                return
        except Exception:
            return
        self.after(TICK_MS, self._tick)
        client = self.win.client
        if self._busy or client is None or self.cur is None or not self.rows:
            return
        freezing = len(self.freezer) > 0
        if not freezing and not self.v_live.get():
            return
        cur = self.cur
        rows = [self.rows[i] for i in self._visible()][:MAX_LIVE_ROWS] if self.v_live.get() else []
        self._busy = True

        def job():
            if freezing:
                self.freezer.tick(client)
            out = []
            for row in rows:
                try:
                    out.append(Q.read_value(client.read_memory, row["vaddr"], cur))
                except Exception:
                    out.append((None, "?"))
            return out

        def done(vals):
            self._busy = False
            if cur is not self.cur:
                return
            for r, (v, txt) in zip(rows, vals):
                r["val"], r["txt"] = v, txt
            self._refresh_texts(rows)

        def err(e):
            self._busy = False
            self.log(f"UE-LIVE Live/Freeze: {e}", "err")

        self.win.bg(job, done, err)

    def _refresh_texts(self, rows):
        shown = set(self.tr.get_children())
        pos = {id(row): str(i) for i, row in enumerate(self.rows)}
        for row in rows:
            iid = pos.get(id(row))
            if iid in shown:
                self.tr.item(iid, values=self._values(row))

    def _targets_or_warn(self):
        if self.cur is None or not self.rows:
            self.log("UE-LIVE: erst links einen Wert anklicken", "warn")
            return None
        rows = self._sel_rows()
        if not rows:
            self.log("UE-LIVE: rechts eine Zeile wählen (oder Ziel 'alle Instanzen')", "warn")
            return None
        if self.win.client is None:
            self.log("UE-LIVE: nicht verbunden", "err")
            return None
        return rows

    def set_value(self, text=None, rows=None):
        rows = rows or self._targets_or_warn()
        if not rows:
            return
        cur, client = self.cur, self.win.client
        text = self.v_val.get() if text is None else text
        try:
            jobs = [(row, Q.parse_input(cur, text, row["val"])) for row in rows]
        except ValueError as error:
            return self.log(f"UE-LIVE: {error}", "err")

        def job():
            done = 0
            for row, value in jobs:
                Q.write_value(client.read_memory, client.write_memory, row["vaddr"], cur, value)
                if row["vaddr"] in self.freezer:  # eingefroren -> neuer Wert wird gehalten
                    self.freezer.add(row["vaddr"], cur, value)
                row["val"], row["txt"] = Q.read_value(client.read_memory, row["vaddr"], cur)
                done += 1
            return done

        self.bg(
            job,
            lambda n: (
                self._refresh_texts([r for r, _v in jobs]),
                self.log(f"UE-LIVE: {cur.member} = {jobs[0][0]['txt']}  ({n} Instanz(en))", "ok"),
            ),
        )

    def edit_dialog(self):
        sel = [self.rows[int(i)] for i in self.tr.selection() if int(i) < len(self.rows)]
        if not sel or self.cur is None:
            return
        row = sel[0]
        txt = simpledialog.askstring(
            "Wert ändern",
            f"{self.cur.key}\n{row['name']}\naktuell: {row.get('txt', '?')}\n\n"
            "Neuer Wert  ('+100', '*2', 'an'/'aus' sind erlaubt):",
            parent=self.win,
        )
        if txt is not None and txt.strip():
            self.set_value(txt, [row])

    def _companions(self, target):
        if not self.proj or target is None or target.is_bool:
            return []
        import uecheat

        try:
            return [
                Q.Target(target.cls, m.name, m.type, m.offset, m.bit)
                for m in uecheat.companions(self.proj.sdk, target)
                if Q.PACK.get(Q.norm_type(m.type)) and m.bit < 0 and "max" in m.name.lower()
            ]
        except Exception:
            return []

    def set_to_max(self):
        rows = self._targets_or_warn()
        comp = self._companions(self.cur) if rows else []
        if not rows or not comp:
            return
        cur, client, max_target = self.cur, self.win.client, comp[0]

        def job():
            for row in rows:
                mv, _ = Q.read_value(client.read_memory, row["vaddr"] - row.get("off", cur.offset) + max_target.offset, max_target)
                disp = mv / Q.FIXED_SCALE if max_target.is_fixed else mv
                v = Q.parse_input(cur, repr(disp))
                Q.write_value(client.read_memory, client.write_memory, row["vaddr"], cur, v)
                if row["vaddr"] in self.freezer:
                    self.freezer.add(row["vaddr"], cur, v)
                row["val"], row["txt"] = Q.read_value(client.read_memory, row["vaddr"], cur)
            return len(rows)

        self.bg(
            job, lambda n: (self._refresh_texts(rows), self.log(f"UE-LIVE: {cur.member} = {max_target.member}", "ok"))
        )

    def freeze_sel(self):
        rows = self._targets_or_warn()
        if not rows:
            return
        cur, client = self.cur, self.win.client
        text = self.v_val.get().strip()
        try:
            planned = [(row, Q.parse_input(cur, text, row["val"]) if text else row["val"]) for row in rows]
        except ValueError as error:
            return self.log(f"UE-LIVE: {error}", "err")
        if any(v is None for _r, v in planned):
            return self.log("UE-LIVE: Wert nicht lesbar - nicht einfrieren", "err")

        def job():
            for row, value in planned:
                Q.write_value(client.read_memory, client.write_memory, row["vaddr"], cur, value)
                self.freezer.add(row["vaddr"], cur, value)
                row["val"], row["txt"] = Q.read_value(client.read_memory, row["vaddr"], cur)
            return len(planned)

        self.bg(
            job,
            lambda n: (
                self._render(),
                self.log(f"UE-LIVE: {n} Wert(e) eingefroren bei {planned[0][0]['txt']} (AUFTAUEN zum Lösen)", "ok"),
            ),
        )

    def unfreeze_sel(self):
        n = 0
        for r in self._sel_rows() if self.cur else []:
            if r["vaddr"] in self.freezer:
                self.freezer.remove(r["vaddr"])
                n += 1
        self._render()
        self.log(f"UE-LIVE: {n} aufgetaut", "ok")

    def unfreeze_all(self):
        self.freezer.clear()
        self._render()
        self.log("UE-LIVE: alles aufgetaut", "ok")

    def _sel_row_addr(self):
        sel = [self.rows[int(i)] for i in self.tr.selection() if int(i) < len(self.rows)]
        if not sel:
            raise ValueError("erst eine Zeile wählen")
        return sel[0]["vaddr"]

    def to_memory(self):
        try:
            self.win.goto_memory(self._sel_row_addr())
        except Exception as error:
            self.log(f"UE-LIVE: {error}", "err")

    def to_watch(self):
        try:
            self.win.to_debug_watch(self._sel_row_addr(), min(self.cur.size or 4, 8))
        except Exception as error:
            self.log(f"UE-LIVE: {error}", "err")

    def shutdown(self):
        self.freezer.clear()
        if self.proj:
            self.proj.close()

```

`tools_unity_gui.py`:

```py
"""tools_unity_gui.py - Tab "UNITY": das Gegenstueck zu UE-LIVE fuer Unity-(IL2CPP)-Spiele.

  1) SPIEL-ORDNER waehlen: der Ordner mit der Ausgabe von Il2CppDumper (dump.cs, script.json, DummyDll ...).
     Verschachtelte Ordner (entpackte ZIPs) sind egal - die Dateien werden gesucht.
  2) Spiel auf der Konsole starten, bis ein Spielstand geladen ist, dann MODUL ERKENNEN.
  3) WERTE:    Feld anklicken (z. B. Gold, Health) -> Live-Instanzen -> aendern / einfrieren
     METHODEN: Methode suchen (z. B. AddMoney, IsDead) -> Rueckgabewert festlegen / Methode leer machen -> AN/AUS
     NAMEN:    Enum-Tabellen (Item-IDs, Rezepte, ...) nach Namen durchsuchen - nie wieder Zahlen raten

Logik in il2cpp_dump.py (testbar ohne Konsole); Schreib-/Einfrier-Logik teilt sich der Tab mit UE-LIVE (ue_quick.py).
"""

import json
import os
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import filedialog, messagebox, simpledialog, ttk

import il2cpp_dump as D
import ue_quick as Q
from tools_common import ACCENT, BG, FONT_LABEL, TEXT_DIM, WARN, BaseTab, button, entry, label, tree, with_scroll

CFG = os.path.join(os.path.expanduser("~"), ".reaperpy_unity.json")
TICK_MS = 400
MAX_ROWS = 4000
MAX_LIVE_ROWS = 120
SNOW = "❄"


def _load_cfg():
    try:
        with open(CFG, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            return json.load(fh)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return {}


def _save_cfg(d):
    try:
        with open(CFG, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            json.dump(d, fh)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        pass


def _hex_or_none(text):
    try:
        return int((text or "").strip(), 16)
    except ValueError:
        return None


class AppliedPatch:
    def __init__(self, method, mode, value, addr, original, new):
        self.method, self.mode, self.value = method, mode, value
        self.addr, self.original, self.new = addr, original, new
        self.on = True

    @property
    def title(self):
        what = {"true": "gibt immer TRUE", "false": "gibt immer FALSE", "noop": "macht nichts",
                "value": f"gibt immer {self.value}"}[self.mode]
        return f"{self.method.cls.name}.{self.method.name}: {what}"


class UnityTab(BaseTab):
    def __init__(self, parent, win):
        super().__init__(parent, win)
        self.game = self.live = None
        self.mod_base = None        # IL2CPP-Modul-Basis (live) - eigener Name, BaseTab.base ist die eboot-Basis
        self.targets, self.shown, self.cur = [], [], None
        self.rows = []
        self.static_keys = set()
        self.counts = None          # Ergebnis des Spiel-Scans: {Klasse: Objekte inkl. Unterklassen}
        self.inited = set()         # Klassen, die im Spiel schon initialisiert sind
        self.freezer = Q.Freezer()
        self.applied = []
        self.mshown = []
        self._busy = False
        self._pending = None
        self._cfg = _load_cfg()

        top = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG)
        top.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=(8, 2))
        button(top, "SPIEL-ORDNER…", self.pick_game, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        self.v_game = tk.StringVar(value=self._cfg.get("game", ""))
        entry(top, self.v_game, 60).pack(side="left", padx=4, fill="x", expand=True)
        button(top, "↻ LADEN", self.load).pack(side="left", padx=2)
        mod = tk.Frame(self, bg=BG)
        mod.pack(fill="x", padx=8, pady=2)
        button(mod, "② MODUL ERKENNEN", self.detect_base, accent=True).pack(side="left", padx=2)
```
