```py
    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ Laden
    def _autoload(self):
        g = self.v_game.get().strip()
        if g and os.path.isdir(g) and self.game is None:
            self.load()

    def pick_game(self):
        d = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self.win, title="Ordner mit dump.cs / script.json / DummyDll")
        if d:
            self.v_game.set(d)
            self.load()

    def load(self):
        folder = self.v_game.get().strip()
        if not folder or not os.path.isdir(folder):
            return self.log("UNITY: erst SPIEL-ORDNER wählen", "warn")
        self.lbl.configure(text="Lade dump.cs und script.json (große Spiele: bis ~20 Sekunden) …", fg=WARN)

        def job():
            files = D.find_game_files(folder)
            return D.GameDump(files, log=lambda m: self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(f"UNITY: {m}", "info"))).load()

        def ok(g):
            self.game, self.live, self.mod_base = g, None, None
            self.freezer.clear()
            self.counts, self.inited = None, set()
            self.rows, self.cur = [], None
            self._cfg["game"] = folder
            _save_cfg(self._cfg)
            self._rebuild_targets()
            self._fill_names()
            self.lbl.configure(
                text=f"{g.title}: {len(g.classes)} Klassen, {len(self.targets)} Werte, {len(g.all_methods())} Methoden "
                     "- jetzt Spiel starten und ② MODUL ERKENNEN", fg=ACCENT)

        def err(e):
            self.lbl.configure(text=f"Fehler: {e}", fg="#ff3366")
            self.log(f"UNITY: {e}", "err")

        self.bg(job, ok, err)

    def _rebuild_targets(self):
        if not self.game:
            return
        self.targets, self.static_keys = [], set()
        hide = self.v_gen.get()
        for c, f, prim, _s in self.game.value_targets(self.v_only.get()):
            if hide and D.is_generated(c, f):
                continue
            self.targets.append(Q.Target(c.full, D.clean_field_name(f.name), prim, f.offset, category="alle"))
        for c, f in self.game.static_targets():
            if self.v_only.get() and not c.image.startswith("Assembly-CSharp"):
                continue
            if hide and D.is_generated(c, f):
                continue
            t = Q.Target(c.full, D.clean_field_name(f.name), D.PRIMS[f.prim] if f.prim in D.PRIMS else f.prim, f.offset,
                         category="statisch")
            if t.writable and f.offset >= 0:
                self.targets.append(t)
                self.static_keys.add(t.key)
        self.targets.sort(key=lambda t: (t.cls.lower(), t.offset))
        self._fill_targets()

    def _count_of(self, t):
        """Objekte im Speicher fuer das Ziel (None = noch kein Scan). Statische Felder: 1, wenn die Klasse initialisiert ist."""
        if self.counts is None:
            return None
        if t.key in self.static_keys:
            return 1 if (t.cls in self.inited or self.counts.get(t.cls)) else 0
        return self.counts.get(t.cls, 0)

    def _fill_targets(self):
        self.tl.delete(*self.tl.get_children())
        q = self.v_q.get().strip().lower().split()
        only_live = self.v_live_only.get() and self.counts is not None
        self.shown = []
        for t in self.targets:
            if not all(p in t.key.lower() for p in q):
                continue
            if only_live and not self._count_of(t):
                continue
            self.shown.append(t)
        for i, t in enumerate(self.shown[:MAX_ROWS]):
            typ = t.type + (" (statisch)" if t.key in self.static_keys else "")
            n = self._count_of(t)
            self.tl.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(t.key, "" if n is None else n, typ, f"{t.offset:#x}"))
        n = len(self.shown)
        hint = ""
        if self.counts is None:
            hint = "  - ② b. SPIEL SCANNEN zeigt nur Felder von Klassen, die im Spiel wirklich existieren"
        elif only_live:
            hint = f"  - nur Klassen mit Objekten im Speicher ({len([c for c, v in self.counts.items() if v])} Klassen)"
        self.lbl_list.configure(
            text=f"{n} Werte" + (f" - nur die ersten {MAX_ROWS} sichtbar, Suchwort eingeben" if n > MAX_ROWS else hint),
            fg=WARN if n > MAX_ROWS else TEXT_DIM)

    def scan_game(self):
        client = self._need_client()
        if not client:
            return

        def job():
            live = self._ensure_base(client)
            live.set_maps(self._maps(client))
            live.drop_cache()

            def prog(done, total):
                self.win.ui(lambda: self.lbl.configure(
                    text=f"Scanne Spiel-Speicher … {done * 100 // total}% ({done >> 20} / {total >> 20} MB)", fg=WARN))

            counts, inited = live.census(progress=prog)
            return self._roll_up(counts), inited

        def ok(r):
            self.counts, self.inited = r
            n = len([c for c, v in self.counts.items() if v])
            self.lbl.configure(text=f"Scan fertig: {n} Klassen haben Objekte im Speicher - die Liste zeigt jetzt nur diese",
                               fg=ACCENT)
            self.log(f"UNITY: Scan fertig, {n} Klassen mit Objekten", "ok")
            self._fill_targets()

        self.bg(job, ok, lambda e: (self.lbl.configure(text=f"Fehler beim Scan: {e}", fg="#ff3366"),
                                    self.log(f"UNITY: {e}", "err")))

    def _roll_up(self, counts):
        """Objekte einer Unterklasse zaehlen auch fuer ihre Basisklassen (geerbte Felder stehen im Dump bei der Basis)."""
        out = dict(counts)
        for full, n in counts.items():
            c = self.game.by_full.get(full)
            seen = 0
            while c is not None and seen < 30:
                c = self.game.parent_of(c)
                if c is None:
                    break
                out[c.full] = out.get(c.full, 0) + n
                seen += 1
        return out

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ Modul / Live
    def _need_client(self):
        if self.win.client is None:
            self.log("UNITY: nicht verbunden (Haupt-Fenster: VERBINDEN)", "err")
            return None
        if not self.game:
            self.log("UNITY: erst Spiel-Ordner laden", "warn")
            return None
        return self.win.client

    @staticmethod
    def _maps(client):
        return client.get_maps_named() if hasattr(client, "get_maps_named") else client.get_maps()

    def _make_live(self, client, base):
        try:
            st = int(self.v_static.get().strip(), 16)
        except ValueError:
            st = D.K_STATIC_FIELDS
        return D.Il2CppLive(client.read_memory, self.game, base, self._maps(client), static_off=st,
                            log=lambda m: self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(f"UNITY: {m}", "info")))

    def detect_base(self):
        client = self._need_client()
        if not client:
            return
        manual = _hex_or_none(self.v_base.get())
        self.lbl.configure(text="Suche das IL2CPP-Modul im Spiel …", fg=WARN)

        def job():
            maps = client.get_maps_named() if hasattr(client, "get_maps_named") else client.get_maps()
            if manual:
                ok_n, tried = D.check_base(client.read_memory, manual, self.game, maps=maps)
                if ok_n == 0:
                    raise D.DumpError(f"Die eingetragene Basis {manual:#x} passt nicht zu den Klassennamen aus dump.cs.")
                return manual, ok_n
            base = D.find_module_base(client.read_memory, maps, self.game,
                                      log=lambda m: self.win.ui(lambda: self.log(f"UNITY: {m}", "ok")))
            return base, D.check_base(client.read_memory, base, self.game)[0]

        def ok(r):
            self.mod_base, n = r
            self.v_base.set(hex(self.mod_base))
            self.live = None
            self.lbl.configure(text=f"IL2CPP-Modul bei {self.mod_base:#x} bestätigt ({n} Klassen) - WERTE / METHODEN sind bereit",
                               fg=ACCENT)

        self.bg(job, ok, lambda e: (self.lbl.configure(text=f"Fehler: {e}", fg="#ff3366"), self.log(f"UNITY: {e}", "err")))

    def _ensure_base(self, client):
        """Im Job-Thread: Basis kennen (Feld oder automatisch) und Il2CppLive bereitstellen."""
        if self.mod_base is None:
            m = _hex_or_none(self.v_base.get())
            self.mod_base = m or D.find_module_base(client.read_memory, self._maps(client), self.game)
            self.win.ui(lambda: self.v_base.set(hex(self.mod_base)))
        if self.live is None or self.live.base != self.mod_base:
            self.live = self._make_live(client, self.mod_base)
        return self.live

    def _on_pick(self):
        sel = self.tl.selection()
        if not sel:
            return
        self.cur = self.shown[int(sel[0])]
        self.rows = []
        self._render()
        self.lbl_cur.configure(text=f"{self.cur.key}  [{self.cur.type}]  - suche Instanzen im Spiel …", fg=WARN)
        if self._pending is not None:
            try:
                self.after_cancel(self._pending)
            except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                pass
        self._pending = self.after(250, self.refind)

    def refind(self, force=False):
        self._pending = None
        cur, client = self.cur, self.win.client
        if cur is None:
            return self.log("UNITY: erst ein Feld anklicken", "warn")
        if self._need_client() is None:
            return
        is_static = cur.key in self.static_keys

        def job():
            live = self._ensure_base(client)
            if force:
                live.drop_cache()
                live.set_maps(self._maps(client))
            cls = self.game.by_full.get(cur.cls)
            self.win.ui(lambda: self.log("UNITY: suche Klasse/Instanzen im Speicher (beim ersten Mal etwas Geduld) …", "info"))
            if is_static:
                sb = live.static_base(cls)
                return [{"addr": sb, "vaddr": sb + cur.offset, "val": None, "txt": "?"}] if sb else []
            return [{"addr": a, "vaddr": a + cur.offset, "val": None, "txt": "?"} for a in live.instances(cls, use_cache=not force)]

        def ok(rows):
            if cur is not self.cur:
                return
            self.rows = rows
            for r in rows[:MAX_LIVE_ROWS]:
                try:
                    r["val"], r["txt"] = Q.read_value(client.read_memory, r["vaddr"], cur)
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    pass
            self._render()
            if rows:
                src = {"cache": "sofort aus dem Scan", "scan": "Speicher durchsucht"}.get(getattr(self.live, "last_source", ""), "")
                self.lbl_cur.configure(text=f"{cur.key}  [{cur.type}]  - {len(rows)} Instanz(en)" + (f" ({src})" if src else ""),
                                       fg=ACCENT)
            else:
                self.lbl_cur.configure(text=self._why_none(cur, is_static), fg=WARN)

        self.bg(job, ok, lambda e: (self.log(f"UNITY: {e}", "err"), self.lbl_cur.configure(text=f"Fehler: {e}", fg="#ff3366")))

    def _why_none(self, t, is_static):
        if is_static:
            return (f"{t.key}: Klasse im Spiel noch nicht initialisiert (oder STATIC-OFFSET passt nicht). Spielstand laden, "
                    "dann ↻ INSTANZEN NEU.")
        return (f"{t.key}: kein Objekt dieser Klasse im Speicher. Die Klasse wird oft erst im Spiel erzeugt - "
                "Spielstand laden / Menü öffnen, dann ↻ INSTANZEN NEU. Alternativ ein anderes Feld derselben Klasse versuchen.")

    def _render(self):
        self.tr.delete(*self.tr.get_children())
        for i, r in enumerate(self.rows[:MAX_ROWS]):
            self.tr.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(SNOW if r["vaddr"] in self.freezer else "", r["txt"],
                                                          f"{r['addr']:#x}", f"{r['vaddr']:#x}"))
        self.lbl_fz.configure(text=f"{len(self.freezer)} eingefroren" if len(self.freezer) else "")

    def _sel_rows(self):
        if not self.rows:
            self.log("UNITY: keine Instanzen - erst ein Feld anklicken", "warn")
            return []
        if self.v_scope.get() == "alle Instanzen":
            return list(self.rows)
        sel = [self.rows[int(i)] for i in self.tr.selection()]
        if not sel:
            self.log("UNITY: erst eine Zeile rechts wählen (oder Bereich 'alle Instanzen')", "warn")
        return sel

    def _tick(self):
        try:
            if not self.winfo_exists():
                return
        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
            return
        self.after(TICK_MS, self._tick)
        client = self.win.client
        if self._busy or client is None or self.cur is None or not self.rows:
            return
        freezing = len(self.freezer) > 0
        if not freezing and not self.v_live.get():
            return
        cur = self.cur
        rows = self.rows[:MAX_LIVE_ROWS] if self.v_live.get() else []
        self._busy = True

        def job():
            if freezing:
                self.freezer.tick(client)
            out = []
            for r in rows:
                try:
                    out.append(Q.read_value(client.read_memory, r["vaddr"], cur))
                except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
                    out.append((None, "?"))
            return out

        def done(vals):
            self._busy = False
            if cur is not self.cur:
                return
            for r, (v, txt) in zip(rows, vals):
                r["val"], r["txt"] = v, txt
            for i, r in enumerate(rows):
                if self.tr.exists(str(i)):
                    self.tr.set(str(i), "v", r["txt"])

        def err(e):
            self._busy = False
            self.log(f"UNITY Live/Freeze: {e}", "err")

        self.win.bg(job, done, err)

    def set_value(self, text=None):
        rows = self._sel_rows()
        if not rows:
            return
        cur, client = self.cur, self.win.client
        text = self.v_val.get() if text is None else text
        try:
            jobs = [(r, Q.parse_input(cur, text, r["val"])) for r in rows]
        except ValueError as e:
            return self.log(f"UNITY: {e}", "err")

        def job():
            for r, v in jobs:
                Q.write_value(client.read_memory, client.write_memory, r["vaddr"], cur, v)
                if r["vaddr"] in self.freezer:
                    self.freezer.add(r["vaddr"], cur, v)
                r["val"], r["txt"] = Q.read_value(client.read_memory, r["vaddr"], cur)
            return len(jobs)

        self.bg(job, lambda n: (self._render(), self.log(f"UNITY: {cur.member} = {jobs[0][0]['txt']} ({n} Instanz(en))", "ok")))

    def edit_dialog(self):
        sel = self.tr.selection()
        if not sel or self.cur is None:
            return
        r = self.rows[int(sel[0])]
        v = simpledialog.askstring("Wert ändern", f"{self.cur.key}\naktuell: {r['txt']}\nneuer Wert:", parent=self.win)
        if v:
            self.set_value(v)

    def freeze_sel(self):
        rows = self._sel_rows()
        if not rows:
            return
        cur, client = self.cur, self.win.client

        def job():
            for r in rows:
                v, _t = Q.read_value(client.read_memory, r["vaddr"], cur)
                self.freezer.add(r["vaddr"], cur, v)
            return len(rows)

        self.bg(job, lambda n: (self._render(), self.log(f"UNITY: {n} Wert(e) eingefroren (aktueller Wert wird gehalten)", "ok")))

    def unfreeze_sel(self):
        for r in self._sel_rows():
            self.freezer.remove(r["vaddr"])
        self._render()

    def unfreeze_all(self):
        self.freezer.clear()
        self._render()

    def to_memory(self):
        sel = self.tr.selection()
        mem = getattr(self.win, "t_mem", None)
        if not sel or mem is None:
            return
        try:
            mem.v_addr.set(f"{self.rows[int(sel[0])]['vaddr']:#x}")
            self.win.show_tab(mem)
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            self.log(f"UNITY: Speicher-Tab nicht erreichbar: {e}", "warn")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ Methoden-Patches
    def _fill_methods(self):
        self.ml.delete(*self.ml.get_children())
        if not self.game:
            return self.log("UNITY: erst Spiel-Ordner laden", "warn")
        self.mshown = self.game.search_methods(self.v_mq.get())
        for i, m in enumerate(self.mshown[:MAX_ROWS]):
            self.ml.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(m.key, m.sig, f"{m.rva:#x}"))

    def apply_patch(self, mode):
        client = self._need_client()
        sel = self.ml.selection()
        if not client or not sel:
            return self.log("UNITY: erst eine Methode in der Liste wählen", "warn") if client else None
        m = self.mshown[int(sel[0])]
        value = None
        if mode == "value":
            value = simpledialog.askstring("Rückgabewert", f"{m.sig}\nWert, den die Methode immer liefern soll "
                                           "(Zahl, z. B. 99999 oder 1.5):", parent=self.win)
            if value is None:
                return
        if m.n_params > 0 and mode in ("true", "false", "value", "noop"):
            pass  # Parameter sind fuer diese Patches egal (Methode kehrt sofort zurueck)
        if m.static is False and m.name in (".ctor", ".cctor"):
            return self.log("UNITY: Konstruktoren werden nicht gepatcht", "warn")
        try:
            new = D.make_patch(m, mode, value)
        except (ValueError, TypeError) as e:
            return messagebox.showwarning("Nicht möglich", str(e), parent=self.win)

        def job():
            live = self._ensure_base(client)
            addr = live.method_addr(m)
            orig = client.read_memory(addr, len(new))
            if orig[:1] == b"\xc3" or orig == new:
                raise RuntimeError("Dort steht schon ein ret / der Patch - Methode evtl. schon gepatcht oder nicht lesbar")
            client.write_memory(addr, new)
            return AppliedPatch(m, mode, value, addr, orig, new)

        def ok(p):
            self.applied.append(p)
            self._fill_applied()
            self.log(f"UNITY: {p.title}  @ {p.addr:#x}", "ok")

        self.bg(job, ok, lambda e: self.log(f"UNITY: Patch fehlgeschlagen: {e}", "err"))

    def _fill_applied(self):
        self.al.delete(*self.al.get_children())
        for i, p in enumerate(self.applied):
            self.al.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=("AN" if p.on else "aus", p.title, f"{p.addr:#x}"))

    def _sel_applied(self):
        return [self.applied[int(i)] for i in self.al.selection()]

    def toggle_patch(self):
        client = self.win.client
        ps = self._sel_applied()
        if not ps or client is None:
            return

        def job():
            for p in ps:
                client.write_memory(p.addr, p.original if p.on else p.new)
                p.on = not p.on

        self.bg(job, lambda _r: self._fill_applied())

    def remove_patch(self):
        self._restore(self._sel_applied())

    def remove_all(self):
        self._restore(list(self.applied))

    def _restore(self, ps):
        client = self.win.client
        if not ps or client is None:
            return

        def job():
            for p in ps:
                if p.on:
                    client.write_memory(p.addr, p.original)
                    p.on = False
            return ps

        def ok(done):
            for p in done:
                if p in self.applied:
                    self.applied.remove(p)
            self._fill_applied()
            self.log(f"UNITY: {len(done)} Patch(es) zurückgesetzt", "ok")

        self.bg(job, ok)

    def export_patches(self):
        if not self.applied:
            return self.log("UNITY: nichts angewendet - erst Methoden patchen", "warn")
        folder = filedialog.askdirectory(parent=self.win, title="Ordner für die .reapproj-Dateien")
        if not folder:
            return
        n = 0
        for p in self.applied:
            doc = D.reapproj_for_patch(
                p.title, p.method.rva, p.original, p.new,
                info=f"Unity/IL2CPP: {p.method.sig}  RVA {p.method.rva:#x} im IL2CPP-Modul. Image-Basis = IL2CPP-Modul-Basis.")
            D.write_reapproj(folder, doc)
            n += 1
        self.log(f"UNITY: {n} Datei(en) in {folder}. In ReaperPy die Image-Basis auf die IL2CPP-Modul-Basis stellen "
                 f"({self.v_base.get() or 'siehe MODUL-BASIS'}).", "ok")

    # ------------------------------------------------------------------ Namen
    def _fill_names(self):
        self.nl.delete(*self.nl.get_children())
        if not self.game:
            return
        q = self.v_nq.get().strip()
        if not q:
            self.lbl_names.configure(text=f"{sum(1 for c in self.game.classes if c.kind == 'enum')} Enums - Suchwort eingeben",
                                     fg=TEXT_DIM)
            return
        self.nshown = self.game.enum_search(q, limit=MAX_ROWS)
        for i, (c, n, v) in enumerate(self.nshown):
            self.nl.insert("", "end", iid=str(i), values=(c.name, n, v, hex(v) if v >= 0 else ""))
        self.lbl_names.configure(text=f"{len(self.nshown)} Treffer - Doppelklick kopiert den Wert", fg=TEXT_DIM)

    def _copy_name_value(self):
        sel = self.nl.selection()
        if sel:
            v = str(self.nshown[int(sel[0])][2])
            self.clipboard_clear()
            self.clipboard_append(v)
            self.log(f"UNITY: Wert {v} kopiert", "ok")

```

`ue_auto.py`:

```py
"""ue_auto.py - die ganze Kette in einem Schritt: SDK + Offsets + Dump -> Kandidaten -> Instruktionen -> Patches.

Kommandozeile:
  python ue_auto.py --sdk SDK_ORDNER --offsets Offsets.json --dump Dump.bin [--dump-rva 0x0]
                    [--min-score 8] [--top 15] [--categories Leben,Munition] [--out ORDNER] [--writes-only]

Ausgabe: Bericht auf der Konsole, `ue_report.json` und (mit --out) fertige .reapproj-Dateien
(NOP-Patch je Treffer + 'kann nicht sinken'-Cave, wo sie sich bauen laesst).
"""
import argparse
import json
import mmap
import os
import re
import sys

import ue_instr as U
import uecheat
import uesdk


def load_dump(path):
    f = open(path, "rb")
    try:
        return mmap.mmap(f.fileno(), 0, access=mmap.ACCESS_READ)
    except Exception:
        return f.read()


def targets_for(sdk, cands):
    """Kandidaten -> ({offset: [tags]}, {offsets aller Member der Klassen})"""
    targets, class_offs = {}, set()
    for c in cands:
        targets.setdefault(c.offset, []).append(c.key)
        for m in sdk.all_members(c.cls):
            if m.offset >= 0x80:
                class_offs.add(m.offset)
    return targets, class_offs


def analyze(sdk, dump, dis, cands, base_va=0x400000, dump_rva=0, include_reads=False, progress=None):
    """-> {candidate.key: [Hit]} (nach Score sortiert)."""
    targets, class_offs = targets_for(sdk, cands)
    hits = U.scan(dump, targets, dis, class_offs, base_va=base_va, dump_rva=dump_rva,
                  include_reads=include_reads, progress=progress)
    by = {}
    for h in hits:
        for t in h.tags:
            by.setdefault(t, []).append(h)
    return by


def hit_line(h):
    i = h.ins
    extra = []
    if h.dec_hint:
        extra.append("SUB davor")
    if h.ambiguity > 12:
        extra.append(f"mehrdeutig ({h.ambiguity} Funktionen)")
    return (f"{h.score:6.1f}  RVA {h.rva:#010x}  {i.text:<44} [{h.kind}] Ko-Zugriffe={h.coaccess}"
            + (f"  ({', '.join(extra)})" if extra else ""))


def safe_name(s):
    return re.sub(r"[^\w .()+-]", "_", s).strip(" .") or "Patch"


def write_patches(out_dir, dump, dis, hits, base_va, author="ReaperPy UE-Auto", with_aob=True,
                  caves=True, log=print, code_range=None):
    """-> [dateinamen].  Je Treffer NOP-Patch (+ Cave, wenn baubar)."""
    os.makedirs(out_dir, exist_ok=True)
    written, used = [], set()

    def save(p):
        fn, k = safe_name(p["name"]) + ".reapproj", 2
        while fn.lower() in used or os.path.exists(os.path.join(out_dir, fn)):
            fn, k = f"{safe_name(p['name'])} ({k}).reapproj", k + 1
        used.add(fn.lower())
        with open(os.path.join(out_dir, fn), "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as f:
            json.dump(p, f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
        written.append(fn)

    for h in hits:
        aob_text = None
        if with_aob:
            try:
                aob_text, _n = U.make_aob(dump, dis, h, base_va, code_range=code_range)
            except Exception as e:
                log(f"  AOB fuer {h.rva:#x} fehlgeschlagen: {e}")
            if not aob_text:
                log(f"  {h.rva:#x}: keine eindeutige Signatur im Dump - Patch nutzt feste Adresse")
        save(U.nop_patch(dump, h, aob_text, author=author))
        if caves:
            ok, why = U.can_cave(h)
            if ok:
                save(U.keep_cave_patch(dump, h, aob_text, author=author))
            else:
                log(f"  {h.rva:#x}: keine Cave ({why})")
    return written


def report_dict(cands, by, limit=8):
    out = []
    for c in cands:
        hs = by.get(c.key, [])[:limit]
        out.append({"candidate": c.key, "category": c.category, "score": c.score, "offset": hex(c.offset),
                    "type": c.type, "reasons": c.reasons,
                    "hits": [{"rva": hex(h.rva), "insn": h.ins.text, "kind": h.kind, "score": h.score,
                              "coaccess": h.coaccess, "dec_hint": h.dec_hint, "ambiguity": h.ambiguity}
                             for h in hs]})
    return out


def main(argv=None):
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="UE-SDK + Dump -> Cheat-Instruktionen + Patches")
    ap.add_argument("--game", help="Spielordner (findet offsets.json, dump.json/bin, SDK_HEADERS, GObjects automatisch)")
    ap.add_argument("--native", choices=("auto", "rva", "va"), default="auto",
                    help="sind 'native 0x..' im Header RVAs oder virtuelle Adressen?")
    ap.add_argument("--functions", type=int, default=0, help="N Funktions-Ziele mit Adresse und Implementierung ausgeben")
    ap.add_argument("--func-patch", action="append", default=[],
                    help="Klasse.Funktion:modus (ret|false|true|one|float0) - schreibt einen Funktions-Patch")
    ap.add_argument("--check-objects", action="store_true",
                    help="GObjects/GNames offline aus dem Dump pruefen und Diagnose ausgeben")
    ap.add_argument("--sdk"), ap.add_argument("--offsets"), ap.add_argument("--gobjects")
    ap.add_argument("--dump")
    ap.add_argument("--dump-rva", default="0x0", help="RVA, die Position 0 der Dump-Datei entspricht")
    ap.add_argument("--base", default="0x400000", help="Modul-Basisadresse (nur fuer Anzeige/Disasm)")
    ap.add_argument("--min-score", type=float, default=8.0)
    ap.add_argument("--top", type=int, default=15)
    ap.add_argument("--categories", default="", help="Komma-getrennt, z.B. Leben,Munition,Währung")
    ap.add_argument("--writes-only", action="store_true", default=True)
    ap.add_argument("--with-reads", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--out", help="Ordner fuer .reapproj-Patches")
    ap.add_argument("--patches-per-candidate", type=int, default=2)
    ap.add_argument("--disasm", choices=("capstone", "objdump"))
    a = ap.parse_args(argv)
    if a.game:
        return main_game(a)
    if not a.dump:
        ap.error("--dump oder --game angeben")

    sdk = uesdk.load(a.sdk, a.offsets, a.gobjects)
    print(f"SDK: {sdk.stats['classes']} Klassen, {sdk.stats['members']} Member, {len(sdk.offsets)} Offsets")
    cands = uecheat.find_candidates(sdk, a.min_score)
    if a.categories:
        want = {c.strip() for c in a.categories.split(",")}
        cands = [c for c in cands if c.category in want]
    cands = cands[:a.top]
    if not cands:
        print("Keine Kandidaten - --min-score senken oder SDK-Pfad pruefen.")
        return 1
    dump = load_dump(a.dump)
    dis = U.get_disasm(a.disasm)
    base, rva = int(a.base, 0), int(a.dump_rva, 0)
    print(f"Dump {len(dump):,} Byte, Disassembler: {dis.name}")
    by = analyze(sdk, dump, dis, cands, base, rva, a.with_reads,
                 progress=lambda d, t: print(f"\r  Byte-Treffer {d}/{t}", end="", file=sys.stderr))
    chosen = []
    for c in cands:
        print(f"\n[{c.category}] {c.key}  @ {c.offset:#x} ({c.type})  Score {c.score:.1f}")
        hs = by.get(c.key, [])
        if not hs:
            print("   keine schreibende Instruktion gefunden")
        for h in hs[:6]:
            print("   " + hit_line(h))
        chosen += hs[:a.patches_per_candidate]
    with open("ue_report.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(report_dict(cands, by), f, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    print("\nBericht: ue_report.json")
    if a.out and chosen:
        files = write_patches(a.out, dump, dis, chosen, base)
        print(f"{len(files)} Patch-Datei(en) nach {a.out}")
    return 0


def check_objects(proj, out=print):
    """Objekt-Erkennung offline pruefen (GObjects/GNames aus dump.bin)."""
    import collections
    import ue_live
    if not proj.dm:
        out("kein dump.bin/dump.json gefunden - Pruefung nicht moeglich. Gefunden wurde:")
        for k, v in proj.files.items():
            out(f"   {k:10} {v or 'FEHLT'}")
        out("Tipp: den Spiel-Ordner angeben (dort, wo dump.bin liegt), nicht nur den SDK-Unterordner.")
        return 1
    e = proj.engine or {}
    out(f"Basis (offsets.json): {proj.base:#x}   engine.json: arr={e.get('arr')} pool={e.get('pool')} layout={e.get('layout')}")
    lv = ue_live.UELive(proj.dm.read, proj.base, proj.sdk, log=out)
    try:
        rep = lv.setup([proj.base], **proj.live_args())
    except ue_live.UELiveError as ex:
        out(str(ex))
        out("-> Diagnose bitte weitergeben (mit den ersten Zeilen von offsets.json und dump.bin.engine.json).")
        return 2
    out(f"OK: GObjects @{rep['array']:#x}, {rep['count']} Objekte, Item {rep['item_size']:#x}, Name-Pool @{rep['name_blocks']:#x}")
    out(f"Name-Pool-Format: {lv.name_style.upper()}   - lese Objekt-Koepfe ...")
    idx = lv.build_index(lambda d, t: print(f"\r  {d}/{t}", end="", file=sys.stderr))
    print(file=sys.stderr)
    classes = collections.Counter(idx[idx[p][1]][2] for p in idx if idx[p][1] in idx)
    out(f"{len(idx)} Objekte lesbar; haeufigste Typen: " + ", ".join(f"{k} ({v})" for k, v in classes.most_common(6)))
    return 0


def main_game(a):
    """--game: alles aus einem Spielordner."""
    import ue_project
    proj = ue_project.GameProject(a.game, native=a.native).load()
    f = proj.files
    print(f"Spiel {proj.title or '?'}  Basis {proj.base:#x}")
    print("  gefunden: " + ", ".join(f"{k}={'ja' if v else 'NEIN'}" for k, v in f.items()))
    st = proj.sdk.stats
    print(f"  SDK: {st['classes']} Klassen, {st['members']} Member, {sum(len(c.funcs) for c in proj.sdk.classes.values())} Funktionen")
    if proj.native_info:
        m, r, v = proj.native_info
        print(f"  native-Adressen: {m.upper()}" + (f" (Treffer RVA {r:.0%} / VA {v:.0%})" if r is not None else " (vorgegeben)"))
    if a.check_objects:
        return check_objects(proj)
    cats = {c.strip() for c in a.categories.split(",")} if a.categories else None
    cands = proj.candidates(a.min_score, cats, a.top)
    if not cands:
        print("Keine Kandidaten - --min-score senken.")
        return 1
    by = {}
    chosen = []
    if proj.dm:
        by = proj.analyze(cands, a.with_reads,
                          progress=lambda d, t: print(f"\r  Byte-Treffer {d}/{t}", end="", file=sys.stderr))
    for c in cands:
        print(f"\n[{c.category}] {c.key}  @ {c.offset:#x} ({c.type})  Score {c.score:.1f}")
        for r in c.reasons[:3]:
            print(f"     - {r}")
        hs = by.get(c.key, [])
        if proj.dm and not hs:
            print("   keine schreibende Instruktion gefunden (Schalter/Daten werden evtl. nur per Live-Wert gesetzt)")
        for h in hs[:5]:
            print("   " + hit_line(h))
        chosen += hs[:a.patches_per_candidate]
    fnl = proj.functions()
    if a.functions:
        print("\n=== Funktions-Ziele ===")
        for d in fnl[:a.functions]:
            rv = proj.native_rva(d["native"]) if d["native"] else None
            line = f"{d['score']:4.1f}  {d['cls']}.{d['name']:<34} native RVA {rv:#x}" if rv is not None else \
                   f"{d['score']:4.1f}  {d['cls']}.{d['name']:<34} (keine Adresse)"
            if d["shared"]:
                line += "  [geteilter Stub - nicht patchbar]"
            elif proj.dm and d["native"]:
                try:
                    impl = proj.resolve_impl(d)
                    if impl:
                        line += f"  -> Impl RVA {impl[0] - proj.base:#x}"
                except Exception:
                    pass
            print(line)
    json_out = {"title": proj.title, "candidates": report_dict(cands, by), "functions": [
        {k: (hex(v) if k in ("native", "flags") and v is not None else v) for k, v in d.items()} for d in fnl[:300]]}
    with open("ue_report.json", "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        json.dump(json_out, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
    print("\nBericht: ue_report.json")
    wrote = []
    if a.out and chosen:
        cv = proj.code()
        wrote += write_patches(a.out, cv["buf"], proj.dis, chosen, cv["base_va"], code_range=cv["range"])
    if a.func_patch:
        if not a.out:
            print("--func-patch braucht --out"); return 1
        os.makedirs(a.out, exist_ok=True)
        idx = {(d["cls"], d["name"]): d for d in fnl}
        idx.update({(d["cls"].lstrip("UAF"), d["name"]): d for d in fnl})
        for spec in a.func_patch:
            try:
                nm, mode = spec.rsplit(":", 1)
                cls, fn = nm.rsplit(".", 1)
                d = idx.get((cls, fn)) or idx.get((cls.lstrip("UAF"), fn))
                if not d or not d["native"]:
                    raise KeyError(f"{nm} nicht gefunden/keine Adresse")
                if d["shared"]:
                    raise KeyError(f"{nm}: geteilter Stub")
                impl = proj.resolve_impl(d)
                if not impl:
                    raise KeyError(f"{nm}: keine Implementierung hinter dem Thunk gefunden")
                p = proj.function_patch(impl[0], mode, nm)
                fnm = os.path.join(a.out, safe_name(p["name"]) + ".reapproj")
                with open(fnm, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as fh:
                    json.dump(p, fh, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False)
                wrote.append(os.path.basename(fnm))
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"  --func-patch {spec}: {e}")
    if wrote:
        print(f"{len(wrote)} Patch-Datei(en) nach {a.out}")
    proj.close()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
```

`ue_call.py`:

```py
"""ue_call.py - eine UFunction im laufenden Spiel aufrufen (ProcessEvent), mit Parametern per Namen.

    ProcessEvent(UObject* obj, UFunction* fn, void* params)    -> Adresse aus der vtable von obj

Der Aufruf laeuft ueber ps5_more.call (Trampolin, Thread des Prozesses wird kurz gekapert).  Gut fuer
Funktionen, die Werte lesen/schreiben (SetGlobalTimeDilation, AddHP ...).  Alles, was Objekte ERZEUGT
(SpawnActor, Widgets), gehoert auf den Game-Thread und kann hier abstuerzen - dasselbe Verfahren und
dieselbe Einschraenkung wie `uecall` im ps4-unreal-dumper (TetzkatLipHoka, MIT).
"""
import struct

import uesdk

SCALAR = {"float": "<f", "double": "<d", "int32_t": "<i", "int": "<i", "int32": "<i", "uint32_t": "<I", "uint32": "<I",
          "int64_t": "<q", "int64": "<q", "uint64_t": "<Q", "uint64": "<Q", "int16_t": "<h", "uint16_t": "<H",
          "uint8_t": "<B", "int8_t": "<b", "uint8": "<B", "int8": "<b", "bool": "<B"}


class CallError(ValueError):
    pass


def _norm(t):
    return t.replace("class ", "").replace("struct ", "").replace("enum ", "").replace(" ", "")


def _kind(p):
    t = _norm(p.type)
    if t.endswith("*") or p.ptype in ("ObjectProperty", "ClassProperty", "WeakObjectProperty", "InterfaceProperty"):
        return "ptr"
    if t.lower() in SCALAR:
        return "scalar"
    if p.ptype == "ByteProperty" or p.ptype == "EnumProperty":
        return "byte"
    if p.ptype == "BoolProperty":
        return "bool"
    return "raw"


def parse_assignments(text):
    """'TimeDilation=0.3 WorldContextObject=0x1038e68080 Flag=true' -> {name: text}"""
    out = {}
    for tok in text.split():
        if "=" not in tok:
            raise CallError(f"'{tok}': erwartet Name=Wert")
        k, v = tok.split("=", 1)
        out[k.strip()] = v.strip()
    return out


def _to_bytes(p, text):
    k = _kind(p)
    if text.lower().startswith("hex:"):
        raw = bytes.fromhex(text[4:].replace(" ", ""))
        if len(raw) != p.size:
            raise CallError(f"{p.name}: hex: braucht genau {p.size} Byte")
        return raw
    if k == "ptr":
        return struct.pack("<Q", int(text, 0) & (2**64 - 1))
    if k == "bool" or _norm(p.type).lower() == "bool":
        return bytes([1 if text.lower() in ("1", "true", "ja", "an", "on") else 0])
    if k == "byte":
        return bytes([int(text, 0) & 0xFF])
    if k == "scalar":
        fmt = SCALAR[_norm(p.type).lower()]
        v = float(text) if fmt in ("<f", "<d") else int(text, 0)
        return struct.pack(fmt, v)
    raise CallError(f"{p.name}: Typ '{p.type}' wird nicht unterstuetzt (Struct/String/Name) - hex:AABB.. verwenden")


def encode_params(fp, assign):
    """-> bytearray der Parameter-Struct.  Nicht angegebene Eingaben bleiben 0."""
    names = {p.name for p in fp.params}
    unknown = set(assign) - names
    if unknown:
        raise CallError(f"unbekannte Parameter: {', '.join(sorted(unknown))} (gueltig: {', '.join(sorted(names))})")
    buf = bytearray(max(fp.size, max((p.offset + p.size for p in fp.params), default=0)))
    for p in fp.params:
        if p.name in assign:
            raw = _to_bytes(p, assign[p.name])
            buf[p.offset:p.offset + len(raw)] = raw
    return buf


def decode_outputs(fp, raw):
    """Ausgabe-/Rueckgabeparameter -> [(name, text)]"""
    out = []
    for p in fp.params:
        if not p.pflags & (uesdk.CPF_OUT | uesdk.CPF_RETURN):
            continue
        b = bytes(raw[p.offset:p.offset + p.size])
        k, t = _kind(p), _norm(p.type).lower()
        if k == "ptr":
            txt = f"{struct.unpack('<Q', b[:8])[0]:#x}"
        elif k == "scalar":
            fmt = SCALAR[t]
            v = struct.unpack(fmt, b[:struct.calcsize(fmt)])[0]
            txt = f"{v:.9g}" if fmt in ("<f", "<d") else str(v)
        elif k in ("byte", "bool"):
            txt = str(b[0])
        else:
            txt = b.hex(" ").upper()
            if t == "fvector" and len(b) == 24:
                txt = ", ".join(f"{x:.4f}" for x in struct.unpack("<3d", b)) + "  (double x/y/z)"
            elif t == "fvector" and len(b) == 12:
                txt = ", ".join(f"{x:.4f}" for x in struct.unpack("<3f", b))
        out.append(("ReturnValue" if p.pflags & uesdk.CPF_RETURN else p.name, txt))
    return out


def process_event_addr(read, obj, index, fallback=None):
    """ProcessEvent aus der vtable von obj (Slot `index`); sonst `fallback` (Adresse aus offsets.json)."""
    try:
        vt = struct.unpack("<Q", read(obj, 8))[0]
        pe = struct.unpack("<Q", read(vt + 8 * index, 8))[0]
        if pe >= 0x10000:
            return pe
    except Exception:
        pass
    if fallback:
        return fallback
    raise CallError("ProcessEvent-Adresse nicht ermittelbar")


def call_ufunction(client, obj, ufunc, fp, assign, pe_addr, caller=None):
    """-> [(name, wert)] der Ausgaben.  caller(client, rip, rdi, rsi, rdx) -> rax  (Standard ps5_more.call)."""
    if caller is None:
        import ps5_more
        caller = lambda c, rip, a, b, d: ps5_more.call(c, rip, a, b, d)
    buf = encode_params(fp, assign)
    addr = client.allocate_memory((len(buf) + 0xF) & ~0xF or 0x10)
    try:
        client.write_memory(addr, bytes(buf))
        caller(client, pe_addr, obj, ufunc, addr)
        raw = client.read_memory(addr, len(buf))
    finally:
        try:
            client.free_memory(addr, (len(buf) + 0xF) & ~0xF or 0x10)
        except Exception:
            pass
    return decode_outputs(fp, raw)

```

`ue_cavegen.py`:

```py
"""ue_cavegen.py - allgemeiner Code-Cave-Baustein: JEDE native UFunction (Item geben, Geld, XP ...) als Trainer-Eintrag.

Baut auf cave_trainer.py auf (gleiche statische Cave: ProcessEvent-Haken im vtable, Schalter-Bytes, ein Aufruf je Klick).
Statt der fest verdrahteten Standard-Form (Item geben) wird der Aufruf aus den Parametern der Funktion zusammengesetzt
(System-V-ABI, wie die Exec-Thunks der Spiele sie aufrufen):

    rdi = this           (nichts / das gehookte Objekt / ein Zeiger-Member des gehookten Objekts, z. B. CheatManager)
    rsi, rdx, rcx, r8, r9 = Ganzzahl-/Zeiger-/FName-Parameter in Deklarationsreihenfolge
    xmm0..xmm7           = float/double-Parameter
    FName / Zahl per ZEIGER ('ref', const T&): die Cave legt den Wert hinter ihren Code und uebergibt die Adresse

Nicht unterstuetzt (klare Fehlermeldung statt Raten): Out-Parameter, Structs/Strings/Arrays als Parameter, mehr als 5
Ganzzahl- bzw. 8 Gleitkomma-Parameter, Rueckgabe-Structs.  Alles am echten Spiel NICHT getestet - die erzeugte Cave
selbst wird in tests/test_ue_cavegen.py auf einem echten x86-64-Prozessor ausgefuehrt.
"""
import re
import struct

import cave_trainer as T
import ue_profile as P

INT_REGS = [  # (mov r32,imm32 | movabs r64,imm64 | lea r64,[rip+disp32])
    ("BE", "48BE", "488D35"),     # rsi
    ("BA", "48BA", "488D15"),     # rdx
    ("B9", "48B9", "488D0D"),     # rcx
    ("41B8", "49B8", "4C8D05"),   # r8
    ("41B9", "49B9", "4C8D0D"),   # r9
]
MAX_FLOAT_REGS = 8
SIZES = {"bool": 1, "int8": 1, "uint8": 1, "int16": 2, "uint16": 2, "int32": 4, "uint32": 4, "int": 4, "int64": 8,
         "uint64": 8, "int8_t": 1, "uint8_t": 1, "int16_t": 2, "uint16_t": 2, "int32_t": 4, "uint32_t": 4,
         "int64_t": 8, "uint64_t": 8}
SIGNED = {"int8", "int16", "int32", "int", "int64", "int8_t", "int16_t", "int32_t", "int64_t"}
THIS_MODES = ("zero", "hooked", "member")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Parameter klassifizieren
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
def param_kind(ptype, sdk=None):
    """-> (kind, size, signed) mit kind 'int'|'float'|'double'|'fname'|'ptr'|'enum', oder None (nicht unterstuetzt)."""
    raw = str(ptype)
    b = P.base_name(raw)
    if "*" in raw:
        return "ptr", 8, False
    if b == "FName":
        return "fname", 8, False
    if b in SIZES:
        return "int", SIZES[b], b in SIGNED
    if b == "float":
        return "float", 4, True
    if b == "double":
        return "double", 8, True
    if re.search(r"\benum\b", raw) or (sdk is not None and b in sdk.enums):
        return "enum", 1, False
    return None


def classify_params(params, sdk=None):
    """[(type, name)] -> [{'name','type','kind','size','signed','role','out'}]; wirft TrainerError bei Nicht-Unterstuetztem.
    role: 'id' (FName/ID-Zahl), 'count' (Menge) oder 'other'."""
    out = []
    for t, n in params:
        raw = str(t)
        if "&" in raw and "const" not in raw:
            raise T.TrainerError(f"Parameter '{n}' ({raw}) ist ein Out-Parameter - nicht unterstuetzt")
        k = param_kind(raw, sdk)
        if k is None:
            raise T.TrainerError(f"Parameter '{n}' hat den Typ '{raw}' - nur Zahlen, Bool, Enum, FName, float/double und "
                                 "Zeiger werden unterstuetzt")
        kind, size, signed = k
        role = "other"
        if kind == "fname" or (kind == "int" and P.ID_NAME.search(n) and not P.COUNT_NAME.search(n)):
            role = "id"
        elif kind in ("int", "float", "double") and P.COUNT_NAME.search(n) and not P.COUNT_BAD.search(n):
            role = "count"
        out.append({"name": n, "type": raw, "kind": kind, "size": size, "signed": signed, "role": role,
                    "ref": "const" in raw and "&" in raw})
    n_int = sum(1 for a in out if a["kind"] in ("int", "ptr", "fname", "enum"))
    n_flt = sum(1 for a in out if a["kind"] in ("float", "double"))
    if n_int > len(INT_REGS):
        raise T.TrainerError(f"Zu viele Ganzzahl-Parameter ({n_int} > {len(INT_REGS)}) - der Rest laege auf dem Stack")
    if n_flt > MAX_FLOAT_REGS:
        raise T.TrainerError(f"Zu viele Gleitkomma-Parameter ({n_flt} > {MAX_FLOAT_REGS})")
    return out


def check_return(ret):
    r = str(ret or "").strip()
    if not r or r == "void":
        return
    if param_kind(r) is None and "*" not in r:
        raise T.TrainerError(f"Rueckgabetyp '{r}' (Struct/String?) wird nicht unterstuetzt - der Aufruf waere falsch")


def choose_this(sdk, owner, hooked="APlayerController", static=False):
    """Woher kommt `this`?  -> (modus, offset, hinweis)."""
    if static:
        return "zero", 0, "statische Funktion: this wird nicht gebraucht"
    if P.derives_from(sdk, hooked, owner):
        return "hooked", 0, f"{owner} ist Elternklasse von {hooked}: this = das gehookte Objekt"
    for m in sdk.all_members(hooked) if hooked in sdk.classes else []:
        t = P.clean_type(m.type)
        if "*" in str(m.type) and t and (t.split()[-1] == owner or P.derives_from(sdk, t.split()[-1], owner)):
            return "member", m.offset, f"this = {hooked}.{m.name} (Zeiger @+{m.offset:#x}); ist er 0, wird der Aufruf uebersprungen"
    return "zero", 0, (f"Keine Instanz von {owner} ueber {hooked} erreichbar - this = 0.  Funktioniert nur, wenn die Funktion "
                       "this nicht benutzt; sonst Absturz moeglich!")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Aufruf-Beschreibung + Maschinencode
# --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
class CallSpec:
    """impl_rva = native Implementierung (RVA); this_mode zero|hooked|member (+this_off); args = Liste von Dicts
    {name, kind, size, signed, value, mode} mit mode 'val' | 'ref'; value: int/float oder 8 Byte (FName)."""

    def __init__(self, impl_rva, args, this_mode="zero", this_off=0, function=""):
        if this_mode not in THIS_MODES:
            raise T.TrainerError(f"this-Modus '{this_mode}' unbekannt")
        self.impl_rva, self.this_mode, self.this_off, self.function = int(impl_rva), this_mode, int(this_off), function
        self.args = [dict(a) for a in args]
        for a in self.args:
            a.setdefault("mode", "val")
            v = a["value"]
            if isinstance(v, str):
                a["value"] = bytes.fromhex(v)
            if a["kind"] == "fname" and (not isinstance(a["value"], (bytes, bytearray)) or len(a["value"]) != 8):
                raise T.TrainerError(f"FName-Parameter '{a['name']}' braucht 8 Byte")

    def to_json(self):
        return {"function": self.function, "impl_rva": hex(self.impl_rva), "this": self.this_mode, "this_off": hex(self.this_off),
                "args": [dict(a, value=a["value"].hex() if isinstance(a["value"], (bytes, bytearray)) else a["value"])
                         for a in self.args]}

    @classmethod
    def from_json(cls, d):
        return cls(int(d["impl_rva"], 16), d["args"], d.get("this", "zero"), int(d.get("this_off", "0"), 16), d.get("function", ""))


def _raw_value(a):
    """Wert -> Bytes in Parametergroesse (Ganzzahl little endian, float/double IEEE)."""
    v, k, sz = a["value"], a["kind"], a["size"]
    if isinstance(v, (bytes, bytearray)):
        return bytes(v)
    if k == "float":
        return struct.pack("<f", float(v))
    if k == "double":
        return struct.pack("<d", float(v))
    iv = int(v)
    if not -(1 << (8 * sz - 1)) <= iv < (1 << (8 * sz)):
        raise T.TrainerError(f"Wert {iv} passt nicht in Parameter '{a['name']}' ({sz} Byte)")
    return (iv & ((1 << (8 * sz)) - 1)).to_bytes(sz, "little")


def emit_call(e, spec, base):
    """Ein kompletter Aufruf: this, Parameter, call.  Benutzt nur rax (Float-Laden) und die Argumentregister; die
    Originalargumente liegen auf dem Stack: [rsp]=rdx, [rsp+8]=rsi, [rsp+16]=rdi (die Cave hat sie gerettet)."""
    skip = None
    if spec.this_mode == "zero":
        e.raw("31FF")                                           # xor edi,edi
    else:
        e.raw("488B7C2410")                                     # mov rdi,[rsp+0x10]   (gehooktes Objekt)
        if spec.this_mode == "member":
            e.raw("488BBF" + struct.pack("<i", spec.this_off).hex())    # mov rdi,[rdi+off]
            e.raw("4885FF")                                     # test rdi,rdi
            skip = e.uniq("skip")
            e.raw("0F84")                                       # jz skip
            e.rel32(skip)
    ireg = freg = 0
    for a in spec.args:
        raw = _raw_value(a)
        k = a["kind"]
        if k in ("float", "double") and a["mode"] == "val":
            if k == "float":
                e.raw("B8" + raw.hex())                         # mov eax,imm32
                e.raw("660F6E" + f"{0xC0 + 8 * freg:02X}")      # movd xmmN,eax
            else:
                e.raw("48B8" + raw.hex())                       # mov rax,imm64
                e.raw("66480F6E" + f"{0xC0 + 8 * freg:02X}")    # movq xmmN,rax
            freg += 1
            continue
        mov32, mov64, lea = INT_REGS[ireg]
        ireg += 1
        if a["mode"] == "ref":
            lab = e.pool(raw.ljust(8, b"\0"))
            e.raw(lea)                                          # lea reg,[rip+pool]
            e.rel32(lab)
        elif a["size"] == 8 or k in ("fname", "ptr"):
            e.raw(mov64 + raw.ljust(8, b"\0").hex())            # movabs reg,imm64
        else:
            iv = int.from_bytes(raw, "little")
            e.raw(mov32 + struct.pack("<I", iv & 0xFFFFFFFF).hex())   # mov reg32,imm32 (Null-Erweiterung)
    e.raw("E8")                                                 # call impl
    e.rel32(base + spec.impl_rva)
    if skip:
        e.label(skip)


class CallRow(T.Row):
    """Eine Trainer-Zeile = ein beliebiger Funktionsaufruf.  fname/amount dienen nur Anzeige und FNAMES PRUEFEN."""

    def __init__(self, alias, spec, fname=None, amount=1):
        self.alias, self.spec, self.amount = alias, spec, max(1, int(amount))
        self.fname = bytes(fname) if fname is not None else None
        self.call_impl_rva = spec.impl_rva

    def emit(self, e, impl, base):
        emit_call(e, self.spec, base)

    def to_json(self):
        return {"alias": self.alias, "fname": self.fname.hex() if self.fname else None, "amount": self.amount,
                "call": self.spec.to_json()}

    @classmethod
    def from_json(cls, d):
        f = d.get("fname")
        return cls(d["alias"], CallSpec.from_json(d["call"]), bytes.fromhex(f) if f else None, d.get("amount", 1))


def build_row(alias, impl_rva, params, ret, sdk, this, id_value=None, count_value=1, extra=None, byref=(), function=""):
    """Eine Zeile aus den SDK-Parametern der Funktion.
      id_value   FName-Bytes (8) oder ID-Zahl fuer den Parameter der Rolle 'id'
      count_value Menge fuer die Rolle 'count'
      extra      {Parametername: Wert} fuer alle uebrigen (Standard 0)
      byref      Namen der Parameter, die per Zeiger uebergeben werden (const T&)
      this       (modus, offset)"""
    check_return(ret)
    cls = classify_params(params, sdk)
    extra = dict(extra or {})
    args, fname, amount = [], None, count_value
    used_id = used_cnt = False
    for a in cls:
        n, k = a["name"], a["kind"]
        if n in extra:
            val = extra[n]
        elif a["role"] == "id" and not used_id and id_value is not None:
            val, used_id = id_value, True
        elif a["role"] == "count" and not used_cnt:
            val, used_cnt = count_value, True
        elif k == "fname":
            raise T.TrainerError(f"Fuer den FName-Parameter '{n}' fehlt der 8-Byte-FName (Tabellenzeile waehlen)")
        else:
            val = 0.0 if k in ("float", "double") else 0
        if k == "fname":
            if not isinstance(val, (bytes, bytearray)) or len(val) != 8:
                raise T.TrainerError(f"Fuer den FName-Parameter '{n}' fehlt der 8-Byte-FName (Tabellenzeile waehlen)")
            if any(val) and fname is None:
                fname = bytes(val)
        mode = "ref" if n in byref else "val"
        args.append({"name": n, "kind": k, "size": a["size"], "signed": a["signed"], "value": val, "mode": mode})
    spec = CallSpec(impl_rva, args, this[0], this[1], function)
    for a in spec.args:                 # Wert-Pruefung jetzt, nicht erst beim Bauen
        _raw_value(a)
    return CallRow(alias, spec, fname, int(amount) if isinstance(amount, (int, float)) and amount >= 1 else 1)


def find_impl(read, base, thunk):
    """Native Implementierung hinter einem Exec-Thunk = letzter Aufruf des Thunks (Stack-Rahmen `push rbp; mov rbp,rsp`)
    -> Adresse oder None (nur Lesen, braucht Capstone)."""
    import asm_tools

    try:
        ins = asm_tools.disassemble_lines(read(thunk, 0x500), thunk, 160)
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return None
    calls = []
    for i in ins:
        if i["mnemonic"] == "call" and i["op_str"].startswith("0x"):
            t = int(i["op_str"], 16)
            if t != thunk and base <= t < base + 0x2000_0000 and t not in calls:
                calls.append(t)
        if i["mnemonic"].startswith("ret"):
            break
    if not calls:
        return None
    try:
        return calls[-1] if read(calls[-1], 4) == b"\x55\x48\x89\xE5" else None
    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001
        return None
```

`ue_hook.py`:

```py
"""ue_hook.py - ProcessEvent-Haken im vtable (Slots finden); gemeinsam fuer Cave-Trainer und Entdecker.  Nur Lesen."""
import struct


def find_slots(read, objs, pe_index, pe_addr):
    """vtable-Slots von ProcessEvent der Objekte `objs` -> (slots, notizen).  Nur Slots, die wirklich auf `pe_addr`
    zeigen (sonst waere die Hoehle fuer sie das falsche `orig`).  Jeder vtable nur einmal."""
    slots, notes, seen = [], [], set()
    for obj in objs:
        try:
            vt = struct.unpack("<Q", read(obj, 8))[0]
            if vt < 0x10000 or vt in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(vt)
            slot = vt + 8 * pe_index
            val = struct.unpack("<Q", read(slot, 8))[0]
        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001
            notes.append(f"{obj:#x}: vtable nicht lesbar ({e})")
            continue
        if val == pe_addr:
            slots.append(slot)
        else:
            notes.append(f"vtable {vt:#x}: Slot {pe_index} zeigt auf {val:#x}, nicht auf ProcessEvent - ausgelassen")
    return slots, notes

```

`ue_instr.py`:

```py
"""ue_instr.py - findet im Spiel-Dump (Dump.bin) die Instruktionen, die einen SDK-Member lesen/schreiben,
und baut daraus Patches (NOP / "nur erhoehen"-Cave) im ReaperPy-Format.

Ablauf
  1. Byte-Suche nach dem 32-Bit-Displacement jedes gesuchten Offsets (schnell, ohne den ganzen Dump
     zu disassemblieren)
  2. je Treffer die Funktion bestimmen (Heuristik: 16-Byte-Grenze hinter CC/C3) und linear
     disassemblieren; nur Instruktionen mit passendem [reg+offset] zaehlen
  3. Ranking: schreibt die Instruktion? stehen in derselben Funktion weitere Member derselben Klasse
     (-> es ist wirklich Code dieser Klasse)? steht ein SUB davor (Schaden)? ist der Offset ueberall
     im Spiel (mehrdeutig)?

Disassembler: Capstone (pip install capstone) - Ausweichloesung `objdump`, falls Capstone fehlt.
Offsets im Dump sind Dateipositionen; RVA = Position + dump_rva.  Patches enthalten RVAs
(= Offset relativ zur Modul-Basis, wie in .reapproj ueblich).
"""
import math
import os
import re
import shutil
import struct
import subprocess
import tempfile
from dataclasses import dataclass, field

import aob as AOB

_BRANCH = re.compile(r"^(j\w+|call|loop\w*|ret\w*|syscall|int3?)$")
_WRITE_PREFIX = ("mov", "vmov", "add", "sub", "adc", "sbb", "and", "or", "xor", "inc", "dec", "neg", "not", "shl",
                 "shr", "sar", "rol", "ror", "bts", "btr", "btc", "xchg", "xadd", "cmpxchg", "set", "pop", "stos")
_WRITE_EXCL = ("movsx", "movzx", "movsxd", "movmsk", "movsb", "movsw", "movsq", "movsl")   # Reg-Ziel / String-Ops


@dataclass
class Mem:
    base: str = None
    index: str = None
    scale: int = 1
    disp: int = 0


@dataclass
class Insn:
    addr: int
    size: int
    raw: bytes
    mnem: str
    ops: str
    mem: Mem = None
    reads: bool = False
    writes: bool = False
    wild: list = field(default_factory=list)      # [(offset_in_insn, laenge)] - Adressen/Displacements

    @property
    def branch(self):
        return bool(_BRANCH.match(self.mnem))

    @property
    def text(self):
        return f"{self.mnem} {self.ops}".strip()


def split_ops(ops):
    """'dword ptr [rbx + 0x8], xmm0' -> ['dword ptr [rbx + 0x8]', 'xmm0'] (Komma in [] ignorieren)."""
    out, depth, cur = [], 0, ""
    for ch in ops:
        if ch == "[":
            depth += 1
        elif ch == "]":
            depth -= 1
        if ch == "," and depth == 0:
            out.append(cur.strip()); cur = ""
        else:
            cur += ch
    if cur.strip():
        out.append(cur.strip())
    return out


# ==================================================================
# Backend 1: Capstone
# ==================================================================
class CapstoneDisasm:
    name = "capstone"

    def __init__(self):
        import capstone as cs
        self.cs = cs
        self.md = cs.Cs(cs.CS_ARCH_X86, cs.CS_MODE_64)
        self.md.detail = True

    def sweep(self, buf, off, length, addr):
        return [self._conv(i) for i in self.md.disasm(bytes(buf[off:off + length]), addr)]

    def _conv(self, i):
        cs = self.cs
        mem, reads, writes = None, False, False
        for op in i.operands:
            if op.type == cs.x86.X86_OP_MEM:
                reg = lambda r: i.reg_name(r) if r else None
                mem = Mem(reg(op.mem.base), reg(op.mem.index), op.mem.scale, op.mem.disp)
                if op.access & cs.CS_AC_READ:
                    reads = True
                if op.access & cs.CS_AC_WRITE:
                    writes = True
        wild = []
        try:
            is_jump = i.group(cs.CS_GRP_JUMP) or i.group(cs.CS_GRP_CALL)
            if i.disp_size == 4 and mem and mem.base == "rip":
                wild.append((i.disp_offset, 4))
            elif i.imm_size == 4 and is_jump:
                wild.append((i.imm_offset, 4))
            elif i.disp_size == 4 and not is_jump:
                wild.append((i.disp_offset, 4))
        except Exception:
            pass
        return Insn(i.address, i.size, bytes(i.bytes), i.mnemonic, i.op_str, mem, reads, writes, wild)


# ==================================================================
# Backend 2: objdump (Linux/Binutils) - Ausweichloesung und Test
# ==================================================================
_OBJ_LINE = re.compile(r"^\s*([0-9a-f]+):\t((?:[0-9a-f]{2} ?)+)\s*(?:\t(.*))?$")
_MEMRE = re.compile(r"\[([^\]]+)\]")


def _parse_mem(inner):
    m = Mem()
    for sign, tok in re.findall(r"([+-]?)\s*([A-Za-z0-9_*]+)", inner):
        neg = sign == "-"
        if re.fullmatch(r"0x[0-9a-fA-F]+|\d+", tok):
            v = int(tok, 0)
            m.disp += -v if neg else v
        elif "*" in tok:
            r, s = tok.split("*")
            m.index, m.scale = r.lower(), int(s)
        elif m.base is None:
            m.base = tok.lower()
        else:
            m.index = tok.lower()
    return m


class ObjdumpDisasm:
    name = "objdump"

    def __init__(self):
        if not shutil.which("objdump"):
            raise RuntimeError("objdump nicht gefunden")

    def sweep(self, buf, off, length, addr):
        data = bytes(buf[off:off + length])
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as d:
            p = os.path.join(d, "x.bin")
            with open(p, "wb") as f:
                f.write(data)
            r = subprocess.run(["objdump", "-D", "-b", "binary", "-mi386:x86-64", "-M", "intel",
                                f"--adjust-vma={addr:#x}", p], capture_output=True, text=True)
        out = []
        for line in r.stdout.splitlines():
            m = _OBJ_LINE.match(line)
            if not m:
                continue
            a, hx, txt = int(m.group(1), 16), bytes.fromhex(m.group(2).replace(" ", "")), m.group(3)
            if txt is None:                                  # Fortsetzungszeile langer Befehle
                if out:
                    out[-1].raw += hx; out[-1].size += len(hx)
                continue
            if "(bad)" in txt:
                break
            txt = txt.split("#")[0].strip()
            parts = txt.split(None, 1)
            mnem, ops = parts[0].lower(), (parts[1] if len(parts) > 1 else "").lower()
            if mnem in ("rep", "repz", "repnz", "lock", "bnd", "notrack", "data16") and ops:
                p2 = ops.split(None, 1)
                mnem, ops = p2[0], (p2[1] if len(p2) > 1 else "")
            out.append(Insn(a, len(hx), hx, mnem, ops))
        for i in out:
            self._fill(i)
        return out

    @staticmethod
    def _fill(i):
        mm = _MEMRE.search(i.ops)
        parts = split_ops(i.ops)
        if mm:
            i.mem = _parse_mem(mm.group(1))
            dest_mem = bool(parts) and "[" in parts[0]
            m = i.mnem
            writes = dest_mem and m.startswith(_WRITE_PREFIX) and not m.startswith(_WRITE_EXCL) \
                and not m.startswith(("cmp", "test", "bt "))
            if m.startswith(("sub", "add", "mul", "div")) and m[-2:] in ("ss", "sd") and not dest_mem:
                writes = False
            i.writes = bool(writes)
            i.reads = (not dest_mem) or m.startswith(("add", "sub", "adc", "sbb", "and", "or", "xor", "inc",
                                                      "dec", "neg", "not", "xchg", "xadd", "cmp", "test", "shl",
                                                      "shr", "sar"))
        # Wildcards (Naeherung): rel32 bei Spruengen, disp32 bei Speicheroperanden
        raw = i.raw
        if i.branch and len(raw) >= 5 and raw[0] in (0xE8, 0xE9):
            i.wild = [(1, 4)]
        elif i.branch and len(raw) >= 6 and raw[0] == 0x0F and 0x80 <= raw[1] <= 0x8F:
            i.wild = [(2, 4)]
        elif i.mem and (i.mem.disp > 0x7F or i.mem.disp < -0x80 or i.mem.base == "rip"):
            pos = raw.find(struct.pack("<i", i.mem.disp))
            if pos >= 0:
                i.wild = [(pos, 4)]


def get_disasm(prefer=None):
    errs = []
    for cls in ((ObjdumpDisasm, CapstoneDisasm) if prefer == "objdump" else (CapstoneDisasm, ObjdumpDisasm)):
        try:
            return cls()
        except Exception as e:
            errs.append(f"{cls.name}: {e}")
    raise RuntimeError("Kein Disassembler: pip install capstone  (" + "; ".join(errs) + ")")


# ==================================================================
# Scan
# ==================================================================
def byte_hits(dump, offsets, min_disp=0x80, lo=0, hi=None):
    """{offset: [dateipositionen des 32-Bit-Displacements]} - nur im Bereich [lo, hi)"""
    res = {}
    hi = len(dump) if hi is None else hi
    for o in offsets:
        if o < min_disp or o > 0x7FFFFFFF:
            continue
        pat, pos, lst = struct.pack("<I", o), lo, []
        while True:
            pos = dump.find(pat, pos, hi)
            if pos < 0:
                break
            lst.append(pos); pos += 1
        res[o] = lst
    return res


def _boundary(dump, q):
    if q <= 0 or q >= len(dump):
        return False
    prev = dump[q - 1]
    if dump[q] == 0xCC:
        return False
    if prev in (0xCC, 0xC3):
        return True
    if prev == 0x90:                                    # NOP-Auffuellung hinter CC/C3
        k = q - 1
        while k > q - 16 and dump[k] == 0x90:
            k -= 1
        return dump[k] in (0xCC, 0xC3)
    return False


def function_starts(dump, pos, max_back=0x4000, limit=4, floor=1):
    """Kandidaten fuer den Funktionsanfang vor `pos`, nahe zuerst."""
    q, lo, n = pos & ~0xF, max(floor, pos - max_back), 0
    while q >= lo and n < limit:
        if _boundary(dump, q):
            yield q
            n += 1
        q -= 16


def sweep_function(dis, dump, f, base, max_len=0x3000, hi=None):
    if hi is not None:
        max_len = max(0, min(max_len, hi - f))
    ins = dis.sweep(dump, f, max_len, base + f)
    out = []
    for k, i in enumerate(ins):
        out.append(i)
        end = i.addr - base + i.size
        if i.mnem.startswith("ret") and end < len(dump) and dump[end] == 0xCC:
            break
        if i.mnem == "jmp" and not i.mem and end < len(dump) and dump[end] == 0xCC and (end % 16 == 0 or dump[end:end + 1] == b"\xcc"):
            break
    return out


def write_kind(i):
    m = i.mnem
    if m.startswith(("mov", "vmov")):
        return "store"
    if m in ("sub", "dec", "neg", "sbb"):
        return "dec"
    if m in ("add", "inc", "adc"):
        return "inc"
    if m in ("xchg", "xadd", "cmpxchg"):
        return "atomic"
    return "rmw"


@dataclass
class Hit:
    addr: int                    # virtuelle Adresse (base_va + Position)
    pos: int                     # Position im Dump
    rva: int
    func_pos: int
    ins: Insn
    offset: int
    kind: str
    writes: bool
    reads: bool
    coaccess: int = 0
    dec_hint: bool = False
    ambiguity: int = 0           # in wie vielen Funktionen wird dieser Offset geschrieben
    score: float = 0.0
    tags: list = field(default_factory=list)       # z.B. ["UHealthComponent.Health"]
    stolen: list = field(default_factory=list)     # Folge-Instruktionen im 8-Byte-Hook-Bereich


def scan(dump, targets, dis, class_offsets=None, base_va=0, dump_rva=0, include_reads=False,
         min_disp=0x80, progress=None, max_positions=200000, code_range=None):
    """targets: {offset: [tag, ...]} ; class_offsets: Offsets weiterer Member derselben Klassen
    (fuer die Ko-Zugriffs-Wertung).  -> [Hit] (absteigend nach Score)."""
    class_offsets = set(class_offsets or ()) | set(targets)
    want = {o for o in class_offsets if o >= min_disp}
    lo, hi = code_range if code_range else (0, len(dump))
    hits_by_off = byte_hits(dump, want, min_disp, lo, hi)
    funcs, total = {}, sum(len(v) for v in hits_by_off.values())
    if total > max_positions:
        raise RuntimeError(f"{total} Byte-Treffer - Offsets zu unspezifisch (Dump zu gross oder Liste zu lang)")
    done = 0
    sweeps = {}                                           # func_pos -> [Insn]
    pos_func = {}
    for o, plist in hits_by_off.items():
        for p in plist:
            done += 1
            if progress and done % 2000 == 0:
                progress(done, total)
            if p in pos_func:
                continue
            for f in function_starts(dump, p, floor=max(1, lo + 1)):
                if f not in sweeps:
                    sweeps[f] = sweep_function(dis, dump, f, base_va, hi=hi)
                if any(i.addr - base_va <= p < i.addr - base_va + i.size and i.mem and i.mem.disp in want
                       for i in sweeps[f]):
                    pos_func[p] = f
                    break
    touch, hits, seen = {}, [], set()
    for f, insns in sweeps.items():
        offs = set()
        for i in insns:
            if i.mem and i.mem.disp in want and i.mem.base not in (None, "rip", "rsp") and i.mem.disp > 0:
                offs.add(i.mem.disp)
        touch[f] = offs
    for f, insns in sweeps.items():
        for k, i in enumerate(insns):
            if not i.mem or i.mem.disp not in targets or i.mem.base in (None, "rip", "rsp") or i.mem.disp <= 0:
                continue
            if not (i.writes or (include_reads and i.reads)):
                continue
            pos = i.addr - base_va
            key = (pos, i.mem.disp)
            if key in seen:
                continue
            seen.add(key)
            h = Hit(i.addr, pos, pos + dump_rva, f, i, i.mem.disp, write_kind(i) if i.writes else "read",
                    i.writes, i.reads, tags=list(targets[i.mem.disp]))
            h.coaccess = len(touch.get(f, set()) - {i.mem.disp})
            if i.writes and i.mnem.startswith(("mov", "vmov")):
                for prev in insns[max(0, k - 12):k]:
                    if prev.mnem.startswith("sub") or prev.mnem in ("dec", "neg"):
                        h.dec_hint = True
                        break
            tot, n = 0, 0
            for j in insns[k:k + 6]:
                tot += j.size
                n += 1
                if tot >= 8:
                    break
            h.stolen = list(insns[k + 1:k + n])
            hits.append(h)
    amb = {}
    for h in hits:
        if h.writes:
            amb.setdefault(h.offset, set()).add(h.func_pos)
    for h in hits:
        h.ambiguity = len(amb.get(h.offset, ()))
        h.score = score_hit(h)
    hits.sort(key=lambda h: -h.score)
    return hits


def score_hit(h):
    s = 0.0
    if h.writes:
        s += 3
    s += min(h.coaccess, 8) * 1.5
    if h.dec_hint:
        s += 4
    if h.kind == "dec":
        s += 3
    if h.ambiguity > 12:
        s -= min(8.0, math.log2(h.ambiguity / 12.0) * 3)
    if h.ins.size < 5:
        s -= 1
    return round(s, 2)


# ==================================================================
# Signatur + Patch-Bau
# ==================================================================
def make_aob(dump, dis, h, base_va=0, hook_len=8, min_len=12, max_len=96, code_range=None):
    return make_aob_at(dump, dis, h.pos, h.addr, hook_len, min_len, max_len, code_range)


def make_aob_at(dump, dis, pos, addr, hook_len=8, min_len=12, max_len=96, code_range=None):
    """Muster im ReaperPy-Stil: hook_len Wildcards, dann Folge-Bytes (Displacements/Spruenge als ??),
    muss im Dump (Code-Bereich) eindeutig sein.  -> (text|None, treffer)"""
    lo, hi = code_range if code_range else (0, len(dump))
    ins = dis.sweep(dump, pos, hook_len + max_len + 16, addr)
    flags = bytearray()
    raw = bytearray()
    for i in ins:
        f = bytearray(i.size)
        for o, n in i.wild:
            for k in range(o, min(o + n, i.size)):
                f[k] = 1
        raw += i.raw; flags += f
    if len(raw) <= hook_len + min_len:
        return None, 0
    tail, tflags = bytes(raw[hook_len:]), bytes(flags[hook_len:])
    last = 0
    for n in range(min_len, len(tail) + 1, 4):
        body = tail[:n]
        mask = bytes(0 if tflags[k] else 1 for k in range(n))
        if sum(mask) < 6:
            continue
        pat = b"\x00" * hook_len + body
        m = b"\x00" * hook_len + mask
        rx = AOB._regex(pat, m)
        found = _all_matches(rx, dump, limit=3, lo=lo, hi=hi)
        last = len(found)
        if len(found) == 1 and found[0] == pos:
            return AOB.format_pattern(pat, m), 1
        if len(found) == 0:
            return None, 0
    return None, last


def _all_matches(rx, dump, limit=3, lo=0, hi=None):
    res, pos = [], lo
    hi = len(dump) if hi is None else hi
    while len(res) < limit:
        m = rx.search(dump, pos, hi)
        if not m:
            break
        res.append(m.start()); pos = m.start() + 1
    return res


def _spaced(b):
    return " ".join(f"{x:02X}" for x in b)


def _src_dest(ins):
    p = split_ops(ins.ops)
    return (p[0], p[1]) if len(p) == 2 else (None, None)


def can_cave(h):
    """Kann fuer den Treffer eine 'nur erhoehen'-Cave gebaut werden? -> (ok, grund)"""
    i = h.ins
    if i.size < 5:
        return False, "Instruktion kürzer als 5 Byte"
    dest, src = _src_dest(i)
    if not dest or "[" not in dest:
        return False, "kein einfacher Store"
    is_xmm = src.startswith("xmm") and i.mnem in ("movss", "movsd")
    is_gpr = i.mnem == "mov" and re.fullmatch(r"(e[a-ds][xip]|r(?:[a-ds][xip]|\d+[dwb]?)|[a-ds][xil]|e?[sd]i|r[sd]i)", src or "")
    if not (is_xmm or is_gpr):
        return False, "Quelle ist weder xmm noch Register"
    if i.mem.base == "rip":
        return False, "RIP-relativ"
    total = i.size + sum(j.size for j in h.stolen)
    if total < 8:
        return False, "Folge-Instruktionen fehlen für den 8-Byte-Hook"
    for j in h.stolen:
        if j.branch or (j.mem and j.mem.base == "rip"):
            return False, f"Folge-Instruktion '{j.text}' ist nicht verschiebbar"
    return True, ""


def nop_patch(dump, h, aob_text=None, name=None, author=""):
    i = h.ins
    name = name or f"{'+'.join(h.tags) or hex(h.offset)} - Schreiben aus ({i.text})"
    v = {"label": "OriginSource", "offset": hex(h.rva), "defaultValue": _spaced(dump[h.pos:h.pos + i.size]),
         "newValue": _spaced(b"\x90" * i.size)}
    if aob_text:
        v["aob"], v["aobOffset"] = aob_text, 0
    return {"name": name, "author": author, "Variables": [v]}


def keep_cave_patch(dump, h, aob_text=None, name=None, author=""):
    """'Wert kann nicht sinken': Store nur ausfuehren, wenn der neue Wert >= alter Wert."""
    ok, why = can_cave(h)
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(why)
    i = h.ins
    dest, src = _src_dest(i)
    if i.mnem in ("movss", "movsd"):
        cmp_ = "comiss" if i.mnem == "movss" else "comisd"
        lines = [f"{cmp_} {src}, {dest}", "jb NoDecreaseSkip", f"{i.mnem} {dest}, {src}"]
    else:
        lines = [f"cmp {dest}, {src}", "jg NoDecreaseSkip", f"mov {dest}, {src}"]
    lines.append("NoDecreaseSkip:")
    lines += [j.text for j in h.stolen]
    lines.append("jmp OriginReturn")
    total = i.size + sum(j.size for j in h.stolen)
    name = name or f"{'+'.join(h.tags) or hex(h.offset)} - kann nicht sinken ({i.text})"
    first8 = dump[h.pos:h.pos + 8]
    src_v = {"label": "OriginSource", "offset": hex(h.rva), "defaultValue": _spaced(first8),
             "newValue": "jmp OriginTarget"}
    if aob_text:
        src_v["aob"], src_v["aobOffset"] = aob_text, 0
    return {"name": name, "author": author, "Variables": [
        src_v,
        {"label": "OriginReturn", "offset": hex(total), "defaultValue": "", "newValue": ""},
        {"label": "OriginTarget", "offset": "0x0", "defaultValue": "\n".join(lines), "newValue": ""}]}


_SIZE_WORDS = {"byte": 1, "word": 2, "dword": 4, "qword": 8}
_PTR_PREFIX = re.compile(r"^\s*(byte|word|dword|qword)\s+ptr\s+", re.I)
_FORCE_MNEM = ("mov", "add", "sub", "adc", "sbb", "and", "or", "xor", "inc", "dec", "neg", "not", "movss", "movsd")


def store_operand(h):
    """Speicher-Ziel der schreibenden Instruktion als (Text ohne Groessen-Praefix, Groesse in Byte) oder (None, 0)."""
    i = h.ins
    ops = split_ops(i.ops)
    if not ops or "[" not in ops[0] or ":" in ops[0].split("[")[0]:      # kein Segment-/String-Ziel
        return None, 0
    m = _PTR_PREFIX.match(ops[0])
    if not m:
        return None, 0
    return ops[0][m.end():].strip(), _SIZE_WORDS[m.group(1).lower()]


def can_force(h):
    """Kann hinter dem Schreibzugriff ein fester Wert in dasselbe Ziel geschrieben werden? -> (ok, grund, groesse)"""
    i = h.ins
    if not i.writes:
        return False, "die Instruktion schreibt nicht", 0
    if i.mnem not in _FORCE_MNEM:
        return False, f"'{i.mnem}' wird nicht unterstützt", 0
    if i.size < 5:
        return False, "Instruktion kürzer als 5 Byte", 0
    if i.mem is None or i.mem.base in (None, "rip"):
        return False, "RIP-relativ oder ohne Basisregister", 0
    dest, size = store_operand(h)
    if dest is None:
        return False, "Ziel ist kein einfacher Speicher-Operand mit Größenangabe", 0
    if i.mnem.startswith("mov") and i.mnem in ("movss", "movsd") and size not in (4, 8):
        return False, "Ziel hat keine 4/8 Byte", 0
    total = i.size + sum(j.size for j in h.stolen)
    if total < 8:
        return False, "Folge-Instruktionen fehlen für den 8-Byte-Hook", 0
    for j in h.stolen:
        if j.branch or (j.mem and j.mem.base == "rip"):
            return False, f"Folge-Instruktion '{j.text}' ist nicht verschiebbar", 0
    return True, "", size


def force_cave_patch(dump, h, bits, aob_text=None, name=None, author=""):
    """'Wert festschreiben': die Original-Instruktion laeuft, danach wird `bits` (Rohbits, Groesse = Store-Groesse) in
    dasselbe Ziel geschrieben.  Fuer Zahlen und Schalter; fuer 8-Byte-Ziele muss der Wert als vorzeichenerweiterter
    32-Bit-Wert passen."""
    ok, why, size = can_force(h)
    if not ok:
        raise ValueError(why)
    if not 0 <= bits < (1 << (8 * size)):
        raise ValueError(f"Wert passt nicht in {size} Byte")
    imm = bits
    if size == 8:
        if bits >= 1 << 63:
            bits -= 1 << 64
        if not -(1 << 31) <= bits < (1 << 31):
            raise ValueError("Wert passt nicht in einen 32-Bit-Direktwert (8-Byte-Ziel)")
        imm = bits
    i = h.ins
    dest, _ = store_operand(h)
    word = {1: "byte", 2: "word", 4: "dword", 8: "qword"}[size]
    lines = [i.text, f"mov {word} ptr {dest}, {imm:#x}" if imm >= 0 else f"mov {word} ptr {dest}, -{-imm:#x}"]
    lines += [j.text for j in h.stolen]
    lines.append("jmp OriginReturn")
    total = i.size + sum(j.size for j in h.stolen)
    name = name or f"{'+'.join(h.tags) or hex(h.offset)} - Wert festgeschrieben ({i.text})"
    src_v = {"label": "OriginSource", "offset": hex(h.rva), "defaultValue": _spaced(dump[h.pos:h.pos + 8]),
             "newValue": "jmp OriginTarget"}
    if aob_text:
        src_v["aob"], src_v["aobOffset"] = aob_text, 0
    return {"name": name, "author": author, "Variables": [
        src_v,
        {"label": "OriginReturn", "offset": hex(total), "defaultValue": "", "newValue": ""},
        {"label": "OriginTarget", "offset": "0x0", "defaultValue": "\n".join(lines), "newValue": ""}]}


# ==================================================================
# Funktionen: sofort zurueckkehren / Implementierung hinter dem Exec-Thunk finden
# ==================================================================
RET_MODES = {
    "ret":    (b"\xC3", "Funktion sofort beenden (void)"),
    "false":  (b"\x31\xC0\xC3", "gibt 0 / false zurück"),
    "true":   (b"\xB0\x01\xC3", "gibt true zurück"),
    "one":    (b"\xB8\x01\x00\x00\x00\xC3", "gibt 1 zurück"),
    "float0": (b"\x0F\x57\xC0\xC3", "gibt 0.0 (float/double) zurück"),
}


def func_ret_patch(dump, pos, rva, mode, name, aob_text=None, author=""):
    """Patch, der eine Funktion am Anfang sofort zurueckkehren laesst (Werte werden nie veraendert)."""
    new, desc = RET_MODES[mode]
    v = {"label": "OriginSource", "offset": hex(rva), "defaultValue": _spaced(dump[pos:pos + len(new)]),
         "newValue": _spaced(new)}
    if aob_text:
        v["aob"], v["aobOffset"] = aob_text, 0
    return {"name": f"{name} - {desc}", "author": author, "Variables": [v]}


def branch_targets(insns):
    """Direkte CALL/JMP-rel32-Ziele einer Instruktionsliste -> [(art, ziel, adresse)]"""
    out = []
    for i in insns:
        if len(i.raw) == 5 and i.raw[0] in (0xE8, 0xE9):
            rel = struct.unpack("<i", i.raw[1:5])[0]
            out.append(("call" if i.raw[0] == 0xE8 else "jmp", i.addr + 5 + rel, i.addr))
        elif len(i.raw) == 2 and i.raw[0] == 0xEB:                   # kurzer JMP (nahes Tail-Ziel)
            out.append(("jmp", i.addr + 2 + struct.unpack("<b", i.raw[1:2])[0], i.addr))
    return out


def _thunk_insns(dis, dump, pos, base_va, hi, max_len=0x400):
    ins = dis.sweep(dump, pos, min(max_len, max(0, hi - pos)), base_va + pos)
    out = []
```
