```py
          text='Erkennt Kandidaten für Gesundheit/Survival, Geld, Waffen/Munition, Inventar/Items, Bewegung, Debug-/Cheat-Menüs, Progress/Unlocks, Welt/AI, Fahrzeuge und sonstige Systeme. Reine Bau-/Herstellungskosten werden herausgefiltert. Treffer sind statische Hinweise, keine bestätigten Cheats.')
        bottom.pack(fill='x',padx=8,pady=(0,8),ipady=5)

    def pick_folder(self):
        p=filedialog.askdirectory(title='Unreal Dump / SDK-Ordner auswählen')
        if p:self.path.set(p)
    def pick_zip(self):
        p=filedialog.askopenfilename(title='Dump-/SDK-ZIP auswählen',filetypes=[('ZIP','*.zip'),('Alle Dateien','*.*')])
        if p:self.path.set(p)
    def scan(self):
        p=self.path.get().strip()
        if not p:return messagebox.showinfo('Universal Analyzer','Bitte zuerst Ordner oder ZIP auswählen.')
        if self.scanning:return
        self.scanning=True; self.cancel_event=threading.Event(); self.status.set('Scan läuft bzw. setzt vorhandenen Checkpoint fort …')
        self.progress['value']=0
        for x in self.tbl.get_children():self.tbl.delete(x)
        def progress(done,total,current):
            pct=(done/total*100) if total else 0
            self.after(0,lambda d=done,t=total,f=current,v=pct:self._progress(d,t,f,v))
        def job():
            try:r=analyze_dump(p,progress_callback=progress,cancel_event=self.cancel_event,resume=True); err=None
            except Exception as e:r=None;err=str(e)
            self.after(0,lambda:self._finish(r,err))
        threading.Thread(target=job,daemon=True).start()
    def _progress(self,done,total,current,pct):
        self.progress['value']=pct
        self.status.set(f'Scan: {done}/{total} Dateien ({pct:.1f} %) — {os.path.basename(current)}')
    def cancel_scan(self):
        if self.cancel_event and self.scanning:
            self.cancel_event.set(); self.status.set('Abbruch angefordert — Checkpoint wird gespeichert …')
    def restart_scan(self):
        if self.scanning:return messagebox.showinfo('Scan','Bitte laufenden Scan erst abbrechen.')
        p=self.path.get().strip()
        if not p:return messagebox.showinfo('Scan','Bitte zuerst Ordner oder ZIP auswählen.')
        if not messagebox.askyesno('Neu scannen','Vorhandenen Checkpoint für diese Quelle löschen und von vorn beginnen?'):return
        try:
            cp=default_checkpoint_path(p)
            if os.path.exists(cp):os.remove(cp)
            self.status.set('Checkpoint gelöscht. Nächster Scan startet von vorn.')
            self.progress['value']=0
        except Exception as e:messagebox.showerror('Checkpoint',str(e))
    def _finish(self,r,err):
        self.scanning=False
        if err:self.status.set('Fehler: '+err);return
        self.report=r
        for h in r['candidates'][:5000]:
            self.tbl.insert('', 'end', values=(h['score'],h.get('status','candidate'),h['category'],h['kind'],h.get('class_context') or '—',h['file'],h['line'],h['symbol']))
        if r.get('partial'):
            self.status.set(f"Teilscan gespeichert: {r['files_scanned']}/{r.get('total_files', '?')} Dateien | {r['candidate_count']} Treffer — SCAN / FORTSETZEN setzt fort.")
            return
        self.progress['value']=100
        self.status.set(f"Fertig: {r['files_scanned']} Dateien | {r['class_struct_lines']} Klassen-/Struct-Zeilen | {r['function_like_lines']} Funktionskandidaten | {r['candidate_count']} Treffer | {len(r.get('class_summary', []))} Klassenprofile (Anzeige max. 5.000).")
    def save_json(self):
        if not self.report:return messagebox.showinfo('Export','Bitte zuerst scannen.')
        p=filedialog.asksaveasfilename(defaultextension='.json',filetypes=[('JSON','*.json')])
        if p:
            try:export_report(self.report,p);messagebox.showinfo('Export','JSON-Bericht gespeichert.')
            except Exception as e:messagebox.showerror('Export',str(e))
    def save_csv(self):
        if not self.report:return messagebox.showinfo('Export','Bitte zuerst scannen.')
        p=filedialog.asksaveasfilename(defaultextension='.csv',filetypes=[('CSV','*.csv')])
        if p:
            try:export_csv(self.report,p);messagebox.showinfo('Export','CSV-Bericht gespeichert.')
            except Exception as e:messagebox.showerror('Export',str(e))
```

`unreal_profiles.py`:

```py
"""Evidence-based Unreal capability and item-definition profile builder.

This module intentionally performs static classification only. It does not modify game memory.
"""
from __future__ import annotations
import re
from collections import defaultdict

CAPABILITY_RULES = {
    'health_survival': (r'health|\bhp\b|stamina|hunger|thirst|oxygen|breath|survival|invulnerab|god.?mode|heal|revive', r'health|stamina|hunger|thirst|oxygen|damage|heal|revive|god'),
    'currency_economy': (r'money|currency|gold|coin|cash|credit|wallet|bank|funds|economy|price', r'money|currency|gold|coin|cash|credit|wallet|balance|funds|economy'),
    'weapons_ammo': (r'weapon|firearm|ammo|ammunition|bullet|magazine|reload|projectile|recoil|fire.?rate', r'weapon|ammo|bullet|magazine|reload|projectile|attack|damage'),
    'inventory_items': (r'inventory|item|slot|backpack|container|quick.?bar|loot|pickup|stack|FName|FString|FText', r'item|inventory|slot|container|loot|pickup|stack|give|grant|add'),
    'debug_console': (r'debug|cheat|console|developer|admin|exec|test.?menu|cheatmanager', r'debug|cheat|console|developer|admin|exec|menu|command'),
    'movement_traversal': (r'movement|walk.?speed|run.?speed|jump|fly|teleport|gravity|sprint|noclip|playerpawn', r'move|speed|jump|fly|teleport|gravity|sprint|noclip'),
    'progress_unlocks': (r'experience|\bxp\b|level|skill.?point|talent|perk|unlock|achievement|quest|mission|reputation', r'experience|level|skill|talent|perk|unlock|achievement|quest|mission'),
    'world_ai_spawn': (r'world|weather|time.?of.?day|spawn|npc|enemy|creature|ai.?controller|loot.?table', r'world|weather|time|spawn|npc|enemy|creature|ai|loot'),
    'equipment_vehicles': (r'equipment|armor|armour|gear|durability|vehicle|mount|fuel|attachment', r'equipment|armor|gear|durability|vehicle|mount|fuel|attachment'),
    'save_settings_misc': (r'savegame|save.?game|profile|setting|cooldown|timer|weight|carry.?capacity|craft.?speed', r'save|profile|setting|cooldown|timer|weight|capacity'),
}
ITEM_CLASS = re.compile(r'(?:^|\b)(?:U|A|F)?(?:.*(?:Item|Inventory|Loot|Pickup|Equipment|Weapon|Consumable|ItemData|ItemDefinition|ItemSlot|ItemStack).*)$', re.I)
ITEM_NAME = re.compile(r'item|loot|pickup|inventory|slot|stack|equipment|weapon|consumable|itemdata|itemdefinition', re.I)
NOT_ITEM = re.compile(r'widget|blueprint.?library|recipe|craft|building|construction|material.?cost|build.?cost|quest.?objective|tooltip|icon|thumbnail|scrolllist|button|entry.?widget', re.I)
ACTION = re.compile(r'add|give|grant|spawn|create|insert|push|equip|pickup|drop|remove|consume|set|unlock|open|execute|cheat|debug|teleport|heal|revive|restore|refill', re.I)

def build_capability_profiles(hits):
    """Group evidence by class and infer possible capabilities without claiming validation."""
    grouped = defaultdict(lambda: {'evidence': [], 'categories': set(), 'files': set(), 'functions': [], 'properties': [], 'scores': []})
    for hit in hits:
        cls = hit.get('class_context')
        if not cls:
            continue
        row = grouped[cls]
        row['evidence'].append(hit)
        row['categories'].update(x.strip() for x in (hit.get('category') or '').split(';') if x.strip())
        if hit.get('file'): row['files'].add(hit['file'])
        if hit.get('kind') == 'Function candidate' and hit.get('function_signature'): row['functions'].append(hit['function_signature'])
        if hit.get('kind') == 'Property / data candidate': row['properties'].append(hit.get('symbol'))
        row['scores'].append(int(hit.get('score') or 0))
    profiles=[]
    for cls, row in grouped.items():
        joined = ' '.join([cls] + row['functions'] + row['properties'] + [h.get('evidence','') for h in row['evidence']]).lower()
        capabilities=[]
        for name,(class_pat,signal_pat) in CAPABILITY_RULES.items():
            if re.search(class_pat, cls, re.I) or re.search(signal_pat, joined, re.I):
                capabilities.append(name)
        actionable = [f for f in row['functions'] if ACTION.search(f)]
        profiles.append({'class_name':cls,'capabilities':capabilities,'evidence_count':len(row['evidence']),
          'function_candidates':list(dict.fromkeys(row['functions']))[:100],
          'action_like_functions':list(dict.fromkeys(actionable))[:50],
          'property_candidates':list(dict.fromkeys(x for x in row['properties'] if x))[:100],
          'source_files':sorted(row['files']),'max_static_score':max(row['scores'] or [0]),
          'validation_status':'unvalidated_static_profile'})
    return sorted(profiles,key=lambda p:(-len(p['action_like_functions']),-p['evidence_count'],p['class_name'].lower()))

def build_item_catalog(hits):
    """Rank item-definition and inventory plumbing candidates; separate UI/recipe noise."""
    groups=defaultdict(lambda:{'evidence':[],'functions':[],'properties':[],'files':set(),'score':0})
    for h in hits:
        cls=h.get('class_context') or h.get('symbol') or ''
        evidence=' '.join(str(h.get(k) or '') for k in ('class_context','symbol','evidence','function_signature','file'))
        if not ITEM_NAME.search(evidence): continue
        if NOT_ITEM.search(cls) or NOT_ITEM.search(h.get('file','')):
            classification='likely_ui_recipe_or_build_noise'
        elif re.search(r'itemdefinition|itemdata|iteminfo|itemconfig|itemtable|itemdatabase|itemcatalog', cls, re.I):
            classification='possible_item_definition'
        elif re.search(r'inventory|itemslot|itemstack|container|loot|pickup', cls, re.I):
            classification='inventory_or_item_flow'
        else:
            classification='item_related_unclassified'
        key=(cls,classification)
        g=groups[key];g['evidence'].append(h)
        if h.get('kind')=='Function candidate' and h.get('function_signature'):g['functions'].append(h['function_signature'])
        if h.get('kind')=='Property / data candidate' and h.get('symbol'):g['properties'].append(h['symbol'])
        if h.get('file'):g['files'].add(h['file'])
        g['score']=max(g['score'],int(h.get('score') or 0))
    result=[]
    for (cls,classification),g in groups.items():
        funcs=list(dict.fromkeys(g['functions']))
        can_add=any(re.search(r'add|give|grant|insert|create|pickup|spawn',f,re.I) for f in funcs)
        if classification=='possible_item_definition' and can_add: classification='item_definition_with_add_flow_signal'
        result.append({'class_or_symbol':cls,'classification':classification,'add_flow_signal':can_add,
          'evidence_count':len(g['evidence']),'function_candidates':funcs[:50],
          'property_candidates':list(dict.fromkeys(g['properties']))[:80],'source_files':sorted(g['files']),
          'max_static_score':g['score'],'validation_status':'unvalidated_static_candidate'})
    order={'item_definition_with_add_flow_signal':0,'possible_item_definition':1,'inventory_or_item_flow':2,'item_related_unclassified':3,'likely_ui_recipe_or_build_noise':4}
    return sorted(result,key=lambda x:(order.get(x['classification'],9),-x['evidence_count'],x['class_or_symbol'].lower()))
```

`unwind.py`:

```py
"""unwind.py - Aufrufkette aus dem Stack rekonstruieren, auch ohne Frame-Pointer.

Der Server-seitige RBP-Walk scheitert an Code ohne Frame-Pointer.  Hier wird der Stack ab RSP
gelesen und jeder Wert, der (a) in ausfuehrbarem Speicher liegt und (b) direkt hinter einem
CALL-Befehl steht, als Rueckkehradresse gewertet.  Das findet auch ueberschriebene/alte Rahmen
(Kandidaten), daher ist die Liste eine gute Naeherung, kein Beweis.
"""
import struct


def call_len_ending_at(code, end):
    """Laenge eines CALL-Befehls, der bei `end` (Index in code) endet, sonst 0.
    code: bytes, end: Index hinter dem Befehl."""
    if end >= 5 and code[end - 5] == 0xE8:
        return 5                                   # call rel32
    for n in range(2, 10):                         # call r/m64  (FF /2)
        s = end - n
        if s < 0:
            break
        i = s
        while i < end and (0x40 <= code[i] <= 0x4F or code[i] in (0x66, 0x67, 0x2E, 0x3E)):
            i += 1
        if i + 1 >= end or code[i] != 0xFF:
            continue
        modrm = code[i + 1]
        if (modrm >> 3) & 7 != 2:
            continue
        mod, rm = modrm >> 6, modrm & 7
        ln = i - s + 2
        sib_base = None
        if mod != 3 and rm == 4:
            if i + 2 >= end:
                continue
            ln += 1
            sib_base = code[i + 2] & 7
        if mod == 1:
            ln += 1
        elif mod == 2:
            ln += 4
        elif mod == 0 and (rm == 5 or sib_base == 5):
            ln += 4
        if ln == n:
            while s > 0 and 0x40 <= code[s - 1] <= 0x4F and n < 9:   # REX-Praefix (z.B. 41 FF D3)
                s, n = s - 1, n + 1
            return n
    return 0


def unwind(read, rsp, in_code, depth=0x800, max_frames=32, rip=None):
    """read(addr, n) -> bytes ; in_code(addr) -> bool.
    -> [{'slot','ret','call_len'}]  (aufsteigend nach Stack-Adresse)"""
    raw = read(rsp, depth)
    out = []
    for off in range(0, len(raw) - 7, 8):
        val = struct.unpack_from("<Q", raw, off)[0]
        if val < 0x10000 or not in_code(val):
            continue
        try:
            window = bytes(read(val - 10, 10))
        except Exception:
            continue
        n = call_len_ending_at(window, 10)
        if n:
            out.append({"slot": rsp + off, "ret": val, "call_len": n,
                        "callsite": val - n})
            if len(out) >= max_frames:
                break
    return out

```

`update_check.py`:

```py
"""update_check.py - Prueft, ob es eine neuere ReaperPy-Version gibt.  Laedt NIE etwas herunter und sendet keine Daten.

Es wird nur eine kleine JSON-Datei gelesen, deren Adresse du selbst in der Konfiguration einstellst ("update_url"):
    {"version": "5.8.0", "url": "https://.../download", "notes": "Was ist neu"}
Ohne "update_url" ist die Pruefung aus.  Nur https (http nur fuer localhost); Antwort hoechstens 64 KB.
"""
import json
import re
import urllib.parse
import urllib.request
from dataclasses import dataclass

MAX_BYTES = 65536
TIMEOUT = 6


def parse_version(v):
    """'v5.7.0-beta1' -> ((5, 7, 0), 0, 'beta1');  Release sortiert ueber Vorabversion gleicher Nummer."""
    m = re.match(r"^(\d+(?:\.\d+)*)(?:[-+](.+))?$", str(v).strip().lstrip("vV"))
    if not m:
        raise ValueError(f"keine Versionsnummer: {v!r}")
    nums = [int(x) for x in m.group(1).split(".")][:4]
    nums += [0] * (3 - len(nums))
    pre = m.group(2) or ""
    return tuple(nums), (0 if pre else 1), pre


def is_newer(remote, local):
    return parse_version(remote) > parse_version(local)


def _allowed_url(url, allow_local_http=True):
    u = urllib.parse.urlparse(str(url))
    if u.scheme == "https" and u.netloc:
        return True
    return allow_local_http and u.scheme == "http" and u.hostname in ("localhost", "127.0.0.1", "::1")


def fetch_json(url, timeout=TIMEOUT, opener=None):
    if not _allowed_url(url):
        raise ValueError("Update-Adresse muss mit https:// beginnen")
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={"User-Agent": "ReaperPy-update-check", "Accept": "application/json"})
    op = opener or urllib.request.build_opener()
    with op.open(req, timeout=timeout) as r:
        raw = r.read(MAX_BYTES + 1)
    if len(raw) > MAX_BYTES:
        raise ValueError("Antwort zu gross")
    data = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8"))
    if not isinstance(data, dict):
        raise ValueError("Antwort ist kein JSON-Objekt")
    return data


@dataclass
class Result:
    status: str = "off"          # off | uptodate | newer | error
    local: str = ""
    remote: str = ""
    url: str = ""
    notes: str = ""
    error: str = ""


def check(url, current, fetch=None):
    res = Result(local=str(current))
    if not url:
        return res
    try:
        data = (fetch or fetch_json)(url)
        res.remote = str(data["version"]).strip()
        dl = str(data.get("url", "")).strip()
        res.url = dl if dl and _allowed_url(dl, allow_local_http=False) else ""      # nur https-Links weitergeben
        res.notes = str(data.get("notes", ""))[:500]
        res.status = "newer" if is_newer(res.remote, current) else "uptodate"
    except (KeyError, ValueError, TypeError, OSError, json.JSONDecodeError) as e:
        res.status, res.error = "error", f"{e.__class__.__name__}: {e}"
    except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 - urllib wirft viele Arten (URLError, timeout, ssl)
        res.status, res.error = "error", f"{e.__class__.__name__}: {e}"
    return res

```
